programme.title: A Bridge Too Far
programme.desc: With an all-star cast that includes Sean Connery, Anthony Hopkins, Laurence Olivier, Gene Hackman and Robert Redford, this epic WW II drama recreates Operation Market Garden, an ambitious plan to hasten the end of WW II that ended in disaster.

programme.title: Hart's War
programme.desc: Bruce Willis stars as an imprisoned officer who refuses to give up his fight against the Nazis, even from behind enemy lines. With the help of a young lieutenant (Colin Farrell), he risks everything to free his men and change the outcome of the war!

programme.title: The Delta Force
programme.desc: Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage...and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

programme.title: Delta Force 2: The Colombian Connection
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is in peak form in this explosive action/adventure that brings back one of his most unforgettable characters, Delta Force Colonel Scott McCoy, for a daring mission to destroy a deadly drug cartel led by the ruthless Billy Drago!

programme.title: Murphy's Law
programme.desc: Charles Bronson stars as an LAPD cop framed for murder by Joan Freeman, a vicious ex-con he had put in prison. Going on the run and handcuffed to a foul-mouthed petty thief, he attempts to track down Freeman even as she keeps killing his associates.

programme.title: Assassination
programme.desc: Hard-hitting action, cross-country adventure and a government conspiracy that goes all the way to the top highlight this pulse-pounding political thriller in which Charles Bronson must protect the First Lady (Jill Ireland) from ruthless assassins.

programme.title: The Born Losers
programme.desc: When a vicious motorcycle gang launches an assault on a small town and a local girl (Elizabeth James), Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) goes on a one-man crusade to save the town and the girl! The first of the wildly successful Billy Jack feature films.

programme.title: Chrome And Hot Leather
programme.desc: Enraged when a biker gang kills his fiancée (Cheryl Ladd), a Green Beret (Tony Young) declares war and discovers that revenge is a dish best served...with a rocket launcher! Also stars William Smith, Marvin Gaye, Peter Brown and Michael Sterns.

programme.title: White Lightning
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds stars as a moonshiner who wages war against corrupt police officials in this action extravaganza full of epic car chases, bone-crunching brawls and terrific acting by a stellar cast that includes Ned Beatty, Diane Ladd and Bo Hopkins.

programme.title: Gator
programme.desc: The Feds want Gator McKlusky (Burt Reynolds) to go undercover to expose local crime boss and former boyhood pal, Bama McCall. When Gator discovers Bama is involved in extortion, prostitution, and murder, the suspense builds to an explosive climax!

programme.title: Malone
programme.desc: Ex-CIA agent (Burt Reynolds) has his quiet life disrupted when he stumbles onto a military conspiracy led by a rightwing zealot (Cliff Robertson).

programme.title: 52 Pick-Up
programme.desc: In this tense thriller, Roy Scheider has it all until a trio of pornographers shows up with a video of him in bed with his mistress. When he tries to pit one blackmailer against the other, the tension mounts - as does the possibility of murder.

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: An Army Major discovers a devious plot by a cabal of enemy leaders bent on political upheaval

programme.title: No Way Out
programme.desc: Kevin Costner and Gene Hackman star in this taut, political thriller that sees Costner, as Naval Commander Tom Farrell, on the hunt for a very real killer and a very unreal Russian mole, and all the clues lead back to himself. Sean Young co-stars.

programme.title: The Package
programme.desc: Gene Hackman and Tommy Lee Jones headline this explosive action-thriller about Green Beret (Hackman) who uncovers a terrifying military conspiracy when he is tasked with escorting a U.S. soldier (Jones) back to the States for a court martial.

programme.title: Rollerball (1975)
programme.desc: James Caan stars as a rollerball champ in this fast-hitting, action-packed glimpse into a dystopian future in the year 2018 where a brutal, no-holds-barred sport takes the place of war, and murder is just a part of the game! John Houseman co-stars.

programme.title: Futureworld
programme.desc: After the "Westworld" disaster, the Delos corporation is back, this time with "Futureworld!" But the resort might not be as safe as Delos claims...

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: Boot up for suspense and high-powered excitement with Jonny Lee Miller and Angelina Jolie when a group of hackers, the rebels of the information age, find themselves embroiled in a plot that could destroy the world's ecosystems...or their own lives.

programme.title: Anti-Trust
programme.desc: In this sizzling, fast-paced thriller, computer whiz Milo Hoffman (Ryan Phillippe) lands his dream job at a major computer company, only to learn that the C.E.O. (Tim Robbins) may employ some very unorthodox -- and very deadly --business practices.

programme.title: The Mod Squad
programme.desc: Three problem teens headed to jail...until a police captain offers them a deal to work for him and go undercover in the hip L.A. club scene.

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: Strap yourself in for one hilarious action-comedy starring Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton and Cate Blanchett! Convicts Joe (Willis) and Terry (Thornton) run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife (Blanchett).

programme.title: RoboCop
programme.desc: Classic sci-fi adventure about a cop...part man...part machine...the future of law enforcement.

programme.title: RoboCop (2014)
programme.desc: In 2028 Detroit, when Alex Murphy (Joel Kinnaman) -- a loving husband, father and good cop -- is critically injured in the line of duty, the multinational conglomerate OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.

programme.title: Bulletproof Monk
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat and Seann William Scott star in this heart-pumping action-adventure when a mysterious Tibetan monk, who has protected a powerful scroll for 60 years, believes he has found his successor in a pick-pocketing, streetwise punk.

programme.title: Pray For Death
programme.desc: A vicious gang forces Akira to shed his quiet persona and reveal his other identity...that of a skilled Ninja!

programme.title: Rage Of Honor
programme.desc: When his partner is killed during a drug bust, a federal agent throws away his badge and the rule book with it. Arming himself with an array of deadly weaponry including nunchucks and ninja stars, he sets out to settle the score with the bad guys.

programme.title: Dark Angel
programme.desc: Detective Jack Caine (Dolph Lundgren) thought he;d dealt with every kind of crime on earth, but someone "or something" is using human bodies to manufacture narcotics.

programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: A drug called "Fatal Beauty" has hit the streets of Los Angeles, and tough cop Rita Rizzoli is out to take down the drug lord responsible!

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: In this nail-biting action film, when an aging hitman (Charles Bronson) takes on an eager apprentice (Jan-Michael Vincent) they become an unmatchable team of killers...until the pupil's ruthlessness puts the two on a deadly collision course!

programme.title: Mr. Majestyk
programme.desc: Cinema tough guy Charles Bronson stars as Majestyk, an ex-con and Vietnam vet, whose efforts to run a farm are thwarted by narrow-minded locals and corrupt cops. But when a Mafia hitman destroys his crop, the farmer's fuse is finally blown.

programme.title: Breaker! Breaker!
programme.desc: Breaker! Breaker! stars Chuck Norris at his butt-kicking best as a trucker on a mission to locate his kidnapped brother and bring down a corrupt Judge (George Murdock) who may just have played a role in the disappearance.

programme.title: The Octagon
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

programme.title: Firewalker
programme.desc: Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

programme.title: Mindwarp, Part Three
programme.desc: (7/14) Kivs brain rejects his new body and Crozier is forced to rethink his plan.

programme.title: Mindwarp, Part Four
programme.desc: (8/14) Sil is appalled to realize Crozier has selected Peri to be the Kivs new host body.

programme.title: Terror of the Vervoids, Part One
programme.desc: (9/14) A series of murders leads the Doctor to suspect something strange is happening.

programme.title: Terror of the Vervoids, Part Two
programme.desc: (10/14) The Vervoids begin to attack the crew and passengers.

programme.title: Terror of the Vervoids, Part Three
programme.desc: (11/14) The Commadore loses command of his ship.

programme.title: Terror of the Vervoids, Part Four
programme.desc: (12/14) The Doctor realizes something about the Vervoids life span.

programme.title: The Ultimate Foe, Part One
programme.desc: (13/14) The Valeyards true identity is revealed and the trial aborted.

programme.title: The Ultimate Foe, Part Two
programme.desc: (14/14) Mel realizes that the Valeyard has created a weapon within the Matrix.

programme.title: Part One
programme.desc: The Doctor and Mel end up in South Wales along with an assassin and his intended victim...

programme.title: Part Two
programme.desc: Gavrok and the Bannermen have arrived on Earth, searching for Delta and slaughter the holidaymakers without compunction to draw her out.

programme.title: Part Three
programme.desc: As Billy and Ray do what they can to help save Delta, the Doctor faces Gavrok and his Bannermen one last time.

programme.title: Part One
programme.desc: (1/4) A newly regenerated Doctor is taken to the Rani's base by Urak the Tetrap.

programme.title: Part Two
programme.desc: (2/4) The Doctor attempts to learn the secret of the Loyhargil.

programme.title: Part Three
programme.desc: (3/4) The furious Rani begins to slaughter the Lakertyans, so Mel rallies the survivors.

programme.title: Part Four

programme.title: Part One
programme.desc: (1/4) Supposed to be the height of luxury, Paradise Towers is far from paradise.

programme.title: Part Two
programme.desc: (2/4) With the Doctor condemned to death, Mel faces cannibalistic OAPS.

programme.title: Part Three
programme.desc: (3/4) Mel and Pex play cat and mouse with the lethal cleaner robots.

programme.title: Part Four

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: On Iceworld, the Doctor and Mel meet Ace, who has found herself there after a timestorm.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Kane turns on his allies, as he cannot trust anyone in his search for the dragonfire...

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: In the archive, the Doctor discovers that Kane is from the dead world of Proamon.

programme.title: Part One
programme.desc: (1/4) In Shoreditch, 1963, the Doctors past begins to catch up with him.

programme.title: Part Two
programme.desc: (2/4) Renegade Daleks battle Imperial Daleks for control of the Hand of Omega.

programme.title: Part Three

programme.title: Part Four

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: (1/4) The Doctor and Ace meet other visitors to the Psychic Circus on Segonax.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: (2/4) Captain Cook goes to extreme measures to ensure he's not the next to face the odd family.

programme.title: Part 3

programme.title: Part 4

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: (1/3) Neo-Nazis are seeking the Nemesis Statue - as are Cybermen and Lady Peinforte.

programme.title: Part 2

programme.title: Part 3

programme.title: Part One

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: An aging ranch hand (James Whitmore), having refused property as reward for saving Trampas, later becomes a stable worker; guests Don Stroud, Douglas Kennedy.

programme.title: Lady From Wichita
programme.desc: Two Wichita saloonkeepers (Joan Collins, Rose Marie) inherit property and arrive intending to be proper members of society; guest Harry Lauter.

programme.title: Masquerade
programme.desc: Medicine Bow helps a timid banker convince his father, a retired Idaho sheriff Idaho, that he carries on the tradition.

programme.title: Bitter Autumn
programme.desc: A Texan's brother accidentally shoots a woman (Virginia Gregg) in Medicine Bow and becomes the target of her husband (John Anderson), a former marshal; guest Jeanette Nolan.

programme.title: Ah Sing vs. Wyoming
programme.desc: An alcoholic lawyer (Edmond O'Brien) is prodded into fighting prejudice and the bottle to defend a Chinese immigrant who has been denied his legal rights; guests Lloyd Bochner, Jill Donohue.

programme.title: A Bad Place to Die
programme.desc: The staff of Shiloh Ranch conducts a hurried investigation in an attempt to save Trampas, awaiting execution on a murder charge; guest Victor Jory.

programme.title: The Reckoning
programme.desc: The Virginian, Clay and Elizabeth go to buy cattle in a Texas border town, where outlaws snatch Elizabeth away to Mexico; guest Charles Bronson.

programme.title: The Gentle Tamers
programme.desc: Three convicts (Anthony Call, Darwin Joston, Don Pedro Colley) come to work at the Shiloh Ranch as part of an experimental parole program; guests Wesley Lau, James Griffith.

programme.title: Stacy
programme.desc: A buggy accident leaves Stacy's arm paralyzed, and he sinks into self-pity after an operation apparently fails and his girlfriend (Lee Kroeger) abandons him; guest John Bryant.

programme.title: Seth
programme.desc: While hunting for a steer-killing cougar, Trampas offers food and shelter to a half-starved boy (Michael Burns), who hesitates over accepting or remaining in the hills to rendezvous with an outlaw gang.

programme.title: The Fortress
programme.desc: A Canadian cattle buyer (Leslie Nielsen) who owns his own city pays the Virginian $100,0000 then has his henchmen rob the local bank, rendering the Virginian's bank draft worthless.

programme.title: With Help From Ulysses
programme.desc: A shaggy dog named Ulysses must help Trampas decide which of two saloon girls (Barbara Rhoades, Jill Donohue) is really the niece of a dying prospector (J. Pat O'Malley); guests Hugh Beaumont, June Vincent.

programme.title: Johnny Moon
programme.desc: An injured Canadian Mountie (Tom Bell) refuses to give up his pursuit of a wanted man (Ben Johnson), although out of his jurisdiction into Wyoming; guest Bo Hopkins.

programme.title: Barren Ground
programme.desc: The Virginian faces mixed reactions from the father (Jay C. Flippen), sister (Collin Wilcox) and vengeful brother (Bryon Mabe) of a young outlaw he was forced to kill in self-defense.

programme.title: The Crooked Path
programme.desc: After his father whips him publicly, a braggart comes to Shiloh.

programme.title: Execution at Triste
programme.desc: After a fortuneteller predicts death, Trampas and two other Shiloh hands face a gunslinger as they pass through a doomed town after delivering cattle to an Army base; guests Robert Lansing, Sharon Farrell.

programme.title: Death Wagon
programme.desc: An outlaw dealing with scarlet fever forces captured Holly and Elizabeth to help him evade his Army escorts.

programme.title: Jed
programme.desc: An itinerant gunslinger (Steve Ihnat) hires on with a rancher who aims to begin a range war over two homesteaders, then goes to work as a spy among the opposing forces at Shiloh; guest Brenda Scott.

programme.title: Handy Man
programme.desc: A rancher (Tom Simcox) halts his feud with Shiloh when he mistakes a drifter (Mel Tormé) for a gunslinger.

programme.title: Good-Hearted Badman
programme.desc: Elizabeth and Holly care for a wounded outlaw (Peter Duel), who faces a dilemma when his recovery means either being turned over to the authorities or facing a pursuing bounty hunter; guest Anthony Zerbe.

programme.title: The Decision
programme.desc: At his wife's insistence, a lawman (Kenneth Tobey) gives up his badge then discovers that his replacement (Steve Carlson) is just not up to the job; guests Ben Murphy, Lawrence Dane.

programme.title: Stopover
programme.desc: The moment he steps from the stagecoach, a gunslinger (Herb Jeffries) has everyone wondering who he is after; guests Jay C. Flippen, John Kellogg, John McLiam.

programme.title: Eileen
programme.desc: Concerned about marriage plans, a father sends his daughter (Debbie Watson) to Shiloh for the summer, but her fiancé hires on incognito as a ranch hand.

programme.title: Storm Over Shiloh
programme.desc: Elizabeth is late returning from a ride for dinner and her horse returns alone, so the Graingers, The Virginian and Trampas head out into a storm to go looking for her.

programme.desc: Toby and Michelle investigate a string of high-tech thefts in Vancouver.

programme.desc: Toby and Michelle search for a dangerous gang while feeling the pressure of the new police superintendent.

programme.title: Early Checkout

programme.desc: Bull represents a priest who knows, but cannot reveal, the identity of a driver involved in a fatal hit-and-run accident.

programme.title: Separate Together

programme.title: A Shot in the Dark
programme.desc: When Cara Ryan shoots her ex-husband and accuses him of threatening to kill her, police question her motive.

programme.title: Devil's Bathtub
programme.desc: When a father goes missing and his body is found in a field several miles away, the investigation reveals multiple suspects -- including members of his own family.

programme.title: She Didn't Come Home
programme.desc: A mother in Pennsylvania disappears after co-workers see her leaving for lunch.

programme.title: Collision
programme.desc: The battle between a wife and a mistress for one man's heart leads to a deadly car chase.

programme.title: Justice for Nikki
programme.desc: When a young woman is found dead in a field on the outskirts of Green Bay, Wis., a fitness tracker helps detectives solve the mystery.

programme.title: Inside the Hunt for El Chapo
programme.desc: Former DEA agent Andrew Hogan details his search for Mexican drug lord Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán with never-before-seen videos and photographs.

programme.title: The Prussian Blue Mystery
programme.desc: When a San Diego woman who is near death arrives at an emergency room, the FBI and local law enforcement are called in to try to solve a medical mystery and a horrific crime.

programme.title: NBC Nightly News With Tom Llamas
programme.desc: Tom Llamas anchors the latest news, going beyond the headlines to see how lives are affected by the world around them.

programme.title: Today
programme.desc: News headlines, interviews, and stories intended to inform, entertain, inspire and set the agenda each morning for Americans and help viewers with their finances, health and well-being.

programme.title: Finding Venus
programme.desc: A mother of two mysteriously vanishes from her parents' Michigan home while going to check the mailbox, leaving her phone and identification behind; police declare her dead without discovering a body.

programme.title: 11 Minutes
programme.desc: The father of an Alabama teenager calls the police after he returns home to find his son had thrown a party, leaving the place trashed; 11 minutes after the deputy leaves the house, another 911 call is placed reporting a shooting at the residence.

programme.title: Unchecked Evil
programme.desc: A 21-year-old college senior is shot and killed in a public park just months before her graduation.

programme.title: At the Bottom of the Lake
programme.desc: A pilot flees following a plane crash, becomes a fugitive and lives a double life for decades.

programme.title: The Alamo
programme.desc: John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

programme.title: Red River
programme.desc: John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.

programme.title: Man From Del Rio
programme.desc: When a Mexican gunslinger (Anthony Quinn) rids a town of several notorious gunfighters, he is named the sheriff, but must win over the rest of the residents who are yet to warm to his hard-hitting ways. Katy Jurado and Peter Whitney co-star.

programme.title: Gun The Man Down
programme.desc: When an outlaw is shot during a heist and left for dead by his partners - who take his money and his woman - he sets out to track them down. And when he catches up with them, he'll have to rely on his wits...as much as the loaded gun in his holster!

programme.title: Terror In A Texas Town
programme.desc: In this compelling and imaginative western, a peace-loving Swedish seaman is forced to take on an entire frontier town when he discovers a ruthless oil prospector has been forcing farmers to sell their land...or pay for it with their lives.

programme.title: Man With The Gun
programme.desc: As a gang of brutal gunmen forcefully gain control of Sheridan City, its terrified citizens hire the notorious "town-tamer" Clint Tollinger to help them. But Tollinger operates in his own way...so things could get a lot worse before they get better!

programme.title: The Wonderful Country
programme.desc: In this action-packed western, ex-pat Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) travels to Texas to broker an arms deal for Mexican Governor Castro (Pedro Armendariz). But things get complicated when the the guns he was returning to Mexico are stolen.

programme.title: Young Billy Young
programme.desc: In this gun-slinging adventure, an aging lawman (Robert Mitchum) teams up with Young Billy Young (Robert Walker), a fast-draw outlaw on the run. But it's an alliance that explodes when the lawman discovers a secret that could rip two towns apart!

programme.title: Sam Whiskey
programme.desc: Welcome to America's Wild - and very wacky - West! Burt Reynolds, Clint Walker, Ossie Davis and Angie Dickinson star in this tongue-in-cheek tale of love, lust and larceny as an amiable con-artist is hire by a sexy widow to break into the U.S. Mint.

programme.title: The Scalphunters
programme.desc: Sydney Pollack directs Burt Lancaster, Shelley Winters, Ossie Davis and Telly Savalas in this lively and ribald western about a frontier-wise fur trapper who loses his pelts to a band of Kiowas in exchange for a slave he doesn't want.

programme.title: Valdez Is Coming
programme.desc: In this rousing Western, when a greedy rancher causes the death of an innocent man, former sheriff Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) orders him to provide financial support for the widow. But when he refuses, Valdez vows to exact justice at any cost!

programme.title: Lawman
programme.desc: In Michael Winner's unique take on the western, a sheriff (Burt Lancaster) is determined to bring to justice a rancher (Lee J. Cobb) and his hands who accidentally killed an old man during a drunken spree. Robert Ryan and Robert Duvall co-star.

programme.title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
programme.desc: Buffalo Bill has fought Indians & Civil War battles, but nothing can prepare him for show business! When he signs Sitting Bull for a role in his Wild West Show, the clash of cultures reverberates far beyond the boundaries of their sprawling theater.

programme.title: Cattle Annie And Little Britches
programme.desc: Burt Lancaster, Amanda Plummer and Diane Lane star in this offbeat western about two aspiring outlaws who join what's left of the Doolin-Dalton gang.

programme.title: Ned Kelly
programme.desc: Mick Jagger makes his dynamic screen debut in this explosive tale based on the true-life story of the 19th-century Australian "Armored Bandit," who would become a mythic sagebrush hero even as the law closes in and prepares for an all-out war.

programme.title: Michael Cimino's Heaven's Gate
programme.desc: This lavish, epic western retells the true story of Wyoming's infamous Johnson County War, a brutal, late 19th century conflict during which wealthy cattlemen, backed by the U.S. government, hired mercenaries to murder 125 immigrant settlers.

programme.title: Five Guns West
programme.desc: Five Civil War outlaws must brave hostile Comanche territory - and a cunning woman - to hijack a stagecoach carrying a traitor...and $30,000 in gold!

programme.title: Southwest Passage
programme.desc: Rod Cameron plays a Western explorer with a unique scheme--to open a new desert route by using camels as pack animals. His trek is imperiled by a phony law-avoiding doctor (John Ireland) and his woman (Joanne Dru), a search for water and attacking Indians.

programme.title: Robbers' Roost
programme.desc: Zane Grey Western of outlaw gangs fighting for control of ranchland.

programme.title: Vera Cruz
programme.desc: In this epic Western, two shady mercenaries (Gary Cooper, Burt Lancaster) in Mexico during the 1866 revolution are hired to escort a Countess and her gold to the Mexican army in Vera Cruz and find themselves at odds with the army... and each other!

programme.title: Along Came Jones
programme.desc: Gary Cooper gives a marvelous, tongue-in-cheek performance as a fumble-fingered cowpoke who is mistaken for a notorious bandit and almost gets killed by both sides of the law...all while managing to capture the attention of Loretta Young.

programme.title: Man Of The West
programme.desc: Screen legend Gary Cooper demonstrates why he will always be remembered as one of the most authentic stars of the screen. Capable yet vulnerable, Cooper's portrayal of a former outlaw whose past returns to haunt him ranks among his very best.

programme.title: Alias Jesse James
programme.desc: In this hilarious western spoof, insurance broker Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) unwittingly sells a life insurance policy worth $100,000 to the infamous Jesse James. Now, he has to figure out how to keep the deadliest outlaw in history alive!

programme.title: ¡Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that's a fiesta of fun.

programme.title: Invitation To A Gunfighter
programme.desc: Screen legend Yul Brynner turns in a magnificent performance as a gunfighter who must do battle with his most formidable adversary - his own conscience - in this gripping, double-barreled western full of surprise twists and colorful villainy.

programme.title: Return Of The Seven
programme.desc: Starring Yul Brynner and a stellar supporting cast that includes Robert Fuller, Warren Oates and Claude Akins, this classic western adventure follows the legendary Magnificent Seven as they thunder through Mexico to face the shootout of their lives!

programme.title: Guns Of The Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: In this thrilling follow-up to one of the greatest Western sagas in film history, notorious desperado Chris Adams (George Kennedy) is offered a huge reward to free a young Mexican revolutionary from prison...in the midst of the Mexican Revolution.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven Ride!
programme.desc: When his wife is killed, Marshal Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) discovers that a ruthless horde of marauders have killed all the men -- and will come back for the women -- in a nearby border town...unless The Magnificent Seven can stop them!

programme.title: Comes A Horseman
programme.desc: Set in the American West of the 1940s, a pair of little-guy ranchers join forces against the depredations of a ruthless land baron determined to expand his empire at whatever cost. Starring Jane Fonda, James Caan, and Jason Robards.

programme.title: The Claim
programme.desc: Twenty years after an unforgivable act, a pioneer has amassed immense wealth and a thriving mining town. But the blind ambition and greed that drove him to succeed finally catch up to him with the unexpected arrival of three apparent strangers.

programme.title: Day Of The Outlaw
programme.desc: In this stark, unconventional and powerful western, a ruthless rancher (Robert Ryan) must find a way to save the town of Bitters, Wyoming, its citizenry, and his own soul when a gang of outlaws rides into town. Burl Ives and Tina Louise also star.

programme.title: Man From Del Rio
programme.desc: When a Mexican gunslinger (Anthony Quinn) rids a town of several notorious gunfighters, he is named the sheriff, but must win over the rest of the residents who are yet to warm to his hard-hitting ways. Katy Jurado and Peter Whitney co-star.

programme.title: The Kentuckian
programme.desc: Eli Wakefield (Burt Lancaster) and his son are Kentucky adventurers longing for life on the Texas frontier. They learn, however, that their greatest challenge lies not in the uncharted wilderness, but in the people they meet along the way.

programme.title: John Sturges' The Hallelujah Trail
programme.desc: Chaos reigns on the wide open plains as Burt Lancaster and Lee Remick let loose in this comedy that spoofs nearly every convention of movie westerns.

programme.title: The Unforgiven
programme.desc: John Huston directs Audrey Hepburn in this thrilling, romantic western about a woman who becomes the target of lawless racism and brutality when it is discovered that she was born to the Kiowa tribe but secretly adopted by a white frontier family.

programme.title: Dances With Wolves
programme.desc: Kevin Costner, Mary McDonnell and Graham Greene star is this masterpiece that took home 7 Academy Awards, including Best Picture. Sent to protect a U.S. outpost, Lt. John Dunbar (Costner) befriends those he was taught to fear, the Sioux Nation.

programme.title: Wild Thanksgiving
programme.desc: In the final qualifying round, three teams have to showcase how two animals that don't ordinarily get along can celebrate Thanksgiving together in the animal kingdom.

programme.title: The Ultimate Snowball Fight
programme.desc: With the qualifying rounds complete, six teams of masterful cake and sugar artists face off in a challenge to imagine the perfect way to win the ultimate snowball fight.

programme.title: Intergalactic Holidays
programme.desc: The five remaining teams of cake and sugar artists are challenged to imagine friendly aliens celebrating their own holidays on another planet; at the end of the face-off, the field of competition narrows with one team's elimination.

programme.title: Holiday Sing-Along
programme.desc: The four remaining teams of master cake and sugar artists are challenged to bring the story of a carol to life using their imagination, with cake.

programme.title: Merry Grinchmas!
programme.desc: In the penultimate battle, three teams of master cake and sugar artists bring Dr. Seuss' iconic "How the Grinch Stole Christmas" to life by re-imagining the world-famous story as a big-screen epic in a whole new movie genre.

programme.title: Santa's New Ride
programme.desc: With $25,000 and the title of Holiday Wars Champion at stake, the last two teams of cake and sugar artists must showcase the wildest, most powerful, modernization imaginable for Santa's new ride.

programme.title: Champion Cake Off
programme.desc: The reigning champions of "Halloween Wars" and "Holiday Wars" face off in a New Year's themed battle involving team mascots and champagne-inspired cakes; the winning team gets a trip to New York City for the biggest New Year's party in the world.

programme.title: Platform 9 3/4
programme.desc: The bakers create an edible 2-foot-tall showpiece with a magical effect.

programme.title: Gringotts Wizarding Bank
programme.desc: The teams are in Gringotts Wizarding Bank, where James and Oliver Phelps ask the bakers to create 3-foot showpieces inspired by the bank's main hall, tunnels and vaults.

programme.title: Diagon Alley
programme.desc: In a salute to the famed shops of Diagon Alley, hosts James and Oliver Phelps challenge the bakers to make 50 handheld desserts to feed a crowd of Harry Potter fans, who vote on a winner; judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef decide which team must go.

programme.title: The Forbidden Forest
programme.desc: James and Oliver Phelps host as pairs of professional bakers create edible showpieces on the actual Harry Potter film sets; guest actors from the films share behind the scenes experiences as they join judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef.

programme.title: Dumbledore's Office
programme.desc: James and Oliver Phelps ask bakers to create a four-foot-tall showpiece inspired by Albus Dumbledore's office items; Harry Potter alumna Bonnie Wright joins judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef to decide which teams advance to the final showdown.

programme.title: The Great Hall
programme.desc: Creating a showpiece that reaches at least 6 feet tall and commemorates at least one event that takes place in the Great Hall; the bakers must also include two culinary effects and incorporate at least two tasting elements; surprise guests arrive.

programme.title: The House Duels
programme.desc: James and Oliver Phelps assign eight pairs of pastry wizards into the four Hogwarts Houses and ask them to create a showpiece with at least one tasting element; Judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef decide which bakers move on to the next challenge.

programme.title: Wizard's Journey
programme.desc: In front of the Knight Bus, James and Oliver Phelps ask the remaining six teams to make transportation-inspired showpieces that incorporate classic English desserts; guest Devon Murray joins Judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef.

programme.title: The Edible Artifacts
programme.desc: Inspired by Polyjuice Potion, James and Oliver Phelps challenge the five remaining teams to recreate two items as hyperrealistic edible showpieces; judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef decide which team made the most convincing and delicious artifact.

programme.title: Up to No Good
programme.desc: Hosts James and Oliver Phelps challenge the baking teams to create supersized "Harry Potter" artifacts that reveal something from within; special guest Afshan Azad joins judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef.

programme.title: Magical Beasts, Beings, and Creatures
programme.desc: James and Oliver Phelps ask the remaining four baking teams to create showpieces that bring a Harry Potter creature to life, along with a bold smoky or spicy tasting element; special guest Warwick Davis joins judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef.

programme.title: The Goblet of Fire
programme.desc: For the finale in the Great Hall, James and Oliver Phelps ask the bakers to create showpieces celebrating the Goblet of Fire; guest judges Warwick Davis, Afshan Azad and Devon Murray join Carla Hall to award the Wizards of Baking trophy.

programme.title: Elf's Downhill Derby
programme.desc: Jeff Mauro welcomes three teams to the first qualifying round; the talented cake and sugar artists must create a derby car fit for Santa's elves; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide who will move on and who heads home for the holidays.

programme.title: Hanging with Old St. Nick
programme.desc: Three new teams face off in the second qualifying round as Jeff Mauro challenges them to imagine how Santa spends time with his BFF; Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira send two more teams to the main competition and one group goes dashing home.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Turkey Trot
programme.desc: In the final qualifier, Jeff Mauro tasks three new teams with crafting a turkey and rider to race in the first annual Turkey Trot; Judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide whose Thanksgiving creations will move on and whose will not.

programme.title: Reindeer's New Hobby
programme.desc: The six remaining teams face off as Jeff challenges them to envision a hobby for Santa's reindeer to enjoy when they aren't pulling the sleigh; Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira judge the designs before flying one team home.

programme.title: Ugly Sweater Party
programme.desc: Jeff Mauro challenges the five remaining teams to create a woodland creature that is throwing an ugly sweater party for all its forest friends; at the end of the festive fiesta, judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira eliminate one more team.

programme.title: Time Travelin Santa
programme.desc: Jeff Mauro and the Holiday Wars time machine send the remaining four teams back in time; each group must create a Santa from a specific period in history; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide who will move forward.

programme.title: A Very Peanuts Christmas Tree
programme.desc: Jeff Mauro invites the remaining teams to create a Christmas tree featuring Charles Schulz's beloved Peanuts characters; two teams will face off in the finale for a trip to Iceland.

programme.title: North Pole Talent Show
programme.desc: Santa throws a North Pole talent show and the final two teams showcase the secret talents of the town's brave residents; Jeff Mauro, Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira crown the champion.

programme.title: They're Called 'Classics' for a Reason
programme.desc: Chefs put their spin on Thanksgiving dinner; in the first round, they reinvent a classic side; they are asked to make an entire turkey dinner in just one hour and incorporate an ingredient from the very first Thanksgiving.

programme.title: Pies and a Leftovers Surprise
programme.desc: The four remaining chefs take Thanksgiving classics to new heights; in round one, the chefs turn sweet pies into a holiday side; the winner receives a huge advantage in round two during which the chefs take on everyone's leftovers.

programme.title: A Feast to Remember
programme.desc: The remaining three chefs are pushed to the limits of their creativity; in the first round, crucial kitchen equipment is off limits for competitors; in the final round, the last two chefs must make a full Thanksgiving meal in just three hours.

programme.title: Bang for Your Buck
programme.desc: Six of America's best chefs begin their journey to being crowned the Ultimate Thanksgiving Challenge Champion; host Giada De Laurentiis sets up their first challenge: transforming a low-cost item into an extraordinary Thanksgiving appetizer.

programme.title: Untraditional Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Giada asks the five competing chefs to put a Thanksgiving spin on a classic dish; the winner receives an advantage point.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Week
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis challenges the four remaining chefs to embrace Thanksgiving week by creating their version of Friendsgiving dinner; the chefs are also paired up to compete as a team using a nontraditional Thanksgiving protein.

programme.title: $25,000 Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis challenges the three final chefs to make a dish that represents the person they're most thankful for, and they each have to incorporate a different type of squash.

programme.title: 'Tis the Season Open House
programme.desc: Autumn-inspired food, including chai chocolate truffles, white velvet soup, spicy cocktail puffs and jam cocktails.

programme.title: Classic Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Holiday dishes with a modern spin, including pumpkin Alfredo lasagna rolls, crispy truffled turkey and caramelized apple semifreddo cake.

programme.title: Friendsgiving Party
programme.desc: A cocktail-style Thanksgiving celebration with appetizer-sized versions of beloved holiday dishes, like stuffing arancini, turkey Waldorf bites, charred Brussels sprout crostini and a mulled cosmo cocktail.

programme.title: Santa's Grab Bag
programme.desc: Roasted fennel with Parmesan; creamy lobster pasta; chocolate almond cheesecake; citrus berry vermouth spritz.

programme.title: Holiday Desserts
programme.desc: Indulgent desserts and sparkling cocktails, including orange mousse with ginger snap crumble, peppermint patty sandwich cookies, hazelnut torte with chocolate espresso frosting and lemon hazelnut spritz cocktails.

programme.title: Kids' Gingerbread House Party
programme.desc: Giada treats her daughter Jade and friends to a party, where each guest makes their own gingerbread house; kid-friendly treats like s'mores popcorn, pizza grilled cheese, veggie forest with Parmesan ranch dip and frozen hot chocolate affogatos.

programme.title: Christmas at Giada's
programme.desc: Giada hosts a Christmas dinner for family and friends; on the menu, tortellini in Parmesan brodo, risotto with clams, braised lamb shanks with escarole and radicchio and a chocolate candy cane tower.

programme.title: Halloween Open House
programme.desc: Giada hosts a Halloween open house for neighborhood trick-or-treaters and their parents; Giada creates a spooky menu for her guests which includes Coconut Bones, Spooky Chicken Finger Sammies, Witches' Brooms and Here's Looking at Boo Treats.

programme.title: Happy Hour
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis hosts a fancy, vintage-inspired cocktail party and serves throwback recipes with a modern twist like bacon onion dip, a spiked gelatin mold and a Korean shrimp cocktail.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Feast
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis asks her Thanksgiving guests to each bring something to add to a large antipasti platter; spicy turkey breast cacciatore; smoky candied carrots and walnut gremolata; simple wilted greens; chocolate chunk hazelnut pie.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Brunch
programme.desc: The morning after Thanksgiving, Giada De Laurentiis feeds her guests with a brunch made from Thanksgiving leftovers; crispy turkey bites; cheesy root vegetable bake; sweet potato puffs; rye-spiked chai lattes.

programme.title: Christmas Sing-Along
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis throws a pre-Christmas party for the kids; holiday sing-along; cheesy chicken flautas; veggie voodle salad; chocolate-covered chips; apple pie soda à la mode.

programme.title: Christmas Dinner at Giada's
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis' family members exchange Secret Santa gifts; stuffed tricolore pork loin; roasted acorn squash agrodolce; chopped romaine and radicchio salad; black and white brownie ice cream cake.

programme.title: Chicken and Pie Party
programme.desc: One of Trisha Yearwood's favorite spots in Nashville is The Loveless Cafe; she spends the day putting a spin on her favorite dishes from the restaurant with recipes like cheesy angel biscuits and cornbread crusted fried pork chops.

programme.title: Giada's Turkey Day Feast
programme.desc: Giada has a step-by-step approach for planning and executing Thanksgiving; lemon and pea Alfredo; sweet and savory kale salad; prosciutto-wrapped turkey; for dessert, mascarpone cannoli cheesecake.

programme.title: That's a Wrap! Party
programme.desc: It's the day after Thanksgiving, and that usually means three things: college football, Christmas shopping and Thanksgiving leftovers; Giada marks the official start of the Christmas season with wrapping gifts and delicious food.

programme.title: Christmas Cocktails
programme.desc: A Christmas cocktail party and silly Santa gift exchange; holiday appetizers and favorite karaoke tunes; spinach artichoke panini bites; warm citrus marinated olives; chocolate coconut cake and burnt citrus cocktails.

programme.title: Santa's Cookies
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis and her daughter Jade host a Christmas party for Jade and her friends; Giada prepares a batch of holiday cutout sugar cookies that the kids can decorate using a variety of fun toppings and frosting.

programme.title: Night Before Christmas Party
programme.desc: In Italy, the night before Christmas is celebrated with the Feast of the Seven Fishes, and Giada De Laurentiis hosts a family Christmas Eve dinner that honors this tradition.

programme.title: Holiday Kick-Off Brunch
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis kicks off the season with a buffet brunch that features the flavors of autumn; bacon cranberry scones with citrus basil butter; sweet potato; kale Spanish frittata; smoked salmon waffles with waffle bar; apple raspberry sangrias.

programme.title: Giada's Italian Thanksgiving
programme.desc: A look back at some great game day and tailgating recipes; jalapeno-stuffed curly dogs, buffalo pierogies, baked chicken tenders with cheese cracker breading and no-bake rocky road bars.

programme.title: Small Bites Pot-Luck Party
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis hosts an open house and makes a variety of Italian-themed appetizers; goat cheese-stuffed baby peppers; crispy chicken meatballs; shrimp fra diavolo bites; chocolate Christmas tree brownies; a whiskey spritz cocktail.

programme.title: Name That Holiday Tune Party
programme.desc: Giada hosts a party where guests are asked to come dressed as their favorite holiday song; guests enjoy Giada's festive menu that includes a mozzarella bar, chicken piccata skewers, slow-roasted mustard salmon and a Sparkling Cosmo Punch.

programme.title: Winter Wonderland Party
programme.desc: Giada hosts a holiday party for kids and transforms the house into a winter wonderland; guests get to make their own snow globes and enjoy a menu of creamy tomato soup, triple chocolate hot cocoa, crispy chicken sandwiches and Italian flag cookies.

programme.title: Family Christmas Dinner
programme.desc: Giada hosts family Christmas dinner and pulls out all the stops with a fun gift exchange and an elegant menu; she makes a simple standing rib roast, Blistered Baby Pepper Salad, cavatelli with Gorgonzola and tomatoes and a panettone trifle.

programme.title: Giada's Fall Festival
programme.desc: Giada hosts a harvest-themed festival for her neighbors; the feast includes roasted squash and Gorgonzola pizza, made with Giada's own pizza dough, complemented with Italian carrot salad and spiced apple cake.

programme.title: Friends Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Giada asks each family member to invite a friend and provides a personalized welcome message, the guests enjoy a menu of braised turkey braciole, bacon stuffing with radicchio and chestnuts, Brussels sprouts agrodolce and Parmesan Apple Pie.

programme.title: Thankful for You
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis and her daughter, Jade, host a holiday party for friends; Jade helps prepare the menu, prep for the party and plan the activity of making homemade Christmas gifts for a teacher; the menu is a gourmet twist on kid favorites.

programme.title: Giada's Holiday Challenge
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis invites her cousins to bring an appetizer over for a Christmas party, and surprise guest Aunt Raffy judges which is the best; after the highly competitive game, Giada and her guests dine on a festive buffet-style meal.

programme.title: Giada and Raffy's Miracle
programme.desc: Giada is on a mission to recreate a family holiday recipe called miracle rice with her Aunt Raffy; the dish reflects generations of stories and memories; they also create a simple sorbet before ending the night with a grab-bag gift exchange.

programme.title: Italian Christmas Brunch
programme.desc: Giada hosts a formal brunch for her family on Christmas day, with a California twist; her menu includes beef tenderloin with scallion salsa verde, a crab and artichoke frittata, olive biscuits and a decadent chocolate panettone sformato for dessert.

programme.title: Live Well Party
programme.desc: Giada helps her girlfriends jump-start the new year with a fun gathering that focuses on wellness and self-care; she serves a buffet menu of her healthy wedge salad, broiled salmon with fennel salad, and herb de Provence roasted potatoes.

programme.title: Christmas Family Fun
programme.desc: Bakers craft two different decorated Christmas tree cookies; in the display challenge, bakers must create a giant cookie puzzle based on a Christmas carol.

programme.title: Traditions Turned Trendy
programme.desc: Cookie makers hack classic cookie cutter shapes and decorate them with totally wild new designs; bakers build an entire Christmas tree out of cookies.

programme.title: Santa's Sweet Spot
programme.desc: For the display round and with $10,000 on the line, the remaining cookie makers must bring a winter wonderland scene to life using cookies to create a 3D tableau.

programme.title: Cookie Pairings
programme.desc: Cookie mug toppers and decadent cookie dunkers; in the display round, the final three prepare an entirely edible cookie platter, complete with edible shot glasses.

programme.title: Christmas Gifts
programme.desc: Making decorated cookie toys in the first round; in the display round, cookie masters make entirely edible cookie boxes to fill with Christmas cookies.

programme.title: Spice Up Your Christmas
programme.desc: Putting wintry Christmas window views on a cookie; in the display round, the remaining cookie masters represent their favorite Christmas Eve tradition in 3D cookie form.

programme.title: Crafty Christmas
programme.desc: Five clever cookie makers must create custom Santas without cookie cutters.

programme.title: Christmas Vacation
programme.desc: Five cookie makers enter the workshop to find host Eddie Jackson lounging in a beach chair under a palm tree; the bakers are challenged to create cookies perfect for a Christmas in the tropics.

programme.title: Christmas Surprises
programme.desc: Eddie Jackson mistakenly grabs his box of Halloween cookie cutters from the attic; five cookie makers must hack the Halloween cutters into classic Christmas cookies.

programme.title: Some Assembly Required Christmas
programme.desc: Five of America's best cookie makers create two cookies on sticks: one representing the best part of Christmas for kids and another showing the best part for grown-ups; judges Ree Drummond, Dan Langan and Aarti Sequeira weigh in.

programme.title: Modern Classics
programme.desc: For the decorating challenge, five of the cleverest cookie makers design two different cookies: one showcasing Santa's new outfit and another featuring his new ride; Vivian Chan, Ree Drummond and Gesine Prado judge.

programme.title: Christmas Comes in All Sizes
programme.desc: Five of America's finest cookie makers must use traditional nesting dolls as inspiration to make six cookies of the same design that get progressively smaller; Stephanie Boswell, Ree Drummond and Molly Yeh judge.

programme.title: Mr. and Mrs. Claus
programme.desc: Everyone knows how Santa Claus spends Christmas Eve, but for this decorating challenge, host Eddie Jackson asks five talented cookie makers to imagine what Christmas Eve looks like for Mrs. Claus.

programme.title: Colorful Christmas
programme.desc: Festive foodies have been lighting up social media with hip ombre hues; for the decorating challenge, host Eddie Jackson asks five trendy cookie makers to create cookies that feature at least four shades of a color.

programme.title: Homemade Holidays
programme.desc: Eddie Jackson cherishes homemade gifts that come from the heart, so he asks five of the top cookie makers to create cookies that look like handcrafted gifts; the bakers have to create complex cookie garlands.

programme.title: Center of the Season
programme.desc: Five talented cookie makers strive for the spotlight when Eddie Jackson presents the most difficult decorating challenge of all: the dreaded slice-and-bake.

programme.title: Merry Christmas Makeover
programme.desc: The competitors decorate cookies showing beloved characters from the North Pole getting fit while judges Matt Adlard, Ree Drummond and Brandi Milloy decide which cookie makers shape up and which ones ship out.

programme.title: Colors of Christmas
programme.desc: Five creative cookie makers are dreaming of a white Christmas as Eddie Jackson challenges them to decorate cookies using only detail, texture and relief.

programme.title: Picture-Perfect Christmas
programme.desc: Eddie Jackson invites five of America's finest cookie makers to take on the world of fine art by assembling spectacular cookie mosaics; the cookie masters have to arrange decorated cookies into a single image worthy of display in the Louvre Museum.

programme.title: Christmas Traditions
programme.desc: Five of the finest cookie makers around push the envelope when Eddie Jackson calls on them to craft creative Christmas cards out of cookies.

programme.title: Christmas Mischief
programme.desc: There's no hiding when Eddie Jackson tasks five of America's best cookie makers with creating Christmas character masks made of cookies.

programme.title: Bright Lights, Big Cookies
programme.desc: Eddie Jackson challenges five talented cookie makers to flex their skills with classic cookie cutters, using them to make dazzling designs that have nothing to do with the cutters' original shapes.

programme.title: Can You Crack This One?
programme.desc: Celebrating "piece" on Earth by making festive puzzle cookies; bakers are tasked with creating a 3D nutcracker doll out of cookies and incorporate walnuts, pecans or almonds into the product.

programme.title: Visions of Christmas
programme.desc: The five bakers use cookies to show off their vision of Christmas future; building baked and breakable gift displays to re-create the joy of unwrapping gifts on Christmas morning.

programme.title: Homespun Christmas
programme.desc: Five talented cookie makers are tasked with creating Christmas cross-stitch cookies; the crafting continues as the bakers combine the beauty of a wreath with the fun of a Christmas character in one massive, 3-D cookie display.

programme.title: Christmas Illusions
programme.desc: Five cookie makers make Christmas colors swirl by taking on the tie-dye cookie trend; they decorate cookies that look just like savory holiday appetizers, but they must use classic crudités ingredients in their cookie displays.

programme.title: Christmas Games and Music
programme.desc: Five cookie makers begin with mix-and-match Christmas character cookies; then the bakers must craft 3D cookie displays inspired by holiday music where they must incorporate ingredients from classic Christmas songs, like pears, figs and chestnuts.

programme.title: Christmas is Heating Up
programme.desc: Five cookie makers put their heart and soul into crafting cookies that celebrate Christmas weddings; the competition heats up as the cookie makers create 3D Christmas trees inspired by plants found deep in the dessert.

programme.title: Returning Champs
programme.desc: Five former champions return to the workshop for another round of competition; creating a Christmas village puzzle out of six perfectly interlocking cookies and crafting massive Christmas mantels with realistic fireplaces.

programme.title: Self-Portraits
programme.desc: Five cookie-makers re-create the feel of a cup of hot cocoa on a frosty Christmas morning by crafting holiday mugs out of cookies.

programme.title: Christmas Cookie Games
programme.desc: Five bakers flip the script on classic Christmas designs; the bakers make edible board games; incorporating boozy flavors into cookies.

programme.title: A Very Retro Christmas
programme.desc: Five top cookie makers create Christmas cookies that reflect decades past; crafting edible snow globes with 360-degree shine while drawing flavor inspiration from globe-shaped ingredients like blood oranges, golden berries and grapes.

programme.title: Christmas Chandeliers
programme.desc: Five cookie makers must take on the latest dessert trend and create cookies decorated to reveal surprises beneath the icing, then they have to defy gravity by building giant, hanging, cookie chandeliers worthy of the finest Christmas dinner table.

programme.title: Occasional Adult
programme.desc: In Virginia Beach, a young woman that aspires to be an FBI agent is brought in after trying to run her boyfriend over with her car; a male exotic dancer finds himself back in jail due to a previous DUI charge.

programme.title: Whipped Cream With a Felony on Top
programme.desc: In Modesto, a 21-year-old lands in jail for kicking a police officer; a man in Virginia Beach is brought in after robbing several gas stations; a former bail bondsman finds himself on the other side of the law.

programme.desc: Rachel tackles her first official guest bedroom makeover, where she finds her flow with a custom plant wall; when a layout snag changes her plans, she pivots to build an integrated headboard and a floating bed that lights up the desert night.

programme.title: Building Through Heartbreak and Healing
programme.desc: Rachel installs a glass door that connects the guest suite to the ranch's vast views; when tragedy strikes with the loss of her beloved bulldog, Rachel creates a special outdoor tribute and pushes on to finish the guest bedroom.

programme.title: Living With Leo
programme.desc: Rachel welcomes Leo the pig to the ranch, complete with a custom-built outdoor habitat; she is joined by her partner, Aaron, a fellow builder who helps her start to blend their lives and styles together with collaborative mini makeovers.

programme.title: Heights of the Evergreen State
programme.desc: Levi heads to Issaquah at Ananda, a modern sanctuary featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, overlooking the Raging River; next, he travels to Ashford to visit Treehouse Mt. Rainier, a rustic-elegant escape supported entirely by eight towering trees.

programme.title: Meadows and Modernism
programme.desc: Levi visits two retreats that celebrate open spaces and minimalist design; he starts at the Alto A-Frame, an elevated architectural gem nestled beside a creek; next, he tours the Timber Haus, a Scandinavian-inspired stay tucked in a field of florals.

programme.title: Tracks and Tranquility
programme.desc: Levi travels the countryside to see two historic railcars transformed into stationary sanctuaries; first, he arrives in Deary, Idaho, to step inside a restored 1909 carriage; next, Levi heads to Long Lane, Missouri, to tour a 1928 Luxury Railcar.

programme.title: Biblical Authors
programme.desc: The Bible is the most widely read book in the history of the world. But does anyone know who really wrote it? What are the facts behind this immortal manuscript? New scientific research and theological insight may provide new clues. What can the Dead Sea Scrolls tell us about the origins of the Bible? Discover how modern technology may finally unravel this age-old mystery.

programme.title: Biblical End Times
programme.desc: The Bible warns of cataclysmic disasters that will fulfill the End Time prophecy. Is it possible the ancients foresaw the wars, natural disasters and strife of the 21st Century? What about the prophecies of others from Nostradamus to Father Malachi O'Morgain? Are these warnings just stories from the ancient past or will we witness the End Times in our generation?

programme.title: The Shroud: Face to Face
programme.desc: Robert Orlando's documentary portrays Jesus' crucifixion as a transformative true crime story. It uses New Testament insights, expert interviews, and digital recreations to examine the Shroud of Turin. Bloodstains align with gospel accounts, suggesting authenticity. Orlando hopes to renew interest in Christian history.

programme.title: The Tomb of Jesus
programme.desc: The Real Discoveries team visit two tombs each believed to be the tombs where Jesus was laid to rest and later rose. However, Jesus could not have been laid and risen from both tombs. Is there any evidence to support the fact that either of these sites is the genuine one? Find out as we journey to discover the Tomb of Jesus!

programme.title: Third Day
programme.desc: On the third day after Jesus' crucifixion, eyewitnesses reported that they found an empty tomb and had an encounter with a living, breathing Jesus of Nazareth. What proof do we have that the resurrection really happened? This intriguing documentary digs deep into the biblical and historical accounts and explores these questions: Did the disciples steal the body?

programme.title: Prophecies of the Passion
programme.desc: Prophecies of the Passion is an extraordinary look at the Messianic prophecies fulfilled during the final week of Christ's life on earth. The Gospels clearly describe Jesus' betrayal, arrest, death, and resurrection. Remarkably, these events were foretold by Hebrew prophets-in specific detail... centuries before they actually occurred.

programme.title: John
programme.desc: John was called by Jesus from the shores of the Sea of Galilee to come and follow him. For 3 years he was one of the inner-band of disciples, witnessing the transfiguration. After the death of Jesus, he was first at the tomb to discover that Jesus had risen. He became leader of the church at Ephesus where he wrote the Gospel of John. In the mines of Patmos, he had a wonderful vision of God.

programme.title: Peter
programme.desc: The Galilean fishmonger, Peter, emerged as pre-eminent amongst the apostles. We look at his controversial life and career ending with his martyrdom in Rome and his place in laying the foundation of the Catholic Church.

programme.title: Tomb of Jesus: The Evidence
programme.desc: The Real Discoveries team visit two tombs each believed to be the tombs where Jesus was laid to rest and later rose. However, Jesus could not have been laid and risen from both tombs. Is there any evidence to support the fact that either of these sites is the genuine one? Find out as we journey to discover the Tomb of Jesus!

programme.title: Judas
programme.desc: Judas has been the symbol of evil and treachery but does he deserve this reputation? Why has he continued to fascinate writers, actors and artists? It is time to re-examine his role in the Jesus story and in the centuries that followed.

programme.title: Jesus' Silent Years: Where Was Jesus All Those Years?
programme.desc: The Bible is silent about Jesus' life from the ages of 2 to 12 and 13 to 30. Are these silent early years of Jesus really lost? The answers may surprise you!

programme.title: Jesus The Desire Of Ages
programme.desc: Jesus: The Desire of Ages tells the familiar story in a fresh way, through the eyes of those who knew and loved the Son of Man. An inspiring and triumphant music score combined with imaginative visual artistry will grip your heart as you experience the reality of Jesus' ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Charlton Heston Presents The Bible: Behind the Scenes
programme.desc: Never-before-seen documentary footage takes you on an amazing adventure behind the scenes, to see first-hand how this epic multi-national production was filmed on the very ground where it happened From the Creation to the Resurrection, Heston captures the passion of the Bible through the power of the spoken word, the way its mysteries and legends were originally passed down for generations.

programme.title: The Week That Changed The World
programme.desc: The resurrection happened. It's not just the belief of Christians, it's borne out by history, archaeology, and science. This documentary takes viewers step by step through the events of Holy Week-shedding light on the key players, unraveling the political intrigue, and answering long standing questions about what happened, and why. Professor of ancient history and world-renowned expert Dr. Paul L.

programme.title: Biblical Women
programme.desc: Who was Mary Magdalene? A fallen woman rescued by Jesus or was she Christ's beloved disciple. An investigation into the mystery surrounding her identity produces startling insights. What message did the Virgin Mary bring to Fatima and reveal in 1917? A prophecy from biblical times? Learn the surprising answer.

programme.title: Herod's Temple: The Temple Jesus Knew
programme.desc: Jerusalem, rich in historical and Biblical heritage, is the home of the Temple Mount, one of the world's most recognizable and visited sacred sites. Now, travel back in time to see it the way Jesus and his disciples did over 2,000 years ago. They knew it as Herod's Temple. We remember it as the Temple Jesus knew.

programme.title: The Passion
programme.desc: The tragedy and victory of the New Testament. Follow Jesus through the Last Supper, His betrayal by Judas in Gethsemane, His trial before Pilate and the crowds, His Crucifixion, and the joyful triumph of His Resurrection and Ascension. He is Risen.

programme.title: Path Of The Wind
programme.desc: As an ex-convict, Lee Ferguson's biggest desire is to leave his past behind and make a fresh start with Katie, his new love. But when Lee finds out Katie is a Christian, his pre-conceived ideas and her moral standards clash. Through engaging action and drama, this film explores temptation, sin, forgiveness and redemption, while helping seekers and believers understand one another!

programme.title: Mystery of the Shroud
programme.desc: In a tomb located in Jerusalem's Hell Valley, on land bought with Judas Iscariot's bloodstained silver, a sensational discovery was made. Vital information has been uncovered to paint a picture of what Jesus' grave would have looked like and what his burial process involved. One of the key moments in Christian history is made real and contemporary through this exciting archaeological discovery.

programme.title: I Believe In Easter

programme.title: The Last Hours of Jesus Christ
programme.desc: From his arrest to his resurrection, a lot of questions still surround the last hours of Jesus' life. Recent discoveries and eXperts' analysis shed some light on this enigma. Did Jesus really dies on the cross? Follow this investigation on one of History's biggest mysteries.

programme.title: The Final 24 Hours of Jesus' Life

Witness Jesus' temptation in the wilderness, the Sermon on the Mount, the healing of the blind and many miracles.
