programme.title: Dvalishvili vs Nurmagomedov
programme.desc: At UFC 311, Champion Merab Dvalishvili takes on title challenger Umar Nurmagomedov.

programme.title: 632 ci Big Block Chevy Build for Project Wild & Willys
programme.desc: A high-compression 632 ci Big Block Chevy provides massive power for XOR's Willys Wagon.

programme.title: Chevy Blazer Assembly/Interior
programme.desc: Klassy K5 returns from fresh paint for re-assembly, and interior goodies, plus the "dress-up" of our Ram 1 ton dually with mega-bumpers and headache rack

programme.title: Dirt Track Small Block
programme.desc: We team up with UNOH to build a brand-new engine for their racing program. A new car class with new engine rules makes for an educational build experience that pays off on the racetrack.

programme.title: Overtaker! It's a Hearse Full Build Resurrection
programme.desc: The Detroit Muscle team takes on a 1976 Cadillac Hearse, sending it as fast as it will go down the 1/8 mile drag strip.

programme.title: Compression Obsession: A Bigger Block
programme.desc: Our Small Block Chevy cracked during a cold snap. So we're going to take its guts, put them in a bigger 406ci block, and prep it for bigger power!

programme.title: Fuel Fiasco - Project UnSanctioned Part 3
programme.desc: The Carcass guys continue the build of their grassroots BMW race car. Addressing some problems with the factory fuel system that could hinder their performance on the track. Plus, they install vital components to get UnSanctioned fired up.

programme.title: Super Street 427ci SBC Part 1
programme.desc: We kick off a ground up build based around Summit's brand new, specially designed Small Block Chevy engine block. Featuring a large bore and stroke equaling 427ci, this robust platform will become the foundation for a high horsepower, pump gas, street dominator.

programme.title: Road Course Camaro Part 10 Custom Dash Panel
programme.desc: The guys show you how to create a custom steering column for your race car that won't break the bank. Plus, they will fabricate a custom dash to accept their new digital gauge cluster, and show you an easy way to wire your project.

programme.title: Ultimate 318 LA: Part 1
programme.desc: We pull a 318 LA straight from the junkyard and put it on the Dyno to see what this over 40-year-old Mopar can make. Then we tear into it to upgrade the parts holding it back on power and get it prepped to become a righteous street monster.

programme.title: Ultimate Ford 300 Turbo Build - Part 3
programme.desc: Our famous Turbocharged Ford 300 returns for Part 3 of our dream six-cylinder build. We finish it up, then watch the numbers stack up on the SuperFlow Dyno both naturally aspirated and when we put our Big Six under boost.

programme.title: Why This Can Am Baja Bug Conversion Is So Retro Rad
programme.desc: Baja Style bug gets a 80's retro style paint job to go along with a long travel suspension before the Carcass team takes this incredible combo to Dirty Turtle Offroad Park. This is Part 3 of 3 of the BajAwesome build.

programme.title: Style and Speed: Rebuilt Buick Regal Gbody Unleases on the Street
programme.desc: Street Regal gets an updated custom interior to complement it' custom paint and we take her out on the town putting it through the paces seeing what she is made of.

programme.title: OBS Pro Touring Chevy Heads to the C10 Nationals and Hits the Track
programme.desc: We add the final touches to our OBS Pro Touring Chevy C1500 and take it to the C10 Nationals where we put it to the test at the Nashville Superspeedway.

programme.title: Crushing It: Episode 4
programme.desc: Grab a backstage pass and get a glimpse of what it takes to produce a Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live event. Our team presents you with the stars of Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live, while hanging out with Demo Derby driver, Derick Anson, and visiting FMX driver, Cody Elkins, at his home in Oklahoma.

programme.title: From Classroom to Circle Track
programme.desc: As part of the Motorsports Team, students at UNOH build high-performance Stock and Modified dirt race cars. On Friday nights, they push them to their limits at Limaland Motorsports Park!

programme.title: Slammed '65 C10 Fleetside
programme.desc: The '65 C10 Fleetside gets a coilover conversion that will slam her to the ground!

programme.title: Dirty JL
programme.desc: We're on the trail! We are taking our Jeep JL to Burning Rock Off Road park, and the Hatfield McCoy Trail system in West Virginia to see just how dirty our Jeep can get!

programme.title: Prerunner Ranger's Final Hours
programme.desc: Our Ford PrerunnerRanger is in its final hours. The rear axle is going in its final location, and we're making a few aesthetic changes out front.

programme.title: Autocross Camaro is Gets a New Suspension and Aero Package to Grip the Pavement
programme.desc: A 25th anniversary Camaro transforms into an Autocross beast. New Power, new suspension, and an aero package allow this 30 year old car grip the pavement.

programme.title: Top 10 American Muscle Part 2
programme.desc: Have we missed any? Here is the conclusion of our top 10 American Muscle Cars. So much muscle, so little time to get to number one!

programme.title: Improved Handling For Our Camaro Race Car
programme.desc: The Carcass shop starts the suspension work on our '72 road course Camaro. We'll get the front subframe cleaned up and modified to accept our new high-performance parts.

programme.title: Building a Chevy 292 Inline Straight-Six
programme.desc: We build a hot rod 292 Chevy straight-six that puts power to the pavement for Truck Tech's 1965 C10.

programme.title: Reviving a High Mileage '69 Camaro
programme.desc: Destination "fun-town," Marc and Tommy are taking a '69 Chevy Camaro RS/SS to the next level! With performance, handling, and appearance upgrades, it's time to revive this ultra-cool muscle car giveaway ride.

programme.title: Installing a NASCAR Style Exhaust System on a Foxbody Mustang
programme.desc: Our Mustang Cobra Project Sydewinder gets its aggressive exhaust system and we work on Project Street Regal for larger rear tires.

programme.title: Junkyard Ford 445 FE Gets Modern EFI
programme.desc: Our 445 FE is back, a modern EFI system, along with a time-tested tunnel wedge intake made for drivability.

programme.title: Modding A Jeep Wrangler JK Into An Extreme Off-Road Weekend Warrior Part 1
programme.desc: The team ventures to the north Georgia mountains to pick up and test an '07 Jeep Wrangler JK, then we head to the Summit Racing store in search of parts to mod it for extreme off-road fun!

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 5 - New Chains
programme.desc: Prisoners love their chains, and Project Henchman is no different. On this episode of Detroit Muscle, the 1969 GTO gets a shiny new exterior look.

programme.title: Becoming Legendary: Road Burner Hits the Hot Wheels Legends Tour Part 7
programme.desc: Forget everything you think know about patina cars, because we are going to school you on how mother nature's handiwork, combined with some elbow grease, can create a masterpiece worthy of a Hot Wheel.

programme.title: Straight Six on Steroids: Boosting a Chevy 292 Inline Straight-Six
programme.desc: The straight-six engine gets a big horsepower boost with a custom-designed turbo setup.

programme.title: Artistry In Motion - Project UnSanctioned Part 5
programme.desc: Our 2001 BMW race car, Project Unsanctioned, heads to the paint booth to paint the roll cage. Then we'll head back into the shop for a stylistic wrap and some artistic freedom, before finally assembly and taking it to the track.

programme.title: G-Body Buck Regal Build, Checking Glass and Trim Off the List
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc give us some tips on painting trim and glass installation before our '85 Buick gets a new interior. Plus a Chevelle owner in need of a little rescuing.

programme.title: Freeing Clint Black's Flooded F-100
programme.desc: Eric and Joel unearth a piece of country music history as they kick off the new season with Clint Black's fabled 1960 Ford F-100 from the "Killing Time" video.

programme.title: '69 Road Runner Gets A Gen III Hemi Swap Part 2
programme.desc: Our '69 Road Runner, nicknamed Road Burner, gets a big bump in power when we perform a Gen III Hemi engine swap.

programme.title: Camaro vs Firebird vs Silverado on the Dyno and the Dragstrip : BBQ & Burnouts
programme.desc: Mike and Pat from Engine Power take their custom Pro Street Chevy II Nova on a local outing with several aftermarket suppliers and their rigs on a road trip starting at the PowerNation Tech Center for a chassis dyno session and then on to a local race track to see who gets bragging rights for the best and the fastest. Oh and long the way will stop at some amazing southern eateries to taste the local best.

programme.title: OBS 632 SS Part 8 Sport Truck Assemble/Crossing the Finish Line
programme.desc: The 632 OBS Chevy is in the final lap of completion. We'll finish up the interior with new seats and gauge cluster. Then we'll add one more detail to accentuate our exterior, before hitting the streets and the strip.

programme.title: A Tennessee Tom in King Arthur's Brake Factory
programme.desc: Learn how the major components of a brake system are manufactured as the guys go to England and tour the EBC Brakes facilities.

programme.title: Crushing It: Episode 6
programme.desc: The Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live team loves the exhilarating jumps and stunts during a show, but nothing beats the excitement we bring to those most important to us, the fans. Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live hits the road as Demo Derby visits kids at Victory Junction, a camp for children with serious or chronic medical conditions.

programme.title: Gauges, Wiring, and Welding Galore!
programme.desc: Eric and Chris dive deep into the mechanics of Project Leadfoot, our 1994 Ford F150, mapping out a whole new set of custom gauges, building bespoke bracing for a divorced transfer case, and wiring up everything to make sure that the 600 horsepower Ford V8 from Engine Power can sing its sweet sweet song.

programme.title: F350 Dually Work Truck Upgrades
programme.desc: We bring in a new Ford F350 Crew Cab Dually and make improvements that will make the truck more functional as a towing rig and all-around work truck for everyone here at PowerNation.

programme.title: 509ci W-Series Big Block Chevy Part 2
programme.desc: We continue the buildup of our 509ci W-Series engine as we get it ready to hit the engine dyno. We wrap up this vintage looking hot rod power plant with high flowing induction and throttle body EFI before we see how much power it makes in the dyno.

programme.title: New Chains
programme.desc: Prisoners love their chains, and Project Henchman is no different. On this episode of Detroit Muscle, the 1969 GTO gets a shiny new exterior look.

programme.title: Building a Dyno Test Sled from a Race Car Chassis
programme.desc: Using a custom-built Factory Five chassis, we're building a vehicle for in-depth, on-road engine testing.

programme.title: Scouring A Salvage Yard For The Perfect Project: A '69 Plymouth Road Runner
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc head out to salvage an old B-Body that has seen better days. Plus look for some hidden treasures in a automotive time capsule.

programme.title: '65 Chevy C10 Teardown
programme.desc: LT and Austin start the teardown process and make some upgrade decisions for Project Lo 'n Slo.

programme.title: Transforming the VW Bug From Cool to Bajawesome
programme.desc: The Carcass duo adds a custom fit roll cage, fabricated louvers out back, and a whole bunch of style points to this baja style bug. This is part 2 of 3 of the BajAwesome build.

programme.title: 1965 Chevy C10 292 Straight Six Turbo
programme.desc: This week we configure a turbo setup on our '65 C10's 292 straight six.

programme.title: Junkyard Ford 390 FE Gets Serious Power Upgrades
programme.desc: After some super dyno pulls on our supercharged 383, Mike and Pat try to bring back an old Ford 390 FE from the dead! What will it take to go from the junkyard to the dyno?

programme.title: Project Bullseye - Suspension Installation
programme.desc: With the paint dried, it's now time to bring our 1969 Dodge Dart one step closer to rolling! We dive deep into installing the suspension, front to back. We'll share tips that'll save your knuckles (and your sanity). We break down the process so you can tackle it solo in your own garage. Suspension isn't just about ride height, it's about control, safety, and style. Follow along as we get this Dart back on its feet.

programme.title: 1965 Chevy C10 Upholstery | GMC Sierra AT4
programme.desc: We'll show you how to craft custom upholstery using our '65 Chevy C10, plus we get up close with GMC's new Sierra AT4!

programme.title: Easy Upgrades for a Stock Big Block Chevy
programme.desc: It's not all about horsepower! We take a Chevy 454 big block and dial in hard-hauling, heavy-pulling torque.

programme.title: Chevy DragAlanche - Part 2 LS Tear Down & Front-End Rebuild
programme.desc: The 6.2-liter V8 engine of our Chevy Avalance, project DragAlanche, is stripped down and prepped for machine work as the foundation is laid for future performance upgrades. Then, the front suspension gets a major overhaul, replacing worn factory components with fresh parts to deliver the stance, adjustability, and performance needed for both street driving and drag strip action.

programme.title: Adding 8in Lift & Brake Upgrades to a Chevy Silverado
programme.desc: We jack up the '14 Silverado and add big wheels, tires, and brake upgrades.

programme.title: Single Cylinder Special
programme.desc: We show you how to have lots of fun building engines on a budget. We dive into the world of small engines doing a multi-stage build on a 212 CC Go-Kart engine, and we test some easy, bolt-on upgrades on the chassis dyno and behind the wheel.

programme.title: Ignition & Cooling Upgrades Gets This '79 Ford Ranchero Square Body Road Ready
programme.desc: We help one of our viewers get their automotive project back on track, on today's Driveway Rescue.

programme.title: Twin Big Blocks Dyno'd Together Part 2
programme.desc: Today, it's do or die. We connect TWO 496 Big Block Chevy engines to the dyno to find out exactly how much power two of the same engine will make running in tandem!

programme.title: Can a Stock Cast SBC Crank live at 7000 RPM and 570+ HP?
programme.desc: E85 fuel promises high-octane performance for almost any engine. We put it to the test in our revamped 360ci "Compression Obsession" Small Block Chevy.

programme.title: Backyard Engine Build
programme.desc: Out of the shop and into the yard! We take a weekend to rebuild a 350ci small block Chevy V8 engine like you would at your home. We'll trade in our professional gear for tools you might have at your house to show you how to get the most out of your build.

programme.title: What Happens If You Just Add A Stroker Kit To A Stock Mopar Magnum?
programme.desc: We show what happens when our 360 Magnum engine gets fifty extra cubic inches from a forged stroker kit.

programme.title: Diagnosing Problems On A Caprice Wagon To Get It Up And Running
programme.desc: We found an old Caprice wagon and diagnosed some problems to get it back on the road. After getting it running, we head to the hills of Kentucky for the Pineville Hill Climb, a grassroots racing event that adds some local flair.

programme.title: Mocking Up a New 1974 Bronco
programme.desc: It's time to mock everything in place in our 1974 Bronco. We'll also have the frame blasted and powder coated, the body in epoxy, and assembled to the frame.

programme.title: Complete Rebuild Of An AMC 304 Including Adding Port Fuel Injection
programme.desc: We take the original anemic 304 powerplant from an AMC Javelin, and turn it into a high-tech muscle car bullet with some bite!

programme.title: Extreme Diesel Rigs at Ultimate Callout Challenge
programme.desc: LT & Austin purchase a 2011 Sierra Denali HD, plus they are on the road in Indy for coverage of the Ultimate Callout Challenge.

programme.title: Swapping In A Performance Clutch On The Spec Miata Racecar - Part 3
programme.desc: The crew starts tearing into the drivetrain and suspension of their Spec Mazda Miata racecar to help it perform better on the track.

programme.title: How Can an Old 408ci Windsor Make 500HP?
programme.desc: We've got the tips and techniques for Stroking a 408 ci Windsor. So, what does it take to make big power?

programme.title: Shifting Our 1963 Ford Falcon Into Hyperdrive
programme.desc: Now that we've dumped the engine, it's time to drop in the clutch as we install a manual transmission into our 1963 Ford Falcon. We're hoping this will help get our Black Bird off the endangered species list.

programme.title: Tired Supercharged Coyote Mustang Interior Gets an Overhaul
programme.desc: The Detroit Muscle crew creates a custom exhaust with some TIG Tech, and they lay out a new living room for our EBC Supercharged Coyote Mustang.

programme.title: SCCA SPEC Mustang Part 1
programme.desc: Engine Power embarks on a new project for SCCA's inaugural SPEC Mustang class. We'll take a 2008 Mustang GT and begin getting it ready for this entry level, but competitive class.

programme.title: Can We Make This Stock '91 Suburban Unbreakable?
programme.desc: In the series launch we take a 1991 Chevy Suburban and transform it into 'Project Unbreakable.' We test the Suburban at on off-road track, then return to the studio to tear it down to the frame, create a full build-plan, get the engine work underway, and begin fabrication.

programme.title: Hear That Hemi: Bringing A 1970 Hemi Cuda Back To Life
programme.desc: HEMI Cuda', need we say more? The Detroit Muscle crew tune up a rare 1970 HEMI Barracuda for its busy owner. We wake the elephant sleeping under the hood, and take joy ride!

programme.title: Building a Small Block Ford Race Engine
programme.desc: Endurance is the name of the game in building a fresh Small Block Ford race engine.

programme.title: Lifting Big with 8" BDS Coilover Conversion and 35" Tires
programme.desc: We jack up the '14 Silverado and add big wheels, tires, and brake upgrades.

programme.title: Running Our '69 Camaro Through the Wringer
programme.desc: With the SeaFoam Camaro finished up, it is time to see what all those upgrades have done for our Restomod Giveaway. Then we help a viewer with some repairs on their vehicle on another Driveway Rescue

programme.title: Building a Windsor Stroker - There's No Replacement for Displacement
programme.desc: There's a surefire way to make more horsepower for our Windsor, Make it a Stroker! Plus, all new dyno room - Meet Cellblock D!

programme.title: Hellcat Dodge Charger Hits the Road
programme.desc: We put the final touches to our '69 Hellcat Powered Dodge Charger, getting it ready to hit the road!

programme.title: Will Race Fuel And A Bigger Cam Improve Power On The Chevy 350 Dyno Mule?
programme.desc: We just can't stop searching for more power from our Small Block Chevy! It's getting high-octane race fuel, more aggressive timing, and a bigger cam.

programme.title: Supercharging Our Drift Trailblazer To Push It Past the 500 HP Threshold
programme.desc: Part 4 of the Drifting Trailblazer. Jeremy and Jimmy wear out some tires with their drifting Trailblazer SS, after pushing it past 500HP on the dyno.

programme.title: Brake the Pavement
programme.desc: The EBC Brakes and Pedal Commander Dodge Charger gets its final touches on brakes and cosmetics before hitting the track.

programme.title: Toughening Up The '91 Suburban With New Axles And A 4-Link Coilover Kit
programme.desc: Our GMC "Unbreakable" Suburban gets its new suspension along with a good sanding and paint job to help get it ready for the real world.

programme.title: 302 vs. 305 Round 2
programme.desc: The second round of putting data behind the classic 302 SBF vs. 305 SBC debate happens on this episode as Pat and Frankie bring back the Bowtie and Blue Oval in their Small Displacement Showdown. The viewers asked and we listened... so the next round of budget minded upgrades focus on testing what many consider to be each engines best production cylinder heads from the 90's.

programme.title: How-To Custom Paint Graphics in 2 hours
programme.desc: Project Sydewinder get some custom paint and graphics plus demystifying older car terms and labels.

programme.title: Squeezing the Heartbeat Of Our '69 Camaro Between the Fenders
programme.desc: The guys down in Engine Power have finished beefing up our '69 Camaro' s engine with some high-performance parts, now we have to install it and upgrade the drive train so it can hold it's own with today's modern muscle.

programme.title: Rebuilding The Rusted Out Chassis On Our Square Body
programme.desc: A 50 year old tow truck gets a newly fabricated rear chassis to return it to its former glory.

programme.title: Dropping Our '53 Willy's Wagon Body On Its New Chassis
programme.desc: The Carcass duo fab up some custom body mounts for a first look at the Chevy M1010 and Willys Wagon combo. Plus, a sneak peak at the powerhouse that will drive it all.

programme.title: Adding JDM Styling Cues To The 1978 Datsun 280Z Heritage Restomod
programme.desc: The Carcass crew makes body modifications to our 1978 280Z that take on some JDM styling cues. And we're in the paint booth to show you how to make your paint come out smooth as glass.

programme.title: Over 13:1 on Pump Gas! Chevy 350 Dyno Mule - Part 2
programme.desc: We finish our 350 ci Small Block Chevy with high-performance induction, then we put it to the test in the dyno cell!

programme.title: Axles On, Powertrain In
programme.desc: With the Land Cruiser FJ60 plan in motion, the build speeds up. The engine bay gets cleaned up and painted, the freshly rebuilt axles go back under the truck, and the powertrain finally goes in, setting the stage for the next wave of the project build.

programme.title: Chevy C-10 - Part 2: Building the Foundation
programme.desc: The MCT guys start the teardown of their C-10 Chevy. They'll mockup of the front suspension, getting their Chevy closer to the ground for better handling. Plus install a big brake kit for improved stopping power.

programme.title: Mustang Sydewinder at the Mid America Ford and Shelby Nationals
programme.desc: Our Mustang Cobra project "Sydewinder" hits the track at the Mid America Ford and Shelby Nationals! 600+Horsepower and set up for the track, the Foxbody beast is loose!

programme.title: UTV Refurb: General Maintenance
programme.desc: Generally, when you think of trucks, the letters UTV may not come to mind, but today, we're here to change your point of view. The guys tear down a 2019 Polaris General and build it back up to be a lean, mean off-roading machine with all-new suspension, brakes, and some performance upgrades to make this the ultimate utility-train vehicle.

programme.title: Building a Mini Monster Mud Truck from a Surplus Military Ambulance
programme.desc: Jeremy and Jimmy take suggestions from the Powernation team on what to do with their Chevy M1010, before taking this huge military ambulance out on the trails.

programme.title: Chevy C-10 - Part 1: Auto Cross Pretender
programme.desc: Music City Trucks takes their new C-10 project on a wild ride, putting it to the test, to get a better idea of what improvements this old Chevy needs to make it a custom cruiser.

programme.title: Fat Stack - Part 14: Clean, Mean, and Candy Green
programme.desc: Our 1971 Chevy Caprice, Project Fat Stack, ROARS to life after almost a year of work. Tommy and Peyton give the nitty gritty on exhaust installation and finish the interior. Fat Stack turns heads in downtown Nashville to the delight of the Broadway crowd.

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 7 - Midnight Masterpiece
programme.desc: Clutch performance - Today Tommy and Joel install a new third pedal and show you the do's and don'ts on how to bleed the transmission to make your ride run smooth. Then, the dash gets an upgrade but its aesthetic stays true to its retro-glory.

programme.title: Hot Rod Godzilla
programme.desc: We get our hands on Ford's new 7.3 liter pushrod V-8 Godzilla engine and see how it stacks up against the other BIG 3 swap engines. After doing a baseline test, we'll make some modifications by throwing the Engine Power touch on it and see what this beast lays down in the dyno cell.

programme.title: Boost-Ready Stroker LS3
programme.desc: We've got big plans for this aluminum block! That includes stroking it to 419ci, along with a fully-forged rotating assembly that's ready for a power adder!

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 8 - Power Moves
programme.desc: Wired and inspired - The guys enter the winding maze of wiring as they install a new ECU. Then, it's out with the old and in with the new as Joel upgrades the sound deadening and Tommy puts a new shine on the original taillights.

programme.title: Prerunner Ranger Suspension Mods and Fiberglass Panels
programme.desc: Jeremy and Eliza finish up mounting the adjustable shocks add the Raptor-like fiberglass skin to the Prerunner Ranger.

programme.title: Ram 3500 Bullet-Proof Transmission
programme.desc: Ever wonder how a performance transmission can withstand 800 horsepower? We'll crack the case and show the inner workings. Plus, tradition meets 5000 HP at the granddaddy of all Tractor Pulls!

programme.title: Building Up a New 6.4L Gen III HEMI For Reliable Muscle Car Power
programme.desc: Starting with a bare block, we build a piece of big modern Mopar muscle! Complete with a Holley High-Ram Intake and Terminator X Max Fuel Injection, we get a big jump in power that's dyno proven!

programme.title: Waking Up Our Caddy Hearse With A New Exhaust & Fuel Upgrades
programme.desc: Our '76 Caddy gets help to make that engine come to life. We install a custom exhaust, & add fuel and air goodies to make Overtaker rise from the ashes.

programme.title: Lift & Shift
programme.desc: We yank out our old suspension, upgrade the underside of our Diesel Dually, Nightshift, and give it a disc brake conversion and lift kit to help uphold its Dodge signature style.

programme.title: How To Lift And Level Your Truck For More Clearance
programme.desc: When adding bigger wheels and tires to your vehicle may cause some problems with clearance. We show you some quick solutions to get you rolling again.

programme.title: Upgrading the Cadillac 500 To Make Serious Heavy Horsepower
programme.desc: Our '76 Cadillac Hearse gets some engine upgrades to help it get down track. Plus, Tommy goes on the hunt for an axle to keep all that power to the pavement.

programme.title: Ford 300 Inline Six Gets Eye-Popping Off-The-Shelf Power
programme.desc: Even after 45 years, our antique Ford engine still runs. And after some needed upgrades, it will run like a champ!

programme.title: Outlaw Street Car Reunion
programme.desc: We work on the Triple Threat Camaro... and play at the OSCR drag race in Bowling Green, KY.

programme.title: Custom Race Inspired Fuel System for a Buick Regal
programme.desc: With a nod to the Grand National we're giving our Buick Regal more Go Go. Fabricating a race inspired fuel system gets us one step closer to our '85 Buick Regal launch.

programme.title: Stump Pulling Stroked Big Block 390 FE
programme.desc: Mike and Pat stroke a vintage junkyard Ford 390 but an unexpected surprise puts a delay in their progress. Then it's full steam ahead for finding the limit for this big block stump puller

programme.title: Turn Back Time and Prep for the Future
programme.desc: Recap and Forecast on the projects we have in the shop. Install new drivetrain and chassis on Buick Project Street Regal.

programme.title: 427ci LSx Part 2
programme.desc: We wrap up our 427ci LSx engine build for the Music City Trucks' C10 so it can hit the engine dyno! We're topping this engine with a high flowing induction package, stand-alone EFI, and classic small block look. We'll tune it up on the dyno to make pump gas power that will dominate the street!

programme.title: Turbo Tahoe 383 SBC : Part 2
programme.desc: We're putting the final touches on our turbocharged Gen 1 small block and prove you don't need big money to make big power. Once this dead reliable 383 is assembled, it hits the Dyno for NA power pulls before we add boost to Blacktop Speed Shop's pump-gas show stopper.

programme.title: Building a Mudracing Willys Mega Truck
programme.desc: Let the cutting, grinding, and blasting begin! We're boxing the frame on our 1963 Wicked Wet Willys in preparation for an 1100+ horsepower bullet from Engine Power.

programme.title: Klassy K5 Wiring & Glass Tech
programme.desc: How to re-wire your truck with a simple color-coded kit, plus Klassy needs some glassy! Easy how-to on how to replace your own windshield

programme.title: Triple Threat Completion
programme.desc: It's down to the wire, as we ready our Camaro race car for the track.

programme.title: Our Square Body Suburban is Transformed from Tame to Off-Road Beast
programme.desc: Come along as we take a massive '91 GMC Suburban square body and turn it into a lifted off-road beast in this complete build from suspension and drivetrain, to some crazy big tires, to a trail-test adventure!

programme.title: Rebuilding the Rear End of a Chevy K1500
programme.desc: LT and Austin take delivery on "Project Lo 'n Slo". Find out what's in store for this 53 year old C-10. Plus loose ends on the Chevy K1500 "RedTide" get tied up including gearing and a rear-end rebuild.

programme.title: Style Over Substance: Muscle Trux Build-Off
programme.desc: With power taken care off, improvements in the good-looks department include cowl hood, custom wheels, plus tips on restoring old paint

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 2 - Medical Checkup
programme.desc: The warden's calling for diagnostics for Detroit Muscle's next prisoner, their 1969 Pontiac GTO. They'll have to tear down and look inside the skeleton of this old muscle car before they fix it up.

programme.title: Pre-Runner Ranger Part 3 Brake and Safety Upgrades
programme.desc: Eliza and Jeremy are adding high performance brakes and working on the roll cage of their 2002 Pre-Runner!

programme.title: How to Install a Convertible Top
programme.desc: Step by step, we install a new top on our 1966 Pontiac convertible. Plus, a High Performance visit to Las Vegas for LS Fest West.

programme.title: Prerunner Ranger: Headers & Shocks
programme.desc: Cagetube, Rollcage, Shock loops and more, our Prerunner Ranger is getting custom headers and long travel shocks.

programme.title: Lowering And Chopping The Bed On The Turbocharged Ford 300 Flatbed
programme.desc: We bring our now turbocharged 1964 Ford F350 flatbed shop truck back for upgrades. We'll bob the bed by cutting the frame, build and install a new exhaust, and then drive it like we stole it!

programme.title: Will This Junkyard 1977 C-30 Square Body Tow Truck Start?
programme.desc: The Carcass Duo find a left for dead tow truck that they want to give a new life through fabrication and a little imagination.

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 6 - The Art of Darkness
programme.desc: Steel meets style - Today the boys finally lay down some paint on their '69 GTO. Peyton and Tommy then wrestle the body back onto the frame and slap on all new weather stripping to lock out the elements and preserve this poised piece of Pontiac perfection.

programme.title: The Kaiser Gets a Roll Cage
programme.desc: Chris teams up with veteran welder and lead technician for Forney Industries, Gabby Nieto, to test out a brand-new welder and install the roll cage onto Project Spartan's truck bed. Meanwhile, Eric dives deep into the inner workings of this 60s Jeep 6-cylinder motor to see how everything has held up over the past five+ decades.

programme.title: Stopping this Old C10 From Spewing Fuel and Fire
programme.desc: The tuner aftermarket for Jeeps is thriving! A supercharged JK makes some impressive power gains on the dyno, thanks to HP Tuners.

programme.title: Jeep Comanche Driveway Rescue!
programme.desc: Eliza and Jeremy are helping a Marine Corp veteran get his Jeep Comanche back up and running - right in his own driveway!

programme.title: Better Handling Suspension Honda Rally Car Workout
programme.desc: Our '96 Honda Civic gets some suspension upgrades with some new coil racing shocks. Then it's time to head to the rally course to put all our work to the test.

programme.title: Ford F350 Work Truck Upgrades
programme.desc: We bring the 2021 Ford F350 PowerNation work truck into the shop for upgrades that you can do to your ride. We'll add a lift and leveling kit, better brakes, wheels and tires, and we'll show you ways to make a modern truck even more modern.

programme.title: Triple Threat Camaro: Interior
programme.desc: The "Split-Bumper Thumper" gets tubs for bigger tires, along with an easy-to-install roll cage.

programme.title: Building 1974 Bronco From The Ground Up
programme.desc: With the help of some master craftsmen, the guys start building a Bronco from the ground up, one that will cruise the beach, scream down the interstate, and everything in between.

programme.title: Building a Ford 2.3L 4-Cylinder Lima Engine For The Dirt Track
programme.desc: It's a first for HorsePower - putting together a four-banger, high performance engine dedicated to oval, dirt track competition. It's amazing how much power you can pack into a small race engine designed especially for dirt tracks.

programme.title: Setting Front End Alignment for the Track on a Mustang Foxbody
programme.desc: We take Project Sydewinder to get its suspension setup for the track. Plus, Tommy and Marc get a rare look inside the Indianapolis Motor Speedway Museum Vault.

programme.title: Sierra HD Duramax Allison Transmission
programme.desc: We'll show you the step-by-step inner workings of an Allison transmission when our guys build the gearbox for a Sierra HD Duramax.

programme.title: JL Rubicon: Strength
programme.desc: Our Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon gets a stronger axle, and a custom built bumper. Plus, how you can build your own rack for trail tools.

programme.title: Turbo Tech Making 1200+ Horsepower
programme.desc: Turbo pioneer, Kenny Duttweiler steps in to lend a hand with our LME 427 ci LSX engine. Boosting this bullet with a high-tech turbo system produces a lot of excitement and big dyno numbers!

programme.title: Test Sled Reincarnated Stage 1
programme.desc: We dust off our Test Sled from the pits of darkness and give it a new life. It gets a new heartbeat with a 410ci stack-injected LS engine, backed by a Tremec TKX transmission, to bring the Test Sled back to track ready status

programme.title: Honda Civic Rally Ripper Gets Safety & Seat Upgrades
programme.desc: Our '96 Honda Civic Rally car gets some racing seats for comfort and a rally cage for added safety.

programme.title: Mocking Up ta Coyote in our Rolling Dyno Test Sled
programme.desc: What's heating up the track at the American Endurance Racing Mid-Ohio Event? From inside where all the action takes place, strap in and hang on. Plus, mocking up the dyno test sled for a new boosted Coyote.

programme.title: Carcass In England
programme.desc: The guys from Carcass head across the pond to the UK to tour EBC Brakes and their Center of Excellence. We also check out England's ultimate motorsports summer garden party at the Goodwood Festival of Speed.

programme.title: OBS 632 SS Part 3 Building Blocks
programme.desc: The '89 Chevy's frame need's a few more modifications before heading to powder coat. We'll show you how to stiffen the frame by adding some boxing plates. We'll mockup our new fuel tank. We also dive into proper clutch installation, and get our drivetrain assembled and dropped into the chassis.

programme.title: Partying at Holley's MoParty with the Detroit Muscle Crew
programme.desc: The Detroit Muscle crew pulls a driveway rescue to spruce up a '70 Bronco. Then, the guys hit the road and jump over to Holley's MoParty, where it's a celebration of anything and everything MoPowered.

programme.title: Building a Dream '74 Bronco From the Ground Up
programme.desc: We take one of the most sought after vehicles - a true old-school '74 Ford Bronco, and strip it down to the chassis to bring it back to life, ultimately deciding on building it back up to an actual all-new dream machine...piece by piece.

programme.title: Final Install: '91 Suburban Gets Its 383 Stroker And 4-Link Suspension
programme.desc: Our "Unbreakable" Suburban gets its engine and transmission, fuel system, 4-link suspension, front clip and hood all installed and ready to go.

programme.title: SeaFoam Camaro Finish Up and Payoff
programme.desc: With the SeaFoam Camaro finished up, it is time to see what all those upgrades have done for our Restomod Giveaway. Then we help a viewer with some repairs on their vehicle on another Driveway Rescue

programme.title: Ultimate 318 LA: Part 2
programme.desc: Our small block 318 Mopar returns to be prettied up and completed on this episode. We cover it in a custom color and go through a detailed assembly process to get it ready for our Dyno. But things go sideways during the testing with our 318, first making excellent power then revealing major problems, and we hope we caught it in time.

programme.title: Road Course Camaro Part 9 Front Clip Fabrication
programme.desc: The Carcass Crew jumps back on their 1972 Camaro, metal working the damaged core support. They show you the right techniques to bend and manipulate metal brackets to save you money. They'll also show you how they are going to install the carbon fiber fenders.

programme.desc: Today we'll show you the 5 most common reasons your engine won't start...and how to fix it!

programme.desc: We're taking Project Creep it Real out for fun at 2 off-road parks!

programme.title: The Next Three Days
programme.desc: Life for John and Lara Brennan (Russell Crowe, Elizabeth Banks) is miserable after she is convicted of a murder she says she did not commit. Three years later while struggling with the demands of work and raising his son alone, John is still trying to establish her innocence. When her final appeal is rejected, Lara becomes suicidal, forcing John to exercise the only option he has left: Break her out of prison.
A desperate man takes part in an underworld game of Russian roulette in which gamblers place bets on who will survive.

programme.title: Mechanic: Resurrection
programme.desc: Living undercover in Brazil, master assassin Arthur Bishop (Jason Statham) springs back into action after an old enemy (Sam Hazeldine) kidnaps the woman (Jessica Alba) he loves. To save her life, Bishop must kill an imprisoned African warlord, a human trafficker (Toby Eddington) and an arms dealer (Tommy Lee Jones), all while making the deaths look like accidents. When things don't go exactly as planned, Bishop turns the tables on the people who forced him out of retirement.

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: A recently released convict and his criminally inclined best friend execute a daring daytime bank robbery.

programme.title: War on Everyone
programme.desc: Two corrupt cops, who make money blackmailing criminals, come up against one who may be far more dangerous than both of them.

programme.title: Traitor
programme.desc: When straight-arrow agent Roy Clayton (Guy Pearce) assumes command of a special FBI task force, he becomes entangled in a web of covert operations. All the clues in Clayton's investigation point to Samir Horn (Don Cheadle), a former Special Ops soldier who now aids terrorists. But as Clayton digs deeper and contradictory evidence begins to emerge, he begins to question Horn's motives.

programme.title: Raw Deal
programme.desc: When efforts to prosecute mob boss Luigi Patrovita are repeatedly derailed thanks to a mole in the FBI, the only choice is to bring in an outsider -- specifically, Mark Kaminsky, a disgraced agent who leaps at a chance for reinstatement. After FBI chief Shannon gives him his orders, Kaminsky fakes his death and reemerges as an ex-con named Brenner. Undercover and accountable to no one, the former Fed tears up the mob from the inside.

programme.title: The Way of the Gun
programme.desc: They make no excuses. They don't ask forgiveness. Their story is without compromise, brutal and simple. For contemporary desperados Parker and associate Longbaugh, crime means survival at any cost. Their impromptu plan to kidnap surrogate mother Robin, just weeks from delivering the son of Hale and Francesca Chidduck, seems to be a fast way to cash in on a fat ransom and head for the border. But their haste does indeed make waste.

programme.title: Catch .44
programme.desc: The plan of three women (Malin Akerman, Nikki Reed, Deborah Ann Woll) to intercept a drug shipment for their boss (Bruce Willis) goes horribly wrong.

programme.title: Killing Them Softly
programme.desc: When rival crook Johnny Amato (Vincent Curatola) hatches a plan to rob a card game run by mob lackey Markie (Ray Liotta), he picks a low-rent thug named Frankie (Scoot McNairy) to do the job. Frankie picks a less-than-ideal partner (Ben Mendelsohn) to help him, but despite their combined incompetence, they manage to make off with the mob's money. In retaliation, Markie's bosses hire Jackie Cogan (Brad Pitt), a mob enforcer, to eradicate those responsible.

programme.title: Dig
programme.desc: Held hostage by a dangerous couple, a widower and his daughter must work together to outsmart their captors and survive the night.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: In the summer of 1967, rioting and civil unrest starts to tear apart the city of Detroit. Two days later, a report of gunshots prompts the Detroit Police Department, the Michigan State Police and the Michigan Army National Guard to search and seize an annex of the nearby Algiers Motel. Several policemen start to flout procedure by forcefully and viciously interrogating guests to get a confession. By the end of the night, three unarmed men are gunned down while several others are brutally beaten.

programme.title: Kickboxer 3: The Art of War
programme.desc: A Los Angeles martial artist (Sasha Mitchell) goes to Rio de Janeiro and fights to save a girl from a drug lord.

programme.title: Acts of Violence
programme.desc: Three Midwestern brothers, a crime lord, and an incorruptible cop are on a deadly collision course when the youngest brother's fiancée is kidnapped by human traffickers. To save her, the MacGregor boys call on their military training -- and the strength of family -- to fight the most important battle of their lives.

programme.title: Hunter Killer
programme.desc: American submarine Capt. Joe Glass is on the hunt for a U.S. sub in distress in the Arctic Ocean. He soon learns that a secret Russian coup is in the offing, a conspiracy that threatens to dismantle the world order. With crew and country on the line, Glass must assemble an elite group of Navy SEALs to sneak through enemy waters, rescue the kidnapped Russian president and prevent World War III.

programme.title: Line of Duty
programme.desc: A disgraced cop teams up with a livestreaming news broadcaster to try and save the police chief's kidnapped daughter.

programme.title: Seized
programme.desc: A former special forces agent's son is kidnapped and must now wipe out three dangerous crime syndicates, if he wants to see his son alive again.

programme.title: Escape Plan
programme.desc: Tough and chiseled Ray Breslin (Sylvester Stallone) knows how to infiltrate a prison -- and bust out of one. His latest job leads to a double-cross, leaving him stuck in a high-tech facility with the worst that society has to offer. Luckily for Ray, he meets Emil Rottmayer (Arnold Schwarzenegger), an inmate who secretly helps him hatch a plot to win his freedom. Only sadistic warden Hobbes (Jim Caviezel) stands in the way of the two men successfully making it out alive.

programme.title: Escape Plan 2: Hades
programme.desc: Ray Breslin manages an elite team of security specialists trained in the art of breaking people out of the world's most impenetrable prisons. When his trusted operative, Shu Ren, is kidnapped and disappears inside the most elaborate prison ever built, Ray assembles an elite team to assist in the rescue.

programme.title: Escape Plan: The Extractors
programme.desc: Ray Breslin and his team of security experts fight to rescue Breslin's girlfriend and a tech mogul's daughter from a formidable prison known as Devil's Station.
