programme.title: Take This Waltz
programme.desc: A young woman (Michelle Williams) is torn between the husband (Seth Rogen) that she loves and a new man (Luke Kirby) in her life, whom she's unable to ignore.

programme.title: Infinity Baby
programme.desc: A man works for a company called Infinity Baby, which is tasked with farming out 3-month-old babies who don't age.

programme.title: The Magic of Belle Isle
programme.desc: An alcoholic, disabled novelist finds his muse again after he moves into a lakeside cabin and meets a single mother and her daughters.

programme.title: The Hunter
programme.desc: A shadowy corporation sends a mercenary (Willem Dafoe) to Tasmania to track down a nearly extinct tiger whose genetic code holds the secret to a dangerous weapon.

programme.title: The Canyon
programme.desc: A honeymooning couple has to survive in the Grand Canyon after getting lost.

programme.title: Mister America
programme.desc: Despite being completely inexperienced and broke and having just defeated a murder charge, a man mounts a campaign to unseat the San Bernardino district attorney.

programme.title: Frank
programme.desc: An aspiring musician (Domhnall Gleeson) finds himself way out of his element after he joins a pop group led by an enigmatic figure (Michael Fassbender) who wears a giant fake head.

programme.title: The Right Kind of Wrong
programme.desc: A stubborn idealist (Ryan Kwanten) spies a bride (Sara Canning) on her way to her wedding and immediately falls in love with her.

programme.title: Diggers
programme.desc: During the 1970s as corporate fisheries began snatching up water rights around the Hamptons, independent clammers Hunt and his friends could do little else but watch their way of life slip away. While members of the group look for ways to cope, Hunt begins a summer romance with a young vacationer.

programme.title: The Double
programme.desc: An awkward office drone (Jesse Eisenberg) becomes increasingly unhinged after a charismatic and confident look-alike takes a job at his workplace and seduces the woman (Mia Wasikowska) he desires.

programme.title: The Last Days on Mars
programme.desc: Astronauts (Liev Schreiber, Elias Koteas, Romola Garai) on Mars contend with a microbe that turns those it infects into zombielike killers.

programme.title: Centurion
programme.desc: In ancient Scotland, the Ninth Legion liberates a Roman officer named Quintus Dias (Michael Fassbender) from his Pict captors. The soldiers are in pursuit of the Pict leader, and Quintus joins their quest. Soon afterward, the Romans' Pict guide betrays them, resulting in the slaughter of all but a handful of men. The Roman survivors try desperately to reach safety, as the indigenous warriors pick them off one by one.

programme.title: Jack & Diane
programme.desc: Diane's feelings for Jack, the girl she met over the summer, begin to manifest themselves in terrifying ways when she learns that her friend will soon be moving away.

programme.title: How I Live Now
programme.desc: As conflict in Europe escalates, an American teen (Saoirse Ronan) fights to survive in the English countryside.

programme.title: Mutant Chronicles
programme.desc: In the 28th century, four rival corporations are in a constant state of war for control of the Earth. During one such battle, an ancient machine is uncovered and reactivated, and starts churning out undead mutants by the hundreds. While the corporations make plans to abandon the Earth, a strike force led by Maj. Mitch Hunter (Thomas Jane) and clergyman Brother Samuel (Ron Perlman), embark on a mission to destroy the machine before the mutants overrun the planet.

programme.title: Alone
programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer hunts a widow in the wilderness after she escapes from his remote cabin in the Pacific Northwest.

programme.title: 12 Hour Shift
programme.desc: Bodies start to pile up when a drug-addicted nurse and her crazed cousin try to find a replacement kidney for an organ trafficker.

programme.title: Black Death
programme.desc: During the time of the bubonic plague in 14th-century England, young monk Osmund is recruited by the knight Ulric to lead a group of soldiers through the marshes into a mysterious village, where rumors are spreading that a necromancer is raising plague victims from the dead. Osmund agrees, but he has an ulterior motive—to find Averill, a young woman who has gone missing. Along the way, the group encounters unimagined darkness.

programme.title: Heel
programme.desc: A dysfunctional couple kidnap a 19-year-old criminal, chain him up in their basement and subject him to a violent and twisted rehabilitation process. As he complies with their relentless mind games, he frantically searches for a way to escape.

programme.title: Little Men
programme.desc: Two teens develop a growing friendship in Brooklyn, N.Y., while the feud between their respective parents (Greg Kinnear, Jennifer Ehle) continues to escalate.

programme.title: Ira and Abby
programme.desc: A rocky road is ahead when Ira (Chris Messina), a neurotic doctoral candidate, meets and marries Abby (Jennifer Westfeldt), a free-spirit, almost on a whim. The pair enjoy marital bliss for a while, but the relationship hits the skids when Ira learns Abby is twice-divorced. The marriage breaks apart, but the lovers have yet to realize that they may not be able to live without one another.

programme.title: Humpday
programme.desc: Two college buddies reunite after a decade apart. Ben (Mark Duplass) is married and planning to start a family; Andrew (Joshua Leonard), a free spirit, has spent the last 10 years traveling the globe. Reigniting the rivalries of their college years, the friends agree to enter a movie in an upcoming amateur porn festival. Ben and Andrew's constant need to one-up each other results in a daring proposition: The staunchly heterosexual friends must star together in a gay adult film.

programme.title: God Bless America
programme.desc: Fed up with the cruelty and stupidity of American culture, an unlikely duo (Joel Murray, Tara Lynne Barr) team up to whack reality TV stars, bigots and others they find repugnant.

programme.title: The Lost City
programme.desc: Fico Fellove (Andy Garcia), an apolitical Havana club owner, gets caught in the middle when Fidel Castro's Communist Revolution sweeps through Cuba. He tries to keep the strife outside the walls of his popular establishment, but his family becomes divided when his brothers (Nestor Carbonell, Enrique Murciano) join the fight against Batista.

programme.title: Rabbit Trap
programme.desc: Seeking new inspiration and a fresh start, married musicians Darcy and Daphne move to the Welsh countryside to finish their new record. While collecting audio samples, Darcy inadvertently creates a field recording of a mysterious sound never before heard by human ears. The discovery soon renews Daphne's creative energy, but as the echoes of her music bleed into the surrounding landscape, ancient and malevolent woodland forces are disturbed.

programme.title: The Wave
programme.desc: A Norwegian geologist (Kristoffer Joner) and his family (Ane Dahl Torp, Jonas Hoff Oftebro) fight for survival when a massive landslide causes a 250-foot tidal wave.

programme.title: Mayday
programme.desc: A young woman is transported to another world where a never-ending war is raging. There, a clutch of women lure men to their deaths at sea via radio transmissions, like 20th-century sirens. She soon realizes she's not the killer they want her to be.

programme.title: Marrowbone
programme.desc: A young man and his younger siblings who have concealed the death of their mother to remain together are plagued by a sinister presence in their home.

programme.title: Nature Calls
programme.desc: After his troops ditch him for a slumber party at the posh home of his rival brother (Johnny Knoxville), a scoutmaster (Patton Oswalt) lures the youths away in the middle of the night for an ill-advised camping trip.

programme.title: Results
programme.desc: Personal trainers (Guy Pearce, Cobie Smulders) are charged with whipping a newly wealthy and highly unmotivated slob (Kevin Corrigan) into shape.

programme.title: Honeymoon
programme.desc: A honeymooning bride (Rose Leslie) goes sleepwalking into the woods surrounding a secluded cabin. When she returns she looks the same, but something about her is frighteningly different.

programme.title: Little Joe
programme.desc: A plant created via genetic engineering appears to produce curious changes in the people and animals it comes into contact with.

programme.title: The Assessment
programme.desc: In a not-so-distant future where parenthood is strictly controlled, a couple's seven-day assessment for the right to have a child unravels into a nightmare, forcing them to question the very foundations of society.

programme.title: White Bird in a Blizzard
programme.desc: A teenager (Shailene Woodley) relishes her newfound freedom after her disturbed mother (Eva Green) vanishes, but the strange facts of the disappearance soon begin to haunt her.

programme.title: In the Fade
programme.desc: Katja's life falls apart in the blink of an eye when two neo-Nazis kill her husband and 6-year-old son in a bomb attack. Her quest for justice soon pushes her to the edge as the two suspects stand trial for murder.

programme.title: Shadow Dancer
programme.desc: Arrested after a failed bombing attempt, a single mother and IRA member (Andrea Riseborough) falls into the hands of a British agent (Clive Owen) who offers her a choice: Spy on her IRA comrades, or spend a long prison term away from her young son.

programme.title: The World's Fastest Indian
programme.desc: New Zealander Burt Munro spent years perfecting his classic Indian motorcycle. The year is 1967, and Burt takes his machine to Utah's salt flats, where he attempts the impossible, using his dream bike to set a new world's record for speed. Based on a true story, the record Munro set more than three decades ago still has not been broken to this day.

programme.title: Tangerine
programme.desc: After hearing that her boyfriend/pimp cheated on her while she was in jail, a transgender sex worker and her best friend set out to find him and teach him and his new lover a lesson.

programme.title: Bolt-On Is a Dirty Word
programme.desc: Bill looks to the year 2073 when the owner of a '73 El Camino challenges the shop to transform his vehicle into the Ride of the Future; the city wants a custom bumper on a 2020 Freightliner tow truck.

programme.title: 100 and C10 Percent
programme.desc: Bill and the team get their chance to finish a 1968 Chevy C10, which they turn into a unibody by welding the body and bed into one piece; an old dump truck rolls into the shop as the biggest truck the team has ever customized.

programme.title: Big Diesel and Drag Truck
programme.desc: A 1937 International Harvester gets a big old Cummins 12-valve diesel engine that's as heavy as the truck itself; a 2005 Chevy Colorado gets a new lease on life as a nitrous-infused drag truck.

programme.title: Dump Truck to Show Truck
programme.desc: A 1996 dump truck is the largest truck the shop has ever customized; the guys go extra heavy duty to create a military-styled megatruck; a lowrider enthusiast wants a custom air ride and LS swap for his pristine 1934 Buick.

programme.title: 5500 Lifted, Texas Edition
programme.desc: This year's over-the-top build has Bill and crew lifting a 2020 Chevy Silverado 5500 more than a foot with a custom heavy-duty air suspension; the guys also prove their Texas mettle by radically overhauling the utility bed.

programme.title: Earl Campbell's Custom Cadillac
programme.desc: Hall of Fame running back Earl Campbell arrives with the body and parts of a 1949 Cadillac, and the crew is honored to create a ground-up build for the local legend; a 1940 F-100 build snowballs into a much bigger job.

programme.title: Earl Campbell's Custom Cadillac Part 2
programme.desc: NFL Hall of Famer Earl Campbell made a career mowing down defenders, so the guys take the same hell-bent approach to rebuilding his 1949 Cadillac; they also customize a van for a disabled motocross rider so he can drive again.

programme.title: Earl Campbell's Custom Cadillac Part 3
programme.desc: The team revamps an old school '34 Buick into a modern day lowrider; after months of rebuilding the body and making a custom frame for Earl Campbell's '49 Cadillac, the Hall of Famer challenges the shop with a last-minute wrinkle.

programme.title: Fantastical Failures of Automotive Ambition
programme.desc: Every so often a visionary comes along, and with their imagination, grit and perseverance, they manage to fail and leave a mark on automotive history.

programme.title: Legendary Visionaries
programme.desc: Rob Corddry and Emelia Hartford tell two stories of Japanese visionaries who managed to bring their visions to life and change the car world, despite obstacles.

programme.title: Rebel Innovators
programme.desc: Rule benders and sneaky geniuses: these are stories of creative risk-takers who know that sometimes you have to break the rules to be the hero.

programme.title: Unsung Modified Cars
programme.desc: There are a million ways to modify a car, but few like these stories. From a manufacturer creating a narrow-use case spec, to one guy making a complete unicorn in his garage, we celebrate some forgotten oddballs of the mod world.

programme.title: Ultimate Heroes of Speed
programme.desc: Certain men in the history of cars were just made from different stuff; these two drivers achieved insane feats against impossible odds to prove that they are legends among legends.

programme.title: Old Timey Car Tales
programme.desc: Taking a trip back in time to the early days of the automobile, when the first enterprising car enthusiasts laid the foundations for the car world today.

programme.title: Cars, Crime, Curse, Mystery
programme.desc: Some cars carry powerful myths with them long after they are gone; these are stories of cars whose intriguing legends have endured long past the metal they are made from.

programme.title: Extreme Speed Clubs
programme.desc: The quest for speed has been ingrained in humans since the birth of the wheel; these are stories of people who gathered like-minded speed freaks and created outlaw cultures of pushing the limits of public roads.

programme.title: The Rebirth of a Generation
programme.desc: To kick off the show, Nads and Amir build their dream Civic Type R hatch.

programme.title: Taking a 2016 Subaru BRZ From Fun Commuter to Track-Day Hero
programme.desc: The boys get their hands on a stock Subaru BRZ; Nads and Amir add some affordable mods to turn it into a respectable track car; they try to turn a fast enough time at the track to gain entry into the exclusive sub-two-minute lap club.

programme.title: Beat Down 350Z Drift Missile to Street Shark Dripping With Style
programme.desc: "Hot Rod Garage" built a Nissan 350Z drifter with a welded differential, hydraulic handbrake, steering angle kit and not much else; then they abandoned it; Nads and Amir try to salvage this one with some much-needed style and a Formula Drift debut.

programme.title: JDM Toyota Chaser Goes From Big-Body Drifter to Quarter-Mile Dragger
programme.desc: The boys score a Japanese-spec, right-hand-drive 1997 Toyota Chaser; it's the perfect recipe for a sideways, big-body drift car, but Nads and Amir want to go in a different direction: straight down the drag strip.

programme.title: Classing Things Up With a Japanese-Inspired 2005 Lexus LS 430 VIP
programme.desc: VIP cars include rare body kits, oversized wheels and slammed ride heights; the boys try to build something that's true to the roots of the space and make it to an exclusive VIP party reveal.

programme.title: Giving Our JDM Toyota Chaser a Big Turbo in Pursuit of Big Time Slips
programme.desc: Our quest to transform a drift car into an all-out drag car continues.

programme.title: Amir's Lotus Elise Is Also Our First EURO Complete With a JDM Twist
programme.desc: Amir's Elise has been a long-standing dream, but now that he has it, the boys can't leave well enough alone; Honda's Civic Type R engine makes for a perfect swap.

programme.title: The Blue Ridge Buckin' Bronco
programme.desc: Tommy Pike and his crew are no strangers to working on off-road vehicles, so when a client drops off a '74 Bronco, it's game on; they transform this Bronco by dropping a giant engine into a new body, with fresh paint and a fully re-designed interior.

programme.title: The Monster Carlo
programme.desc: Tommy and his best friend take a ride back to the '80s; the shop crew transforms a bone-stock 1986 Monte Carlo SS into a LT4 "Monster Carlo" mega machine.

programme.title: Top Secret Impala
programme.desc: Tommy's dear friend and father figure Kenny sold his 1960 Chevy Impala when he started a family, and has wanted it back ever since; Tommy finds one and plans to restore it, but keeping the secret is more of a challenge than the team ever imagined.

programme.title: I Love It
programme.desc: Tommy and his team continue the secret '60 Chevy Impala restoration; they revitalize the machine with a new suspension, rebuilt engine and a stunning interior, before reuniting Tommy's father figure with the car of his dreams.

programme.title: Corn-fed '55 Chevy
programme.desc: Tommy Pike and his team restore and modernize a 1955 heirloom Chevy truck.

programme.title: Lambo Livin'
programme.desc: Tommy and his team up the ante by working on a cutting-edge Lamborghini Huracán; the crew feels excited about their supercar project, before realizing what a tricky project they've taken on.

programme.title: Mr. B's Controversial Corvette
programme.desc: One of the shop's best customers has a big request; now Tommy and the crew need to finish up a one-of-a-kind '54 Chevy Corvette build before a big local car show.

programme.title: Beast of the Southeast
programme.desc: A client brings Tommy his '73 Chevy Vega for a nostalgic restoration; the team has to roll up their sleeves and uncover all the issues on this half-baked restomod.

programme.title: Safari Style
programme.desc: Tommy and the crew pay homage to the '71 East African Safari Rally winner by transforming a brand-new Nissan Z into an era-specific ride that needs to be ready for a SEMA debut.

programme.title: Abandoned Chevy C10
programme.desc: Tommy and the crew find a partially restored '60 Chevy C10 pick up that's been abandoned at the end of the build process and decide to bring it back to life.

programme.title: '67 'Vette Retro Racer
programme.desc: A Corvette aficionado trusts Tommy to put his spin on a classic '67 Chevy Corvette and go full-tilt bozo on the machine; the crew must pull out all the stops to reimagine the car from the ground up.

programme.title: '67 Vette Hits the Track
programme.desc: While the team continues putting their own spin on a classic '67 resto-modded Chevy Corvette, Tommy recruits his buddy Dewayne to get the interior in tip-top shape.

programme.title: That's Not an Engine...That's a Kevdogg
programme.desc: Something lurking in a 1952 Pontiac threatens the entire build.

programme.title: Mischief
programme.desc: The team struggles with the trim, paint and upholstery on a '52 Pontiac.

programme.title: If Your Car Ain't Turning You On, Get Another One
programme.desc: The owner of a '69 Camaro has a specific mission for Dave and the crew.

programme.title: We Can Work This Out
programme.desc: Dave fixes up a '72 Chevy Blazer he purchased to build and sell.

programme.title: It's a Super Car Farm Truck...Duh?
programme.desc: Dave and a client have different ideas for the re-design of a 1955 F-100.

programme.title: The F Five OHHHHHHH
programme.desc: The crew scrambles to get parts and the color just right on the Ford F-100.

programme.title: Back to Basics
programme.desc: Dave buys a 1965 Volkswagen bus to restore, re-upholster and flip.

programme.title: De-pimp My Ride, Please!
programme.desc: Handicap golf professional Dennis Walters asks Dave to de-pimp his ride.

programme.title: Anyone Know Where I Can Find a Bitchin' Ride?
programme.desc: Dave transforms a stock '68 Camaro for a client from Massachusetts.

programme.title: Nomad? No Way!
programme.desc: The crew takes on a 1955 Nomad that's been through two previous shops.

programme.title: New Season, New Headache
programme.desc: A 1957 Ford Fairlane 500 that hasn't seen the road since 1957 gets revived.

programme.title: Mint Condition
programme.desc: The team faces obstacles while trying to get the Fairlane's engine running.

programme.title: On the Road Again
programme.desc: Dave and Kevin head to Colorado in hopes of winning an award for the shop.

programme.title: Rear-Engine Replacement: The Econorado Is Born
programme.desc: David and Mike attempt to fill the Mazdarati void with their new Econorado.

programme.title: 440 Big-Block Samurai: From the Junkyard to the Road
programme.desc: David and Steve built the Super Sammy, a junkyard-rescued Suzuki Samurai that they crammed a 440 Chrysler big-block into right where it sat in the middle of the junkyard; now they're back to find out why Suzuki never offered this engine combination.

programme.title: The Ultimate Beater Burnout Machine
programme.desc: David and Mike consider themselves masters of burnout-ology; yet they have never actually entered a burnout competition until now; they take a rusted-out '76 Camaro and set out across Texas to show how to scientifically get the best burnouts.

programme.title: Junkyard Rescue Four-Speed Big Block
programme.desc: David and Mike take a 1964 Ford Galaxie 500 XL that absolutely needed to be rescued; after a few miles, the car begins to smoke worse than any car in the history of Roadkill.

programme.title: Cheap Beater Battle
programme.desc: David and Mike find beaters under $3K; it's a four-vehicle shootout with Chevy vs. Ford, truck vs. car, and old vs. newer; Freiburger chose a 2006 Crown Vic and a 1999 Chevy S-10; Finnegan went vintage with a 1972 Ford Maverick and a 1976 Chevy LUV.

programme.title: Parking Lot Engine Swap
programme.desc: The guys return to a parking lot to swap out the engine in a '74 Jag XJ12.

programme.title: Trading Cars Across Power Tour
programme.desc: Mike and David drive a new car every day as they trade their way through the 25th Hot Rod Power Tour; each day, they'll swap their junk for someone else's and try to make it to the next stop on the tour.

programme.title: Junkyard Rescue T-37 Pontiac!
programme.desc: Steve finds a '71 Pontiac T-37 at a junkyard in Idaho; Mike and David take their time reviving a motor that's been sitting for 38 years.

programme.title: Road Trip Survival: The LUV Is All You Need!
programme.desc: Mike Finnegan and Tony Angelo buy a mid-1970s Chevy LUV mini-truck and hit the road, enduring electrical problems, torrential downpours, water in the engine, and floods.

programme.title: Episode 100: Back to Throwing Darts!
programme.desc: David and Mike take the show back to its roots, but take things to new heights with a bigger map and a four-door Dart; they'll see how the 2013 version stacks against the '76 318-powered Dodge that started it all.

programme.title: Project Car Showdown and Roadkill Nights Powered by Dodge!
programme.desc: David and Mike bring their best Dodge project cars out to the M1 Concourse for the annual Roadkill Nights event in Pontiac, Mich.; this time, it's a road course, skidpad and drag racing with seven favorite projects.

programme.title: Blasphemi takes on HOT ROD Drag Week!
programme.desc: Mike, Tony and the '55 Chevy race for glory in a brutal five-day test for drag-racing, street-driven cars; Blasphemi is known for three things, going fast, being awesome and breaking apart.

programme.title: Rotsun Lives Again!
programme.desc: The guys want to revive the long-neglected '71 240Z and drive it to SEMA.

programme.title: Diesel Swapped Drag Racing Torino Wagon!
programme.desc: Mike and Tony divert from a road trip to accept a drag racing challenge.

programme.title: Hilarious Car Shootout
programme.desc: Mike and David buy each other their worst automotive nightmares and put them to the test against Steve in a showdown; Finnegan rides high, Freiburger works through some "cosmetic" damage and Dulcich rampages through fire.

programme.title: Blown T-Bird Winter Road Trip!
programme.desc: The T-Bizzle is an '86 Thunderbird powered by a 302 V8, topped with a 6-71 blower and welded gears; Freiburger and Finnegan take it across the frozen tundra of the northern U.S., on a classic road trip with plenty of fail.

programme.title: Top Project Car Updates!
programme.desc: Freiburger and Finnegan take a look at Roadkill's Top Project Cars.

programme.title: D100 Pick Up Rescue!
programme.desc: Freiburger and Finnegan clean out wheels that have been stashed in the garage for far too long by slapping them on a neglected '66 Dodge D100 Utiline truck; they hit the road on a quest to find the perfect 440 for it.

programme.title: At-Home Build-Off: COVID 350 vs Mini Truck!
programme.desc: The guys scrounge their parts piles and come up with impressive results.

programme.title: Cheap 4x4 Challenge!
programme.desc: Freiburger and Dulcich settle who has the better cheap 4x4.

programme.title: Budget Drag Build and Battle!
programme.desc: The guys have a build off and race like no other; Tony transforms a shell of an '85 Monte Carlo into a beast, while Finnegan makes Newbern's Nova run with ramp truck parts; it's three days of wrenching, two tracks and one unbelievable race.

programme.title: Barn Find Firebird Rescue!
programme.desc: Mike Finnegan and David Newbern rescue a mint '67 Pontiac Firebird that has been stowed in a barn for almost two decades; the guys battle old parts, downpours and other issues in order to get this old drag car racing down the track once again.

programme.title: Road Trippin' the Wreck Runner!
programme.desc: Freiburger and Dulcich hit the road in the '68 Wreck Runner, a four-speed, 383ci clone made from the scraps of a '68 Road Runner and a '68 Satellite; it only has a few little issues; they hit the road to sort 'em out.

programme.title: Barnfind Firebird vs. Crusher Camaro!
programme.desc: Finnegan and Newbern take the barn-find '67 Firebird on an 800-mile road trip to race Freiburger and Dulcich in the Crusher Camaro.

programme.title: Dirt Track Rally Shootout!
programme.desc: Freiburger and Finnegan race Dulcich and Newbern in a dirt-track shootout.

programme.title: No-Prep Drag Race Mustangs!
programme.desc: The guys try their hand at no-prep drag racing against Lyle Barnett and his turbocharged 1,500-hp Beer Money Mustang.

programme.title: Two Legends Become One
programme.desc: For years, Pigpen, the junkyard rescued 1950 GMC truck, has sat dormant; the guys awaken a monster by donating the chassis of their own legendary 1985 S-15 in a body swap for the ages, then take on Randy Pobst at Atlanta Motor Speedway.

programme.title: Dirt Track Racing Mini-Honda!
programme.desc: Everyone wants their car to be better, faster, stronger, but a difference is hard to make on a budget; David Newbern and Mike Cotten may not have all the answers, but they're willing to give it a run by mixing affordable upgrades with sweat equity.

programme.title: Crown Victorious
programme.desc: The guys uncover a cop car racing series around the Ford Crown Victoria P71 Police Interceptor; with a handful of bolt-on upgrades, they turn their former police auction find into a road race ripper around Willow Springs.

programme.title: Baja Bug V-8 Swap!
programme.desc: The guys take on off-road Baja legend Cameron Steele on a brutal desert off-road course with a Baja Bug; they may be outmatched by Cameron's unlimited racing rig, but the addition of a 350 V-8 to their Bug closes a big gap.

programme.title: Lifted Lambo Mud Truck!
programme.desc: The guys take their V-8-powered Pontiac Fiero-based Lamborghini Countach kit car known as the Scamborghini and give it a 6-foot lift to take on an insane wheelie-popping mud truck through what's known as a bounty hole.

programme.title: '57 Chevy Two-Day Turnaround!
programme.desc: The guys take a big-block '57 Bel Air to compete in the autocross at Cruisin' the Coast in Miss.; with a complete overhaul of the suspension in the event's parking lot, the guys find out how much lap time they can shave in a weekend.

programme.title: V-8 Baja Bug Suspension
programme.desc: Off-road legend Cameron Steele warned the guys that a V-8 swap wouldn't cut as much time as a long-travel suspension could; now Newbern and Cotten finally heed his advice, going all-out with major suspension upgrades to their Baja-inspired VW Beetle.

programme.title: Drag Racing Model A!
programme.desc: The guys take on Clay Millican by transforming a Model A from the ground up; with a new chassis, suspension and fresh 400-hp 347ci V-8, the Ford is improved in every way.

programme.title: Turbocharged Eagle Rally Racer
programme.desc: Newbern and Cotten discover a gem which is not a typical American muscle with a turbocharged Eagle Talon; Shea Seefeldt challenges the guys on a rally course with his LS-swapped Subaru.

programme.title: Monte Carlo Surprise!
programme.desc: Newbern surprises Cotten with a mint 1984 G-body and an '80s-style, stock-car-inspired build to take on an actual former cup car around the circle track.

programme.title: Pro Street Mirada Makeover!
programme.desc: Cotten's Pro Street big-block 1980 Dodge Mirada's engine dies on Roadkill; things don't go as planned as the guys attempt to add a giant blower and bigger tires, and bring the car back to its 1990s-era glory.

programme.title: Funny Car Dirt Drags!
programme.desc: The guys transform a '73 Opel funny car into a dirt-roosting machine.

programme.title: Vette Kart vs. 700hp Truck!
programme.desc: The dream of long travel suspension on Roadkill's slightly modified Vette Kart finally comes true for the guys; Brad DeBerti helps them figure out how to not taco the front end as they take on a Pro2 truck on an off-road short course.

programme.title: A Mother's Intuition
programme.desc: With help from a handsome investigator, a brilliant sculptor unravels the twisted truth behind her missing newborn baby.

programme.title: Blood on Her Badge
programme.desc: A cop and a drug dealer join forces to commit a violent robbery.

programme.title: Feast of the Flesh
programme.desc: Manny goes missing during his secret five-year affair behind Exondia's back, crushing their plans to get married.

programme.title: AWOL Abduction
programme.desc: Elihue's disappearance uncovers a twisted ring of greed and deception that leads investigators face to face with pure evil.

programme.title: Shot to the Heart
programme.desc: Life resembles a fairytale come true for high school sweethearts Re'Mano and Eugenia Campbell.

programme.title: Lying in Wait
programme.desc: When a decorated Navy commander is found dead in a hotel room, those close to him suspect suicide; when autopsy results point to homicide, investigators sort through numerous lies to uncover a calculated plot fueled by lust and greed.

programme.title: Driven by Jealousy
programme.desc: When an up-and-coming rapper is killed in a hit-and-run in East Chicago, police suspect jealousy fueled the crime; the victim had multiple women in his life, but detectives soon realize the killer will do anything to get away with murder.

programme.title: Open to Love
programme.desc: With a bound body of a missing man recovered from the river, foul play becomes immediately obvious; detectives quickly uncover a dangerous love triangle, hidden bloodstains, and an informant who brings the twisted truth to light.

programme.title: Toxic Intentions
programme.desc: When a dedicated educator is found unresponsive in his home, family and friends are left puzzled by his unexpected passing; after receiving a tip suggesting his death was no accident, police uncover a sophisticated killer with a chilling motive.

programme.title: Demented Deception
programme.desc: When a young woman and the love of her life begin preparing a future together, they're struck by tragedy with a miscarriage; as the cracks between them begin to form, one woman will have to decide how far she'll go to create a perfect family.

programme.title: In Bad Faith
programme.desc: A woman's reunion with her high school sweetheart ends in tragedy after what appears to be a robbery-gone-wrong; when investigators dive in deeper, they discover a devilish plot driven by the woman's desires to appease a new man.

programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: A young woman who is desperate to live the life of the rich and famous meets a promising young rapper; they fall madly in love and are willing to do what it takes to achieve their goal of wealth and success.

programme.title: A Family Affair
programme.desc: When a young woman begins a family with the man of her dreams, everything seems perfect; after an argument with a neighbor goes too far and threatens her new family, she'll be faced with protecting her man or risking everything she holds dear.

programme.title: Level of Loyalty
programme.desc: A promising young woman with a passion for hip-hop finds her ride-or-die soul mate in a young up-and-coming rapper; when a petty feud turns deadly, she'll have to decide if she's all in for her man or if she's better off taking this ride alone.

programme.title: The Cost of Desire
programme.desc: When a close-knit family is brutally gunned down in their home, detectives initially suspect a botched business deal provoked the tragic massacre; as the investigation ensues, police uncover an apathetic killer motivated by greed and lust.

programme.title: Flames of Revenge
programme.desc: When a young teacher and animal lover abandons her dogs for days, her family knows something is wrong; during the search, investigators receive a tip from loved ones, leading them to investigate a tumultuous past that blows the case wide open.

programme.title: Kenyon Beaty
programme.desc: A casual summer morning turns deadly as a man is killed in a drive-by shooting; to solve this case, Quinn and Vince must build trust with the community and key witnesses to discover the leads they need to find the killer's true motive and identity.

programme.title: Eric Honea
programme.desc: Quinn and Vince are on the case when a man is found murdered in his truck in northwest Atlanta; when one eyewitness contradicts another, the detectives will have to sift through fact and fiction to bring this killer to justice.

programme.title: Blood for Blood
programme.desc: An up-and-coming rapper is shot while preparing for a music video; as authorities look into the shooting, they learn of other shootings that happened nearby earlier that day; they find that the rapper's death was a case of mistaken identity.

programme.title: Knoxville
programme.desc: When a beloved high school football player dies while shielding three girls from bullets in a random shooting, a city comes together to seek justice for a young life lost.

programme.title: Without a Word
programme.desc: When a mother of four disappears, detectives quickly suspect foul play; with little physical evidence to go on, it doesn't take long to realize that a complicated web of relationships may have played a role in why she vanished without a word.

programme.desc: A young woman down on her luck falls in love with an older man who swears to protect her; after a deadly encounter leaves a family member in critical condition, his protection may not be enough when his actions lead her down a deadly path.

programme.desc: A Baltimore mother reconnects with her childhood sweetheart, but she ends up in the middle of a criminal investigation; loyalty to her man may put the blame on her.

programme.title: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: A young woman dedicated to her boyfriend offers to help with an easy errand, but when the task doesn't go according to plan, her man decides to seek reparations; his plan wraps her into an investigation.

programme.title: Path of Vengeance
programme.desc: When a 26-year-old woman falls for a handsome 28-year-old, she believes she's found a man who will truly love and protect her; but when his protection comes with dire consequences, she'll have to weigh the cost of his security versus her own freedom.

programme.title: Deadly Arrangement
programme.desc: After achieving the American Dream, a beloved Egyptian mother is viciously killed in the night; as the motive for the murder hangs in the air, detectives are without a suspect, until a shocking development takes the case in a new direction.

programme.title: Love and Lies
programme.desc: A quiet community is rattled when a family is gunned down in the middle of the street, leaving a young mother dead; at first it looks like a hate crime, but soon police uncover the secrets and lies that were bound to tear this family apart.

programme.title: Lacharity Gaines
programme.desc: When a detective in New York calls Atlanta Police about a case, Quinn and Vince take the call; in doing so, the detectives reopen a cold case about a woman found dead in her apartment; to catch this killer, they'll need to take a trip to New York.

programme.title: Kenny Wimbush
programme.desc: A man is shot in broad daylight, and while eyewitnesses know the killer, they don't know his real name; Quinn and Vince will need to get an eyewitness to identify the killer before they can bring him in, but they still may not have the right guy.

programme.title: Driven by Revenge
programme.desc: In June 1995, residents of Colorado Springs are on edge after a seemingly random shooting leaves a man dead; after speaking with witnesses and family of the deceased, detectives discover this may be the result of a long-running feud turned violent.

programme.title: New York City
programme.desc: In 1989 in New York, a vicious assault on a female jogger sparks a racially driven witch-hunt for her attackers; police employ aggressive tactics to coerce confessions from five young men whose lives will change forever.

programme.title: Enraged by Envy
programme.desc: When a woman is found lying in a pool of blood in her kitchen, her siblings immediately suspect who is responsible; their lead adds surprising twists to the investigation, and detectives expose a fatal love triangle, violent pasts and deep rage.

programme.title: Hitler's Desert War
programme.desc: While the British army puts the Italian forces to rout, Hitler sends the Afrika Korps led by the general Rommel for help. The Desert fox keeps on winning battles until Montgomery, the British commander, sets up a plan to crush his opponent. After the American landing in North Africa the Axis armies have no choice but to surrender and put an end to the Desert War on May the 13rd of 1943.

programme.title: Rolling Power
programme.desc: The basic combat formation of the modern land army is the division. Divisions contain all of the elements needed to wage land combat including infantry, armor, artillery and other supporting arms. Divisions are substantial in size from 10,000 to 20,000 troops, nearly 500 armored vehicles and 2000 other vehicles.

programme.title: The Blitz the Bismarck and Barbarossa: April-June 1941
programme.desc: With Britain failing to fall, the Blitz drew to a close, the sinking of the German battleship, the Bismarck, lifted the spirits of the British Navy. Hitler's campaign for Russia, Operation Barbarossa, got underway, the course of World War II changed.

programme.title: Russian Roulette: July-September 1941
programme.desc: Hitler had expected a decisive victory in Russia, he was thwarted at every turn and while the Luftwaffe bombed Moscow and the Siege of Leningrad began, the Soviet Red Army refused to capitulate. They just watched and waited for the winter snows.

programme.title: Establishing the Beachhead
programme.desc: Landing Craft - Establishing Beachead. Silent film.

programme.title: Keeping the Railways Open
programme.desc: French civilians and U.S. Army engineers repair and salvage railroad yards, bridges, and trains.

programme.title: Floating Fortress
programme.desc: Mission of the battleship in Korea. Life aboard, and compartmentational operations.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Sir David reveals true stories of unbelievable heroism in World War II, in a world of cold-blooded assassins, crack saboteurs, elite commandos, playboy spies, super-villains and femmes fatales.

programme.title: Carey Mulligan
programme.desc: Carey Mulligan's grandfather Denzil Booth, travelled thousands of miles to fight the Japanese in the final months of the war. His university education meant Denzil was fast-tracked to be a junior officer in the Navy. He lost his closest friends on board the first ever ship to be attacked by a Japanese Kamikaze. Carey travels to Japan to understand the culture of the Kamikaze from the other side.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: In 1943, the Axis was on the defensive everywhere. In 1944, The Allies strength would grow in the East, and in the Soviet Union with the opening of the second front.

programme.title: Medal of Honor Winners
programme.desc: True stories of the Medal of Honor, the highest award for valor which can be bestowed upon an individual serving in the Armed Services of the United States.

programme.title: German Jets and Destroyers
programme.desc: Three years after the end of WW1, civil aviation was permitted in Germany and names that were later to spearhead military aircraft production emerged. Names such as Messerschmittt, Heinkel and Yunkers. This documentary discusses the rise of the top German Jets and Destroyers used in battle during WW2.

programme.title: Rough Riders
programme.desc: Speeding behind German lines the men of Troop A, in their armored cars and half-tracks left destruction and fear in their wake. Surprising the German garrison at the town of Epernay, they established an outpost from which they could defend a counter-attack. Outnumbered and outgunned with thirteen rounds of ammunition left, these brave GI's held this vital town until re-enforcements could arrive.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: Amidst WWII's war-torn skies, Soviet Major Bestuzhev defends the airdrome. A bond forms with comrade Zhenya, but facing overwhelming odds, they must protect their homeland, confronting fears in a narrative of sacrifice, courage, and camaraderie. As the air raid sirens wail, they delve deeper into the turmoil of war, discovering the true essence of duty and the resilience of the human spirit.

programme.title: A Century of Tanks
programme.desc: April 16, 1917, for the first time in history, French tanks fight their way through the black sludge of Chemin des Dames. One year before, in October, British tanks tried their luck in Somme. In both cases, the long-awaited miracle did not take place. Yet, a century later, the tanks are still here, monsters of technology that are becoming increasingly efficient.

programme.title: The Year 1944
programme.desc: Roosevelt, Churchill, and Stalin congregate at the Teheran Conference in 1943. U.S. troops land and fight on Kwajalein, Eniwetok, Saipan, Guam, and other Pacific islands. Russian troops advance to Romania and capture German soldiers. Paratroops jump at Caen. Citizens of Rome, Paris, Bucharest, Brussels, Belgrade, and Athens celebrate their liberation. F.D.R. addresses the United Nations.

programme.title: Japan Surrenders
programme.desc: Tokyo Bay, Japan. September 2, 1945. On board the USS Missouri, an American battleship. Several weeks ago, American atom bombs devastated Hiroshima and Nagasaki. Japan has capitulated. This morning at 9, eleven Japanese government and military officials climb aboard the Missouri to sign the surrender agreement.

programme.title: NEWSREEL FOOTAGE OF THE NAZI WAR CRIMINALS
programme.desc: Nazi war criminals are put on trial for their war crimes committed during WWII. This program covers various events from the Lublin Massacre, German atrocities in concentration camps and many others

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: A Soviet intelligence officer, long operating as Major Feller, flees the German rear with secret documents detailing enemy fortifications and mines. He links with partisans but they're trapped. Command merges Makeev's saboteurs with Zvonareva's unit: saboteurs seize an improvised German airfield while pilots land behind enemy lines to bring Feller to HQ.

programme.title: U-Boat Alert!
programme.desc: World War II at sea was marked by the rise of submarines, leading to fierce battles above and below the waves. Crews faced overcrowding and claustrophobia in these confined spaces. This technological evolution paved the way for modern submarines. Developed by Germany, submarines became as crucial to naval warfare as strategic bombers were to the skies, with other countries soon following suit.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Sir David reveals true stories of unbelievable heroism in World War II, in a world of cold-blooded assassins, crack saboteurs, elite commandos, playboy spies, super-villains and femmes fatales.

programme.title: Pilots at War
programme.desc: Watch as a B-17 Flying Fortress and its crew fights its way over Nazi occupied Europe, battling the enemy's ME-109s and FW-190s. Witness all the fear and excitement of air combat as fighters spit out machine gun fire and brave deadly ground fire.

programme.title: Happy New Year
programme.desc: The Germans launch a last desperate air and ground attack to coincide with the arrival of the last year of the war, and, whilst improved flying conditions enable the US air forces to bring added strength to the battle, the troops on the ground continue to suffer the effects of the coldest Belgian winter in history.

programme.title: Army Group Center
programme.desc: The Wehrmacht organized into 3 army groups for operation. North headed to Stalingrad, South, toward Ukraine, and centre towards the heartland of Russia. Led by General field marshall Fedor Von Bonk, a well known anti nazi, army group centre was the largest and best equipped of all 3 groups. It also contained Gen. Heinz Guderian, perhaps the most renowned commander of the 20th century.

programme.title: Carey Mulligan
programme.desc: Carey Mulligan's grandfather Denzil Booth, travelled thousands of miles to fight the Japanese in the final months of the war. His university education meant Denzil was fast-tracked to be a junior officer in the Navy. He lost his closest friends on board the first ever ship to be attacked by a Japanese Kamikaze. Carey travels to Japan to understand the culture of the Kamikaze from the other side.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: In 1943, the Axis was on the defensive everywhere. In 1944, The Allies strength would grow in the East, and in the Soviet Union with the opening of the second front.

programme.title: Adolf and Eva
programme.desc: The protracted romance between Adolf Hitler and Eva Braun began in 1929 and ended in 1945 in the bunker under the ruins of the Chancellery. Eva was Hitler's bride for less than 40 hours before she committed suicide.

programme.title: Big Picture: Atrocities in Korea
programme.desc: A documented report of Communist atrocities in Korea, with scenes just released depicting the horror and brutality of Communism. Includes interviews with returned prisoners of war who were eye witnesses to some of these atrocities and Major General William Dean and General Mark W. Clark.

programme.title: Duel in the Desert
programme.desc: In the Iraq War, flying in the desert poses unique difficulties - the dust storm that accompanies every landing and take-off - and the lack of places to hide. When a young Royal Navy pilot comes under fire from a tank, he soon finds himself engaged in a deadly game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: Why We Fight
programme.desc: As Hitler's ambitions spread beyond Germany, the world drew toward another great war - to be fought on many battlefields, and for the hearts and minds of the people.

programme.title: America at War: October-December: 1941
programme.desc: As Hitler focussed on Russia, the situation in the Pacific developed to epic proportions when the Japanese air force attacked the American Naval Fleet at Pearl Harbour on the 7th of December. This immediately brought the USA into the Theatre of War.

programme.title: The Fall of Singapore: January-March 1942
programme.desc: With Britain no longer facing Hitler alone, the first GIs arrived in the UK. As Singapore fell, the Allies looked on in horror as Japan also had control of Java, Burma and New Guinea, as they edged ever closer towards Australia.

programme.title: The Battle of Normandy
programme.desc: The Allied landings on D Day and the subsequent battles for control of Normandy.

programme.title: The SS: A Barbaric State
programme.desc: Among the defendants are the Führer's closest surviving accomplices. But not only them: defendant number 27 is not even a man. It is an entire organization: the SS were a state within the state - which ruled all the police - with its own army, within the Nazi regime.

programme.title: Episode Three
programme.desc: This 3-part program concludes with the liberation of the concentration caps and the arrests and trials of the surviving Nazi leaders for war crimes. The end of the Second World War.

programme.title: The Ultimate History of the Messerschmitt
programme.desc: In this program we look at the development of the Bf 109 which flew in all theaters of conflict in which the Luftwaffe was involved. More Bf 109s were built than any other fighter of the era. After the war the Spanish Air Force continued to operate them but powered by the engine of its great wartime adversary the Spitfire's Rolls Royce Merlin. Also featured are the ME 262, Bf110, and ME 169 Komet.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War: The Fall of France
programme.desc: When Hitler claimed restitution of Sudetenland, France and Britain abandoned their ally. Ignoring offers to help defend the Czechs, French leaders met with Hitler in Munich in Sep. 1938. Hitler performed like a statesmen, and French leaders signed a treaty that was in fact a death warrant for their own countries. Hitler felt that the floodgates were open and the wave became unstoppable.

programme.title: The Battle of Berlin: The Russians Are Coming
programme.desc: The advance of the Red Army towards Berlin in the final months of WWII.

programme.title: The Allies Forge On
programme.desc: 'Independence Day in Europe - In France, Eisenhower observes General Bradley fire a giant howitzer signaling our artillery into a massed crescendo of fire. Following the landing battles in Normandy, the Canadians return to the thick of the fighting at Cariquet. So severe that some Canadian camera crew were killed. In their sector, the Yanks are blazing through the hedge rows with grenade guns.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: Amidst enemy forces gathering, a Luftwaffe squadron guards above, raising suspicions of troop relocation. A pilot's sacrifice, underwater tanks, and strategists' debates add to tensions. The mission is to destroy the enemy crossing without battles. Pilots reflect on their future amid potential encirclement and lack of aviation devices.

programme.title: Big Picture: Korean Wind Up 1953
programme.desc: The end of the Korean War and a review of the United Nations that fought against the North.

programme.title: Triumphant on Land
programme.desc: Speed and strategy have always defined warfare. This episode explores the evolution of battlefield mobility-from chariots and cavalry to Humvees and tanks. Highlighting the most iconic and influential combat vehicles, including WWII's infamous tanks, we reveal how movement has been a decisive force in shaping tactics, winning battles, and revolutionizing modern war logistics.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Winter 1914. The first world conflict is becoming bogged down in the trenches. From now on, the war will no longer be solely on the ground. It will also be in the air. But the beginnings are difficult.

programme.title: Reinhard Heydrich
programme.desc: His fleet of U-boats killed thousands and sunk millions of tons of ships and supplies. His career spanned the depths of the ocean to the leader of a nation. At Nuremberg he was charged with piracy and murder as a Nazi War Criminal, and yet escaped the hangman. His story is now told, by both the historians and by the personal statements of those who served with him.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Lt. Kravtsov, a platoon commander, begins his active duty. The odds are against him, as lieutenants typically have only three days to live. Within this time, he must lead his troops in a futile attack, hoping to save the incoming regiment. Can he survive these three days?

programme.title: German Sniper Training
programme.desc: German Sniper Training.

programme.title: The Battle of Italy
programme.desc: The conquest of Italy from the Allied invasion through the various battles.

programme.title: Big Picture: The Korean Ceasefire Talks Begin
programme.desc: This program includes a tribute to the men of the Infantry from an officer who served with them as a platoon leader, Lieutenant Robert Fallon of Washington, D.C. Lieutenant Fallon points out the difficult but important job of the man carrying the rifle in combat. Captain Zimmerman interviews Master Sergeant Heidenreith, also of Washington, D.C. Sergeant Heidenreith was a combat engineer in Korea.

programme.title: Part 2: War on Hitler
programme.desc: During the war with the Soviet Union, 35mm color footage was used for Nazi propaganda. Hitler's pilot filmed his visit to the front lines. Meanwhile, Hollywood director John Ford captured stunning color scenes in North Africa. A camera crew, sent by President Roosevelt, recorded the 1943 Casablanca Conference, where the Allies demanded the unconditional surrender of Nazi Germany.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: 'Black Week' 1943 sees the worst casualties to date with missions bombing ever deeper into Germany. Veterans describe atrocities committed against captured aircrew, and The Mighty 8th set about crushing Nazi industry, preparing for invasion, destroying the Luftwaffe, reaching Berlin, smashing Hitler's Third Reich, and bringing to an end, the greatest conflict the world has ever known.

programme.title: U.X.B. Unexploded Bomb Disposal WWII England
programme.desc: A fascinating British Military Training Film dealing with the reconnaissance, identification, and reporting of unexploded bombs or U.X.B. during WWII. A interesting time capsule showing the horrors or The Blitz.

programme.title: German Armour: The Panzer III
programme.desc: It was Heinz Guderian who in 1934, gave specifications for 2 frontline tanks to be manufactured. The first was intended to be the main battle tank of the Panzer divisions capable of destroying enemy tanks. It was called the Panzer 3. Crewed by 5 men, its weight varied at around 20 tons during the campaign in the west, and achieved a top speed of 25 mph. Its main armament was a 37 mm canon.

programme.title: Big Picture: Army Transportation Corps
programme.desc: We follow the supplies from the factory to the depot in the U.S., to the port to the front line unit in Korea. We show the Port of Embarkation, small boats, the ducks, the rail lines, the trucks. And we show a new development of the TC... the helicopter transportation company in training.

programme.title: Africa: Our First Offensive
programme.desc: The Troops of Operation Torch come from the U.S. and Britain. U.S. industry is shown going to full war production. Equipment is shown being loaded up for transport to North Africa, and the landings are made successfully.

programme.title: The Secrets of the Weapons
programme.desc: From snake-infested jungles to treacherous underground tunnel complexes to city streets, U.S. Infantrymen had to fight in all terrains in Vietnam. Superb combat footage records the war as it raged both in the countryside and in the cities of Saigon and Hue during the Tet Offensive of 1968.

programme.title: Weapons of War: Combat on the Russian Front
programme.desc: Documentary charting the battles waged on the Russian Front in the Second World War. The events which occurred are seen by some as the most barbaric conflict in human history

programme.title: The Battle of Midway and Beyond: April-June 1942
programme.desc: The American Navy got back on course after Pearl Harbour, and in the four-day Battle for the Coral Sea, they claimed victory, before defeating Japan again in the decisive Battle of Midway. Elsewhere the Luftwaffe targeted more British cities.

programme.title: El Alamein to Stalingrad: July-September 1942
programme.desc: Hitler's 'Desert Fox', Rommel advanced at El Alamein, but with the arrival of British General, Bernard Montgomery, to lead the Eighth Army in North Africa, the wind of change was about to blow.

programme.title: Breakout from Normandy
programme.desc: American and German Supply Chain Personnel look back at the Allied breakout from Normandy in the weeks after D Day.

programme.title: The Capture of the Cherbourg Peninsular
programme.desc: Victory on Cherbourg Peninsula - 'Allied troops complete the conquest of the Cherbourg peninsula as reinforcements are flown in by air. 26,000 German prisoners were taken by the allies who either captured or destroyed the greater part of their equipment.'

programme.title: Big Picture: Army Transportation Corps
programme.desc: We follow the supplies from the factory to the depot in the U.S., to the port to the front line unit in Korea. We show the Port of Embarkation, small boats, the ducks, the rail lines, the trucks. And we show a new development of the TC... the helicopter transportation company in training.

programme.title: Exploring Hitler's Munich
programme.desc: Munich was closely tied to National Socialism, where the Nazi movement, SA, and SS were founded. Hitler called it the 'capital of the movement' and planned grandiose architectural projects. Though most plans weren't realized, landmarks like the 'Haus der Kunst' and parts of the party district still stand today. Rare footage shows Hitler visiting construction sites in Munich's transformed areas.

programme.title: Part 2: War on Hitler
programme.desc: During the war with the Soviet Union, 35mm color footage was used for Nazi propaganda. Hitler's pilot filmed his visit to the front lines. Meanwhile, Hollywood director John Ford captured stunning color scenes in North Africa. A camera crew, sent by President Roosevelt, recorded the 1943 Casablanca Conference, where the Allies demanded the unconditional surrender of Nazi Germany.

programme.title: Mastering Arms
programme.desc: Whether revered or reviled, the invention of the gun forever changed how wars are fought and won. From humble beginnings to a tool that built empires, toppled kingdoms, and killed millions, its story is one of power and evolution. This episode explores the gun's transformation over centuries and its influence on the battlefield, in politics, and in shaping the very course of human history.

programme.title: 1940 - Storm Over the Alps
programme.desc: The Alps Front, June 1940. A handful of French soldiers are about to face a flood of 300,000 Italians. Everywhere in France, you see defeat. The Government fled to Bordeaux on June 14th. While France is breaking down, General Olry and his men remain stationed on the Alps. During ten days of fierce battle, the Italians will lose more than 6,000 men without seizing an inch of French territory.

programme.title: Animals at War: Wild Heroes of World War II
programme.desc: Fifty million people died in the WWII, the biggest massacre in the history of humanity. But the animal kingdom also paid a heavy toll, despite no official numbers being compiled for the victims. This included combat animals, animals that backed up humans, those that entertained or consoled them, some that fed people, and other animals that were symbols.

programme.title: WWII War Diaries: 1945
programme.desc: In this final film of the series, '1945', the end of the war is now truly in sight. Yet there were still hurdles to overcome, and with the completion of the Battle of the Bulge still to test the Allies, the race for Berlin was on. Discover what happened in Hitler's final hours and enjoy the VE Day celebrations with Winston Churchill and the people of Britain as the dream of victory became reality.

programme.title: The Stuka
programme.desc: From the moment of the Germany invasion of Poland in 1940, to the downfall of the Third Reich in 1945, one plane was synonymous with the terror and destruction caused by the Luftwaffe during WW2. The infamous Yunkers U87, a dive bomber. There were other dive bombers, but only the U87 was known by the British as and feared, named by the abbreviation - The Stuka.

programme.title: Africa: Our First Offensive
programme.desc: The Troops of Operation Torch come from the U.S. and Britain. U.S. industry is shown going to full war production. Equipment is shown being loaded up for transport to North Africa, and the landings are made successfully.

programme.title: The Air War on Japan
programme.desc: An in-depth look at the air war over Japan during WWII, including the Doolittle Raid, B-29 attacks, and the nuclear bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

programme.title: Scorched Earth: Propaganda
programme.desc: There are many weapons of war; fighter planes, heavy tanks and skilled infantrymen but it could be argued that none is more powerful than the power of suggestion. Propaganda and the war of words played an undoubtedly vital role in both the successes and failures of WW2. Governments struggled to gain the upper hand. But one Nazi proved to have a deft talent for spin. Joseph Goebbels.

programme.title: Triumphant on Land
programme.desc: Speed and strategy have always defined warfare. This episode explores the evolution of battlefield mobility-from chariots and cavalry to Humvees and tanks. Highlighting the most iconic and influential combat vehicles, including WWII's infamous tanks, we reveal how movement has been a decisive force in shaping tactics, winning battles, and revolutionizing modern war logistics.

programme.title: Hitler's Big Guns
programme.desc: Ground-breaking 3D graphics and state-of-the-art computer animation provide some of the highlights in this authoritative, entertaining look at the great German siege guns of World War Two. The programme features extraordinary archive footage culled from German and Allied sources and all-new footage of surviving examples of German heavy artillery.

programme.title: Waking a Sleeping Giant
programme.desc: The 1930's bring remarkable advances in military flight and provide Germany and Japan with decisive advantages in the air as World War II begins. The Germans pound London in the Battle of the Blitz while Japanese naval aviation brings the United States into the war with the attack on Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: Crossing the Rhine
programme.desc: The Allies cross the Rhine River into Germany in the early part of 1945. The Canadians cross in February, followed by the Americans and British, with the Americans taking Cologne and crossing river at Remagen. Winston Churchill visits the front and crosses the river himself in a landing boat.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Lt. Kravtsov, a platoon commander, begins his active duty. The odds are against him, as lieutenants typically have only three days to live. Within this time, he must lead his troops in a futile attack, hoping to save the incoming regiment. Can he survive these three days?

programme.title: Air Defense & Surveillance - Helicopters
programme.desc: In the early 1480s, Leonardo Da Vinci designed an aerial screw. Its intended use was unknown, yet served as the inspiration for the helicopter. Developments over the years have seen the Helicopter becoming more involved in troop transport, including airlifting the wounded directly to hospitals. Today's attack Helicopters show the versatility of this war machine.

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: A woman's carefully constructed life gets upended when an unwelcome shadow from her past returns, forcing her to confront the monster she's evaded for two decades.

programme.title: Surveillance
programme.desc: A seemingly normal security guard (Armand Assante) reveals a sinister side.

programme.title: Terminal
programme.desc: In the dark heart of a sprawling and anonymous city, two assassins carry out a sinister mission, a teacher battles a fatal illness, an enigmatic janitor and a curious waitress lead a dangerous double life. Murderous consequences unravel in the dead of night as their lives all intertwine at the hands of a mysterious criminal mastermind who is hell-bent on revenge.

programme.title: The Tax Collector
programme.desc: Two enforcers for a crime lord face an uncertain future when an old rival reappears.

programme.title: True History of the Kelly Gang
programme.desc: An exploration of Australian bushranger Ned Kelly and his gang as they attempt to evade authorities during the 1870s.

programme.title: Official Secrets
programme.desc: One day in 2003, in the lead up to the Iraq War, British intelligence specialist Katharine Gun receives a memo from the NSA with a shocking directive: the United States is enlisting Britain's help in collecting compromising information on U.N. Security Council members to blackmail them into voting in favor of an invasion of Iraq. Unable to stand by and watch the world be rushed into war, Gun makes the gut-wrenching decision to defy her government and leak the memo to the press.

programme.title: Queen of Earth
programme.desc: Tensions rise when an emotionally fragile woman (Elisabeth Moss) spends one week with her best friend (Katherine Waterston).

programme.title: White Elephant
programme.desc: When two cops witness an assassination attempt, a ruthless crime boss orders Gabriel Tancredi, an ex-Marine turned mob enforcer, to eliminate any and all threats. With an eager underling out to prove himself, rival gangs making moves, and a rising body count, every step Tancredi makes threatens lives -- including his own.

programme.title: A Score to Settle
programme.desc: Diagnosed with a fatal condition, a mob enforcer leaves prison after 19 years and plots a bloody course of revenge against his old gang.

programme.title: Dead Mail
programme.desc: A post office employee investigates the mysterious origins of a blood-stained note that was sent by a captive man.

programme.title: Nitram
programme.desc: Living a life of isolation and frustration, a young man develops an unexpected friendship with a reclusive heiress. When that relationship meets its tragic end, his loneliness and anger culminates into the most nihilistic and heinous of acts.

programme.title: Rust Creek
programme.desc: Sawyer is an ambitious, overachieving college senior who has a seemingly bright future. While on her way to a job interview, a wrong turn leaves her stranded deep in the frozen forest. Suddenly, the young woman who has everything to live for finds herself facing her own mortality as she's punished by the elements and pursued by a band of ruthless outlaws. With nowhere left to run, she is forced into an uneasy alliance with an enigmatic loner who has shadowy intentions.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in Venice
programme.desc: Steve Ford is a private detective in Venice Beach, Calif., who's good with the ladies, bad with the punches and wild about his dog Buddy. When local thugs steal Buddy, Ford turns to Spyder, their devious leader, and forges an unlikely alliance. With help from his best friend, Steve pulls out the big guns to retrieve Spyder's stolen cash and cocaine and save Buddy.

programme.title: Dog Eat Dog
programme.desc: Ex-cons, Troy (Nicolas Cage), Mad Dog (Willem Dafoe) and Diesel (Christopher Matthew Cook), are hired by an eccentric mob boss to kidnap a baby and hold it for a large ransom. When the abduction goes awry, the men find themselves on the run from the mob and the cops. Vowing to stay out of prison at all costs, getting away with the crime is a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The Nightingale
programme.desc: Clare, a young Irish convict, chases a British officer through the rugged Tasmanian wilderness and is bent on revenge for a terrible act of violence the man committed against her family. On the way, she enlists the services of Aboriginal tracker Billy, who is marked by trauma from his own violence-filled past.

programme.title: The Stanford Prison Experiment
programme.desc: In 1971, Stanford's Professor Philip Zimbardo (Billy Crudup) conducts a controversial psychology experiment in which college students pretend to be either prisoners or guards, but the proceedings soon get out of hand.

programme.desc: An assassin on his last assignment travels to Fuerteventura to kill a man he's never met.

programme.desc: We head to Utah to go off-grid with an X-Games gold medalist who is also an amputee. We also test Far Out Camping Co.'s unique rig in Oregon and tell you all about Honda's Transalp adventure bike.

programme.desc: We head to Baja to test a race UTV, then head to Arizona for another incredible off-road adventure. Our crew also tests Sun Lite's 14 THX toy hauler trailer. This is a cool concept that offers so much versatility.

programme.title: Off-Road Travel TV - Jeep Project, Custom Van Build, Bali Off-Road Adventure
programme.desc: Our crew builds two project vehicles including a Jeep Wrangler and Mercedes Sprinter Vans. These are loaded with high-tech gadgets. We also head to Bali for unique off-road adventure and the sights will leave you breathless.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ - Cornwell Tools and 20 Years of Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey is not only showcasing 20 years of a how-to show, but also the tools that make it happen; he dives into the world of video games and pinball to show where they started, where they went and where they are now.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ - Stripping Paint and Restoring Panels and Parts
programme.desc: Ins and outs of stripping paint and what you might expect to see once it's done; next, Stacey walks through the steps of restoring headlight buckets.

programme.title: The Power Wagon Rules
programme.desc: Stacey digs into the unique history of how a WWII vehicle became the first mass-produced civilian 4x4 truck; he upgrades the electrical and fuel systems on a '49 Power Wagon, so you can drive it safely.

programme.title: The National Museum of Military Vehicles
programme.desc: Stacey visits the National Museum of Military Vehicles to check out the gear that shaped history and some of the veteran outreach programs that people can get involved with.

programme.title: The Great Crate Debate
programme.desc: Crate engine or old school; Stacey walks you through how to choose the right components to put together a special drivetrain that performs or looks the way you want it to; he drops one in his '59 Apache pickup!

programme.title: Power Wagon - A New Day Dawning...The Rist of the M6GT
programme.desc: The M6GT is back, but now she's a running, driving car, and a prototype of the car that is available from Retroformance; Stacey goes through the design, development and trial and error it takes to bring a new component car to the market.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ -- Mustang Transmission Swap
programme.desc: Stacey takes an old, beat-up '66 Mustang and puts some pep back in its step; he shows you how to replace an old automatic transmission with a quick-shifting Tremec T5 5-speed and how to lift an old cab or body off a frame without destroying it.

programme.title: Show Truck With a Diesel Twist and Capping a Gladiator
programme.desc: Stacey looks at a new twist on tool storage and sets up a Jeep Gladiator for your outdoor adventure needs!

programme.title: The Stunt Double Final Reveal
programme.desc: The Stunt Double is back in the shop for its reveal and payoff; inspired by the FALL GUY truck, the Stunt Double is a ground up, frame off build of a square body Chevy truck that pays tribute to the stunt world.

programme.title: The Mod Rod, Stripping and Prepping a Cab
programme.desc: Stacey rolls in one of the show cars of the 1970s, the Mod Rod; after that, he shows how to properly disassemble the cab or body of your project and pre-fit some new components at the same time.

programme.title: Hechos son amores y no buenas razones
programme.desc: Una mujer es presa del alcoholismo y no logra ver lo que su nuevo novio quiere hacerles a sus hijas. El novio de la joven esposa entrena mujeres solas y secuestra a sus hijos para forzarlas a ser mulas del narcotráfico.

programme.title: Me he de Comer esa Tuna
programme.desc: Dos mujeres mayores pelean por el amor de Tomás, el dueño del café El Dicho. Isabel, su nieta, se pone muy celosa de ver que su abuelo podría fijarse en otra mujer a pocos meses de la muerte de su abuela.

programme.title: Brasa trae en el seno, la que cría hijo ajeno
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su esposa, un hombre planea casarse con su antigua secretaria, quien está decidida a matar a sus hijos para quedarse sola con él. Es por eso que la hija del hombre y su abuela emprenden una misión para desenmascararla.

programme.title: Cuchillo que no corta y amigo que no aporta, si se pierde no importa
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes son amigos desde la infancia, pero uno de ellos encuentra refugio en las drogas, por lo que su amigo buscará salvarlo.

programme.title: Compadre que no llega a las caderas
programme.desc: Un hombre conquista mujeres al por mayor, al hacerles creer ilusiones y dejarlas enamoradas. Un día encuentra su verdadero amor y esta le pide tener hijos, él se niega rotundamente, pues teme perder su libertad.

programme.title: No es buena la venganza
programme.desc: Una chica planea vengarse de su exnovio diciéndole toda la verdad a su esposa. La esposa al enterarse de la verdad planea poner cara a cara a la amante y a su marido.

programme.title: Vale más ladrón arrepentido
programme.desc: Mauro sale del reclusorio y con la ayuda de Don Tomás, decide regresar al pueblo con su familia. Al llegar se encuentra con la indiferencia de su padre, quien nunca creyó en su inocencia. Mauro se da cuenta de que Jacinto no es de fiar.

programme.title: De los parientes como sol
programme.desc: Pedro queda viudo justo cuando su mujer acababa de tener un hijo. Tras este terrible suceso, su hermano y su esposa intentan aprovecharse de él. Después de un tiempo se da cuenta de que su hermano no hace nada y se está aprovechando de él.

programme.desc: Los papás de Paulina discuten muy seguido por la avaricia de su mamá. Su madre decide mudarse a la casa de su padre después de años de no saber nada de él. Aida le impone a su hija sacarle provecho a las cosas que su abuelo puede comprarle.

programme.desc: Un joven es desalojado de su casa porque su madre la hipotecó y nunca hizo ningún pago. Su madre sufre un accidente y pierde la memoria; él cree que lo abandonó, sus vecinos lo ayudan y le dan hospedaje en su casa.

programme.desc: Un joven se siente presionado por su amigo y por su hermano mayor para experimentar con su sexualidad. Al saber que su madre está de viaje, organiza una fiesta en su casa.

programme.title: Lo que mal empieza, mal acaba
programme.desc: Silvia se enamora de Leonardo, un hombre engreído y flojo. Silvia se entera que su novio se casará con otra mujer porque está embarazada. Tiempo después Leonardo busca nuevamente a Silvia tras divorciarse de su esposa, para proponerle que regresen.

programme.title: Más vale solo
programme.desc: Javier, un diseñador lleno de sueños y proyectos, trabaja con su novia. Juntos trabajan en un proyecto que les dará reconocimiento a su agencia de publicidad. Javier, enamorado de su Lulú, desea formalizar su compromiso.

programme.title: Donde entra mucho vino
programme.desc: Una joven incita a su mejor amiga a consumir alcohol para agradarle a un chico, pero ella bebe en exceso y el joven abusa de ella. Las chicas se dan cuenta de los peligros de consumir alcohol y buscan ayuda.

programme.title: El que es buen gallo
programme.desc: Una joven va a una audición para una película y canta una canción que ella escribió, pero el director trata de aprovecharse de ella. El director de la película le roba la canción a la joven y la registra como suya, pero ella logra desenmascararlo.

programme.title: No hay mal
programme.desc: Patricio tiene que abandonar a su familia para ir a trabajar al norte. Martín, su hijo se molesta, pues no comprende la situación. El hermano de Patricio busca a su familia para quedarse a vivir con ellos y apoyarlos.

programme.title: Nunca es tarde
