Venturing into the jungle, they work on a coffee plantation and discover why Costa Rica is the world's leading exporter of pineapples.

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Pork Chops and Pineapple Upside-down Cake
programme.desc: The key to every fabulous entrée, is a fabulous sauce. Chef Stellino guides you through a the simple preparation of an elegant sauce for your everyday meal. A blast from the past ,a sweet upside-down pineapple cake that will rekindle your memory and seduce your palate.

programme.title: Serial Griller - All the Courses
programme.desc: In "All the Courses," Matt Moore celebrates East Nashville's Tomato Fest with a feast-Breakfast Pizzette, Tuna Nicoise, Scored Flank Steak with Dijon Caper Sauce, and Grilled Watermelon. A multi-course grilling adventure with Southern flair!

programme.title: Serial Griller - Hot Handhelds
programme.desc: Matt Moore kicks off Serial Griller with "Hot Handhelds," grilling up bold favorites like Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwiches, Pork Gyros, char-grilled hot dogs, wings with blue cheese, and the juicy Hemingway Burger. No forks required!

programme.title: Serial Griller - Friends and Family
programme.desc: Matt Moore grills for friends, serving sausage, blade steaks, redneck potatoes, and a Bardstown Buck cocktail.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller - How to make real Victorian sugar plums
programme.desc: Max reveals that sugar plums are sugar-coated confections, not fruit, tracing their history from 1600s England to the Victorian era, including use as medicine and cannonball names. He recreates an 1865 cherry sugar plum recipe, showing the 3-day process of drying cherries, coating with gum arabic and sugar syrup, and adding color for the final treat.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Eating like a Lighthouse Keeper from the 1800's
programme.desc: Max explores lighthouse keeper life via an 1881 provisioning list and period recipes. He covers the isolated, demanding job-cleaning Fresnel lenses with mercury, trimming wicks, and cooking with limited supplies like flour, beans, and salt pork. Featuring keepers Henry Long, Mary Ryan, and Hannah Thomas, he recreates Fannie Farmer's 1896 Boston corn chowder with pilot bread.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller - An Alcatraz Prisoner's Meal
programme.desc: Max explores Alcatraz's surprisingly good food program (1934-1963) via a Women's Club cookbook. He covers Warden Johnston's use of nutrition for order, the mess hall as a riot risk, coveted kitchen jobs, and the 1950 "Spaghetti Riot." He recreates stuffed pork chops, evaporated milk cucumber salad, and quickie apple pie-better than most U.S. prisons' meals.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What Troops Ate On D-Day
programme.desc: Max explores D-Day meals, from pre-invasion steak and lemon meringue pie to the pivotal breakfast of eggs and bacon, K rations, D bars, and British 24-hour assault packs. He covers seasickness, paratroopers trading chocolate for eggs, and 48-hour hunger gaps, featuring stories from USS LCI 94 skipper "Popeye" and soldiers miming chicken for eggs.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Brewing Mesopotamian Beer
programme.desc: Max recreates ancient Sumerian beer using the 4,000-year-old *Hymn to Ninkasi*, detailing a week-long process with soaked barley, bappir bread, malting, crushing, and fermentation with aromatics and date syrup. He explores beer varieties, tavern laws, its role in commerce, and mythology like the drunken tale of Enki and Inanna. The nutty, effervescent brew lasts 2-3 days.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller - The Black Mead of Medieval France
programme.desc: Step back in time and discover the rich, smoky flavors of bochet, an ancient style of mead once crafted in medieval France. In this episode, we explore the fascinating process behind "black mead," where honey is slowly caramelized before fermentation, transforming its color, aroma, and taste into something deep, complex, and unlike traditional mead.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller - A History of Ice Cream: A Recipe from 1789
programme.desc: Max recreates parmesan cheese ice cream from Frederick Nutt's 1789 *Complete Confectioner*. The episode traces ice cream from Roman snow cones to Persian sharbat, Italian sorbetto, and frozen custards. He covers cream cheese molds ("fromage glacé"), key figures like Procopio and Nancy Johnson, and ice cream's rise in America via presidents and soda fountains.

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Medieval Irish Food: Peasant to King
programme.desc: Max recreates Medieval Irish corned beef and cabbage from *The Vision of Mac Con Glinne* (c. 1100) with onion-leek pottage. He explores Ireland's rigid food hierarchy-peasants ate grains and salted meat, butter signified wealth, monks preferred game, nobles had fresh meat-and cultural practices like fosterage, the 7-year child-rearing system, and a satirical poem about King Cathal's gluttony.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Danube River Adventure | Part 1
programme.desc: Set sail with Chef Walter Staib on a two-part adventure down the majestic Danube River! Part 1 charts a course through Germany and Austria, exploring stunning valleys amidst Europe's heart. Discover historic sites, artistic treasures, and culinary delights at every stop along this unforgettable journey.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Danube River Adventure | Part 2
programme.desc: Our journey continues through Austria, Slovakia, and ending in the Hungarian city of Budapest. We'll marvel at architectural wonders and savor the flavors of the region with Chef Walter Staib as he prepares traditional meals aboard a luxurious cruise ship. Don't miss this unforgettable finale on the mighty Danube!

programme.title: A Taste of History - Nourished by Nature | St. John's, Newfoundland
programme.desc: Journey to St. John's, Newfoundland, to discover the deep connection locals have with nature's bounty, and meet inspiring individuals who fish, farm, and cook with generations of tradition. Savor unique recipes prepared over crackling fire-pits, including the king of St. John's cuisine: cod.

programme.title: A Taste of History - A Pioneer Palate | Colorado Springs
programme.desc: Join Chef Walter Staib on a journey to Colorado Springs, where we'll explore the history of this scenic landscape, from the indigenous Ute people through the era of homesteaders. At the Historic Rock Ledge Ranch, savor delicious recipes that have withstood the test of time. Don't miss out on this opportunity to experience the flavors and heritage of Colorado Springs!

programme.title: A Taste of History - Dushi Delights & Beachside Bites | Curacao, Caribbean
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib visits Curacao to unravel the delicious stories behind this vibrant Caribbean island. We'll meet local chefs who share their culinary passion through mouthwatering dishes like stewed papaya, okra soup, and stuffed Dutch cheese. Unforgettable flavors and island adventures await as we explore Curacao's heritage and unique cuisine, making this an episode you won't want to miss!

programme.title: A Taste of History - Coastal Texas Treasure | Port Aransas, Texas
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib dives into the coastal bounty of Port Aransas, Texas! Discover legendary fishing tales, explore the vibrant local culture, and savor unique seafood creations with Chef Pete Mims. Experience how Texas spices meet Gulf Coast flavors in a culinary adventure that blends tradition and innovation. Join us for an unforgettable journey through the rich, diverse tastes of coastal Texas.

programme.title: A Taste of History - History, Horses, & Hospitality | Nashville, Tennessee
programme.desc: Saddle up for Southern charm as Chef Walter Staib rides through Nashville's history at Belle Meade Mansion. Explore the melodic roots of Country Music, visit iconic landmarks, and whip up delicious Southern eats like Country ham, fruitcake, and syllabub. Experience Nashville's rich cultural heritage and culinary delights in this captivating journey.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Rice & Resilience | Charleston, South Carolina
programme.desc: Unveil Charleston's soul as we explore the layers of its history at the International African American Museum and a Lowcountry rice farm. Learn crabbing secrets from a local pro, then cook with a passionate chef, celebrating Southern staples of the local cuisine.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - The Breakfast Show
programme.desc: The Breakfast Show: Whether you're hosting guests or seeking a reason to get out of bed, this show amps up your breakfast game by firing up the grill. First, a spectacular breakfast pizza. Next, a supremely satisfying grilled vegetable frittata. Finally, the most outrageous cinnamon rolls we've ever tasted from executive chef Russel Cunningham of St. Louis' Union Station.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Raichlen's Rules: Seafood
programme.desc: Raichen's Rules: Seafood: Seventy percent of the earth is covered with water and yet, the combination of live fire and seafood can be a grillers worst nightmare. For this season's Raichlen's Rules, we've decided to ease your anxiety. A lot of people are intimidated by the prospect of grilling seafood, but by strategically picking the method, fire can make the bounty of the sea wondrous.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Game Day Grill
programme.desc: Game Day Grill: No one knows what spectators ate at the first Olympic games, held in ancient Greece in 776 BCE, but today's sports fans and grill fanatics like to celebrate their obsession with a barbecue. Tailgating favorites come hot off the grill in this episode as we tackle Project Fire Rib Wings, Buffalo Brisket Burnt Ends, and a Balkan Mixed Grill with some special guests.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Sandwiches Hit the Grill
programme.desc: Sandwiches Hit the Grill: It's a simple formula: bread + protein + condiment, but it adds up to a triple decker of pleasure. In today's show, the sandwich hits the grill. From a glorious BLT made with home cured and smoked bacon, to pan bagnat-a magisterial grilled tuna sandwich inspired by the French Cote d'Azur. And then it's a sandwich for dessert in a Project Fire mystery box.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - The Mediterranean Grill
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Grill: Physicians have long extolled the virtues of the Mediterranean diet. Today the healthy foods and vibrant flavors of the Mediterranean hit the grill when Steven grills Sicilian grilled artichokes and branzino stuffed with fennel stalks. Then there's Greek grilled baby lamb chops with ember roasted potatoes prepared by friend and host of My Greek Table, Diane Kochilas.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Water Meets Fire
programme.desc: For many, barbecue means meat. But you may be surprised to learn that one of the earliest recorded barbecues featured fish wrapped in grape leaves. Today Steven begins with saffron-scented Catalan shrimp kebabs, followed by trout Mexican style with a sizzling garlic cilantro sauce. Then there's a Mystery Box that will astonish you as much as it surprised Steven.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Wagyu Demystified
programme.desc: Wagyu Demystified: Wagyu, "Japanese cow" literally, was once an obscure cattle breed from Japan. Today, it's on restaurant menus and in butcher shops around the world. Get ready for a sumptuous Japanese A5 Rib-Eye with sesame salt and grilled rice cakes, followed by wagyu steak tomahawks with fire-roasted marrow. Then feast your eyes on wagyu smash burgers with parmesan crisps.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Influential Grilling
programme.desc: Influential Grilling: Scroll through the images on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok, and you'll find grilled and smoked dishes of astonishing ingenuity. In the spirit of this new style of barbecue, we've invited three of my favorite influencers to grill with me - Derek Wolf from Over the Fire Cooking, Scott Thomas from Grillin' Fools, and Susie Bulloch from Hey Grill Hey.

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Black Cod with Mango and Ginger Sauce and Sautéed Green Beans
programme.desc: Chef Stellino shares his sauce making secrets, to inspire the viewers with this elegant and sophisticated Mango and Ginger sauce that is easy to make and tastes delicious! He also shares some important fact about the uniqueness of the Black cod and his step by step secrets on how to plate this dish with the refined elegance of a professional chef.

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Stuffed Meatloaf and Cake with Rum Sauce!
programme.desc: Meatloaf when done right can be a work of art, something worthy of the finest restaurant. It is all about technique and it is never hard to do right. Chef Stellino re-interprets for his viewers a fabulous Sicilian recipe from his youth and in the process he shares with them a series of foolproof techniques for getting done right every time.

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Chops with Port & Gorgonzola Sauce and Ricotta Cheesecake
programme.desc: Cooking the perfect pork chop and preparing the ultimate sauce with port and Gorgonzola is a easy as 1-2-3! Making the perfect ricotta cheesecake is even easier. Chef Stellino loves to share his tips and techniques with a passionate delivery and easy to follow instructions.

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Sizzling Shrimp Dishes
programme.desc: How not to overcook shrimp!! Chef Stellino guides the viewer though a series of tips and techniques on how to make incredibly flavorful shrimp recipes which are fool proof and look and taste like a million dollars.

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Ultimate Steak Dinner
programme.desc: Some call this the ultimate dinner, a perfectly cooked NY steak with a Vodka martini sauce! Chef Stellino once again shares all of his secrets in the making a an iconic sauce , the perfect accompaniment to the king of steaks: The New York. Then to sum it all up he shares with us a lusciously sweet, easy to make dessert of pears braised with Marsala!

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Luscious Soups!
programme.desc: A soup can be a form of art! Chef Stellino shares his secrets for the perfect soups, smooth , luscious and elegant. Plus he shows the viewers a series of simple techniques to create elegant topping to dress it all up. Simple clear instructions with step by step demonstrations on how to get it done in one try!

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Grilled Shrimp with Peppers and Tuna with Tomato Salad
programme.desc: A great dish does not have to be difficult to make in order to taste great! Fresh ingredients and simple techniques are at the core of these fabulously, delicious recipes. Chef Stellino guides the viewers along each step with humor and passion. He also shares his plating techniques that will help the viewers enhance the look of their finished dishes.

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Pork Chops and Pineapple Upside-down Cake
programme.desc: The key to every fabulous entrée, is a fabulous sauce. Chef Stellino guides you through a the simple preparation of an elegant sauce for your everyday meal. A blast from the past ,a sweet upside-down pineapple cake that will rekindle your memory and seduce your palate.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Essential Pastas of Rome
programme.desc: Sara kicks off with a street food tour in Rome led by American Ex Pat Katie Parla. Then, they perform a Roman hat trick - three pastas starting with the same delicious base: Gricia made with guanciale transforms into Amatriciana by adding tomatoes or Carbonara by adding eggs. In her own kitchen, Sara makes baked penne with prosciutto and Fontina cheese.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Vegetariano Italiano
programme.desc: Saras and her guest Cristina Bowerman go on a delicious journey through Cristina's Trastevere neighborhood to pick up ingredients for Cristina's meatless Celeriac and Orange pizza topped with tea and herb oil. In her own kitchen, Sara makes a Spaghetti Squash pasta with walnuts and a creamy goat cheese sauce. Plus, an American in Rome living the dream as a food photographer.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Pizza and Lemons: Naples to Sorrento
programme.desc: In Naples, Sara unlocks the secret recipe for the best Neapolitan pizza at the famous Gino Sorbillos. Fried meat filled pizza may be even better than that, or is the best one a unique star shaped pizza? Just across the bay in Sorrento it's all lemons, all the time as Sara visits a proud family of lemon growers. They make a citrus flecked cheese and Grandma's Lemon Pasta.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Bounty of Parma
programme.desc: Parma, Italy is home to Parmesan cheese, Prosciutto di Parma and some of the best tomatoes in Italy. All three go into a dish Sara cooks with a local chef. You won't find a quicker weeknight meal than his fancy sounding Tagliatelle con Crema di Parmigiana Passata. Sara's Parsley and Asparagus salad makes it a meal. Later, Sara cooks with Italian American chef Joey Campanaro.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Cheese Please
programme.desc: How do you make any dish even more delicious? Just add cheese! To prove the point Sara's got two recipes: a French Onion Soup Burger topped with melty, gooey cheese and an equally gooey Alsatian Onion Pie with caramelized onions and melted Gruyere that puts it over the top. Later, we visit a dairy farm and then on 'Ask Sara', an easy homemade ricotta.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Weeknight Two for One
programme.desc: Sara's strategy for easy weeknight cooking? Simply cook a dish one night, then repurpose it into a different meal for another night. Maya Kaimal joins Sara to make Turkey Keema with sweet potatoes and ground meat. On another night, that morphs into Indian stuffed peppers. Then Sara Sautee's Duck Breasts for a quick meal. She uses those same Duck Breasts in a mouthwatering Peking Duck Wrap.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Festive Feasts
programme.desc: Holidays and special occasions call for showstopping main courses that take a little extra time. Vegetarians, this one's for you - Sara's elegant Butternut Squash and Date Crostata. Then it's Sara's crispy Roast Duck with Duck Fat Popovers. Also a feature on a woman who is saving the recipes of Italian grandmothers she calls 'Pasta Grannies'.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Sketches of Spain
programme.desc: In Spain, paella is so popular there are competitions between towns for the best recipe. It is especially so in Valencia, where Sara cooks with local chef Franck Garanger. If we didn't have you at Paella, just wait for the dinner where it's eaten right out of the pan with special rules for pilfering your dinner partners portion. Then, Sara sautés fish topped with a colorful Gazpacho Vinaigrette.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Wrangler Tailgate
programme.desc: Wrangler Tailgate. Since picnickers in 1869 ate food from buckboards of horse-drawn wagons, Americans have loved tailgating. Now the party goes global, with pulled lamb from a wood-burning smoker at Odys & Penelope in L.A. Honey Soy Chicken Wings on skewers and Brisket Tacos, make magisterial main dishes. True global tailgating, with a Peruvian potato salad with chili-spiked cheese sauce.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Extreme Grilling
programme.desc: Extreme Grilling. Long before grills, charcoal, rotisseries, and planchas, there was fire! We visit L.A.'s Chi SPACCA, for a monster pork tomahawk grilled over wood by chef Ryan DeNicola. Extreme grilling with salmon steaks, smoky, on a shovel in a blazing campfire. Caveman-style pork chops directly on blazing embers with a sizzling poblano pan-fry and decadent brownies on a cedar plank.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Grilling 24/7
programme.desc: Grilling 24/7. The world's pit masters, fire up grills, smokers, or wood-burning ovens for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and late night snacks. For breakfast, farm eggs grilled with Parmesan, and prosciutto. For lunch, pizzas from the Industrial Eats in Buellton, CA. Pastrami Beef Ribs make a spectacular supper, and midnight snack of smoky, salty South African Grilled Cheese sandwiches.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - One Good Turn
programme.desc: One Good Turn. Rotisserie grilling or spit-roasting combines the smoky sear of grilling with the heat of roasting. Add 3 more benefits: basting, no flare-ups, and the fragrance of wood smoke. Game hens acquire golden, crackling-crisp skin. Spare ribs are given the huli-huli (turn-turn) treatment. Wings get a sweet-salty, lacquer-like glaze. Finally, a whole spinning, sugar-crusted pineapple.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Grill Top Cocktail Party
programme.desc: We reinvent the cocktail party, with the power of live fire to take finger food over the top with rum and citrus-glazed jumbo shrimp grilled on sugarcane, "finger-burner" lamb chops from Spain and Smoked Nectarine Bellinis to keep conversation flowing. Sommelier Kristine Bocchino shares suggestions for three great wines to serve at the party.

programme.title: MIX - Beef & Bourbon
programme.desc: Tamee visits LOCK AND KEY SOCIAL DRINKERY & KITCHEN in Downey CA. Bourbon & beef are the pride of this neighborhood hangout where the specialties of the house are a 4O ounce Tomahawk Steak and the Billionaire Cocktail.

programme.title: Almazan Kitchen - Carolina Reaper Cheeseburger, Meatloaf
programme.desc: Carolina Reaper Cheeseburger and Meatloaf

programme.title: Almazan Kitchen - Crispy Pork, Wrapped Chicken
programme.desc: Crispy Pork and Wrapped Chicken

programme.title: Almazan Kitchen - Tomahawk Steak, Deep Fried Steak Sandwich
programme.desc: Tomahawk Steak and Deep Fried Steak Sandwich

programme.title: Almazan Kitchen - Horse Pizzas, Rope Tacos, Cheese & Egg Toast
programme.desc: Horse Pizzas, Rope Tacos and Cheese & Egg Toast

programme.title: Great Chefs of America: Philippe Boulot, Anne Kearney, and Michael Maddox
programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Dungeness Crab Roll with Carrot Salad, Seared Squab with Rice, and Almond Tuile with Passion Fruit Custard. Restaurants include: The Heathman Hotel Portland, Peristyle in New Orleans, and Le Titi de Paris in Arlington Heights.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America: Guenter Seeger, Paul Bartolotta, and Gerard Partoens
programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Lamb Roulade on Zucchini, Scampi, and Summer Berries with White Chocolate Mousse. Restaurants include: The Dining Room in Atlanta, Spiaggia in Chicago, and The Peabody in Orlando.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America: Jose Gutierrez, Guillermo Veloso, and John Fleer
programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Green Tomato Gazpacho, Fried Rabbit, and Rich Pistachio Brownie with Ganache. Restaurants include: The Peabody Hotel in Memphis, Yuca Restaurant in Miami Beach, and The Inn at Blackberry Farm in Walland.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America: Tamara Murphy, Roland Liccioni, and Jea Weitlauf
programme.desc: Recipes: Provencal Fish Soup with Rouille, Daurade with French Green Beans, and Cannoli with Zabaglione Sauce.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America: Rick Bayless, Nick Apostle, and Kevin Boxx
programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Corn Tamales, Pan-fried Soft-shell Crawfish, and Strawberry-Goat Cheese Tart. Restaurants include: Frontera Grill in Chicago, Nick's in Jackson, and The Ritz-Carlton in Amelia Island.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America: Frank Lee, Gary Danko, and Alan Sayers
programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Sauteed Shiitake Mushrooms with Foie Gras, Steamed Moroccan-style Salmon Steak, and Chilled Summer Fruit Soup with Sesame Ice Cream. Restaurants include: Slightly North of Broad in Charleston, The Ritz-Carlton in San Francisco, and Goodfellows in Minneapolis.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Tomato Sauce
programme.desc: Quick, easy & flavorful tomato sauce & simply elegant tuna steaks in piquant caper, balsamic vinegar and more.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Caponata
programme.desc: Sicily's famous savory eggplant relish with onion, capers & black olives followed by delicious veal, and more.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Bruschetta
programme.desc: Quick and easy, toasted garlic bread topped with chopped tomatoes, basil and garlic followed by pasta.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Baked Swordfish
programme.desc: Swordfish steaks smothered in onions, cheese & rich tomato sauce served with classic Italian risotto.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Onion Glazed Pot Roast
programme.desc: Family favorite, melt-in-the-mouth pot roast and onions in hearty gravy served with creamy mashed potatoes.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Shrimp in the Pot
programme.desc: Tender shrimp cooked in a flavorful sauce of wine, garlic and tomato sauce served with baked tomatoes.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Sausage Stuffing
programme.desc: Flavorful stuffing of spicy sausage, mushrooms, cheese & seasoned bread crumbs fills thick & juicy pork chops.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Roasted Chicken
programme.desc: Flavor-filled chicken roasted with wine, rosemary and sage served with garlicky oven roasted potatoes.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Terrine of Roasted Eggplant
programme.desc: Sweet roasted eggplant with spicy bread crumbs and tangy cheese combine in a melt-in-your-mouth appetizer.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Seafood Pasta
programme.desc: Shrimp, scallops & pasta are especially flavorful cooked in an aluminum foil pouch, and ice cream cake.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - A Meal to Impress
programme.desc: Martin and his guest, Michael Lomonaco, show us how to impress your friends and be the life of any dinner party with these unique dishes.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Dishes for Every Palate
programme.desc: Martin whips up three delectable dishes that are sure to please any discriminating palate. Today it's shrimp, chicken and trout as only Chef Yan can.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Versatile Dishes
programme.desc: Quick & easy means versatility. Martin demonstrates how these three recipes can be enjoyed for both lunch & dinner, on their own, as a side dish or together as a meal.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Cantonese Favourites
programme.desc: Martin and his guest, Sara Moulton, explore the exciting world of Cantonese flavours with these variations on some traditional favourites.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Pacific Rim
programme.desc: Martin takes us on a culinary adventure through the Pacific Rim with these quick and easy recipes for crab, sea scallops and rice. Top it off with a refreshing Guava Bellini and you can almost feel the balmy breeze!

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Home Cooking
programme.desc: No time? No problem! Martin proves you don't need to spend hours in the kitchen to make a great, home-cooked meal.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - China & Korea
programme.desc: Two culinary powerhouses come together, as Martin and his guest, barbeque master Rick Browne, explore the difference between Korean and Chinese flavours to create these quick and easy dishes.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - A Simple Meal
programme.desc: Martin shows us how a few simple ingredients can add zing to pork chops, rice and vegetable dishes.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Risi
programme.desc: Three new ideas from a simple pot of rice. We'll set up a risotto bar with lots of creative toppings, make a warm vanilla-flavored Rice Pudding with summer fruit, and mix a beautiful Insalata di Riso with asparagus, fava beans, peas, lemon, ham and herbs. Then we'll see the wine country from the Napa Valley Wine Train.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Primavera
programme.desc: Simple dishes show off the flavor of new peas and asparagus. We'll make a Cheater's Chicken Stock (when there's no homemade stock on hand), a bright green Spring Pea Soup, a quick, tender and lemony Peas and Cipolline dish, and Halibut with Asparagus and Salsa Genovese. We'll see the vineyards of the wine country covered in golden mustard blossoms, and drop in on the Mustard Festival.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Mama's Favorites
programme.desc: Foods that warm the heart and soothe the soul. A ten-minute technique for making olives bright and lively, homemade mozzarella, which we serve en carrozza - in a "carriage" of bread dipped in egg and anchovies - and turkey polpettone filled with a center of melting cheese. We'll learn the stories behind the valley's scenic, historic stone walls.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Mama's Favorites
programme.desc: Foods that warm the heart and soothe the soul. A ten-minute technique for making olives bright and lively, homemade mozzarella, which we serve en carrozza - in a "carriage" of bread dipped in egg and anchovies - and turkey polpettone filled with a center of melting cheese. We'll learn the stories behind the valley's scenic, historic stone walls.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Surf or Turf
programme.desc: Discover a lemon marinade and other secrets for preparing artichoke hearts. We'll sear a sea bass and make an artichoke salad with red onions, kalamata olives, lemons, and other Mediterranean flavors. We'll cook baby lamb chops and artichokes and serve them with a creamy, tangy egg-lemon sauce. And we'll cross the hill to see the other food and wine-loving valley, Sonoma.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Zuppe, Zuppe, Zuppe
programme.desc: Soup makes a meal and, with a few techniques, becomes a sauce the next day for fish, poultry or meat. Summer Corn Soup, served warm or cold, makes a beautiful yellow sauce for scallops. Tart apples and sweet butternut squash make a soup that becomes a full-bodied sauce for pork chops. We'll visit a ghost winery and meet some third-generation California winemakers.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Buttering Up
programme.desc: Our favorite pantry secret stays in your freezer. Compound butters are flavored with fresh herbs and spices, rolled into logs, and kept cold to retain all their flavor. We'll make a Garlic Thyme Butter, a Basil Chive Butter for steak, bruschetta or corn, and a Bagna Cauda Butter for fresh clams and pasta. And we'll visit some of the architectural gems of the Napa Valley.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Breakfast in Turlock
programme.desc: A real farmer's breakfast with potato hash, eggs, and Damn Hot Peppers. We'll finish with Verbena Coffee and a refreshing honey zabaglione that you can make ahead and chill or serve warm. We'll drop in on Michael's hometown of Turlock, California.

programme.title: Superfoods with Chef Walter Staib - Beans and Lentils

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - A Meal to Impress
programme.desc: Martin and his guest, Michael Lomonaco, show us how to impress your friends and be the life of any dinner party with these unique dishes.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Dishes for Every Palate
programme.desc: Martin whips up three delectable dishes that are sure to please any discriminating palate. Today it's shrimp, chicken and trout as only Chef Yan can.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Versatile Dishes
programme.desc: Quick & easy means versatility. Martin demonstrates how these three recipes can be enjoyed for both lunch & dinner, on their own, as a side dish or together as a meal.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Cantonese Favourites
programme.desc: Martin and his guest, Sara Moulton, explore the exciting world of Cantonese flavours with these variations on some traditional favourites.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Pacific Rim
programme.desc: Martin takes us on a culinary adventure through the Pacific Rim with these quick and easy recipes for crab, sea scallops and rice. Top it off with a refreshing Guava Bellini and you can almost feel the balmy breeze!

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Home Cooking
programme.desc: No time? No problem! Martin proves you don't need to spend hours in the kitchen to make a great, home-cooked meal.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - China & Korea
programme.desc: Two culinary powerhouses come together, as Martin and his guest, barbeque master Rick Browne, explore the difference between Korean and Chinese flavours to create these quick and easy dishes.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - A Simple Meal
programme.desc: Martin shows us how a few simple ingredients can add zing to pork chops, rice and vegetable dishes.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Risi
programme.desc: Three new ideas from a simple pot of rice. We'll set up a risotto bar with lots of creative toppings, make a warm vanilla-flavored Rice Pudding with summer fruit, and mix a beautiful Insalata di Riso with asparagus, fava beans, peas, lemon, ham and herbs. Then we'll see the wine country from the Napa Valley Wine Train.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Primavera
programme.desc: Simple dishes show off the flavor of new peas and asparagus. We'll make a Cheater's Chicken Stock (when there's no homemade stock on hand), a bright green Spring Pea Soup, a quick, tender and lemony Peas and Cipolline dish, and Halibut with Asparagus and Salsa Genovese. We'll see the vineyards of the wine country covered in golden mustard blossoms, and drop in on the Mustard Festival.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Mama's Favorites
programme.desc: Foods that warm the heart and soothe the soul. A ten-minute technique for making olives bright and lively, homemade mozzarella, which we serve en carrozza - in a "carriage" of bread dipped in egg and anchovies - and turkey polpettone filled with a center of melting cheese. We'll learn the stories behind the valley's scenic, historic stone walls.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Mama's Favorites
programme.desc: Foods that warm the heart and soothe the soul. A ten-minute technique for making olives bright and lively, homemade mozzarella, which we serve en carrozza - in a "carriage" of bread dipped in egg and anchovies - and turkey polpettone filled with a center of melting cheese. We'll learn the stories behind the valley's scenic, historic stone walls.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Surf or Turf
programme.desc: Discover a lemon marinade and other secrets for preparing artichoke hearts. We'll sear a sea bass and make an artichoke salad with red onions, kalamata olives, lemons, and other Mediterranean flavors. We'll cook baby lamb chops and artichokes and serve them with a creamy, tangy egg-lemon sauce. And we'll cross the hill to see the other food and wine-loving valley, Sonoma.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Zuppe, Zuppe, Zuppe
programme.desc: Soup makes a meal and, with a few techniques, becomes a sauce the next day for fish, poultry or meat. Summer Corn Soup, served warm or cold, makes a beautiful yellow sauce for scallops. Tart apples and sweet butternut squash make a soup that becomes a full-bodied sauce for pork chops. We'll visit a ghost winery and meet some third-generation California winemakers.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Buttering Up
programme.desc: Our favorite pantry secret stays in your freezer. Compound butters are flavored with fresh herbs and spices, rolled into logs, and kept cold to retain all their flavor. We'll make a Garlic Thyme Butter, a Basil Chive Butter for steak, bruschetta or corn, and a Bagna Cauda Butter for fresh clams and pasta. And we'll visit some of the architectural gems of the Napa Valley.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Breakfast in Turlock
programme.desc: A real farmer's breakfast with potato hash, eggs, and Damn Hot Peppers. We'll finish with Verbena Coffee and a refreshing honey zabaglione that you can make ahead and chill or serve warm. We'll drop in on Michael's hometown of Turlock, California.

programme.title: Superfoods with Chef Walter Staib - Beans and Lentils

programme.desc: Dim-witted Cindy Campbell (Anna Faris) and her sex-crazed friend, Brenda (Regina Hall), team up with cute-but-clueless Tom Ryan (Craig Bierko) to save the world from a hostile alien invasion, with hints of War of the Worlds, Saw II, Million Dollar Baby and The Village. Celebrity cameos include Carmen Electra, Shaquille O'Neal, Dr. Phil McGraw, Bill Pullman, Molly Shannon and Michael Madsen.

programme.title: Scary Movie 5
programme.desc: Much bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn infant home from the hospital. When they realize that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal specialists and install numerous cameras to drive out the pesky spirit. Movies that are spoofed in the familiar format include the "Paranormal Activity" franchise, "Mama," "Sinister," "Evil Dead," "Inception," "Black Swan" and "Rise of the Planet of the Apes."

programme.title: Sorry to Bother You
programme.desc: In an alternate reality of present-day Oakland, Calif., telemarketer Cassius Green finds himself in a macabre universe after he discovers a magical key that leads to material glory. As Green's career begins to take off, his friends and co-workers organize a protest against corporate oppression. Cassius soon falls under the spell of Steve Lift, a cocaine-snorting CEO who offers him a salary beyond his wildest dreams.

programme.title: The Crazies
programme.desc: Anarchy reigns when an unknown toxin turns the peaceful citizens of Ogden Marsh into bloodthirsty lunatics. In an effort to contain the spread of the infection, authorities blockade the town and use deadly force to keep anyone from getting in or out. Now trapped among killers, Sheriff Dutton and his wife and two companions must band together to find a way out before madness and death overtake them.

programme.title: Cell
programme.desc: In a Boston airport, a character named Clay, played by Cusack, observes an electronic signal that causes cellphone users to commit acts of violence. Clay and a train driver, played by Jackson, travel through the city to locate Clay's family while avoiding the violent individuals.

programme.title: The Mist
programme.desc: After a powerful storm damages their Maine home, David Drayton (Thomas Jane) and his young son head into town to gather food and supplies. Soon afterward, a thick fog rolls in and engulfs the town, trapping the Draytons and others in the grocery store. Terror mounts as deadly creatures reveal themselves outside, but that may be nothing compared to the threat within, where a zealot (Marcia Gay Harden) calls for a sacrifice.

programme.title: Cabin Fever
programme.desc: Bert (James DeBello), a college student vacationing with friends in the mountains, mistakenly shoots a local man (Arie Verveen) with a skin infection while hunting in the woods. Panicking, he abandons the scene and leaves the man for dead. When the man stumbles into a reservoir, he infects the water supply, and soon one of Bert's friends becomes infected. The friends struggle to stop the contagious, flesh-eating disease while on the run from a group of ornery backwoods locals out for revenge.

programme.title: Punisher: War Zone
programme.desc: Frank Castle, aka The Punisher (Ray Stevenson), turns the streets of New York City red as he wages a one-man war against the crime syndicate responsible for the death of his wife and two kids. Aided by his trusted sidekick, Microchip (Wayne Knight), he almost kills Billy Russoti (Dominic West) and leaves him horribly disfigured. Billy renames himself Jigsaw and with the help of his crazed brother Loony Bin Jim, recruits criminals from every corner of the city to do battle with Frank.

programme.title: Gamer
programme.desc: Each week Kable, a death-row inmate, battles his fellow prisoners in a violent online game called "Slayers," his every move controlled by a young gamer's remote device. To the players, Kable and the other inmates are just simulated characters. But, to a resistance group that opposes the game's inventor, Kable is a critical component of their plan to end the inventor's form of high-tech slavery.

programme.title: Dredd
programme.desc: Mega City One is a vast, violent metropolis where felons rule the streets. The only law lies with cops called "judges," who act as judge, jury and executioner, and Dredd (Karl Urban) is one of the city's most feared. One day, Dredd is partnered with Cassandra (Olivia Thirlby), a rookie with powerful psychic abilities. A report of a terrible crime sends Dredd and Cassandra to a dangerous area controlled by Ma-Ma (Lena Headey), a drug lord who will stop at nothing to protect her empire.

programme.title: Future World
programme.desc: A queen lays dying as her son, Prince, travels across a barren wasteland to find a near-mythical medicine to save her life. After evading violent raiders on motorbikes led by the Warlord and his enforcer, Prince meets Ash, a robotic assassin in search of its own soul. When the Druglord captures Prince, he soon finds himself in an epic battle to save the last remnants of humanity.

programme.title: My Bloody Valentine
programme.desc: Ten years ago, an inexperienced coal miner named Tom Hanniger caused an accident that killed five men and put a sixth, Harry Warden, into a coma. A year later, on Valentine's Day, Harry woke up and murdered 22 people with a pickaxe before dying. Now Tom has returned home, still haunted by the past. And something else is back in Harmony: a pickaxe-wielding killer in a miner's mask, who may be the ghost of Harry, come to claim Tom and his friends.

programme.title: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
programme.desc: Beautiful Mandy Lane (Amber Heard) isn't a party girl but, when classmate Chloe (Whitney Able) invites the Texas high school student to a bash in the countryside, she reluctantly accepts. After hitching a ride with a vaguely scary older man (Anson Mount), the teens arrive at their destination. Partying ensues, and Mandy's close pal, Emmet (Michael Welch), keeps a watchful eye on the young males making a play for Mandy. Then two of the students are murdered.

programme.title: Nurse
programme.desc: A young nurse (Katrina Bowden) begins to suspect that a sexy colleague (Paz de la Huerta) is responsible for murdering a string of unfaithful men.

programme.title: Viral
programme.desc: Separated from their father (Michael Kelly), two teenage sisters (Sofia Black-D'Elia, Analiegh Tipton) try to survive an apocalyptic viral outbreak that leads to a quarantine.

programme.title: Warm Bodies
programme.desc: A terrible plague has left the planet's population divided between zombies and humans. An unusual zombie named R (Nicholas Hoult) sees his walking-dead brethren attacking a living woman named Julie (Teresa Palmer) and rescues her. Julie sees that R is different from the other zombies, and the pair embark on an unusual relationship. As their bond grows and R becomes more and more human, a chain of events unfolds that could transform the entire lifeless world.

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: After carefree teenager Jay (Maika Monroe) sleeps with her new boyfriend, Hugh (Jake Weary), for the first time, she learns that she is the latest recipient of a fatal curse that is passed from victim to victim via sexual intercourse. Death, Jay learns, will creep inexorably toward her as either a friend or a stranger. Jay's friends don't believe her seemingly paranoid ravings, until they too begin to see the phantom assassins and band together to help her flee or defend herself.

programme.title: Pain in the Neck
programme.desc: Ozzy grows increasingly frustrated about being cooped up around the house.

programme.title: Ozzy Knows Best
programme.desc: Ozzy is upset by Kelly's tendency to wear revealing outfits when she goes out to clubs and parties.

programme.title: Valentine Daze
programme.desc: Kelly continues to spend time with Rob, but doesn't want to be his girlfriend.

programme.title: Sleepless in Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Ozzy begins suffering from insomnia. He eventually undergoes testing with a sleep disorder expert to determine the cause. Jack gets a tattoo of a cross on his chest, but Ozzy and Sharon do not like it.

programme.title: Have Ozz Will Travel
programme.desc: The family tries to decide where to go on vacation. Sharon turns down Fiji because none of the hotels meet her standards, while Ozzy nixes a number of other locations for various reasons.

programme.title: Hawaii Five Ozz
programme.desc: Ozzy, Sharon and Jack head to Hawaii for their vacation. Ozzy continues to be miserable for a while but cheers up following a private luau. Jack goes diving in a shark cage. His friends invite strippers to the luau and behave in ways that embarrass him. The traveling party winds up leaving without Jack's friends when they fail to show up on time for their flight.

programme.title: Kelly Interupted
programme.desc: Kelly irritates her mother by getting a lip ring. Ozzy and Jack are convinced that Kelly's erratic behaviour and chronic illness are the result of drug use, but Sharon refuses to hear of it. Kelly eventually admits the truth to Sharon and enters rehab. Ozzy and Sharon don't believe she will stay at the facility for long.

programme.title: 28 Days Later
programme.desc: Kelly struggles to adjust to life in rehab, and frequently calls home requesting various personal belongings. She wants to leave, but Jack urges her to tough it out. Jack celebrates both his birthday and a year of sobriety. Kelly arrives home and becomes frustrated by the curfew and other rules she must follow.

programme.title: Charity Case
programme.desc: Sharon and Kelly plan a trip to Kenya on behalf of a charity organization. Ozzy doesn't want them to go, as he fears they will be kidnapped or contract malaria. Sharon also has second thoughts after hearing more details about the trip.

programme.title: Number One Fan
programme.desc: A 25-year-old fan wins a charity auction for the right to spend the day with Sharon. Sharon is touched by the woman's generosity and invites her to spend the night at the Osbourne home. Meanwhile, Jack must attend an online traffic school after getting a speeding ticket.

programme.title: Lost in Translation
programme.desc: The family travels to Japan, where Ozzy is to receive the Legend Award at the Video Music Awards. Kelly also makes several personal appearances. One of the employees, Sam, meets with some family members whom he hasn't seen in years, but can only communicate with them through a translator.

programme.title: The Show Must Go Off
programme.desc: Sharon's talk show tapes its final episodes. Feeling mistreated, Sharon clashes with her bosses to the very end, showing up late on purpose and demanding money upfront.

programme.title: A Farewell to Ozz
programme.desc: Dr. Phil McGraw pays a visit to the house, where he holds a frank discussion with the Osbournes about drug abuse and other issues that have affected the family's relationships with one another.

programme.desc: Ozzy appears on The Tonight Show with Jay Leno as a performer.

programme.desc: The family's dogs have been excreting far too many times in the house and ruining furniture in the process.

programme.desc: Kelly complains that elder sister Aimee had booked her a gynaecologist appointment.

programme.title: Episode 6

programme.title: Counter Balance Beam/Weenie Roast/Swinging Rope Bridge

programme.title: Disorderly Conduct
programme.desc: Amy, Adam and Chip investigate escalating paranormal problems at a home undergoing renovations; the entities within are fiercely protective of the property and lash out when the team attempts to communicate.

programme.title: Death Alley
programme.desc: Amy, Adam and Chip investigate a century-old theater haunted by a menacing shadow figure; employees worry the uninvited guest may have come from a nearby alley rumored to be the site of many murders.

programme.title: Death Interrupted
programme.desc: The caretaker of a defunct insane asylum calls on Amy, Adam and Chip for help after recent renovations awaken a ghastly presence that stirs up unrest among the building's resident spirits.

programme.title: Fenwick Plantation
programme.desc: The boys hunt for the spirits of pirates, spies and a headless horseman said to still roam the grounds of South Carolina's Fenwick Plantation.

programme.title: Pennhurst Asylum
programme.desc: The TWC investigates the tragically haunted Pennhurst Asylum, a location with a history of child patient abuse.

programme.title: Hill View Manor
programme.desc: The team must find and trap the spirits of two suicidal patients at Hill View Manor in Western Pennsylvania.

programme.title: Sibley Mill
programme.desc: The TWC team is the first to investigate an old confederate gunpowder and fabric factory, Sibley Mill.

programme.title: Fort Delaware
programme.desc: The team is stranded on a river island and has 48 hours to investigate Fort Delaware, a former civil war POW camp that claimed the lives of one in four prisoners; the boys try to solve the ghostly feud of two civil war generals.

programme.title: The Bissman Building
programme.desc: The boys are challenged to prove reports of a dark portal in the Bissman Building located in Mansfield, Ohio.

programme.title: USS Edson
programme.desc: The team members board the U.S.S. Edson, a battleship that served in the Vietnam War, in an attempt to free the spirits purported to be trapped on the ship, including a poltergeist.

programme.title: Old South Pittsburg Hospital
programme.desc: The crew members return to the Old South Pittsburg Hospital, the location of their very first paranormal investigation, where they hope to reveal the true identity of a menacing shadow figure.

programme.title: Peoria State Hospital
programme.desc: The TWC investigate one of the most haunted asylums in the Midwest.

programme.title: Missouri State Penitentiary
programme.desc: The TWC visit Missouri State Penitentiary to banish the spirits of two sinister child killers that still infest its ghostly cellblocks.

programme.title: Castillo de San Marcos
programme.desc: While in Florida, the crew tries to contact a Seminole Indian Chief and a pair of doomed lovers that possibly haunt Castillo de San Marcos.

programme.title: Pauly Jail
programme.desc: The team investigates Pauly Jail, where many unauthorized executions took place, in an attempt to contact two of the perished victims.

programme.title: Preston Castle
programme.desc: The team journeys to Preston Castle, California's first boy's reformatory school, to find answers to two of its most mysterious deaths.

programme.title: Coco Palms Resort
programme.desc: The team goes to Kauai to investigate the abandoned Coco Palms Resort, built atop sacred land that spirits have roamed for centuries.

programme.title: Old Crow Distillery
programme.desc: The TWC is called to investigate reports of paranormal activity on the grounds of the Old Crow Distillery.

programme.title: Brushy Mountain Penitentiary
programme.desc: In Tennessee, the team investigates a legendary prison, Brushy Mountain State Penitentiary; the team is taunted and attacked while battling ghosts during an electrical storm.

programme.title: Anderson Hotel
programme.desc: Over a 72-hour confinement period, Nick and Katrina learn not everyone has checked out of the Anderson Hotel.

programme.title: Franklin Castle
programme.desc: Katrina and Nick investigate a Victorian mansion in Cleveland; the Franklin Castle was home to wealthy immigrant, Hannes Teidermann; Teidermann buried both his wife and one of his children while living in the mansion.

programme.title: Randolph County Infirmary
programme.desc: When Nick and Katrina arrive to investigate residual hauntings inside the long-shuttered Randolph County Infirmary in Winchester, Ind., they are alarmed to discover that there are still residents in the building.

programme.title: Hinsdale House
programme.desc: As Nick and Katrina investigate the demonic past of a house in Hinsdale, N.Y., Nick gets caught in a psychological battle between good and evil.

programme.title: Kreischer Mansion
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina are in Staten Island, New York to seek answers on who is haunting the infamous Kreischer Mansion.

programme.title: Unlocked: The Black Monk House
programme.desc: Katrina Weidman and Nick Groff launch a special investigation of the Black Monk House in Yorkshire, England, feared for its violent poltergeist activity; Groff and Weidman plan to stay in the house for 100 hours.

programme.title: Monroe House
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina spend 72 hours untangling the mysteries of Monroe Demon House, dealing with wraiths that are at odds with each other.

programme.title: Shrewsbury Prison
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina unlock the foreboding secrets of HMS Shrewsbury Prison in England, facing down over 200 years of executions, anger and tragedy.

programme.title: Oliver House
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina visit a historic manor in Middleboro, Mass., to determine if it's unsafe for tourists; Katrina investigates hauntings beyond the house; the paranormal activity hits too close to home for Nick.

programme.title: St. Ignatius Hospital
programme.desc: St. Ignatius Hospital in Colfax, Wash. has been abandoned since 2003, but Nick and Katrina soon realize they are not alone in the hospital.

programme.title: Waverly Hills
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina set out to document the elusive shadow figures lurking within the expansive corridors of Waverly Hills Sanatorium in Louisville, Ky.

programme.title: Bellaire and Hinsdale Unlocked
programme.desc: The team is called to Ohio to help a bereft mother identify the dark energy forcing her family to flee their home; Nick gets caught in a psychological battle between good and evil.

programme.title: Statler and Anderson Unlocked
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina discover that the ghostly remains of a hotel's sordid underground history may have no intention of staying buried; Nick and Katrina learn not everyone has checked out of the Anderson Hotel.

programme.title: White Hill Mansion
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina gather visual evidence of a child in the attic, but a mansion's history as a mob hangout have them questioning whether all the spirits they encounter are that innocent.

programme.title: Malvern and Franklin Unlocked
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina venture to the harrowing halls of Iowa's Malvern Manor for 72 hours in an attempt to capture evidence of aggressive shadow figures; Katrina and Nick investigate a Victorian mansion in Cleveland, the Franklin Castle.

programme.title: Rampart and Randolph Infirmary
programme.desc: On the 10th anniversary of the grisly death of Addie Hall by her boyfriend Zack Bowen, Nick and Katrina return to the scene of the crime in New Orleans to find what spirits still remain.

programme.title: Scutt Mansion
programme.desc: After the owner's tragic death, a Victorian mansion reportedly curses all who live inside, and Nick and Katrina find the curse may be even more dangerous than they anticipated.

programme.title: Old Chatham County Jail
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina investigate a haunted jail in Savannah; haunted by phantom noises during their confinement, they realize that they are not alone.

programme.title: Old Sweet Springs
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina submerge themselves among the spirits of West Virginia's Old Sweet Springs Resort to see what lurks beneath the surface of the once-idyllic retreat.

programme.title: Wildwood Sanitarium
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina go to Wildwood Sanitarium; after its conversion into apartments, tenants report an unnerving male presence and furniture being rearranged.

programme.title: Higginsport School
programme.desc: An unknown spirit lurks in the empty hallways of Ohio's Higginsport School; evidence points to darker haunting caused by recent deaths on the property.

programme.title: Bobby Mackey's Music World
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina use high-tech equipment to face down the dark spirits in one of America's most notorious haunted hotspots - Bobby Mackey's Music World.

programme.title: Monroe House
programme.desc: After Nick and Katrina found human bones in their first lockdown at the Monroe House, they thought the case was closed; now they return to explore further.

programme.title: Jim Beam Distillery
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina are in the historic Jim Beam Distillery, exploring employee claims that bourbon is not the only spirit locked inside its huge warehouse.

programme.title: Old Cambria Jail
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina unlock a local legend at the Old Cambria County Jail; while in pursuit of notorious prisoners, unearthly voices draw them to the prison's dungeon to confront something even darker.

programme.title: Beattie Mansion
programme.desc: A threatening presence brings the construction on the Beattie Mansion to a standstill; Nick and Katrina use cutting edge experiments to lure out the ominous spirits.

programme.title: Roff Family Rituals
programme.desc: When the spirit of a possessed girl starts calling, Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey pick up the line; while communicating with the ghostly caller in Watseka, Ill., they find there's more to her death than anyone suspected.

programme.title: Dead and Forgotten
programme.desc: Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey check into a Michigan asylum to determine what truly haunts its abandoned grounds; as the guys sift through the facility's sordid past, they encounter restless souls who refuse to be forgotten in death.

programme.title: Death Sentence
programme.desc: Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey investigate the site of Louisiana's first double execution; as they dive into the murky waters of the old Beauregard Parish jail's murderous past, the resident spirits begin to tell an unexpected tale.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria

programme.title: Theres The Good the Bad and then theres Alaska
programme.desc: Alaska is home to many people who live by their own rules, which means law enforcement must deal with quirky characters of all kinds on a daily basis; some are good, some are bad and some are downright hilarious.

programme.title: Taste of Blood
programme.desc: In Fairbanks, a wanted fugitive flees into the woods and the police's only lead is frozen footprints in the snow; when a killer bear becomes loose in Kodiak, officers must hunt it down before it strikes again.

programme.title: Arctic Survival
programme.desc: Officer Chris Cook questions his future in remote Kotzebue; officer Stephanie Jones has to battle her own soft-hearted nature to succeed as a rookie; officer Christopher Zenyuch is eager to prove himself in Fairbanks.

programme.title: Last Frontier
programme.desc: Petersburg rookies learn that being an Alaska cop sometimes means saving eagles and battling fires; in Fairbanks, during his last weeks before retirement, Sgt. Peyton Meredith and his officers engage in high-speed chases under dangerous conditions.

programme.title: Wild Wild West
programme.desc: In Kotzebue, Sgt. Norman Hughes gets more than he bargained for on a domestic violence call; officer Robert Odom faces the dangers of working alone; in Fairbanks, a pizza van is carjacked, and the suspect is armed and loose in the city.
