programme.title: Qwerty
programme.desc: In this heartwarming romantic comedy, Zoe's life is turned upside down when she falls for outcast Marty. Together, they battle a dysfunctional family and self-doubt as Zoe trains for the National Scrabble Championship.

programme.title: Loren & Rose
programme.desc: The appetizer is an introduction, the dessert a farewell in this story of an indelible bond between a promising young filmmaker and an iconic actress. Jacqueline Bisset and Kelly Blatz star with a chemistry that is both intoxicating and authentic.

programme.title: Reflections on the Living Dead
programme.desc: Director George A. Romero, co-writer John A. Russo, and producers Russell W. Streiner and Karl Hardman gather for the first time in 25 years for a once-in-a-lifetime roundtable discussion on the making of "Night of the Living Dead."

programme.title: Murder Loves Killers Too
programme.desc: A deranged man, whose version of sex is murdering people, hunts after a group of sexy teenagers.

programme.title: A Christmas Love
programme.desc: Struck by bad luck during the holidays, a struggling couple receives the joyful gift of Christmas love when they discover an old letter that sparks the magic of the season.

programme.title: Reapers
programme.desc: Reapers follows Zion, a resurrected soul collector, on a mission to save his wife. With ghouls, demons, and deadly deals with Death, he must stop a robust briefcase in this thrilling sci-fi action saga from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: Lynch: A History
programme.desc: Lynch: A History is a kaleidoscopic look at Marshawn Lynch's use of silence as a form of protest. Culling 700 clips and placing them in radical juxtaposition, the film is a powerful parable about American sports media and racial oppression.

programme.title: The Exquisite Corpse Project
programme.desc: A first-of-its-kind comedy about five writers who are challenged to each write fifteen minutes of a movie, after having read only the previous five pages of the script.

programme.title: Princes of the Yen
programme.desc: Princes of the Yen reveals how post-war Japanese society was transformed to suit the agenda of powerful interest groups, and how citizens were kept entirely in the dark about this. History is now repeating itself around the world.

programme.title: Meeting Ms. Leigh
programme.desc: A young writer in desperate need of inspiration begins an affair with an enchanting, enigmatic older woman during a weekend in Santa Monica. True feelings emerge, and they must decide whether to continue their torrid romance or go their separate ways.

programme.title: Salton Sea
programme.desc: When Brian takes his wife to the desolate Salton Sea resort town where they had previously honeymooned, he is forced to examine multiple pressing problems.

programme.title: Lost on a Mountain in Maine
programme.desc: When a storm separates a 12-year-old boy from his family while hiking on Mount Katahdin, he must fight to stay alive alone in the wilderness.

programme.title: Reapers
programme.desc: Reapers follows Zion, a resurrected soul collector, on a mission to save his wife. With ghouls, demons, and deadly deals with Death, he must stop a robust briefcase in this thrilling sci-fi action saga from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: Get a Job
programme.desc: Unemployed and living with the "mother-in-law from hell," a young comedian and his childhood friend are sucked into the ride of their lives when they decide there is no time like the present to pursue their dreams of opening a comedy club.

programme.title: Birdies
programme.desc: The tale of a washed-up golf phenom who gets a job at a country club where catching a buzz is par for the course.

programme.title: Code Duello: From The Tithebanner Saga
programme.desc: Following a cataclysmic collision of galaxies, two survivors navigate the strange new world where they find themselves, searching for a place in society to survive and build a new life together.

programme.title: Valley Of The Queens: Planned Obsolescence
programme.desc: When a spiritual oracle confronts him about his mischievous time on Earth, Michael, an angel determined to get justice on his own terms, must save Black Americans from a dark future of planned obsolescence.

programme.title: T h e m
programme.desc: Humans cannot see them anymore. They control the world and everything that happens in it. Humans live in a comfortable dream that repeats itself. They control the dream. They were humans once too. Now they are something else.

programme.title: Chavela
programme.desc: The life of pioneering singer Chavela Vargas, from her birth in Costa Rica in 1919 to her death in Mexico in 2012.

programme.title: Game Face
programme.desc: Game Face sheds light on the coming out journeys of LGBTQ athletes. This documentary tells the stories of Fallon Fox, the first female transgender pro MMA fighter, and Terrence Clemens, a college basketball player in Oklahoma, who happens to be gay.

programme.title: Get the Girl
programme.desc: When a strange girl appears do you help, or mind your business? A retired hitman and his trainee get pulled into the shit when they decide to save a girl who escapes from trafficking. Sometimes you gotta do bad things to bad people.

programme.title: Decrypted
programme.desc: Decrypted is an outrageous and provocative dark comedy about a mismatched NSA team who kidnaps the creator of Bitcoin - Satoshi Nakamoto - and attempts to torture him for the information they need to destroy cryptocurrencies.

programme.title: Dungeon
programme.desc: A real estate broker he finds himself victim to an unusual circumstance the only tenant of the newest building on the market. Frightened and scared, he fights for his life while his loving grandma and the small town detective search for him.

programme.title: Forty Winks
programme.desc: A struggling hypnotist in New York city is blackmailed into being the world's first hypnotist hitman after a mysterious woman finds out his degree is fake.

programme.title: Sons of Perdition
programme.desc: Sons of Perdition follows three teenage boys after they escape from a secretive FLDS polygamist sect and must fend for themselves in mainstream America.

programme.title: Pick It Up! Ska in the '90s
programme.desc: Pick It Up! is a documentary film about the rise in popularity of ska music in the 1990s, often referred to as the third wave of ska.

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: In this disaster movie, Americans and Soviets must put aside their differences to save civilization from a huge meteor bearing down on the planet. Paul Bradley (Sean Connery) enlists the expertise of fellow scientist Alexei Dubov (Brian Keith), who is joined by his beautiful assistant, Tatiana Donskaya (Natalie Wood). Although Paul and Tatiana are attracted to each other, they wisely focus on taking out the meteor, which may still cause massive destruction even if it is partially damaged.

programme.title: Street Code Broken
programme.desc: Two life-long friends come to crossroads when one decides that street life isn't what he wants. Loyalty is tested when the unwritten rules of street code protocol are broken.

programme.title: Amber Road
programme.desc: The Amber Road is a place in the digital universe where anything can be bought, sold, and traded: a place where a person can fulfill their darkest desire or unleash their deepest depravity.

programme.title: Nosferatu - A Symphony of Horror
programme.desc: Summoned to a bloodthirsty vampire's faraway castle, a young land clerk embarks on a harrowing journey into the unknown as his innocent wife falls under the spell of a terrifying shadow in her dreams.

programme.title: Dog Jack
programme.desc: A 14-year-old slave escapes with his loyal dog to join the Union Army. Hounded by slave trackers, he receives the reluctant help of a minister to reach the army of the North.

programme.title: No New Friends
programme.desc: When a group of friends hold a reunion to remember the life of a childhood friend who passed away ten years prior, they find out a friend in need isn't always a friend indeed.

programme.title: Boulevard! A Hollywood Story
programme.desc: Dickson Hughes and Richard Stapley, two young songwriters and romantic partners, find themselves caught in movie star Gloria Swanson's web when she hires them to write a musical version of "Sunset Boulevard."

programme.title: Insert Coin
programme.desc: The untold story of how Mortal Kombat, NBA Jam, and other arcade classics were created by a ragtag crew in the back of a Chicago factory. Generating billions of dollars, they rode the wave of the booming 90s arcade scene... until a new enemy appears.

programme.title: Solitary
programme.desc: A woman afraid to leave her house must solve the mysterious disappearance of her husband.

programme.title: The Cheating Pact
programme.desc: After cheating on their college entrance exams, a group of high school students struggle to keep their secret even as their lives are torn apart by betrayal, revenge, and murder...

programme.title: The Wedding Dance
programme.desc: A bride-to-be is shocked when the father she never knew shows up holding the deed to her family's dance studio. It is the first of many surprises for Cyd who will soon learn other surprises about her father, including their shared love of dancing.

programme.title: My King
programme.desc: A young woman has found the perfect man in her life. Problems arise when his mother starts to interfere in their business.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Elizabeth Taylor (2/21/92)
programme.desc: Two-time Oscar winner Elizabeth Taylor chats about, her new perfume, addiction programs, her seven husbands, and her most marriage to construction worker Larry Fortensky.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Lauren Bacall (6/23/83)
programme.desc: Screen star and two-time Tony winner Lauren Bacall talks about her new play, life in LA and quitting smoking...for the fifth time.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Jack Palance (5/10/74)
programme.desc: Hollywood's best bad guy, Jack Palance says he doesn't like playing villains but loved his role a psychotic antiques dealer in his latest movie, Craze.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Danny Thomas (1/20/76)
programme.desc: Comedian, TV star and noted humanitarian Danny Thomas chats about working with fellow funny man Jonathan Winters and his latest show on NBC.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Dinah Shore (11/10/77)
programme.desc: Fellow talk show host and chart-topping vocalist Dinah Shore sings 2 of her hits and says she'd rather be the one asking the questions. Her dream interview is Israeli Prime Minister Golda Meir.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Tony Curtis (6/21/78)
programme.desc: Movie star Tony Curtis discusses his steamy new novel about Hollywood and the mob. Also shows a clip from his first movie, at age 23, in which he played a rumba dancer.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Jack Palance (5/10/91)
programme.desc: The ultimate Hollywood bad guy, Jack Palance chats with Johnny about his break-out role in Shane (1949). Palance also describes his current line of work -- running a cattle ranch.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Gregory Peck (8/3/77)
programme.desc: Hollywood leading man Gregory Peck dishes on WW2 hero General Douglas MacArthur, whom he played in the biopic, and the General's overlooked sense of humor.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Eli Wallach (9/1/77)
programme.desc: Remember The Thorn Birds? Meet Colleen McCullough, who wrote the blockbuster novel-turned-mini series. Lou Brock discusses his base-stealing record and acting legend Eli Wallach chats about his craft. Don Rickles plugs his show C.P.O. Sharkey.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Peter O'Toole (1/13/78)
programme.desc: Screen star Peter O'Toole was Oscar nom'd 8 times! Never won. Finally bagged the golden statue for lifetime achievement. O'Toole discusses The Stunt Man. Comic Buddy Hackett brings some laughs.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Robert Mitchum (6/16/78)
programme.desc: The gorgeous and talented Ann-Margret says she disguises herself in a black wig when out in public. Screen legend Robert Mitchem reveals he did time on a chain gang, at age 15.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Walter Matthau (12/10/81)
programme.desc: Hollywood heavyweights Jack Lemmon and Walter Matthau regale Johnny with tales of making 5 movies together and one near-death stunt gone very wrong.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Walter Matthau (3/23/82)
programme.desc: Stardom is bad for your health. Walter Matthau dons dark glasses to disguise an eye problem, jokes about his roommate in the hospital and the awful food.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Sean Connery (10/5/83)
programme.desc: Sean Connery gives a Bond trivia quiz, and recalls his scariest stunts. Comic Keenan Ivory Wayans says dating white girls is like being on Mutual of Omaha's Wild Kingdom; people can't stop staring.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Mickey Rooney (3/13/84)
programme.desc: Mickey Rooney compares notes with Johnny on their many marriages. Comic Paul Rodriguez riffs on Mexicans picking fruit and the fun of annoying white drivers on LA freeways.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Walter Matthau (7/22/86)
programme.desc: We're spelling tonight! Walter Matthau and Johnny quiz one another on difficult words. Matthau recalls filming Tunisia and shows a clip from his movie, Pirates.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Raquel Welch (6/22/88)
programme.desc: Hog wild: That's Jay Leno who owns 17 motorcycles. Leno describes a chopper breakdown in LA with a busload of tourists cheering him on. Raquel Welch discusses her children and getting older.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Dennis Hopper (8/15/91)
programme.desc: Not your typical leading man, Dennis Hopper talks about his unusual roles in Blue Velvet and Easy Rider, and his up and down career which began in his Kansas hometown.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Clint Eastwood (5/15/92)
programme.desc: Mr. "make-my-day" Clint Eastwood reminisces about Gunsmoke, Outlaw Josey Wales and Dirty Harry, while Bob Hope and David Letterman also appear.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Jane Fonda (10/6/77)
programme.desc: Activist and two-time Oscar winner Jane Fonda details her suit against the US government for invading her privacy. Also plugs her move, "Julia."

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Dean Martin (12/12/75)
programme.desc: Star party guy, Dean Martin recounts the wild fun celebrating Frank Sinatra's big 6-0. Also fills in Johnny on playing Las Vegas and his frequent forays into the casinos.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Joey Bishop (2/24/76)
programme.desc: Brat packer & longtime TV personality Joey Bishop talks about his career, politics, how he gave up smoking and lost weight.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Raquel Welch (11/21/80)
programme.desc: The great actress and great beauty Raquel Welch chats about Presidents Reagan and Carter, her 2nd marriage, getting negative press and how she imagines her life in the year 2000.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - James Garner (11/4/88)
programme.desc: James Garner shares the gruesome details of his recent bypass surgery and thanks well-wishers for the 9,000 get well cards he received. The operation has not, thankfully, hurt his golf game.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Victor Buono (8/16/73)
programme.desc: The very funny Victor Buono drops in to talk about his recently released book of poetry, and to cut up with Johnny and Ed.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - James Garner (9/13/91)
programme.desc: Actor James Garner stops by to talk about his latest television series, "Man Of The People," and discusses some one of the biggest clinkers of his career, his induction into the Television Hall Of Fame, and his fear of public speaking.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Bruce Dern (12/14/72)
programme.desc: Watch a Tea Time movie with Carol Wayne. Plus Doris Day has a bad neck, Rodney Dangerfield performs and Burt Mustin discusses his first visit to Hollywood in 1925.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Diane Keaton (12/28/72)
programme.desc: Diane Keaton talks about Christmas in her childhood. Gene Hackman also appears.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Ricardo Montalban (8/1/73)
programme.desc: Remember Ricardo Montalban's "rich Corinthian leather?" The king of kitsch (Fantasy Island, 3 Planet of the Apes movies and Star Trek tv series and movie) reveals his obsession with bullfighting!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (10/2/73)
programme.desc: No one rocks a polyester leisure suit like sex god Burt Reynolds. Comic Buddy Hackett's orgasm-sneeze makes for really compelling TV. Master complainer Don Rickles rounds out the show.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Peter Falk (10/5/73)
programme.desc: Catch a rack of iconic rumpled raincoats worn by 4-time Emmy winner Peter Falk in his detective show Columbo. Dallas star Victoria Principal chats about quitting booze and cigarettes.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Gene Hackman (3/21/74)
programme.desc: Oscar winner Gene Hackman shows a watery clip from ocean liner disaster flick Poseidon Adventure. Also on this episode is Diane Keaton

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Jim Henson (5/24/74)
programme.desc: Even celebs like Suzanne Pleshette go to the dentist and suffer with ordinary phobias. Of course, Jim Henson's Muppets are the exception; they have perfect teeth!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (9/26/74)
programme.desc: Decked out in head-to-toe leather, Burt Reynolds shares a clip from The Longest Yard. Comic genius Dom DeLuise discusses his dog's issues and Honeymooners star Art Carney plays "September Song."

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Lilly Tomlin (2/20/75)
programme.desc: Lily Tomlin describes her Detroit childhood, creating a character by working a check-out counter and her career as a shoplifter.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Michael Caine (12/5/75)
programme.desc: Oscar clubbers Michael Caine and Sean Connery share a clip from their movie The Man who would be King. Connery announces he's retiring from James Bond movies and Caine says he's now a wine merchant.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (3/2/77)
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds shows his vacation videos and talks about moving in next door to Barbra Streisand.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Bruce Dern (3/30/77)
programme.desc: Oscar winner Bruce Dern talks about getting his big break and his neighbor Robert Redford. Psychiatrist Sam Dunkell analyzes dreams and sleep positions. `

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Peter Falk (5/20/77)
programme.desc: Columbo Star Peter Falk discusses the series' ties to the Mensa Society. Heavyweight champion and civil rights activist Muhammad Ali shows a clip from The Greatest.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Mark Hamill (11/29/77)
programme.desc: Luke Skywalker, a.k.a. Mark Hamill, chats about the making of the iconic movie Star Wars and working with the legendary Alec Guiness.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Cloris Leachman (2/1/78)
programme.desc: Who's racked up more Emmys than anyone except Julia Louis Dreyfuss and Carl Reiner? Cloris Leachman. She talks to Johnny about growing up in Des Moines and doing live TV.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Goldie Hawn (2/22/78)
programme.desc: The bikini'd star of Laugh-in and Oscar winner Goldie Hawn talks about giving birth. And what's the big deal with King Tut? Buck Henry, who created Get Smart and wrote The Graduate has some thoughts.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Bruce Dern (3/2/78)
programme.desc: Even stars get stiffed. Ask Bruce Dern. Comedian Robert Klein reports on making a movie with Burt Reynolds, and Dr. Carl Sagan bashes Star Wars for strangling science.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (8/2/78)
programme.desc: Pin up guy Burt Reynolds grouses about look-a-likes who impersonate him at public functions. Susan Sarandon demos relaxation techniques and reads Johnny's palm.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Angie Dickinson (4/4/79)
programme.desc: Rat pack darling Angie Dickinson chats about self defense training. Johnny practices the Heimlich maneuver on her with coaching from its developer, Dr. Henry Heimlich.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (6/21/79)
programme.desc: Celebrities at the pump; Burt Reynolds talks about waiting his turn. He also fesses up to coveting an Oscar. Jimmy Carter's mom, Miss Lillian, admits she doesn't like sleeping at the White House.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Bruce Dern (12/20/79)
programme.desc: Acting icon Bruce Dern talks about working with Ann-Margret on Middle Age Crazy, and David Letterman scores laughs describing his visit to a nude beach and his dog's love life.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Angie Dickinson (12/30/80)
programme.desc: Actress Angie Dickinson, who's made over 50 films, chats about New Year's Eve parties, New Year's resolutions, her first date and coping with depression.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Alan Alda (5/19/81)
programme.desc: M*A*S*H* star Alan Alda discusses his career and the impact of celebrity on his life. Comedian David Brenner riffs on health food, controlling his weight and eating in New York.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Bo Derek (7/24/81)
programme.desc: TV star Michael Landon gets sentimental over Bonanza; watching episodes dubbed in Japanese and promoting the show at county fairs. Actress Bo Derek talks about vine-swinging for Tarzan, the Ape Man.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Angie Dickinson (7/31/81)
programme.desc: Show biz veteran Angie Dickinson talks about men who whistle at women, Tommy Lasorda chats about losing weight, and Dom DeLuise dishes on doing an off-Broadway play with Barbra Streisand.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - John Travolta (8/6/81)
programme.desc: Actor/pilot John Travolta on flying lessons, dropping out of high school and getting his first part. Humorist Erma Bombeck complains that "housewives" on commercials don't look like housewives.

programme.title: Win, Place, Bingo
programme.desc: Cooper, Danny and Mike are suspicious of a man (Terry Bradshaw) who has a nearly perfect winning streak; Sam's whale brings his grandmother (Kathryn Joosten) to the casino to play bingo.

programme.title: Three Weddings and a Funeral
programme.desc: Thieves try to steal a rare stamp that is up for auction at the Montecito, taking Danny, Piper, Mitch and the surveillance room hostage; Mike's mom discovers that he is married.

programme.title: Pilot
programme.desc: Big Ed Deline leads a surveillance team charged with maintaining security at one of the largest casinos in Sin City; protégé Danny McCoy must foil a team of high-tech cheats.

programme.title: What Happens in Vegas, Stays in Vegas
programme.desc: The body of Danny's childhood friend is found in the desert; Ed conceals the identity of an ultraconservative senator; Mary contends with an actor who takes his role as King Arthur too seriously.

programme.title: Donny, We Hardly Knew Ye
programme.desc: Danny and Ed become suspicious when a high roller cashes in chips but never plays a hand; Ed's cousin meets the woman of his dreams at the roulette wheel and decides to get married immediately.

programme.title: Jokers and Fools
programme.desc: Cheaters plan to score $10 million with the help of the best pit boss in Vegas -- Nessa; a psychic warns Mary of an audience member's death; Sam plays matchmaker for a lonely lady.

programme.title: Groundhog Summer
programme.desc: Danny and Ed hunt for a sexual predator targeting hotel guests; Danny and Mike suspect three MIT students of planning an electronic heist when they arrive with the latest high-tech equipment.

programme.title: Semper Spy
programme.desc: When Ed leaves Danny in charge of the hotel, a computer glitch causes hundreds of guests to be locked out of their rooms.

programme.title: Pros and Cons
programme.desc: A con artist (Alana De La Garza) scams the daughter of a surveillance specialist into exchanging counterfeit chips for cash; Mary helps a couple down on their luck with tickets to see Wayne Newton.

programme.title: Luck Be a Lady
programme.desc: A stalker disrupts a pop diva's (Sheryl Lee Ralph) performance at the hotel; Ed reunites with a former partner (Mimi Rogers); Sam tries to evict a guest lodged in a prime suite who refuses to gamble.

programme.title: Year of the Tiger
programme.desc: Sam brings one of the premier high rollers (Michael Paul Chan) to the Montecito, promising to arrange a rare reunion with his two high-profile daughters.

programme.title: Decks and Violence
programme.desc: Danny and Ed search the hotel when a member of a husband-and-wife magic troupe vanishes; Mike runs into an old friend from college.

programme.title: Blood and Sand
programme.desc: Ed and Danny referee clashes between rival camps during the premier boxing match of the year; Danny threatens to cancel the fight after the theft of a manager's prosthetic limb; Ed questions the fluctuating odds on an undercard fight.

programme.title: Hellraisers and Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Ed's former CIA buddy (Alec Baldwin) installs a security system which immediately detects a breach made by a computer hacker staying at the hotel.

programme.title: The Night the Lights Went Out in Vegas
programme.desc: A hotel guest is shot dead on the casino floor during a blackout; trapped Danny and Mary rehash old feelings; Mike and Ed are locked inside the surveillance room.

programme.title: Things That Go Jump in the Night
programme.desc: Danny and Ed introduce a suicidal guest (Jon Lovitz) to the thrill of gambling; Sam gets cozy with a client, then his fiancée (Paris Hilton) comes to town.

programme.title: Die Fast, Die Furious
programme.desc: An action star (Jean-Claude Van Damme) dies while executing a stunt for his latest movie; a rival casino host squares off against Sam for the patronage of a high roller.

programme.title: New Orleans
programme.desc: Ed, Danny and Sam follow a high roller to New Orleans to collect $5 million; an unruly clan of farmers gathers for a family reunion; Mike coordinates the world's largest wet T-shirt contest.

programme.title: You Can't Take It With You
programme.desc: A resident (Sean Astin) wins the jackpot at a slot machine, then fakes his own death; Ed's mother (June Lockhart) regales the staff with stories of her son's childhood; a couple uses coupons to avoid spending any money in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Nevada State
programme.desc: An escaped murderer seeks revenge against Sam for testifying against him; the hotel hosts a statewide cheerleading competition; Nessa discusses the merits of Manchester United with a trio of rowdy British soccer fans.

programme.title: Sons and Lovers
programme.desc: Thieves snatch a guest's wallet before he can spend his winnings; the security team assesses a suspicious machine with an unusually high payout pattern; Ed discovers Jillian (Cheryl Ladd) has been hanging out with singer Mark McGrath.

programme.title: The Strange Life of Bob
programme.desc: Nessa tries to uncover the truth about a mystery man (Christian Kane) known only as "Bob the rover"; Danny hunts for a peeping cameraman; Sam enters an eating contest.

programme.title: Family Jewels
programme.desc: Danny asks Mike for his technical expertise when someone steals $5 million in diamonds from one of the guests.

programme.title: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Nessa attempts to calm a blackjack player with a bomb strapped to his chest, while Danny discovers there is another bomb planted by an accomplice.

programme.title: Always Faithful
programme.desc: Danny and Mike search for the source of the phony $100 bills suddenly surfacing at the casino, despite Danny's urgent letter requiring him to report back to active duty.

programme.title: Have You Ever Seen the Rain?
programme.desc: Danny surprises everyone by returning home, but his memories of the war make it hard for him to adjust to life; Ed, Mike and Danny must track down three suspicious characters who are making mischief in the casino.

programme.title: The Count of Montecito
programme.desc: Danny and Sam try to figure out the tactics of a ring of card counters; Fred Puterbaugh (Jon Lovitz) professes his love for Nessa, much to her dismay; Ed and Danny deal with an archaeologist's find near the hotel pool.

programme.title: Blood Is Thicker
programme.desc: Ed is framed for murder when enemies from his past resurface, and Danny and Mike take matters into their own hands; Sam, Mary, Nessa and Delinda select what they believe are the perfect tenants for their new investment property.

programme.title: Catch of the Day
programme.desc: Danny and Mike investigate when a truckload of lobsters is stolen en route to the hotel, while Sam travels across the country to get replacement lobsters.

programme.title: Good Run of Bad Luck
programme.desc: Danny agrees to help the wife of an ex-Marine by watching her baby while she attends an interview, but he becomes concerned when she doesn't return; Sam hosts a man who intentionally throws his money away to confound his soon-to-be ex-wife.

programme.title: Games People Play
programme.desc: Nessa questions everything Ed has told her about her father when a mysterious woman tells her that he is still alive and wishes to contact her.

programme.title: Montecito Lancers
programme.desc: Danny and Mike prepare their youth football team for the Casino League championship game and search for a missing casino employee and aspiring inventor, who is the father of one of the team members.

programme.title: Two of a Kind
programme.desc: Ed, Danny and Mike work to help Dr. Jordan Cavanaugh (Jill Hennessy) and Detective Woody Hoyt (Jerry O'Connell) as they try to solve the murder of a high-stakes gambler who appears to have had many enemies.

programme.title: Degas Away With It
programme.desc: Ed uses past connections and old-school tactics to track down the thief who stole a priceless work of art from the Montecito, leading to a tense reunion with his former partner (Alec Baldwin).

programme.title: Silver Star
programme.desc: Danny and Mike's attempt to find a missing girl leads them to a man with a criminal past; Delinda becomes enamored with the Polyphonic Spree, an unusual musical group, and its leader, Tim DeLaughter.

programme.title: My Beautiful Launderette
programme.desc: Sam learns one of her clients is laundering money for a drug cartel through the resort; Mike is convinced he has met the woman of his dreams and works hard to persuade her to date him.

programme.title: When You Got to Go, You Got to Go
programme.desc: When Ed is kidnapped, Danny and Mike franticly search the city for him, a task made more difficult by Ed refusing to let them call the police or pay the ransom.

programme.title: Sperm Whales and Spearmint Rhinos
programme.desc: A hotel guest is an apparent suicide, but further investigation by Delinda points to murder, so she sends Danny and Ed to search for the killer.

programme.title: The Lie Is Cast
programme.desc: Danny's generous act gets him into trouble with the police, leaving Ed to clean up the mess; Delinda enlists the aid of a singer to convince the chef that the restaurant should be open for lunch.

programme.title: Whale of a Time
programme.desc: A beautiful former co-worker pays a visit to Ed, but her presence puts everyone in danger; when Delinda and Nessa compete for the attentions of a high roller, their friendly competition quickly gets out of hand.

programme.title: Can You See What I See?
programme.desc: Ed decides to shake things up as the casino enters the slow season, so he orders the staff to swap jobs.

programme.title: Tainted Love
programme.desc: Sam's excitement about hosting a billionaire (Dean Cain) at the Montecito turns to dismay when her clients are caught cheating the horse-racing system, requiring Danny to come to her aid.

programme.title: To Protect and Serve Manicotti
programme.desc: When petty mobsters attempt to extort money from a local restaurant owner, Ed asks an old friend, Frank (Sylvester Stallone), to protect the owner.

programme.title: One Nation, Under Surveillance
programme.desc: When Danny's friend, an ex-Marine turned politician, gets caught in a scandal involving a runaway child, he vows to help, but quickly discovers that people are not always who they seem to be.

programme.title: Hit Me!
programme.desc: Ed relies on human ingenuity when cutting-edge technology fails to catch a thief in the act; Mary and Mike intervene when a cheating husband is caught red-handed.

programme.title: Hide and Sneak
programme.desc: Ed suspects that a Gestapo-like police unit has compromised the hotel's security system and is watching everyone, so he enlists Danny and Mike to expose the phantom mole.

programme.title: Letters, Lawyers, and Loose Women
programme.desc: Mary meets her secret admirer; when a philandering hotel guest (Dave Foley) loses his wedding ring at a local brothel, Mike agrees to help him find it.

programme.title: Magic. Carpet. Fred (Maxim Hot 100)
programme.desc: Colorful billionaire Fred Puterbaugh (Jon Lovitz) returns to the Montecito with his girlfriend (Ashanti); a beguiling magician uses his skills to help Ed catch a slippery thief.

programme.title: Centennial
programme.desc: The new owner of the Montecito plans some big changes to the property and to the personnel.

programme.title: Viva Las Vegas
programme.desc: Ed tries to get the Montecito reopened while working for a new boss and trying to lure back his former staff.

programme.title: Fake the Money and Run
programme.desc: Ed tries to keep the new boss out of the loop while he figures out who has been making counterfeit chips; Danny's accountant suggests he sell his father's house and refers him to an attractive real estate agent (Rachael Leigh Cook).

programme.title: Double Down, Triple Threat
programme.desc: When a card counter's daughter is kidnapped, Danny, Mike and Ed reunite with Dr. Cavanaugh (Jill Hennessy) to solve the high-stakes crime.

programme.title: Whatever Happened to Seymour Magoon?
programme.desc: Danny and Penny's relationship hits new levels; Jillian sprains her ankle and convinces Ed to walk the family dog at a local show; Mike must rescue Monica from her shower.

programme.title: The Big Ed De-cline
programme.desc: Ed's plan to rid himself of undue stress ends when he discovers he is a victim of identity theft.

programme.title: The Real McCoy
programme.desc: Despite Mike and Mary's warnings, Danny locates the mystery woman who appears in photos with his father and offers to pay her medical expenses.

programme.title: Everything Old Is You Again
programme.desc: Danny has a flashback to 1962 and being director of entertainment at the Jubilee Hotel and Casino.

programme.title: Bold, Beautiful and Blue
programme.desc: Danny, Monica and FBI Agent Portis review the security measures being taken to protect the Kashmir Sapphire, a priceless gemstone on loan and display at the Montecito.

programme.title: Mothwoman
programme.desc: When the Montecito hosts a comic book convention, fans mistake Monica (Lara Flynn Boyle) for the comic book heroine Mothwoman.

programme.title: For Sail by Owner
programme.desc: A stunning change of events thwarts a hostile takeover of the Montecito; a thug mugs Mike, who leaves Danny to seek his revenge.

programme.title: Down and Dirty
programme.desc: During a nationally televised poker tournament, Danny and Mike suspect someone is cheating and investigate security footage, despite protests from the show's producer.

programme.title: Bait and Switch
programme.desc: Danny and Ed must rely on amateur sex-video footage to help them track down the person who stole diamonds from the Montecito during the taping of a music video.

programme.title: The Bitch Is Back
programme.desc: With great fanfare, the Montecito prepares for the grand opening of Wolfgang Puck's restaurant.

programme.title: And Here's Mike With the Weather
programme.desc: The auditor's report shows a $2.9 million discrepancy when the Montecito staff applies for the annual license renewal; Danny's former Marine sergeant (Dale Dye) visits the hotel, and the two wind up in a bar fight.

programme.title: Urban Legends
programme.desc: NASCAR driver Jimmie Johnson acts as a celebrity judge at the Montecito's car show; Danny and Mike find, in a bathtub full of ice, a man with a kidney missing.

programme.title: Coyote Ugly
programme.desc: When Monica's friend, Norma Pitts (Sarah Ann Morris), finds a finger in the Montecito's new buffet, she has everyone worried that she will sue.

programme.title: Lyle & Substance
programme.desc: Danny apprehends a chip thief who claims he met someone who plans to blow up the Montecito.

programme.title: Like a Virgin
programme.desc: Mary nervously plans a wedding for one of Sam's biggest whales; unusual card-counters plague the casino.

programme.title: Cash Springs Eternal
programme.desc: Danny and Mike divide their time between investigating a string of robberies in the residential suites and posing for a beefcake calendar; Jillian panics when her therapist tells her that her marriage sets a bad example for Delinda.

programme.title: All Quiet on the Montecito Front
programme.desc: Danny and Delinda decide to keep their romance a secret; the department heads go on a paintball retreat.

programme.title: Chaos Theory
programme.desc: Ed and Jillian go on a retreat that proves to be anything but peaceful; Danny and Josh deal with a suspicious character who wants to make bets of $1 million per hand.

programme.title: Fidelity, Security, Delivery
programme.desc: Athlete Sasha Cohen stops by the Montecito; Delinda answers Dr. Derek's marriage proposal; Sam and Woody share a romantic weekend together.

programme.title: Father of the Bride
programme.desc: One of the Montecito ladies is preparing to walk down the aisle; Ed's CIA past puts him in grave danger.

programme.title: Father of the Bride Redux
programme.desc: A gunman attacks Ed; Delinda admits her feelings for Danny; Sam goes to Hawaii to contend with a whale who will not leave the Hawaiian Villas.

programme.title: Died in Plain Sight
programme.desc: Ed returns from his Moroccan trip with shocking news about his past; Danny and Delinda's romance heats up; Mike travels to Hawaii to help Sam with her whale problem.

programme.title: The Story of Owe

programme.title: The Tall T
programme.desc: The luck of Pat Brennan (Randolph Scott) is about to go from bad to worse; after gambling his horse away, he gets a ride from Willard (John Hubbard) and Doretta Mims (Maureen O'Sullivan). Soon, their stagecoach is hijacked by a trio of merciless bandits, led by the especially heartless Frank Usher (Richard Boone). As Usher holds the coach passengers hostage, Brennan falls in love with Doretta and develops a risky plan to free himself and the Mimses, leading to a bloody final standoff.

programme.title: Rio Diablo
programme.desc: Newlywed Benjamin Taber is in town with his bride when a bank robbery goes awry, and she disappears in a chaotic shootout. Determined to find her, Benjamin seeks out the help of crusty Quentin Leech, a bounty hunter who has his own reasons for wanting to catch the outlaws. As they follow the group's trail, they receive help from several unlikely sources, including Flora Mae Pepper, the owner of a brothel that doubles as a safe haven.

programme.title: Barbarosa
programme.desc: In pre-Civil War Texas, naïve Karl Westover (Gary Busey) accidentally kills his brother-in-law, and heads to Mexico to escape the consequences. Along the way, he encounters Barbarosa (Willie Nelson), who is also on the run. Barbarosa teaches Karl survival skills for the desert — and how to rob. In their journey from Texas to Mexico and back again, the two men are captured by outlaw Angel Morales, and pursued by Don Braulio (Gilbert Roland), who wants Barbarosa dead.

Reid, who was injured in the attack, slowly recovers with the help of his childhood friend, the Native American Tonto (Michael Horse). When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture.

He raids a Union Army detail and walks away with valuable treasure that he intends to put to use raising another rebel army. Jonas needs to keep the treasure safe during shipment, so he places it in a coffin and forces saloon girl Claire (Norma Bengell) to play widow. Claire is unwilling to do her part, however, and puts herself in danger by opposing the dangerous Jonas.

programme.desc: In the American West, Willet Gashade (Warren Oates), a former bounty hunter, and Coley Boyard (Will Hutchins), his dimwitted partner, are approached by a secretive young woman (Millie Perkins) who offers them money to guide her through the desert but refuses to discuss why she is traveling. The group embarks on the journey and is eventually joined by Billy Spear (Jack Nicholson), a volatile gunslinger the woman has also hired. The only question is why.

programme.title: There Was a Crooked Man
programme.desc: After a botched heist, Wild West bandit Paris Pitman Jr. (Kirk Douglas) hides his newly stolen money where no one will find it, then loses his entire gang in a blaze of bullets before being captured by the law and given a lengthy sentence in a desert jail. Paris believes that he can buy his way out of his predicament by offering some cash to the guards, but the upstanding Sheriff Lopeman (Henry Fonda) makes sure his men remain honest. Running out of options, Paris begins plotting a jailbreak.

programme.title: The Deadly Companions
programme.desc: When a bank heist goes wrong, outlaw Yellowleg (Brian Keith) inadvertently kills a 9-year-old boy -- the son of saloon girl Kit Tildon (Maureen O'Hara). Plagued by guilt over the shooting, Yellowleg vows to help her bury the boy beside his father in the now-derelict town of Siringo, Ariz. With criminal cohorts Billy (Steve Cochran) and Turk (Chill Wills), Yellowleg embarks on a dangerous journey into Apache territory to lay the boy in his final resting place.

programme.title: Red Headed Stranger
programme.desc: The Rev. Shay moves out West to set up his new home in Montana so that he can spread God's word. But when his wife, Raysha, leaves him for another man -- in part because she wants to return to Philadelphia -- the reverend decides to replace his spiritual ways with a gun. After shooting down his wife and her lover, he battles a landowner intent on keeping all the town's water for himself. But his deadly ways make him yearn for a belief in God again.

That's why he's traveling to Oregon to reunite with his sweetheart, Catherine Tuttle (Helen Shaver). She's the daughter of a judge, and it's no surprise that, when Tracy gets to Portland, he winds up behind bars. But no jail built can hold the desperado, and, after breaking out, Tracy finds himself on the run from every lawman in the state.

programme.desc: Garrett Bess shares his hometown, the Central Jersey Shore, with visits to David Burke's Drifthouse, a feast of seafood at One Willow, and a delicious cheeseburger at local treasure Barnacle Bill's.

programme.title: Stage 10 - POLAND - 2024
programme.desc: A spectacular event on the beach of Gdansk, Poland. A competition in the sand and in the water. Complete with a boat pull. With an impressive line up again, we welcome you to watch us LIVE in the SCL Poland.

programme.title: Stage 11 - DUBAI - 2024 - Part 1

programme.title: Stage 12 - DUBAI - 2024 - Part 2
programme.desc: After three cruel events in part 1, the World record holder on the deadlift with 501 Kg, will fight for the crown and the title. You simply cant miss this most epic show, at in the World Trade Center in Dubai part 2.

programme.title: Stage 13 - CYPRUS - 2024

programme.title: Stage 14 - SOUTH AFRICA - 2024
programme.desc: With 12 of the world's best athletes arriving in Cape Town, South Africa, all fighting for the crown and final ranking points ahead of the World Finals in Turkey. Rayno Nel still needs to qualify along with Brian Kichton also battling for a seat in the World Finals.

programme.title: Stage 15 - TURKEY - WORLD FINALS - 2024 - PART 1

programme.title: Stage 16 - TURKEY - WORLD FINALS - 2024 - PART 2
programme.desc: Part 2 of the world final of the Strongman Champions League tour 2024 in Alanya, Turkey. With three Events down and amazing results. Who will be the new World champion?

programme.title: Stage 01 - ICEMAN - Finland
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 opens in Joensuu, Finland in freezing -5°C conditions. Athletes battle frame carry as first event on ice and snow. Brian Kichton sets early pace, but Kevin Hazeleger ultimately wins with 27.57s. Competitors from USA, Finland, Turkey and others struggle with cold and debut performances, setting the tone for a global season. Cold conditions define the opening stage.

programme.title: Stage 02 - Latvia
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 Stage 2 in Riga, Latvia opens by the Baltic Sea with 12 athletes competing in spring conditions. Events include truck pull, log lift, bag toss medley, loading race and Atlas Stones. Home favourite Aivars Smaukstelis returns in emotional final Latvian appearance aiming for his third SCL crown. The competition begins with a truck pull opener setting early times.

programme.title: Stage 03 - Serbia
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 heads to Zrenjanin, Serbia for Stage 3, where elite athletes compete in a packed city-centre showdown. With four debutants joining established names like Evans Nana and Aivars Smaukstelis, competitors face brutal tests including a 16,000kg truck pull as the season builds momentum.

programme.title: Stage 04 - Italy
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 kicks off in Crema, Italy, for Stage 4 of the season, bringing a world-class lineup to Lombardy. Athletes face brutal tests including car deadlift, log lift medley, Hercules hold, and Atlas stones, as reigning champion Rayno Nel returns fresh from major victory to defend his crown.

programme.title: Stage 05 - Holland Part 1
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Netherlands, for a high-stakes summer showdown. A world-class lineup, including Rayno Nel, Brian Kichton, and Evans Nana, battles in extreme 35°C heat across six brutal events such as truck pull, Viking press, and Atlas stones, as the fight for SCL glory intensifies.

programme.title: Stage 06 - Holland Part 2
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Holland, for Stage 5 as athletes resume Day 2 of competition in a tight battle for the SCL title. With only three events remaining, competitors face a brutal sandbag loading race and other heavy tests, as Kevin Hazeleger and Rayno Nel fight for the overall lead.

programme.title: Stage 07 - Worlds Strongest Viking - Finland
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League heads to Joensuu, Finland, for Stage 7 as athletes battle to be crowned the World's Strongest Viking 2025. Twelve competitors face nine gruelling events in a high-stakes showdown, with top contenders like Brian Kichton, Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana fighting for crucial championship points.

programme.title: Stage 08 - Worlds Strongest Latino - Portugal
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Esposende, Portugal, for the World's Strongest Latino contest. Twelve elite athletes battle through a truck pull, deadlift, log lift, bag toss and medley in front of a packed crowd. Early leader Juan Ferrer sets the pace, as Invernizzi and others fight for top honours.

programme.title: Stage 09 - Worlds Strongest Truckpull - England
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Farnborough, England, for the 2025 World Championship Truck Pull at the British Motor Show. Top international athletes compete in this spectacular test of strength, pulling massive vehicles as crowds gather for a thrilling showcase of power and endurance.

programme.title: Stage 10 - Poland
programme.desc: Stage 10 of the Strongman Champions League 2025 arrives in Gdańsk, Poland, where a world-class lineup competes in tough events including deadlift, log lift, and loading race. With top athletes like Aivars Smaukstelis and Adam Roszkowski in action, the battle intensifies as the season nears its climax.

programme.title: Stage 11 - Hungary
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Siófok, Hungary, by Lake Balaton for a crucial late-season showdown. Reigning champion Adam Roszkowski returns to defend his title against a stacked field, including Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana. With World Finals approaching, the battle for points intensifies.

programme.title: Stage 12 - USA Part 1
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League makes its U.S. debut in Toledo, Ohio! In day 1 of 2, fourteen world-class athletes battle for the SCL USA title across four powerhouse events - including a Super Medley featuring a car push, Fingal's Finger, and a stone-breaking challenge. Other highlights include the Front Hold with a whiskey barrel, a keg toss into water, and a gruelling 130,000 kg boat pull - capped off by an electrifying Guinness World Record attempt.

programme.title: Stage 13 - SCL USA Part 2
programme.desc: It's the final day of the Strongman Champions League's first-ever U.S. event in Sandusky, Ohio. Athletes face a massive gas tanker truck pull, a unique shovel deadlift, and Atlas Stones weighing 120-200 kg - plus a thrilling Guinness World Record attempt. Who will claim the SCL USA crown?

programme.title: Stage 14 - Dubai Part 1
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Dubai for its penultimate stage before the World Finals. Elite athletes battle across gruelling events, including the dumbbell press, deadlift, and bag toss. With fierce competition and rankings on the line, every point counts in the race to qualify for South Africa.

programme.title: Stage 15 - Dubai Part 2
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League continues in Dubai for the final stage before the World Finals. Twelve elite athletes battle gruelling events near the Burj Khalifa, with Ramin Farajnejad leading after three rounds. With fierce competition and last chances to qualify, the stakes couldn't be higher.

programme.title: Stage 16 - South Africa Part 1
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals begin in Uppington, South Africa, after a global season of elite competition. Top athletes gather for a dramatic showdown, led by reigning champion and hometown hero Rayno Nel, as they battle in extreme events for the ultimate strongman title.

programme.title: Stage 17 - South Africa Part 2
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals continue in Uppington, South Africa. With three wins already, hometown hero and World's Strongest Man Rayno Nel leads the competition, backed by a passionate crowd. As athletes battle by the Orange River, the fight for the title and $50,000 intensifies.

programme.title: Feeding Sheep in Winter
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies cannot decide whether to have Tubby Custard or Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Hanukah
programme.desc: The Teletubbies leave their favourite things to watch some boys spinning some spinning tops to celebrate the Hanukah festival. Tinky Winky wears the skirt on his head to do a very special round and round dance.

programme.title: Washing Up
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance a jumping dance before stopping to watch Yvette wash up her plastic cups and saucers. The Teletubbies have a very messy day. So Noo-Noo has to tidy everything up.

programme.title: Number 5
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets. They stop chasing him to watch some children learn about the number five. A flashing light appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Christmas Tree
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'. They hurry up the slide to see some children decorate a Christmas Tree. The Teletubbies get excited when their own Christmas Tree appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Making Christmas Cards
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards. Laa-Laa's present is some lovely decorations. When Noo-Noo tidies them up they tickle his throat, so he throws them out to decorate Home Hill.

programme.title: Crackers
programme.desc: Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other. Dipsy is very pleased to find his present is a cracker. He looks for someone to pull the cracker. It makes a lovely pink bang and the Teletubbies laugh when they fall over.

programme.title: Carol Singing
programme.desc: A group of children sing some Christmas carols to the Teletubbies. Tinky Winky opens his present to find a beautiful star inside. The Teletubbies follow it all over Teletubbyland, but where will is end up?

programme.title: Snowy Day
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and teaches the Teletubbies a winter nursery rhyme. Po's present is a little frosty cloud that begins to snow. All the Teletubbies laugh as they play in the snow.

programme.title: Level Crossing
programme.desc: The Teletubbies see some children visit a level crossing and watch a train pass by. The Teletubbies play their Ready, Steady, Go game.

programme.title: Becky & Jed Find Eggs
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play a slide game before watching Becky and Jed look for eggs on their farm. Then their mum cooks them for their tea. In Teletubbyland, the Lion and Bear play their hide and seek game.

programme.title: Rocking Chair
programme.desc: Alex Pascall and some children sing to their dolls to rock them to sleep. Laa-Laa wants to sing a lovely song, but Tinky Winky is crunching his Tubby Toast too loudly!

programme.title: Colours - Pink
programme.desc: The Teletubbies march up and down a hill and then they watch some children explore the colour pink. Tinky Winky doesn't know how to make Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Living in Flats
programme.desc: Laa-Laa dances with her ball. A little boy tells us why he likes to live in his block of flats. A balloon appears in Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies follow a balloon.

programme.title: Urban Walk
programme.desc: The Teletubbies giggle as they play their 'Through the Arch' game. The windmill stops them to watch a little girl and her dad go for a walk in the town.

programme.title: Our Calf Treacle
programme.desc: The Teletubbies line up to say 'Eh-oh' and then watch Matthew and Mark feed a baby calf. The Teletubbies play a game to see who can eat their Tubby Custard the slowest, but Po can't wait and eats her Tubby Custard very fast.

programme.title: Naughty Pig
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the Naughty Pig. Dipsy's hat keeps blowing away and he has to chase it all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Washing the Car
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa run into Home Hill to say 'Eh-oh', but where 's Po? Some children help their dad to wash his car. They get very wet and soapy.

programme.title: Handy Hands
programme.desc: The Tubbies crawl through the arch in Home Hill and watch Alex Pascall and some children sing 'Handy Hands'.

programme.title: Playing Ball
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children play with balls of different shapes and sizes. In Teletubbyland, something happens to Dipsy's hat.

programme.title: Irish Dancing
programme.desc: It's time for the Teletubbies to do their exercises. A voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies stretch up and down to it's instructions.

programme.title: Numbers 2
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two. Dipsy and Laa-Laa are eating Tubby Toast. They play the game 'Two Little Teletubbies', but while they are playing the Noo-Noo tidies up their Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Giraffes
programme.desc: The Teletubbies take turns to stand on a hill, in front of the house, next to a tree under a cloud. Andy Brown and some children visit some giraffes. The animals march through Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Amy's House
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are eating Tubby Toast. They stop to watch Amy making pasta. A ball of string appears in Teletubbyland. Po knocks the string in to the air with her scooter and it makes a stringy mess all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Naughty Sock Returns
programme.desc: Tinky Winky calls the other Tubbies to come and watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story about the naughty sock. The Tubby Toast machine makes a tower of tubby toast.

programme.title: Penguins
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming. In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies play walk fast and slow, far and near and other different ways.

programme.title: Ned's Geraniums
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play 'Boo', but stop to watch Ned help his dad plant and water some geraniums. In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.

programme.title: Crabs - Digging in the Sand
programme.desc: The Teletubbies love playing on the slide. They stop to watch Andy Brown and some children digging in the sand for crabs.

programme.title: Samira's Gymnastics
