programme.desc: A relationship expert who struggles with love finds herself stuck on a ranch before Christmas with a rancher.

programme.title: Creating Christmas
programme.desc: Aspiring illustrator Harper collaborates with demanding author Caleb. When he insists on working through Christmas in a quaint town, she must use the holiday celebrations to help break his writer's block.

programme.title: The Leak
programme.desc: A routine SWAT takedown of a suspected al-Qaida terrorist turns into a potentially deadly ambush for FBI agents.

programme.title: The Sniper
programme.desc: Sue and the team are under the gun after determining seemingly random shootings are the work of a serial sniper.

programme.title: Prodigal Father
programme.desc: Bobby's wayward father resurfaces with a surprising proposition; Sue starts to come to grips with her feelings for Jack.

programme.title: Love Map
programme.desc: A self-assured relationship columnist who is about to launch a dating app is sent on assignment with a prickly tour guide to create a real map of the most romantic places in Florida.

programme.title: All Aboard for Love
programme.desc: As Alison prepares for new ocean adventures, business executive Joel navigates his way into her heart, and they become co-captains for life.

programme.title: Romance in Hawaii
programme.desc: Leah, a successful but dissatisfied executive, discovers the missing passion from her life when she starts taking hula dance lessons from handsome local Ikaika.

programme.title: Love Amongst the Stars
programme.desc: Heidi, an astronomy professor, is convinced that a rare planetary alignment is key to getting a new observatory for her students. The new history professor, August, might be the key to her research.

programme.title: Dashing Home for Christmas
programme.desc: Holiday traveling mishaps force a successful business consultant to find a way home with help from a stranger.

programme.title: Christmas on the Ranch
programme.desc: A relationship expert who struggles with love finds herself stuck on a ranch before Christmas with a rancher.

programme.title: A Christmas Wish in Hudson
programme.desc: A woman takes a shot at love after seeing a widowed firefighter and chef on a cooking show. With the help of his daughter, the two of them might find love this Christmas.

programme.title: Christmas in Scotland
programme.desc: On vacation in Scotland, a New York installation designer is tasked with helping a small, rural community compete in a "Best Christmas Village" festival. She is forced to work with a wealthy, heir who sees Christmas as an inconvenience.

programme.title: Italy's Heartland
programme.desc: Lidia loves entertaining and today, she shares recipes that are fit for any Italian dinner party. Bruschetta is a great party appetizer, and Lidia shares one of her favorite toppings: Cannellini and Pancetta Bruschetta. Next on the menu is Beef and Root Vegetables Braised in Red Wine, a hearty-one pol meal your guests will love.

programme.title: Childhood Cravings
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia remembers some of her fondest childhood recipes that were made by her Grandmother Rosa in Italy. Recipes include Mussels Triestina and Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto. A fun and fruity Fruit Smash Soda is shared with her mother, Erminia.

programme.title: Italian Style Salads
programme.desc: Panzanella with fennel and shrimp; orange and tropea onion salad; green salad with apples and provolone; cabbage salad with speck.

programme.title: Dress Up Dinner
programme.desc: A Belgian and endive salad that features a rich egg yolk vinaigrette; naked ricotta dumplings with a sage-butter sauce; stuffed tomatoes.

programme.title: My Favorite Braises
programme.desc: Braising is a preferred technique in Lidia's kitchen and today she prepares one rich braised meat dish, along with two braised vegetable choices for the home cook. Recipes include: Beef Braised in Barolo; a Braised Kale with Bacon; and finally Braised Cauliflower.

programme.title: The Italian Products Have Arrived!
programme.desc: The arrival of Italians into America demanded the need for Italian products as well. This resulted in more creativity and flavor in the kitchen, as Italians began to grow their produce in America. Lidia makes a Belgian & Red Endive Salad as well as a sweet Cherry Jam Tart wrapped up in an almond crust.

programme.title: The Tomato
programme.desc: The tomato Is not native to Italy, but it made a big impact on Italian cuisine when it arrived centuries ago. From canned to vine ripened, Lidia shares with you several of her favorite tomato dishes including: Stuffed Tomatoes: stuffed with rice, mozzarella and basil; Braised Pork Ribs with Rigatoni: Tender to the bone pork ribs and braising sauce with rigatoni; and Green Beans in Chunky Tomato Sauce: a perfect side of fresh green beans smothered in a fresh chunky tomato sauce.

programme.title: Welcome To My Kitchen
programme.desc: Focaccia di recco; a quick salad matching salty pecorino Romano cheese with sweet pears and peppery arugula; rigatoni with sausage and cabbage.

programme.title: Embrace The New
programme.desc: Gorgonzola celery; pumpkin risotto topped with gorgonzola; Venetian-style liver with a mushroom onion sauce.

programme.title: The Community Table
programme.desc: Cheese crisp bowls filled with a colourful salad; bucatini with broccoli walnut pesto; turkey stuffed peppers.

programme.title: Summer Picnic
programme.desc: Italians love a good picnic, and Lidia shares some of her favorite picnic foods from her childhood. The menu includes Herb Frittata Rollups, a must-have finger food rolled up with a layer of flavor packed pesto. Lidia's Pasta Salad with Tomato, Mozzarella and Green Beans is a hearty pasta salad that is perfect for any picnic. Her Blueberry and Ricotta Parfait is made with homemade ricotta, blueberry sauce, candied almonds and cake.

programme.title: BAKED PASTA
programme.desc: Everyone loves baked pasta, and in this episode, Lidia prepares a Baked Penne Dish with a comforting pork ragu and zucchini topped with a golden crust of cheese. She also makes an elegant Salad of Asparagus, Scallions and Boiled Egg and finishes the meal with a delicious and moist Chocolate Zucchini Cake

programme.title: Italian Staples
programme.desc: In this episode, it's all about some of Italy's most popular staples. Lidia will share three of her all-time favorites including a Chicken Parmigiana Light - a version of the famous Chicken Parmigiana - made with a chicken thigh topped with fresh tomato and mozzarella and nestled in a bed of tomato sauce. Her Beef and Arugula Bruschetta is a perfect and quick starter to the meal.

programme.title: PIZZA
programme.desc: Everybody loves grilling, and everybody loves pizza. Today Lidia puts the two together and prepares grilled pizza which anyone can do - rain or shine - as it's done in her kitchen. She makes a simple margherita style pizza and another version topped with prosciutto. To start, her fresh and crunchy salad is made with cucumbers, string beans and potatoes. For dessert, she prepares juicy Peaches and Blueberries Soaked in Prosecco.

programme.title: Gnocchi Time Memories with the Grandkids
programme.desc: Lidia has shared her love for gnocchi and passing on traditions for years, and in this episode she makes the gnocchi out of cheese.The comforting meal includes: Lentil Country Salad, Cheese Gnocchi with Butter and Sage Sauce, and Pork Pockets Stuffed with Pickles and Cheese.

programme.title: Spiced Up Soup and Salad Night
programme.desc: Soups are a part of any Italian celebration, and Americans love pairing them with a salad and sandwich. Today, Lidia will combine the best of both with a unique Italian style menu of soup, salad and bruschetta. The menu includes Spicy Italian Style Vegetable Soup, Bruschetta with Ndjua - a crunchy country bread topped with a spicy sausage and a simple and delicious Skillet Peppers and Potatoes.

programme.title: PASTA
programme.desc: Everybody loves pasta and so does Lidia. Today, she makes three dishes that viewers will love. Her first dish is an Orecchiette with Clams and Zucchini, made with scallions, pepperoncino and garlic. Her Spaghetti Caruso is made with a hearty sauce of mixed mushrooms, tomatoes, peas and chicken livers. She finishes with a unique dish of Rigatoni with Cauliflower, Saffron and Golden Raisins.

programme.title: CHICKEN STOCK
programme.desc: Every great kitchen needs a big pot of good stock and with this pot of stock, Lidia will make three delicious dishes. She starts by making a flavorful chicken stock made into "Stracciatella", laced with eggs and spinach. She then uses the stock in her succulent Stuffed Veal Chop with oozing Fontina. Finally, she prepares a Braised Kale with Bacon, a wonderful dish that she has been eating since she was a child.

programme.title: The Start Of The Season
programme.desc: Cannellini pesto dip and a crudite spread; spaghetti primavera with courgette, green beans, peas and asparagus; spinach, bread and ricotta frittata.

programme.title: ANTIPASTI
programme.desc: There is a party in the air with an Italian flair. Lidia teaches the viewer several dishes that will work for any party - including a selection of varies cheese, cured meat and Giardiniera Style Vegetables; an easy and quick Sweet and Sour Zucchini Dish and lastly Stuffed Mushrooms made with a delicious mixture of scallions, red peppers and fresh parsley. Lastly there is still time for a delicious salad of poached seafood featuring shrimp, mussels and calamari.

programme.title: VEGETABLES
programme.desc: Whether used in soups, roasted or stuffed, the Italians love their vegetables. In this episode, she makes a platter full of Roasted Peppers Stuffed with Tuna. She then creates a mellow dish of Savory Onions Stuffed with Lamb and Sweet Raisins. The Cauliflower and Tomato Soup is one that warms the heart and any kitchen table.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Life's Milestones
programme.desc: Join Lidia Bastianich on a deeply personal culinary journey in celebration of life's milestones, sharing in the wonderful diversity of American culture and food. Milestones include sweet sixteen, baptism, graduation, and a house blessing.

programme.title: Best of Baked Dishes
programme.desc: The oven is on in today's episode! With a little bit of prep time and a hot oven, you can enjoy the appetizers with the friends and family while the rest is baking. Today's recipes include: Spicy Stuffed Clams; Roasted Chicken with Pomegranate; and Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage & Mushrooms.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Grilled corn, courgette and tomato salad; spicy lobster linguine.

programme.title: Kneading Dough
programme.desc: The tradition of kneading dough has always been around in Lidia's family. She recalls kneading with her grandmother as a small child and continues to do it with her own grandchildren today. In this episode, she prepares a buttery, flaky Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta, a delicious Butternut Squash and Brussels Sprouts Panzanella using leftover bread, and finally Pappardelle with Mixed Fresh Mushrooms.

programme.title: A Dinner Party
programme.desc: Entertaining comes in many forms, and today Lidia creates a menu that is perfect for an intimate gathering of friends and family. This simply elegant dinner menu includes Swordfish alla Bagnara, a delicately steamed swordfish made with an aromatic mix of lemon, capers and garlic - a traditional dish from the Calabrian town of Bagnara. She'll then do a spicy Bloody Mary, followed by a classic Lagane e Ceci - ribbons of fresh pasta made with chickpeas and pepperoncino.

programme.title: Vegetable Favorites
programme.desc: Italy is a garden year round, and Lidia celebrates an array of beautiful vegetable dishes including: Celery Stalks Stuffed with Gorgonzola and Apples; an elegant Asparagus and Scallion Salad; a refreshing Fava Sesame Dip, that pairs beautifully with flat breads and finally a Linguine with Swisschard made with walnuts and creamy fresh ricotta.

programme.title: Welcome to my Home
programme.desc: Today's recipes are perfect for entertaining and include a savory Onion-Tomato Focaccia, restaurant inspired spreads for fresh bread and Skillet or Grilled Calamari.

programme.title: FOCACCIA
programme.desc: Focaccia is an irresistible, crunchy Italian flatbread. It's great for sandwiches and even to stuff. Lidia begins by making a Classic Rosemary and Lemon Focaccia; she then moves on to a Filled Focaccia with Smoky Speck and Fontina Cheese. To finish these two lunchtime and snack favorites, she creates a Salad of Shrimp, Fava and Cranberry Beans.

programme.title: The Fish Market
programme.desc: Potato and pasta soup; a salad of green beans and new potatoes; ditalini with potatoes and provoke.

programme.title: Surf N Turf
programme.desc: Surf n' Turf might not be an Italian tradition, but a Crispy Shrimp, Swordfish Skewers with Sweet and Sour Sauce go beautifully with a Maremma Style Steak! Tutti in Cucina! Everyone in the kitchen today!

programme.title: Italian Cakes
programme.desc: The oven is on today in Lidia's Kitchen, and she is sharing some of her best cakes. There is a Gianduia Cake - a Piedmontese tradition and a dream for hazelnut and chocolate lovers; a delicious and moist Chocolate and Zucchini Cake; and finally a nutty Walnut and Espresso Cake.

programme.title: Italian All Stars
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares some of her all-time favorites - Tomato and Onion Salad alla Calabrese, a great salad to make in the summer when tomatoes are sweet and ripe. Everyone loves meatballs, and Lidia shows viewers how to use leftovers in a Leftover Meatball Panini. Finally, Lidia stuffs Pizza Rolls with broccoli rabe and sausage and with ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: Eggs and My Chickens
programme.desc: As a child, Lidia's courtyard was home to several animals. She spent a lot of time with chickens, as she would tend to them and gather their eggs. In this episode, Lidia recollects those fond memories and creates a medley of vegetables, salumi, cheese and hard boiled eggs for her Chopped Salad with Frisee and Fennel. She also prepares a Chicken Cacciatore as well as a Potato and Egg Frico.

programme.title: Respect The Ingredients
programme.desc: Steamed broccoli, cannellini and egg salad; skillet tuna with aubergine and courgette in puttanesca sauce.

programme.title: Game Day Bites
programme.desc: Whether it's American football or Italian soccer, game day parties are always popular. Lidia believes that there is nothing like a bountiful spread of food that will fuel the guests and get them cheering. On today's menu, she serves Fried Mozzarella Sandwich Skewers; Carrot and Chickpea Dip and Pizza Rolls - made with both broccoli rabe and sausage AND ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: A Stovetop Dinner
programme.desc: The stove can do a lot of work in any home kitchen, and many recipes can be created simultaneously. In this episode, Lidia shares recipes for: Cannellini and Pancetta Bruschetta; Ziti with Kale and Crispy Bacon; and Monkfish Meatballs in Tomato Sauce

programme.title: Make it Zucchini
programme.desc: Oven-braised pork chops with red onions and pears; beef and root vegetables braised in red wine; tomato-braised cauliflower recipe.

programme.title: The Versatile Tomato and All things Italian
programme.desc: Tomatoes are known in the Italian culture although the tradition goes way beyond the simple tomato sauce. Lidia gathers some of her favorite tomato based recipes and shares them in this episode including: Tomato and Mint Salad, Tomato and Ricotta Crostini, Spaghetti with Quick Pantry Sauce. She finishes with a Gluttonous Tomato- a perfect appetizer or lunch dish starring oven baked tomatoes stuffed with bread, grated cheese and seasoning and topped with farm eggs. Yum!

programme.title: Something For Everyone
programme.desc: Butternut squash and cannellini beans; a quick and easy dessert of strawberries and balsamic; roasted spaghetti squash with spicy tomato sauce.

programme.title: Spice it Up
programme.desc: Spices impart a lot of flavor to a recipe, and today Lidia shows viewers how to use different spices. First on the menu is Mussels with Fennel and Saffron, an elegant and luxurious way to serve mussels. Lidia loves peperoncino in almost any dish, especially when making Spicy Stuffed Clams. And finally, Lidia makes Chicken and Zucchini Salad with Horseradish Dressing.

programme.title: Chicken for Dinner
programme.desc: Pan pizza and a mozzarella cheeseburger using focaccia, mozzarella, pickled peperoncino and a grilled tomato; crispy baked chicken cutlets.

programme.title: The Winter Vegetable Punch
programme.desc: Winter always proved to be a tough time for the garden, but this only made cold weather crops more valuable on Lidia's family table. Recipes in this episode include a delicious Orecchiette with Breadcrumbs, Pancetta, and Cauliflower, and a unique and flavorful Cabbage Salad topped with a warm dressing.

programme.title: Steak Night With London Broil
programme.desc: There is nothing better than a great piece of meat! In today's episode, Lidia takes a less expensive cut, London Broil, and marinate it to perfection. Her menu includes a delicious Vegetable Patty served with green salad which works as an appetizer or by itself as a quick lunch, London Broil with Sun Dried Tomato Marinade and one of her Grandma Rosa's favorite Corn and Walnut Cake

programme.title: Fishing the Adriatic with Uncle Emilio
programme.desc: Lidia fell in love with the sea growing up near the Adriatic's beautiful rocky beaches. Fishing trips with Uncle Emilio were always a lot of hard work, but definitely worth the delicious reward. Today, she prepares a Grilled Calamari Salad with Tomato Coulis, Toasted Bread with Basil Cannellini, and a Whole Roasted Branzino where everything is done in the oven for a trouble-free cleanup.

programme.title: FRESH PASTA
programme.desc: Fresh pasta is an Italian family tradition passed through the generations. Today she starts with a silky pappardelle pasta dressed with pesto made from walnut, basil and parsley. She then takes the same pasta dough and shapes it into Tortelloni stuffed with spinach and ricotta, dressed with a classic marinara sauce.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Return of the Artisans
programme.desc: Lidia Bastianich travels the country to meet with American makers who are mastering the art of meat curing, coopering, coppersmithing, jam-making, cider-making, and more-and finds out what inspires and fuels them. She sees how artisanal crafts and small businesses are a fulfilling way to earn a livelihood, and how many craftspeople are bringing their skills back to their own communities.

programme.title: A Little Spice With A Hint of Beer
programme.desc: There is nothing more delicious than butterflied poultry with super crispy chicken. In this episode, Lidia starts with a Spicy Butterflied Cornish Hen made with hot cherry peppers, rosemary and wine. She then pulls out the beer to add to her Potatoes Baked in Beer .Our favorite Grandma Erminia joins Lidia to taste the Squash and Ricotta Tart.

programme.title: Cooking as a Kid in New York
programme.desc: Lidia's first home economics class as a teenager in New York confirmed her passion for food. Despite the differences compared to what she was used to, she was determined to explore it all. Lidia starts off with Lasagna with Ricotta and Mozzarella, a dish she remembers from when she was first introduced to Italian American food. She follows this with a flavorful Escarole Olive Oil Mashed Potatoes, and finishes with Baked Stuffed Vegetables, a very satisfying mixture.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Freedom & Independence
programme.desc: Join beloved chef and cookbook author Lidia Bastianich on a deeply personal culinary journey to four celebrations of independence, to share in the wonderful diversity of American culture and food.

programme.title: A Cheesy Craving
programme.desc: Italians love cheese, and back in the kitchen, Lidia shares her favorite cheesy appetizers - Baked Goat Cheese, Fava, and Artichoke Dip, baked to golden to perfection; and Baked Stuffed Vegetables, a recipe Lidia often makes when cooking for her family.

programme.title: Holiday Celebrations & Special Occasions
programme.desc: When a holiday or special occasion goes around, it's time to go above and beyond with an extra special feast. Today, Lidia shares some of her best recipes to do just that. Her Wedding Soup is a classic Italian dish that marries the vegetables and meatballs in a delicious pot of soup; Prosecco Punch, made with raspberries and nectarines is a real crowd pleaser, and finally you can't go wrong with a beautiful Roasted Lamb Shoulder with Carrots and Parsnips, a rich and flavorful one pot meal.

programme.title: A Day at the Market
programme.desc: Lidia has always loved trips to the food market. From her days as a small child preparing to go to the market with her grandmother to searching for seasonal produce today, it has always been an adventure. Recipes in this episode include a Shrimp, Roasted Pepper and Olive Salad and a delicious vegetarian Eggplant Parmigiana Stacks.

programme.title: Starring Olive Oil
programme.desc: Olive oil is an essential staple in every Italian home. It's the easiest way to add flavor to any soup, and Lidia shows you how when making Cannellini Bean and Lentil Soup. Olive oil is also used in desserts, and she makes Olive Oil Cake.

programme.title: Family Favorites
programme.desc: Today's recipes are dedicated to the family. They can be made for a weeknight dinner or a large gathering or holiday and include: Oven Braised Pork Chops with Red Onion and Pears; Cherry Jam Tart. To start, Lidia enjoys a special Cherry Bellini.

programme.title: Eggs All Day
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shows you how to brunch Italian-style. On the menu are Herb Frittata Roll-Ups, a wonderful appetizer to pass around at a cocktail party or for a buffet brunch; Pancetta with Fennel-Flavored Eggs and Apples, a delicious breakfast or brunch dish served with lots of crusty bread; and Potato and Egg Frico, a favorite breakfast dish in Lidia's family, in which potatoes and cheese are baked together.

programme.title: Italian Essentials
programme.desc: A light version of chicken parmigiana; rice balls stuffed with sausage ragu; Lidia's traditional Bolognese sauce.

programme.title: The 1970s Italian American
programme.desc: As a teenager in the seventies, Lidia was always curious about Italian-American cuisine, which was extremely popular especially in New York City and all the boroughs. Today she honors the Italian-American culinary culture and prepares a Chicken Parmigiana Light, a leftover Meatball Panino, and a Baked Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Meatballs, and Eggs, which will be sure to leave everyone satisfied.

programme.title: An Italian Cookout
programme.desc: Sausages with fennel and green olives; seared lamb chops with mint salsa and roasted potato wedges; fragoncello.

programme.title: Rethink Risotto
programme.desc: Skillet shrimp with asparagus features sauteed shrimp over grilled bread; skillet gratinate of pork, aubergine and zucchini; one-pot soft polenta.

programme.title: Just Braising
programme.desc: Oven-braised pork chops with red onions and pears; beef and root vegetables braised in red wine; tomato-braised cauliflower recipe.

programme.title: Olive Oil
programme.desc: Olive oil reigns in Lidia's kitchen, and in this episode she teaches the viewer how to use it from appetizer to soup to dessert. She'll start with a delicious Tomato and Bread Salad - a delicious tossed salad of country bread and juicy ripe tomatoes known as panzanella; a nourishing Rice and Lentil Soup and a Cannoli Napoleon, a new twist on the old cannoli: ricotta cream with crunchy almonds and chocolate layered between fried pastry.

programme.title: A Meal To Make You Smile
programme.desc: Radicchio, endive, apple and pecorino with cheese toasts; skilled ricotta mini meatloaves dressed in a mushroom sauce.

programme.title: Tiny Kitchen, Big Flavor
programme.desc: A light version of chicken parmigiana; rice balls stuffed with sausage ragu; Lidia's traditional Bolognese sauce.

programme.title: Cheese Please!
programme.desc: Chopped salad with frisee and fennel; a summertime-inspired tomato and courgette bread lasagna; braised beef rolls.

programme.title: An Easy Holiday
programme.desc: Today is all about stress-free cooking for a holiday celebration or special occasion. Lidia makes Marinated Mushrooms that can be part of an antipasto spread or as a nibble with drinks. Vin Brûlé, the Italian version of mulled wine, is a warm and welcoming drink to make for any holiday celebration. Last on the menu is Turkey Breast with Apricots, an easy and quick way to serve turkey without having to cook a whole turkey.

programme.title: A Kind Gesture
programme.desc: A Belgian and endive salad that features a rich egg yolk vinaigrette; naked ricotta dumplings with a sage-butter sauce; stuffed tomatoes.

programme.title: Storytime with Grandma
programme.desc: Lidia's mother, Erminia, is known to all as "Grandma." She is known for her laughter, singing and entertaining culinary moments with Lidia. In this episode, featured recipes include Corn and Zucchini Minestra, Fried Risotto and Beef & Root Vegetables Braised in Red Wine. "Salute" to Grandma!

programme.title: Gnocchi
programme.desc: They have been called the "gnocchi family", and in this episode, Lidia shares two of her more unusual versions of this dish: Her Butternut Squash Gnocchi are light and slightly sweet as they showcase this welcome vegetable in the potato mix. Her next dish is Plum Gnocchi, which is typical of her homeland and even sweeter, sometimes eaten as a dessert. Made with toasted breadcrumbs, cinnamon and butter, it doesn't get any better than this!

programme.title: Eggs: All Different Ways
programme.desc: It's an episode devoted to the fresh, simple egg, and it highlights some of Lidia's all-time favorites: Stracciatella: a simple chicken stock laced with ribbons of egg and tender spinach; Frittata with Ricotta: a luscious frittata filled with ricotta, tomatoes, onions and basil; Baked Eggplant and Eggs: a baked dish showing off of one of summer's best vegetables.

programme.title: Crespelle
programme.desc: Italians love their crepes either savory or sweet and this episode, Lidia shows two of her favorite crespelle dishes, along with some great chef tips. She will start by highlighting the thin pancakes that can be made into so many things; then she'll make a savory Italian favorite with them - Manicotti and for a sweet version, she will show the Chocolate and Walnut Crespelle that will satisfy any sweet tooth.

programme.title: Party Fixings
programme.desc: Lidia says that the key to a great party is always the food, and in this episode she features some of her best party recipes from over the years. Bruschetta is always a great snack to pass around, and the combinations are endless. Her Fig & Prosciutto Bruschetta is a unique and delicious party item that she includes at almost any gathering. She'll also prepare a colorful Marinated Winter Squash that is a favorite at her home parties.

programme.title: Grandma's Favorites
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia honors the Grandmothers of the family. She starts with a delicious and quick Skillet Gratin of Mushrooms and Chicken, one of her mother's favorites. As the chicken is cooking, she heads.to the side dish, Celery Potatoes and Tomatoes. Joing her at the end of the show is Lidia's granddaughter, Julia to taste Grandma Rosa's Apple cake.

programme.title: SAVORY BAKING
programme.desc: In this episode, the oven is on for the fish dish, the vegetable dish and for the chicken drumsticks! Lidia creates three great main course ideas that are just right for days when you want to do everything in one dish and put it in the oven until it's ready to serve. She makes a Baked Fennel with Tomatoes and oozing Cheese. She then creates a Rollatini of Sole with flavored breadcrumbs baked in a light and delicate sauce of fresh herbs, lemon and white wine.

programme.title: Stretch Your Meal
programme.desc: Fennel and Asian pear salad; cheesy veal chops with cabbage served in a butter sauce; lentil crostini.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: A Salute to First Responders
programme.desc: Chef Lidia Bastianich travels the country visiting men and women who've worked quietly in the shadows and now find themselves thrust into the spotlight by crises facing the country in 2020. From coast to coast, Lidia follows dedicated police officers, firefighters, paramedics, military and medical workers, and observes the prominent role that food plays in these first responders' lives.

programme.title: Is Dinner Ready?
programme.desc: Spicy sheet pan pork chops and broccoli; how to revive leftover soup for an easy weeknight meal; apricot jam half-moons.

programme.title: RISOTTO
programme.desc: If you can't make it to Milan for a dish of "Risotto alla Milanese" bring the dish to your kitchen! Lidia begins today's meal with a Creamy Risotto alla Milanese with Saffron and Marrow bone followed by a Succulent Quail Stuffed with Italian Sausage and Mushrooms. For dessert, it's an Italian classic - light and creamy Panna Cotta with Seasonal Berries.

programme.title: Garlic and Onion Steal the Show
programme.desc: Garlic and Onions appear in many Italian dishes, and in this episode they actually become the "star ingredients." Lidia starts the meal with a quick and easy Savory Onion tart followed by a delicious, mild and creamy Garlic Risotto. For dessert, it's all about chocolate with the moist Torta Caprese.

programme.title: An Easy Effort
programme.desc: Balsamic chicken stir fry; traditional frico with montasio cheese; a sweet grape and ricotta pizza that can be served as dessert, for brunch, or as a snack.

programme.title: More Family Favorites
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia prepares three regional Italian dishes- from Piedmont to Tuscany to Emilia Romagna. Her colorful Peppers Piedmontese are a great addition to any antipasto or buffet table, her Malfada Michelangelo Style is a delicious pasta dish based on dish attributed to Michelangelo. lastly, she shares a Filet Mignon Italian Style with Balsamic Reduction using this liquid gold from the area of Modena.

programme.title: Carry on Tradition
programme.desc: Chopped salad with frisee and fennel; a summertime-inspired tomato and courgette bread lasagna; braised beef rolls.

programme.title: Bolognese
programme.desc: It's a world famous technique but made with milk, it is famous only in the Italian region of Emilia Romagna.

programme.title: Fish Festa
programme.desc: Fish is a staple on Lidia's table all year long, and she loves to plan a dinner that showcases the best and freshest of seafood. The menu is diverse today, as she prepares Mussels with Fennel and Saffron, a fun and elegant dish that is served with grilled bread; Cucumber Salad, a refreshing salad dressed with sweet honey, tangy vinegar and crunchy celery; and finally Baked Striped Bass with Lemon Sauce - made with cheese flavored breadcrumbs and baked to golden perfection.

programme.title: The Flavors of Northern Italy
programme.desc: After the introduction of the southern Italian classics to American cuisine, the flavors of northern Italy began to arrive as well. Lidia takes us through a Layered Casserole with Beef, Cabbage, and Potatoes, a comforting dish that she likes to cook when the cold weather sets in. She then shares her Herbed Frittata Rollup with Prosciutto Cotto, which can be served hot or at room temperature, followed by a family classic- Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto.

programme.title: Simply Delizioso
programme.desc: Today, Lidia shares three simply delicious Italian classics - a Shaved Fennel, Radish, Red onion and Prosciutto Cotto appetizer. Lemony Shrimp over Zucchini take the stage for her main course and a light Olive Oil Cake is a perfect finish to the meal.

programme.title: DOUGH AND CRUSTS
programme.desc: Italians will wrap anything in dough, whether it's savory or sweet, and still have time for a classic. Lidia begins this meal with a savory Zucchini and Rice Crostata. She then turns to the sweets with a celebration of Zeppole, a fried delicious dough stuffed with creamy ricotta. Grandma Erminia, who has the sweet tooth in the family, joins Lidia for this segment.

programme.title: Crazy for Mushrooms
programme.desc: Lidia loves earthy, delicious mushrooms and today shares some of her favorite mushroom recipes that she has prepared over the years. She'll start with a Warm Mushroom Salad, a medley of warm wild mushrooms on a bed of frisee' topped with crispy pancetta and a poached egg. She'll also make Funghi Marinati, marinated button mushrooms in a flavorful mix of rosemary, orange and garlic; Her last dish is a hearty, flavorful and vegetarian Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu.

programme.title: Familiar Flavors
programme.desc: Roasted chicken with pomegranate and a chocolate ricotta cheesecake; baked beans.

programme.title: A Perfect Weeknight Meal
programme.desc: Preparing a delicious and nutritious weeknight meal for the family is not always easy but Lidia shares some of her quickest and simplest recipes that willw ork in any kitchen. The menu includes: carrots and Apple Salad, Salmon Fillets with Prosecco served with Savory Potatoes and Apple Crumble- a dessert that can be made with almost any fruit.

programme.title: Family Meal
programme.desc: Balsamic chicken stir fry; traditional frico with montasio cheese; a sweet grape and ricotta pizza that can be served as dessert, for brunch, or as a snack.

programme.title: Southern Italian Salads
programme.desc: Calabria is famous for its fiery salami spread, 'Nduja. It is delicious on warm grilled bread, and Lidia shows viewers how to make a Bruschetta with 'Nduja; she then makes Raw and Cooked Salad for Summer with green beans and tomatoes, a wonderful way to enjoy seasonal vegetables.

programme.title: Sweetest of Sweets
programme.desc: Today's episode features a collection of the best of Italian dolce or sweets- from cookies to cake to pudding. Lidia begins this episode with Anise Cookies, then prepares a Mint Granita, a light and heavenly Angel Cake with Fresh Berries, and lastly a Rice Pudding with a Blessing, inspired by one of the convents in Italy.

programme.title: Family Favorites
programme.desc: It's all about family in this episode as Lidia shares three of her favorite family recipes. Marinated Meatballs, Zucchini Parmigiana, Artichoke Carbonara and Jam Filler Mezzaluna are the stars of this episode.

programme.title: CRESPELLE
programme.desc: Italians love their crespelle or crepes. In this episode, Lidia teaches viewers how to stuff them with tomato and grated cheese. Today's menu includes: Celery, Artichoke and Mortadella Salad, "Crespelle Manicotti" stuffed with ricotta and mozzarella and for dessert, an Italian classic - beautiful Strawberries Topped with Balsamic Vinegar, a Lidia favorite.

programme.title: What's Baking
programme.desc: With the oven on, Lidia creates sweet and savory dishes her viewers can easily make at home. Gratins are delicious, and she starts with a Leek and Prosciutto Gratin made with Gruyère and walnuts; next is Roasted Chicken with Pomegranate, marvelously moist inside and with a crispy, caramelized exterior. While the oven is still on, she bakes crumbly and chewy Raspberry and Walnut Butter Cookies for dessert.

programme.title: The Power Of Food
programme.desc: Fuzi with chicken ragu; no-bake chocolate ricotta brick cake.

programme.title: Let's Make Dinner
programme.desc: Penne with cauliflower and green olive pesto; poached chicken and giardiniera salad.

programme.title: Breakfast at Lidia's
programme.desc: Fried potatoes with sausage and eggs; breakfast risotto featuring bacon, egg and cheese; ricotta pancakes.

programme.title: Italian American Favorites
programme.desc: Italian American food: Is it Italian, American or a piece of Americana with Italian roots? Today Lidia pays homage to the cooking of Italian American immigrants. Recipes include: Caesar Salad; a luscious Baked Eggplant Stuffed with Meat and Vegetables; and finally Stuffed Mushrooms, a true crowd pleaser.

programme.title: The Olive Grove
programme.desc: Lidia remembers Grandma Rosa's olive trees and the excitement surrounding the late fall harvest of one of Italy's most prized products- newly pressed extra virgin olive oil. Lidia's recipes in this episode showcase this treasured product and include a delicate Striped Bass with Braised Broccolini and Olive Oil Cake, a culinary creation that is perfect for a snack, breakfast, and dessert.

programme.title: Potato, Potato
programme.desc: Potato and pasta soup; a salad of green beans and new potatoes; ditalini with potatoes and provoke.

programme.title: A Bright Summer Feast
programme.desc: Lidia loves bringing people together in her kitchen, and she shares two recipes that are wonderful for a buffet-style meal, her favorite way of entertaining guests. She starts with a quick and easy Lemony Shrimp over Zucchini with a sauce of garlic, butter, white wine, lemon, bread crumbs and parsley. Next on the menu is one of Lidia's favorite soups, Clam Soup, served with plenty of grilled bread on the side.

programme.title: FISH AND SEAFOOD
programme.desc: It doesn't get any better in an Italian kitchen than when Lidia makes fish and vegetables. In this episode, she prepares a nice and refreshing Pan Seared Shrimp with Arugula Pesto. Her next dish is Butterflied Trout, fried in a pan with Bacon and Basil served with a Zucchini Dish made with Anchovies and Capers.

programme.title: Crowd Pleasers
programme.desc: Today is all about feeding a large crowd, and Lidia cooks up recipes that all your guests will love, no matter whom you are hosting - Sausages and Apples, a flavorful one-pot meal that is great for family-style dining; Spaghetti with Roasted Garlic Pesto, a delicious and economical addition to any party; and finally, Chocolate Ricotta Cheesecake, a chocolatey twist to the classic Italian ricotta cheesecake.

programme.title: It's Pasta Night!
programme.desc: Everyone loves pasta, and today Lidia shows you the fun and economical way to make all your friends and family happy at the dinner table with a pasta party. On the menu is Spaghetti with Anchovies and Breadcrumbs, a delicious Southern Italian favorite; a Pasta Chinja - a heart-warming Baked Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Meatballs and Egg. Finally, Lidia will share her Fusilli with Roasted Tomato Pesto - a complex bowl of pasta that will become a staple in your house.

programme.title: The Oven is On
programme.desc: There is nothing like a warm oven that makes guests feel invited in a kitchen. The heat and the aromas permeate and bring smiles to everyone's faces. In this episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite oven baked dishes. Eggplant and Rice Parmigiana, Vegetable and Meat Casserole, Bread Puddign with Pears.

programme.title: Baking Bread
programme.desc: Lidia constantly cherishes the memory of baking bread with her Grandma Rosa. As simple as it was, there is nothing that could take away how powerful this culinary experience was for her. Lidia starts off with a quick and easy Onion Tomato Focaccia, and then talks about Taralli, crunchy little bread rings that are a treat in southern Italy. She then makes Pizza Rolls with two uniquely Italian fillings- broccoli rabe and sausage, and ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: The Next Chapter
programme.desc: Fettuccine with caramelized onions, bacon and olives; orange spritz; roast chicken with rosemary and lemon.

programme.title: Super Simple Seared Lamb Chops
programme.desc: Grilled lamb chops are always delicious but n this episode, Ldiia sears them in a heavy skillet, pressing them down so that all the surface get crisp. She serves the chops with a simple yet elegant red wine sauce with dried cherries, garlic and bay leaves and rosemary. Served with a Tasty Potato Salad and finished with beautiful Almond and Coffee Cream Mini Tarts, this is a meal that everyone will love!

programme.title: Garden of Goodness
programme.desc: Lidia believes in cooking according to season, and when springtime comes, she and her family all work well to create a beautiful garden. In this episode, she shares four delicious recipes that celebrate the bounty of the summertime garden. Tuna Salad with Boiled Zucchini, String Bean Salad with Capers and Basil, Whole Wheat Cous with Cucumbers, and finally Shells with Chicken and Zucchini.

programme.title: Sweet and Savory
programme.desc: It's all about the balance today as Lidia pairs some unexpected ingredients that result in the best of flavors. She starts the meal with her Prosciutto and Fig Bruschetta: grilled bread topped with a salty sweet combination of prosciutto and fig jam; Spaghetti with Fennel and Bitter Greens: spaghetti tossed with fennel, escarole and a splash of balsamic; Chocolate Anise Biscotti: the "twice cooked" Italian cookie made with chocolate and anise.

programme.title: Prepare the Harvest
programme.desc: Celebrating the late-summer harvest with oat risotto with butternut squash and sunchokes; stuffed mushrooms; one-bowl olive oil cake and red wine poached pears.

programme.title: Sympony of Pasta
programme.desc: There is nothing like pasta to bring the Lidia's family to the table. In this episode Lidia shares some of her favorite pasta dishes including a comforting Baked Rigatoni with Zucchini , a delicious Penne with Ricotta and Mushrooms and one of her personal favorites, Fettuccine with a Clam and Leek Sauce.

programme.title: The Sweet Life in Italy
programme.desc: Bergamot and ricotta parfait with nougatine and toasted almonds; almond tart; chocolate anise biscotti.

programme.title: SAVORY BAKING
programme.desc: Lidia introduces this episode with "Beautiful vegetables and a hot oven: a great marriage!" She then begins the meal with a simple and refreshing Sesame and Fava Bean Dip, perfect for flatbreads. Next, she prepares a Baked Eggplant Stuffed with Meat and Vegetables, topped with a golden, cheesy crust. Her unique version of Baked Potatoes is made with Pancetta and Oregano.

programme.title: Cozy Wintertime Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is a celebration of some of Lidia's favorite comfort foods. The combination of potaoes and pasta in one dish is not unusual in Italy and in her Pippette with Sweet Potatoes, Lidia adds a beloved American ingredient to give it a nutritious and complex finish. Veal Stew with Onion and Squash is the perfect one-pot meal, in which the protein and vegetables come together.

programme.title: The Roast
programme.desc: Lidia loves a good roast. It brings out unimaginable flavors, and the aromas from the kitchen will beckon your family to the table. Today's menu includes Red Onions Stuffed with Rice; a Roast Pork Shoulder with Roast Vegetable Sauce, and a brown sugar, bourbon and warm Baked Pineapple served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. She'll also show you how to prepare an easy dessert spread with seasonal fruits and a few store-bought sweet Italian specialties.

programme.title: Mastering Simplicity
programme.desc: Italian cuisine is known for seasonal ingredients and simple techniques. In today's episode, Lidia will share recipes that master simplicity: Sausages with Fennel & Olives; Orange and Red Salad and a delicious "Almost a Tiramisu" recipe.

programme.title: Here I Come New York!
programme.desc: As a young girl, from a small, rural setting, the majestic skyscrapers of Manhattan were quite the sight for Lidia. As a young teenager, Lidia was in charge of most dinners since her parents were returning home late in the evening, and soups were a popular choice to feed the family. In this episode, Lidia prepares a filling meal of Potato and Pasta Soup followed by Polenta with Honey and Berries, an easy way to use leftover polenta.

programme.title: The Risotto Is On
programme.desc: Yellow saffron seafood and leek risotto; how to replenish stock using food scraps from the freezer; barley risotto with cabbage and sausage.

programme.title: Poached Egg
programme.desc: The egg is a staple ingredient in any kitchen and should not be overlooked or overcooked. In this episode, Lidia shows you the classic technique of poaching an egg and making a Warm Mushroom Salad: a bed of frisee with a warm medley of mixed wild mushrooms, pancetta and a poached egg; Eggs Poached in Tomato Sauce: a simple and delicious tomato Sauce poached egg served with slices of grilled country bread and Brutti ma Buoni, a classic Italian hazelnut cookie made with meringue.

programme.title: Tomato Time
programme.desc: Tomatoes make the perfect canvas for any recipe, and in today's episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite dishes featuring this juicy, delicious staple of Italian cuisine. Her menu includes Eggs Poached in Tomato Sauce, served over easy on top of a crunchy slice of grilled country bread; Stuffed Tomatoes, filled with a classic combination of rice, mozzarella and basil.

programme.title: Salt Your Pasta Water!
programme.desc: Pasta primavera "new school" with creamy pesto loaded with fresh vegetables; penne with vodka sauce; cavatappi with asparagus and spinach pesto.

programme.title: Easy Going Recipes
programme.desc: Halibut with saffron fregola; tuna and chickpea salad; shrimp alla Buonavia.

programme.title: Treat Yourself
programme.desc: Celebrating the late-summer harvest with oat risotto with butternut squash and sunchokes; stuffed mushrooms; one-bowl olive oil cake and red wine poached pears.

programme.title: Blow Out
programme.desc: Nash and Joe track down former SIU officer Rick Bettina, who escaped during his parole hearing to recover the money he stole.

programme.title: The Messenger
programme.desc: Nash protects a newscaster from a deranged fan; Joe is caught in the middle of a crime while selling his car.

programme.title: Grave Robbers
programme.desc: Nash takes on the case of a clever con man who fakes his own death after ripping off a dangerous organized crime boss; Joe learns that his mother-in-law smokes marijuana.

programme.title: Bear Trap
programme.desc: Nash and Joe bear down on black market poachers selling animal gall bladders; the office buzzes with rumors of a romance between Nash and Rachel.

programme.title: Recover Me
programme.desc: A wealthy accounting adviser sets Rachel up for a murder, and her lack of cooperation confuses Nash until he discovers a secret from her past.

programme.title: Something Borrowed
programme.desc: Nash is flabbergasted to learn that he's legally married to Tamara Van Zant and comes to the conclusion that she's up to her old tricks again; Nick acts as a "beard" for a lesbian friend.

programme.title: Out of Miami
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Rick Hawks comes back to the Bay Area to transport a key witness in an important drug trafficking case.

programme.title: Slam Dunk!
programme.desc: Nash and Joe investigate the murder of a wealthy lawyer; Cassidy and Rachel are caught in a love triangle.

programme.title: The Partner
programme.desc: Nash and the SIU team try to stop a vigilante who is killing the criminals that are under investigation.

programme.title: Blood Bots
programme.desc: Nash tracks the ringleader of a new technical gang who built a small army of remote-controlled robots, fully equipped with heavy artillery, to pull off a string of robberies.

programme.title: Quack Fever
programme.desc: Painful memories and the dangers of the drug trade collide when Nick learns the truth about Nash's older brother Bobby, who was supposedly missing for more than 20 years.

programme.title: Kill Joy
programme.desc: The murder of a newscaster begins a string of stalkings involving women of the same name, and Harvey eventually discovers the killer's motive.

programme.title: Change Up
programme.desc: Cassidy's future in law enforcement comes under question when her and Rachel's attempts to stop a bank robbery can't prevent an executive's death.

programme.title: Cat Fight
programme.desc: Nash turns up a handful of surprises when tracking down two young women responsible for the death of a security guard during a robbery at a rock concert.

programme.title: Fair Game
programme.desc: While questioning her career in law enforcement, Cassidy steps into the wrong taxi at the wrong time when she becomes a killer cabby's fare; Rachel learns that Nash is being set up.

programme.title: Genesis
programme.desc: A San Francisco police investigator (Don Johnson) uses keen instincts, wit and charm on the job but has less success in his personal life.

programme.title: Home Invasion
programme.desc: A gang terrorizes Nash's (Don Johnson) ex-wife (Serena Scott Thomas) and daughter (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe); Joe (Cheech Marin) moves in.

programme.title: Skirt Chasers
programme.desc: A heroin dealer sets up shop in San Francisco, but his penchant for buying time with women gives Nash and his team a shot at taking him down.

programme.title: High Impact
programme.desc: Nash and Joe Dominguez try to protect the mayor when a religious fanatic takes fire and brimstone seriously and detonates bombs all over San Francisco.

programme.title: The Javelin Catcher
programme.desc: A deadly military weapon stolen by gang members leads Nash to work with a military adviser before more gang violence erupts.

programme.title: Vanishing Act
programme.desc: When a sting operation falls apart and Harvey Leek disappears with the government's money, Joe and Nash set out to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Aloha, Nash
programme.desc: Nash puts his romantic vacation with Kelly on hold to pursue the evils behind an incriminating betting book; Ian's girlfriend is taken hostage.

programme.title: Key Witness
programme.desc: Nash sets out to help Lisa, whose eyewitness account of a murder raises some eyebrows when no body can be found; Joe checks out his new investment.

programme.title: Internal Affairs
programme.desc: Nash must clear his name after being suspended following an Internal Affairs accusation that he murdered a suspect in revenge.

programme.title: Till Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: Joe is exposed to a deadly virus after a thief unwittingly releases it into the air while foraging for drugs at a chemical lab.

programme.title: The Great Escape
programme.desc: Nash's daughter, Cassidy, is kidnapped by an escaped anti-government extremist who is out to avenge his imprisonment and separation from his family.

programme.title: Wrecking Crew
programme.desc: Nash and Joe are taken hostage while attempting to nab a gang of professional thieves during a robbery.

programme.title: Trackdown
programme.desc: Nash attempts to apprehend a former best friend who has become an international mercenary sent to San Francisco for a hit.

programme.title: The Brothers McMillan
programme.desc: Dead bodies begin surfacing as two brothers vie for control of the Irish mafia in San Francisco; Joe suspects someone is stealing from his bar.

programme.title: Night Train
programme.desc: Nash and his team take the subway home from a bachelor party and are held hostage after walking into the midst of a robbery.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Nash calls on his former mentor, Dale Cutter, for help in a murder case that has all the signs of the infamous Zodiac killings.

programme.title: Leo's Big Score
programme.desc: Nash baby-sits a juvenile felon marked for death by drug dealers; Joe gives his son J.J. a job at the bar.

programme.title: Hit Parade
programme.desc: A money launderer-turned-informant is killed, and Nash and Joe discover they are next in line unless they can find the hit man first.

programme.title: Promised Land
programme.desc: A student accused of attempted murder leads Nash and Joe to a Chinese slavery ring smuggling illegal immigrants into the country.

programme.title: 25 Hours of Christmas
programme.desc: Christmas is put on hold as Nash and Joe investigate the death of a store executive murdered at the site of a professional jewelry heist.

programme.title: Road Work
programme.desc: An information leak linked to the government endangers the lives of Nash and Joe, and the federal witness they must protect.

programme.title: Inside Out
programme.desc: Joe infiltrates a prison when all the evidence in the murder of an undercover police officer points to an incarcerated drug lord.

programme.title: The Counterfeiters
programme.desc: Nash and Joe discover that a group is impersonating the Special Investigations Unit in order to pull off a $20 million counterfeit heist.

programme.title: The Web
programme.desc: Nash and Joe learn that a hacker is stealing prototype computer equipment to pay the ransom on his kidnapped wife.

programme.title: Knockout
programme.desc: Nash and Joe search for the perpetrators of a series of sex crimes when Nash's sister, Stacy, becomes a victim and can't remember anything about the attack.

programme.title: Gun Play
programme.desc: While Cassidy recuperates after being struck by a stray bullet, Nash and Joe look for both the shooter and the gun supplier.

programme.title: Rampage
programme.desc: Inspector Robbins wants Nash and Joe to track down his teenage daughter who has joined a convicted felon on a crime spree.

programme.title: Out of Chicago
programme.desc: A beautiful Chicago detective helps Nash and Joe investigate a triple murder; Joe calls a hypnotist for a melancholy racehorse.

programme.title: Moving Target
programme.desc: Searching for a criminal puts Nash and Joe in competition with a bounty hunter who used to be Nash's boss.

programme.title: Wild Card
programme.desc: While eluding a Florida gangster, a former partner enlists Nash's help in finding the man who cheated him in a poker game.

programme.title: Deliverance
programme.desc: Nash and Joe learn that drug dealers are being executed by a commando hired to protect an urban community.

programme.title: Lost and Found
programme.desc: An explosive encounter with carjackers puts Nash on their trail and into conflict with a policewoman who believes he's compromised her undercover investigation.

programme.title: Payback
programme.desc: Nash and Joe (Don Johnson, Cheech Marin) spring a convict (guest star Willie Nelson) from San Quentin so the ex-biker can lead them to a murder suspect (guest star Tobin Bell).

programme.title: Shake, Rattle and Roll
programme.desc: Babysitters Nash and Joe must stop a hit man; Nick has an unsuitable love interest (Jennifer O'Neill).

programme.title: One Flew Over the 'Cuda's Nest
programme.desc: An escaped mental patient goes on a literary killing spree; Joe and Inger regret hiring Nash's baby-nurse friend.

programme.title: Blackout
programme.desc: Nash (Don Johnson) finds a murder case much more difficult to crack after a bomb blast gives him amnesia. With Cheech Marin.

programme.title: Ripcord
programme.desc: A burglar escapes by leaping from the 35th floor with a parachute; Nick volunteers for an experimental program at the university.

programme.title: Sniper
programme.desc: Nash and Joe track a sniper in San Francisco; a social club celebrates Halloween daily; guest Cassandra Peterson, "Elvira."

programme.title: Revelations
programme.desc: A clash between rival drug lords uncovers new evidence on the whereabouts of Nash's missing brother, presumed killed in the Vietnam War.

programme.title: Most Wanted
programme.desc: A convict inadvertently released by county officers targets Michelle; a TV reporter is being blackmailed.

programme.title: Bombshell
programme.desc: Mobsters and federal agents pursue Nash's old flame; Joe films a salsa commercial in Nash's apartment.

programme.title: Found Money
programme.desc: Bettina sets out to be a tough boss, accusing Joe of stealing $3 million from a car stopped after an armed pursuit.

programme.title: Dirty Tricks
programme.desc: A convicted murderer's escape on his way to his sentencing hearing leads Nash and Joe to the British Consulate.

programme.title: Crossfire
programme.desc: A convicted arsonist (Mark Rolston) uses outside contacts to keep Nash (Don Johnson) from testifying at his parole hearing. With Cheech Marin.

programme.title: Live Shot
programme.desc: Nash gets drugged during a bust just before he and Joe are scheduled to recount their careers for Geraldo's cameras.

programme.title: Downtime
programme.desc: A forced vacation has Nash and Joe working outside conventional channels to solve a string of armored car robberies.

programme.title: Skin Deep
programme.desc: Nash clashes with a visiting New York detective over the handling of a stalker case; Evan loses his badge during a one-night stand.

programme.title: Patriots
programme.desc: The Irish husband of Nash's first ex-wife is in San Francisco looking for revenge against IRA terrorists.

programme.title: Cuda Grace
programme.desc: Drug-related murders lead to a millionaire; Evan and Bettina go undercover at a transgender beauty pageant; guest RuPaul.

programme.title: Lady Killer
programme.desc: Nash tries to figure out who is framing Bettina for murder; someone is using Joe's stolen credit cards to live the playboy lifestyle.

programme.title: Danger Zone
programme.desc: Nash and Joe (Don Johnson, Cheech Marin) learn that a truckload of nerve gas is about to be released in downtown San Francisco.

programme.title: Special Delivery
programme.desc: Nash must protect Lynette from Asian mobsters when she unknowingly becomes involved in a forgery ring; Joe's father visits.

programme.title: Touchdown
programme.desc: Several armored cars and their drivers disappear; a football star needs to find "the most beautiful girl in the world"; Nick is reluctant to use a hearing aid.

programme.title: Sacraments
programme.desc: Metal heads go on a crime spree; Nash learns of Cassidy and Evan's relationship; Nick gets an overdue Navy Cross.

programme.title: High Fall
programme.desc: Nash's ex-lover masterminds a real estate scam that leaves him destitute; Joe destroys his own home while trying to improve it.

programme.title: Impostors
programme.desc: Nash and Joe pose as gay detectives in San Francisco's Castro district while trying to find a Cher impersonator's stolen wig.

programme.title: Hot Prowler
programme.desc: Nash and Joe search for a psychopath who telecasts videotapes of his crimes on the Internet; Joe considers suing a restaurant.

programme.title: Overdrive
programme.desc: Nash and Joe scramble to find enough evidence to prove the innocence of a man on death row; a parent sues Joe, claiming his daughter is mistreating his son in preschool.

programme.title: Apocalypse Nash
programme.desc: Nash and Joe share a jail cell while awaiting trial over the murder of three fellow police officers during a drug bust.

programme.title: The Tourist
programme.desc: Nash's ex-wife arrives from Paris and informs him that a bureaucratic snafu fouled up their divorce 12 years earlier.

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: Nash and Caitlin pose as a married couple while investigating wife-swapping parties; Joe helps steal a corpse.

programme.title: Warplay
programme.desc: Wealthy businessmen play a bizarre war game that leads to deadly consequences; Evan's lover is the assistant district attorney's fiancée.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove: Part I - Leaving
programme.desc: Texas Rangers and long-time ranching partners Gus McCrae and Woodrow Call meet their old friend Jake, and decide to strike out from their south Texas base and drive a cattle herd to Montana.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub: Episode 8
programme.desc: "The lone wolf goes deep undercover in a corrupt prison to solve a murder that happened two years ago."

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Hjerson (Dubbed) S1 E8: Episode 8
programme.desc: After a second mysterious crime occurs on the movie set, local police believe the crime is solved. But, Hjerson believes there's something more afoot. Meanwhile, Klara begs the question one last time: Will there be a TV show, or not?

programme.title: Magic
programme.desc: Amina struggles in the wake of the Joshua West scandal.

programme.title: Collateral Damage
programme.desc: A violent war erupts between the 9streets gang and the ZTs, spilling chaos into the streets and leaving tragic casualties in its wake.

programme.title: The Founders
programme.desc: As the streets become a battlefield, Macy faces impossible split-second choices that could mean life or death for herself and her allies.

programme.title: Worlds Apart
programme.desc: Mitchell is trapped in a new Flatland: a twisted mirror-world where everything he knows is turned on its head. It's a nightmare reality where Khan rules with abandon, and Smith is missing; where Amy runs a brothel and JT drives a cab.

programme.title: To Be a Somebody (Part One)
programme.desc: After a violent murder, Fitz is sure the police are on the wrong track, but he and Bilborough (Christopher Ecclestone) have yet to resolve their differences.

programme.title: The male star that disappeared at dawn
programme.desc: Soshun Kouchiyama, a tea master at Edo Castle, secretly fights injustice by beating up powerful oppressors, with the help of his friends.

programme.title: The Pied Piper
programme.desc: A night of terror, and the disappearance of Shane, leads to Cameron, Boris, Lucy, and Pierce being questioned by the authorities the next morning. Cameron decides it is up to them to find Shane, and they have the goggles to assist them.

programme.title: The Video
programme.desc: Thanks to Boris's carelessness, Rock and Roll find footage of the alien encounter and post it on the Internet. When Condon Aerospace finds out and captures the two conspiracy theorists, Cameron, Boris, and Lucy attempt to free them.

programme.title: Memories of a Hero
programme.desc: On the anniversary of the Tunguska Mission, the true identity of a supposedly deceased astronaut surfaces and teams up with Cameron to find his father. Lucy decides it is time to work with the press from behind the scenes.

programme.title: The Taming
programme.desc: The princess Conan rescued is so annoying that he is tempted to let a lizard monster have her.

programme.title: Season 1, Conan The Adventurer 116: The Child
programme.desc: Conan and his men are captured by cannibals. Meanwhile Hissah Zul and the Skull-That-Talks prepare for an astral phenomenon, a wandering star that heralds the birth of a Special Child.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: After Mathias discovers a plot to murder a second victim, he becomes determined to catch the culprit.

programme.title: The Mission
programme.desc: Hoss helps ex army scout Charlie Trent (the towns drunk) regain his self-esteem, by volunteering him to lead Captain Pender's men across the desert with a valuable shipment.

programme.title: The Mall
programme.desc: Jordan's management credentials are tested when the boys are late for a gig at a local shopping mall and Dan is panicking when an influential food vlogger reviews the diner.

programme.title: Tigrero
programme.desc: After tracking down a killer, Tate is shot in the leg while transporting the criminal through a cattle town.

programme.title: Out of Time
programme.desc: Marguerite, the reincarnation of the Druid's priestess, must fulfill her destiny by retrieving emeralds that will save them. Veronica has difficulty giving up a baby she has grown attached to.

programme.title: Echoes of the Past
programme.desc: Mat and his partner Sanct get called to a new crime scene: the body of Drew Wilson is found - this time the victim wears a Humphrey Bogart mask. On the gay man's laptop Mat and Sanct find a picture indicating that the victim had an intimate relationship with Charlie Zeelie, a famous cricket player.

programme.title: Riptide: S1 E8 - Four-Eyes
programme.desc: The boys are hired by a guy to keep tabs on his wife. It seems he wants to divorce her and he wants ammo to avoid giving her alimony.

programme.title: Riptide: S1 E9 - #1 With A Bullet
programme.desc: When a music star is killed in a car accident and the equally famous passenger gets injured, the Riptide agency gets hired by his fanclub to deliver flowers to his hospital bed.

programme.title: Love Bites
programme.desc: Vanessa makes a horrific decision to save her daughter. Axel and a former ally struggle to survive in the wild.. A group of juvenile delinquents come face to face with a sadistic vampire.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Herot is bustling as the town prepares for the Gathering, at which the next ruler of the Shieldlands will be elected. Koll, the deputy Reeve, joins Beowulf in the hunt for the killer and their inquiries lead them to the Golden Hall. A member of Rheda's riding party fails to return to Herot.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: With Slean and Thane Scorann missing, Beowulf and Rate, Thane of the Varni, charge out into the forest in search of them. But with the Gathering fast approaching and Rheda's bid for leadership depending on the hope of the ever-loyal Scorann's vote, Beowulf questions whether their disappearance might be more than a simple coincidence.

programme.title: Cold Case
programme.desc: Sue tries to honor a request a killer be brought to justice. Bobby, Jack, and Myles have a competition over who can draw the highest bids as the dream dates for charity.

programme.title: Calamity Jane Saves the Day
programme.desc: Throughout Deadwood, Calamity Jane is known as a hot-tempered drunk. But when a deadly smallpox outbreak spreads through town, Calamity Jane works tirelessly to save the lives of the infected citizens who once treated her with such contempt.

programme.title: The Four Dead in Five Seconds Gunfight
programme.desc: After two Mexican vaqueros cross the border in search of their stolen cattle, they are gunned down by the rustlers. When El Paso's newly appointed marshal arrests local ranch hands for the murders, he sparks one of the West's most infamous gunfights.

programme.title: Larry McMurtry's Dead Man's Walk: Part 3
programme.desc: As young Texas rangers, Gus McCrae and Woodrow Call join an ill-conceived effort to capture Santa Fe and annex New Mexico.

programme.title: The Little Things
programme.desc: A tumultuous day at the hospital gives way to an awkward dinner with Brian's (Matt Ward) family, leading to an astonishing revelation for Sandy (Sarah Allen).

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Hjerson (Dubbed) S1 E1: Episode 1
programme.desc: Former detective, Hjerson's mother has just died. He boards a ferry to his hometown where he meets Klara, a TV producer. A mysterious murder occurs aboard the vessel and the unlikely pair launch an investigation.

programme.title: Two Worlds
programme.desc: Holly is troubled by The Post's handling of a story, and a crisis looms for Duncan.

programme.title: We Gone See
programme.desc: Caught in the crossfire of a gang war reaching its peak, Macy fights to protect her loved ones while confronting the devastating consequences of her choices.

programme.title: A Long Game
programme.desc: Still reeling from revelations about her past, Macy is devastated when trusted ally Phil is brutally killed. Determined to uncover the truth, she begins a dangerous search for justice and vows to expose the lies behind his murder.

programme.title: Apocalypse
programme.desc: Khan and Smith. Finally, they come face to face. The battle envelops the current lives of all our characters... and comes to a surprise ending that no one could have predicted.

programme.title: The Snow Job
programme.desc: The Leverage team helps a beleaguered National Guardsman to find justice against the unscrupulous construction firm who foreclosed on his home.

programme.title: Burn with fire in the route of love
programme.desc: Soshun Kouchiyama, a tea master at Edo Castle, secretly fights injustice by beating up powerful oppressors, with the help of his friends.

programme.title: The Compound I
programme.desc: Clues in Brady Turner's graphic novel lead Cameron and Boris closer to the location of the mysterious Olivine compound. After a news leak, aliens believe Hugh Condon is in possession of the Olivine compound and confront him.

programme.title: The Compound II
programme.desc: Stella seeks Cameron's help in locating the Olivine compound, and Cameron begins to believe a partnership would be beneficial. Pierce tips off Hugh as to Cameron and Stella's intentions, but in the end, nothing for anyone goes as planned.

programme.title: The Trial
programme.desc: Black Dawn captures Cameron, Boris, and Lucy and accuses them of working with the aliens. Lucy must also stand trial for the death of Black Dawn's Grand Master, in which Cameron and Boris are introduced to shocking evidence about Lucy.

programme.title: The Crystal Arrow
programme.desc: A dying archer gives Conan a magic arrow.

programme.title: Season 1, Conan The Adventurer 117: The Crystal Arrow
programme.desc: Conan comes upon an old archer fighting off attacking soldiers, led by an evil sorcerer, Khartan, who hurls a fiery skull that kills the archer. As hes dying, the old archer gives Conan a special Crystal Arrow that possesses great magic and must be returned to his people who live beyond the Misty Gates, which are sealed with black magic.

programme.title: Redbad - The Legend Part 1
programme.desc: During a time of epic battles and bloodshed, the legend of pagan warrior king Redbad is born, but so is a new weapon against his people: Christianity.

programme.title: Badge Without Honor
programme.desc: The Cartwights become suspicious of a U.S. Deputy marshal, when they find out he is bringing their friend to town, as a witness to a racketeering trial.

programme.title: The Texan: S1 E17 - Outpost
programme.desc: Longley rescues the lone survivor of a murderous stagecoach robbery, but the man refuses to help him identify the three killers.

programme.title: The Sound of Silence
programme.desc: clumsily tries to get Nate and Chloe together at The Palais' silent disco and Harry tries to get over his crush Tyra by going out for an embarrassing dinner with his parents.

programme.title: Comanche Scalps
programme.desc: Amos Dundee returns home to kill the little brother, who wooed away and wed his sweetheart.

programme.title: Neighbours
programme.desc: Mina takes on a troublesome client who keeps making things worse for himself. Adam responds to a desperate call from his mother. Olivia has a surprise visitor.

programme.title: A Penny Saved
programme.desc: A janitor named Andy is embroiled in a murderous plot that leaves a stock broker dead. When Andy finds the body and incriminates himself, Hammer is the only person that can clear his name.

programme.title: Disaster Strike Force: Ice Storm
programme.desc: A devastating deep freeze threatens the East Coast.

programme.title: Disaster Strike Force: Ice Age
programme.desc: Plummeting temperatures signify the dawn of a new Ice Age.

programme.title: A Home
programme.desc: Vanessa encounters a group of vampires whose gruesome methods bring savagery to a new level. The Juvenile Delinquents continue their game of cat and mouse with Sam that has deadly consequences.

programme.title: The Final Act (Part 1)
programme.desc: Helen Mirren stars as DS Jane Tennison, a seasoned detective plunged into the alien world of teen girls after a 14-year-old goes missing.

programme.title: Homeland Security
programme.desc: When Myles' prized painting is discovered to be a forgery, he zealously tracks down the man responsible. A traffic accident reveals a startling piece of a terrorist plot.

programme.title: The Gold Rush Detectives
programme.desc: When gold goes missing from a safe in a remote mining town, Wells Fargo sends detectives Henry Johnson and Isaiah Lees to hunt down the culprits. Though the two men couldn't be more different, they must learn to work together to crack the case.

programme.title: Burton Mossman Crosses the Line
programme.desc: After failing to capture the ruthless murderer Augustine Chacon on U.S. soil, Arizona Ranger Burton Mossman relinquishes his badge to cross the border. In Mexico, he goes undercover as a horse thief to join Chacon's gang and spring his trap.

programme.title: Return To Lonesome Dove: Part I - The Vision
programme.desc: Back in Texas, Capt. Call organizes a mustang drive to Montana. He hires a Gideon, a former Texas Ranger, to head the drive. Newt falls into trouble in is rescued by a crusty rancher named Dunnegan.

programme.title: Political Agenda
programme.desc: When a journalist is murdered, Sue, Jack, and the FBI team are called in to work the high-profile case. Sue helps a congressional aide with his "Get Out The Vote" campaign.

programme.title: Concrete Evidence
programme.desc: Sue gets a new lead in an old case involving the murder of a fellow agent; Jack vows to avenge his friend's death. Myles finds himself at war with his annoying next-door neighbor.

programme.title: Endings & Beginnings
programme.desc: Sue is offered a new high-profile job at the FBI but is torn when she realizes it means leaving her FBI teammates. The real Sue Thomas makes a surprising return guest appearance.

programme.title: Assassins
programme.desc: Sue is swept into the maelstrom of a dangerous assignment when the FBI must protect a visiting dignitary who's targeted for assassination by a terrorist cell.

programme.title: The Sniper
programme.desc: Sue and the team try to determine seemingly random shootings in D.C. Sue finds the case becoming all consuming, forcing her to put her personal life on hold.

programme.title: Dirty Bomb
programme.desc: Sue and the team receive information a "Dirty Bomb" has been smuggled into the country. The agents race against time in a desperate attempt to find the bomb before it is detonated.

programme.title: Pilot Pt 1
programme.desc: Sheltered, young, and deaf, Sue Thomas lands her first job with the FBI. She's relegated to the tedious task of filing fingerprints until she catches the eye of Agent Jack Hudson.

programme.title: Billy The Kid
programme.desc: When Jack's former mentor is shot, the investigation leads Jack to a disturbing discovery involving the world of illicit drug labs.

programme.title: The Heist
programme.desc: When an armored truck disappears into thin air, Jack and the other agents must track down the missing 2.4 million dollars and the missing security guards.

programme.title: Breaking Up Is Hard To Do
programme.desc: Sue tries to use her friendship with the wife of a terrorist to prevent an attack. Meanwhile, Jack searches for terrorists who have a vial containing bubonic plague.

programme.title: The Newlywed Game
programme.desc: In an effort to get close to a suburban husband and wife suspected of having terrorist ties, Sue and Jack go undercover as a married couple.

programme.title: Diplomatic Immunity
programme.desc: Bobby rescues a woman from a vicious attack but his noble action threatens to end his career. Buffeted by lies and facing the stonewall of "diplomatic immunity."

programme.title: Blast From The Past
programme.desc: Dimitrius faces a crisis point in his marriage and career. Sue deals with a mysterious informant while developing leads to bring down a major money-laundering ring.

programme.title: The Leak
programme.desc: What looks like a routine SWAT takedown of a terrorism suspect turns into a potentially deadly ambush of our people. Myles finds himself dealing with the psychological aftermath.

programme.title: A Snitch In Time
programme.desc: Sue cultivates her first informant who leads her from a small time smuggling case to a big time highway robbery ring.

programme.title: Cold Case
programme.desc: Sue tries to honor a request a killer be brought to justice. Bobby, Jack, and Myles have a competition over who can draw the highest bids as the dream dates for charity.

programme.title: The Fraternity
programme.desc: Sue and the rest of the team investigate the death of a prominent Senator's son during a college fraternity hazing.

programme.title: The Gambler
programme.desc: Sue's dependence on her hearing dog, Levi, is threatened when Levi gets lost. When Bobby goes undercover as a gambler - the team might lose more than just the next hand.

programme.title: The Actor
programme.desc: Sue and the team are 'shadowed' by an actor as he prepares for his next movie role. Sue and Jack work with Sue's informant Howie to stop a shipment of guns.

programme.title: The New Mafia
programme.desc: Sue goes undercover with Tony, a visiting FBI agent, in order to infiltrate a mafia family. But Jack becomes concerned because Tony doesn't always play by the rules.

programme.title: Missing
programme.desc: The F.B.I. team's favorite waitress goes missing but what seems like a possible kidnapping case, becomes more complicated.
