programme.desc: Explore the community, culture and craziness of one of America's most adrenaline-charged racetracks as it prepares to host its first NASCAR Cup Series race in more than 50 years.

programme.title: Snuff Bottle Connection
programme.desc: A conspiracy by Chinese traitors to cede large amount of land to the Russians is uncovered by a government agent. After an investigator is killed confronting brawling Russian soldiers, a regional chancellor brings in Shao Ting Shang (John Liu) to figure out what is behind the murder.

programme.title: Dragon Bruce Lee Part 2
programme.desc: Dragon Lee leads a group of fighting patriots seeking liberty from the Japanese rule.... Watch Dragon Lee fighting Bolo, it's a classic!

programme.title: Mysterious Heroes aka Wu Tang Swordsman
programme.desc: Mysterious Heroes centers around Lau Tien, master of the deadly 13-Sword Style. Thrown into prison by a group of jealous enemies, the 13-Sword Style is rarely spoken of, let alone seen, until 20 years later, when a second swordsman going by the name of Lau Tien proves to be the world's second 13-Sword expert. Action-packed martial arts chaos ensues when the enemies of the original Lau Tien vow to destroy his successor

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub The Final: Episode 2
programme.desc: Itto and his son were walking down a street when suddenly they were hit by a pumice stone. Ittou, however, does not turn around and takes the pumice stone on his back. Ittou does not turn around when two or three more pumice stones come flying at him. The man who threw the stones, Wakita, picked up a stone that had fallen by the roadside and threw it. Wakita was convinced that Itto was the skilled warrior he was looking for and wished for an assassin request.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 5
programme.desc: People are attempting to assassinate a noble under the protection of the Shogun and the Lethal Three get pulled into the mess...

programme.title: Killer of Snake Fox of Shaolin
programme.desc: Popular kung fu leading man Carter Wong (18 Bronzemen, Shaolin Invincible) stars in this supernatural martial arts thriller, as he must save a father and his daughter from the powerful snake god known for his deadly kung fu. Filled with magic, special effects, and world class martial arts, Killer of a Snake, Fox of Shaolin is a must see for any serious martial arts fan.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 18
programme.desc: A young nobleman is seeking a suitable retainer and sparring partner. He has an open competition between the ronin for the honor. But something is not quite right.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 12
programme.desc: Okei finds Sengoku unconscious and with a foggy memory. What does it have to do with an unfortunate girl, who was kidnapped?

programme.title: Brave Platoon aka American Force 1: The Brave Platoon
programme.desc: The Brave Platoon like the jungle best. Its darkness, its savage justice.Supreme commandos of The American Force, Randy Nolan, Billy the Kid' Lee and Edward 'Duke' Robertson, are The Brave Platoon. Their gun-blazing mission is to track down a KGB officer who has been secretly supplying arms and training to various rebel factions in the heart of darkness. Their true enemy may be the unscrupulous warlords who seek to gain advantage by pitting one side against the other.

programme.title: Warriors of Budo Episode Five: Kendo
programme.desc: Kendo or the way of the sword, has seen many changes over the last sixty years partly as a result of the dis- semination of Budo culture outside Japan. To understand this phenomenon and how it evolved, we need to know what the spirit of Kendo is. Is it Budo... a way to cultivate oneself? Or is it a competitive sport in which winning is the ultimate objective?

programme.title: Ninja Fantasy
programme.desc: A US agent seeking revenge for the death of a colleague is involved in the war between two narcotics traffickers who vie for control of the business.

programme.title: Ninja Fist of Fire
programme.desc: Martial arts action with a Ninja prince trying to overcome the odds and gain his rightful place on the throne.

programme.title: Ghost Hill
programme.desc: The film opens with a duel on a beach between two master swordsman. An elderly master looks on as the two battle. He stops the duel and proclaims one swordsman the winner and awards him the coveted Purple Light Sword, making him the new Sword King. He returns home to show his sickly teacher the treasure, but they are attacked by the weird minions of evil King Gold who wants to combine the power of the sword with his developing Fire Ball power.

programme.title: Kagemusha Oda Nobunaga
programme.desc: As a feared warlord's power grows, so do his enemies. To reduce the risk of assassination, an impersonator is chosen to make appearances, against the warlord's own wishes. The is the story of the "shadow warrior" aka kagemusha.

programme.title: Top Fighter 2: Deadly China Dolls
programme.desc: Top Fighter 2: Deadly China Dolls is an action festival of skill and beauty. The film takes an in depth look at the female fighting superstars, of stage, ring and screen, with fantastic action footage. Exclusive Top fighter 2, exposes the hardship of Angela Mao's training, the secrets that led Cynthia Rothrock to world stardom, and Michelle Yeoh's rise to the top of the action genre, and much more from fellow stars Moon Lee, Yukari Oshima, and others.

programme.title: Deadly Snail vs Kung Fu Killer
programme.desc: In this kung fu fantasy, a daring duel of powers between the fairies, finds the young mortal Cheung rescuing the Sky Mussel Fairy. His bravery is not repaid, however, as Cheung is driven out of his home by his uncle. Now, Cheung must struggle to stay alive in a world of gods and demons, with only his kung fu powers to keep him safe.

programme.title: Top Fighter
programme.desc: Top Fighter with spectacular footage exposes the secrets of Bruce Lee's jeet kune do. Jackie Chan explains the rigors of his daily training and Jet Li demonstrates the Wu Shu skills that made him national champion and international superstar

programme.title: Eagle Claw vs Butterfly Palm
programme.desc: The great Lo Lieh (Five Fingers of Death) leads an all-star cast in this renowned kung fu classic! Having already destroyed Shaolin and Wu Tang, the feared Butterfly clan now sets their eyes on wiping out all other clans that are in their way. Only a few noble Wu Shu knights are brave enough to face the villains and fight the enemies.

programme.title: The Deadly Fists
programme.desc: A mountain girl Chie finds her father mortally injured by the roadside, and in his dying last breath he names a mysterious stranger, Yuan. She sets out in search to find Yuan, and decides to go to the Shaolin Master, who advises and instructs her to go and meet a rich Lord who might have knowledge of the killer's whereabouts. However, he too seeks Yuan, and fearing competition, he tries to kill her. Who is this stranger, that all are seeking to find him?

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 1
programme.desc: The lone wolf received an assassination request to avenge a clan on the brink of being abolished. The plot thickens as they got caught in a scheme full of betrayals and deceit while being pursued relentlessly by the Yagyu clan.

programme.title: Massive
programme.desc: A martial arts super sleuth is sent to investigate a string of vicious robberies carried out by a man only known as "the jade dragonfly". A who's who of kung fu stars pit their skills and wits against each other in this classic kung fu masterpiece from director Wu Ma.

programme.title: Fatal Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: A crazed martial artist who kills with his flying guillotine wreaks havoc on the martial world. The main character is a swordsman whose mother is ill, and to get the medicine, he must pass 3 tests, which gets him caught up in the guillotine affair.

programme.title: Guards of Shaolin aka Ninja vs Shaolin Guards
programme.desc: A troop of monks from the Shaolin Temple embark on a mission to get the Golden Sutra to Tibet after the Shaolin Abbot is killed by their traitorous teacher. They are joined on their quest by a beautiful, female warrior - with aims to avenge her father's death. They traverse forests and mountains on their mission, all the while fighting off deadly ninja assassins, vicious gangsters and even the undead.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Douglas Wong
programme.desc: Wong is the founder of the modern-day White Lotus system of kung fu. He has traveled the world teaching his art through seminars, training camps, instructional videos, and more. Involved in the martial arts for over 50 years, he has studied under several great teachers, including Ark Y. Wong, the "father of kung fu in America". In the 1970s, he changed history by introducing kung fu into the tournament circuit and developing the most creative demonstration team of that era.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Ernie Reyes
programme.desc: This unique documentary reveals the life of pioneer Ernie Reyes. Raised in poverty and prejudice, he was able to persevere. Through decades of vigorous training, he became one of the top nationally rated competitors in both forms and fighting. He is the chief instructor and co-founder of one of the biggest and most successful schools in the world, the West Coast World Martial Arts.

programme.title: The Clutch of Power
programme.desc: A swordsman known as "Soul of the Sword" has been hired by the Mongolian General to wipe out any Chinese patriots who stand in the way of the Mongol invasion. Leung Kar-Yan comes of best with his lethal spear blade which he uses with great dexterity.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 16
programme.desc: A woman beseeches a man to carryout the revenge he was ordered to do, but a new woman in his life refuses to let him go back to his old ways. Our group of travelers get pulled into the affair during their journeys.

programme.title: Along Comes a Tiger aka Along Comes the Tiger
programme.desc: Wang Tao, Tommy Lee and Philip Ko. Miracle Man arrives in a sleepy town controlled by The Black Dragon gang. Miracle Man elimintes the key members of the gang in a wave of violent and bloody fights.

programme.title: Legendary Strike
programme.desc: The plot deals with a search for a valuable pearl, dubbed the Buddha's Relic, which is sold to an unwitting Japanese emissary by a corrupt Ching Dynasty prince who seeks to steal it back for his own purposes.

programme.title: King of Darts
programme.desc: Tom a British businessman is an opium smuggler in the early years of the Republic of China; the King of Darts Wang Zha Xi uses all his daring skill to put an end to Tom's dastardly trade.

programme.title: One Shot, One Life
programme.desc: In traditional martial arts, mastery of the art is not acquired through technical skill alone. In following 'The Way' one must look beyond technique to become a true master. In Japanese archery or Kyudo, hitting the target by itself is not enough. To shoot correctly we are told to "Shoot from the Heart". As Takeuchi sensei says "As a national team member I had to hit the target no matter what. Eventually all that technique became obsolete in exchange to express myself through the bow".

programme.title: Green Jade Statuette
programme.desc: A band of criminal's returns to a vice-filled village one year after their theft of a valuable family artifact, along with a talented fighter hired to recover the relic. Top-notch old-school shapes from the team that brought you "Eagles Claw".

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 2
programme.desc: While continuing on their separate journeys, the Lethal Three run into each other again along with a woman they previously helped. There is something suspicious going on involving a local lord though. Will the ronin, samurai, and ninja get involved to help?

programme.title: End of the Wicked Tigers
programme.desc: Hong Kong action superstar Samo Hung helped choreograph and he co-stars in this High Noon-like tale of courage and corruption. In the early 20th century, a crime lord (Han Ying Chieh) has a small town under his thumb until a new police captain arrives to put things in order. Only one brave witness, Ma San (Charles Heung), is willing to help fight against the impossible odds. An array of spectacular fight scenes dominates.

programme.title: Rings Untouchable
programme.desc: Two kickboxers become embroiled in a world of performance-enhancing drugs and ruthless gang-rivalry. Now deadly rivals, the only way to resolve their differences is in a challenge to the death in the ring. When a power-enhancing drug has hallucinogenic side effects on kickboxer, Jack, he refuses to take it, and is then dropped by his manager. Desperate for money, he takes his teammate. Kevin's offer to deliver some cocaine, is a set-up to take the business away from the drug-lord, Henry.

programme.title: Sonny Chiba in Shogun's Samurai - Yagyuicizoku no Inbou: Episode 1
programme.desc: Following the massive success of the 1978 movie version, this TV series is newly produced by returning faces such as Director Kinji Fukasaku and actors Sonny Chiba and Kinnosuke Yorozuya. After the death of the second Tokugawa shogun Hidetada, his sons Iemitsu and Tadanaga shed family blood over the succession of the dynasty. Iemitsu's swordmaster Munenori Yagyu leads the Yagyu clan with his oldest son Jubei Yagyu and lends their swords to Iemitsu as they throw themselves into a bloody conflict.

programme.title: Mission Dynamo aka American Force 5: Mission Dynamo
programme.desc: The Vietnam War, and terrorists led by Torosky battle it out with South-Vietnamese guerrilla forces, assisted by the American Army. But for squad leader Merlin and private first class Bill the war has become so meaningless that they don't care anymore. After seeing more and more of their friends die, they decide to desert, but soon discover that there is no sanctuary in the jungle, when it's only a matter of time before Torosky's men will catch up with them.

programme.title: Enter the Panther
programme.desc: In this martial arts action movie, a young kung fu master seeks vengeance upon the villains who murdered a prominent miner.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 13
programme.desc: When Sengoku and the others arrive in a town based around prostitution, they are faced with a dilemma about the women who want to escape. The Tengu Bandits are also stirring up trouble.

programme.title: Sleeping Fist
programme.desc: Kam an undercover cop plans to report the crimes committed by Cho and his thugs. Beaten in a fight he is lucky Kid is nearby to rescue him and introduces him to Old Fox (Simon Yuen), who teaches them both Sleeping Fist Kung Fu.

programme.title: Enter the Game of Death
programme.desc: Kung Fu idol Bruce Le, takes on the mantel of the late Bruce Lee and delivers a powerhouse performance in what many consider to be his best film to date. Loosely based on Lee's original concept, and filmed in the actual location Lee had originally intended to use, Le does battle with a whole array of opponents, including the nunchaku master, snake fist fighter, wing chun expert, and a master of the mystic art of Silat.

programme.title: Master of Flying Daggers
programme.desc: Night Orchid is a notorious nickname attributed to a mysterious character that kills women, leaving an orchid as a signature after the murder. Only the Master of flying daggers, Chu Liu Hsiang can solve the mystery and restore peace to the martial world.

programme.title: Seven Steps of Kung Fu aka Kung Fu of Seven Steps
programme.desc: Little Tiger the town rascal and a pickpocket is also a kung fu disciple of the patriot Master Lee San Pai. One day Tiger steals a medallion from a stranger that is a member of a powerful gang, let by the White Haired Gerneral, who want to overthrow China with the help of Tibetan Lamas. Lee San Pai plots to beat the gang, but first Little Tiger must become and Kung Fu expert.

programme.title: Against Rascals with Kung Fu
programme.desc: Drunken master Sam the Seed takes on a young sheep herder as his newest disciple and teaches him some special kung tu techniques to help rid the town of a violent menace that has been terrorizing the area.

programme.title: Ask Clark: Living Affordably
programme.desc: Americans continue to face rising costs and ongoing economic pressure, focusing on practical, real-world strategies to help viewers navigate inflation and better manage everyday expenses, from housing and groceries to debt and monthly bills.

programme.title: Delitos ocultos
programme.desc: José descubre que Luciano tuvo que escapar del lugar donde lo metió a trabajar; Galia le reclama a Pascual que encubra los delitos de sus jefes; Reverte descubre que Roberta le robó a su perro; Sabrina le dice a Sol que tuvo relaciones con Miguel.

programme.title: Anónimo
programme.desc: Sol le deja un anónimo a Mía, informándole sobre la relación de Sabrina con Miguel. Fátima le pregunta a Jose qué sabe de Gastón. Vico habla con Miguel sobre su amante y le promete no decirle nada a Mía. Sol se empeña en que Mía descubra todo.

programme.title: Petición de divorcio
programme.desc: Roberta insiste en que Reverte le diga la verdad. Gastón le dice a Gandía que Fátima tiene un pasado turbio. Miguel no quiere volver a ver a Sabrina. Nico le pide a Lupita que reanuden su noviazgo. Galia quiere divorciarse de Pascual.

programme.title: Lo sé todo
programme.desc: Diego le pide a Roberta que lo ayude a que León no se entere que sigue en la banda; Mia recibe una carta de Sabrina y Miguel se la quita; Fátima llora y le dice a Gastón que la despidieron. Roberta le dice a Alma y Martín que ya sabe que son novios.

programme.title: Noticias sobre mamá
programme.desc: Alma acepta que anda con Reverte para que Roberta no se entere que es su padre. Franco le dice a Reverte que se quede con ella. Rocco le pide a Mía averiguar si Vico es maltratada por su papá. Roberta le reclama a Alma que no estuvo en su infancia.

programme.title: La gran fiesta
programme.desc: La mamá de Teo sufre una crisis y entra en estado de coma. Rocco deduce que Vico es maltratada por su novio. Nico y Lupita se besan mientras Santos los mira.

programme.title: Jugadas sucias
programme.desc: El padre de Teo le informa que tienen que llevar a su madre a una clínica al norte del país. Alma le explica a Franco que no tiene ninguna relación con Reverte. Max besa a Celina. Santos le dice a Roberta que tendrá que olvidar a Lupita.

programme.title: Déjame solo
programme.desc: Lupita y Nico reanudan su noviazgo. Vico le dice a Mía que no se meta en su vida ni con su familia. Lola le dice a Roberta que vio a Iñaki besar a otra chica. Teo le dice a José que decidió irse a vivir con su papá.

programme.title: Torneo de fútbol
programme.desc: Llegó el día del torneo y los chicos de la Elite Way School están preparados para poder ganarlo. Alicia y Alma encierran a Walter en venganza por robar las estrategias del equipo Elite. Gustavo le pide a José que convenza a Teo.

programme.title: La verdadera novia
programme.desc: Roberta conoce a Javier. Lupita le pide a Nico que no la cele tanto. Celina llora por Max, y Alma le recomienda demostrarle indiferencia. Roberta se entera que Iñaki la engañó y que su supuesta prima es su novia. Vico se da cuenta que Tato es ladrón.

programme.title: Hermanastro insoportable
programme.desc: Vico platica con Rocco del maltrato que sufre por su papá. Diego tiene que soportar al hijo de la novia de León, que parece ser perfecto, Javier. Max le confiesa a Sol que le gusta Celina y ella le dice que no le gustan los hombres. Javier besa a Roberta.

programme.title: Padres divorciados
programme.desc: Roberta le cuenta a Alma sobre el engaño de Iñaki y está triste. Sol le reclama a Celina haberle robado el novio. Pilar no sabe cómo reaccionar ante el divorcio de sus padres. El papá de Vico le pide perdón. Javier apuesta andar con Roberta.

programme.title: Fuera del torneo
programme.desc: Reverte esperará para decirle la verdad a Roberta. Max le reclama a Celina que le gusten las mujeres; a Johnny le preocupa que Diego sea hijo del jefe de Gobierno. José sospecha que Ricardo Cisniega y Gastón Diestro podrían ser padre e hijo.

programme.title: Noche romántica
programme.desc: Luján es premiada con el primer lugar por el cuento que escribió. Pascual encuentra a Pilar y a Tomás en la cafetería besándose. Victoria le aconseja a Mía hablar con Alma sobre su primera vez con Miguel.

programme.title: De regreso al torneo
programme.desc: Mía habla con Alma y le pide consejos sobre la primera relación sexual. Los estudiantes del colegio Elite defienden su lugar en el torneo intercolegial. Javier entra a la habitación de Roberta y roba su diario.

programme.title: Heridas del partido
programme.desc: Guadalupe termina su relación con Nico debido a sus celos. Roberta le reclama a Lola por haber entrado a su habitación. Santos se disculpa con Guadalupe por haberle ocasionado problemas con Nico.

programme.title: Remordimiento de consciencia
programme.desc: Javier trata de impresionar a Roberta hablando bien de Diego. Mía le pide a Franco que organice una cena para conocer a su nueva novia. Roberta y Mía traman un plan contra Sol para chantajearla y que deje a Max.

programme.title: Embarazo inesperado
programme.desc: Miguel visita a Sabrina, ella le confiesa que tiene un retraso de 10 días. Mía, Dulce y Celina confiesan la verdad sobre el secuestro de Sol. Roberta escucha a Miguel contarle a Diego que sospecha que Sabrina está embarazada.

programme.title: Rumor en el colegio
programme.desc: Gastón le pide a Luján que entregue el cuento que está escribiendo. Sabrina visita en el colegio a Miguel para hablar sobre su posible embarazo. El rumor de que Miguel engañó a Mía con Sabrina se dispersa por el colegio.

programme.title: Planeando un viaje
programme.desc: León e Inés enfrentan a Javier por haber sido expulsado de su colegio. Alma termina con Franco, ya que ella se siente rechazada. Roberta y Diego planean enviar de viaje a Mía y a Miguel para que ella no se entere del rumor.

programme.title: Padre biológico
programme.desc: Alma acepta casarse con Franco. Roberta descubre quién es su verdadero padre. Mía se entera de lo que pasó entre Miguel y Sabrina de boca de Celina. Miguel le confiesa a Franco lo que ocurrió con Sabrina.

programme.title: La burla del colegio
programme.desc: Mía le pide a Franco que la cambie a otra escuela. León le ordena a Diego que cuide a Javier ahora que ingresó al colegio Elite. Mía regresa al colegio para reclamarles a Celina y a Victoria no haberle dicho sobre la infidelidad de Miguel.

programme.title: La reconciliación
programme.desc: Sabrina le confiesa a Miguel que no está embarazada; Diego golpea a Javier, y León lo ve; Mía le dice a Miguel que lo perdona, pero su relación no puede seguir; Diego le asegura a Roberta que no robó su diario; Mía y Roberta quieren dejar RBD.

programme.title: La gira arranca
programme.desc: Diego anuncia que RBD se va de gira, pero las chicas deciden no ir por Mía. Reverte logra que los alumnos ganen el primer lugar del intercolegial, y Roberta se molesta porque dice que se hace el héroe.

programme.title: Profesores en descanso
programme.desc: Pascual le dice a Reverte que tendrá que acompañar a los alumnos a su viaje. Franco se molesta con Alma por autorizar la salida de Mía del colegio para la gira de RBD. Javier le sugiere a León ir a la playa con sus compañeros de la Elite.

programme.title: Linda reconciliación
programme.desc: Alma le pregunta a Franco si está seguro de terminar con ella; Diego asegura que su papá está en Nueva York y no sabrá que están de gira; Miguel no sabe cómo decirle a Mía que Sabrina es la fotógrafa oficial de RBD; Sol abandona a Celina en la selva.

programme.title: Sin ganas de cantar
programme.desc: Mía se entera de que Sabrina estará en el concierto de RBD en Monterrey y se entristece; Max llega a Puerto Vallarta y, al ver a Celina, le dice que la quiere. Roberta le dice a Mía que no permita que Sabrina le quite las ganas de cantar.

programme.title: En el hotel
programme.desc: José y Celina se asustan al ver a Javier y al enterarse de que León está en Puerto Vallarta; el concierto de RBD fue un éxito, y Mía le agradece a Roberta sus consejos; Javier le dice a León que Diego está con una chica para distraerlo.

programme.title: Miedo a morir
programme.desc: Los chicos de RBD sufren porque en el avión en el que viajan tienen unas terribles turbulencias provocadas por una tormenta.

programme.title: Disfrutando la playa
programme.desc: Los muchachos de RBD llegan a Puerto Vallarta para reunirse con los otros estudiantes del colegio. Los estudiantes conviven haciendo diversas actividades en la playa. Diego reta a Javier a una carrera en moto acuática y el ganador se queda con Rob.

programme.title: Fiesta en la playa
programme.desc: Miguel encuentra a Mía platicando con Lucca en la alberca. Giovanni consigue botellas de licor para la fiesta en la playa. Mía habla con Celina y Vico y vuelven a ser mejores amigas.

programme.title: Espiando a su exnovia
programme.desc: Antes de regresar, los alumnos hacen una última actividad en el mar. Miguel manda a Santos a investigar a Mía, pero ella se da cuenta e inventa que se acostó con Luca. Martín le confiesa sus intenciones amorosas a Carla.

programme.title: Atracción mutua
programme.desc: Miguel le exige una explicación a Mía sobre Luca. Roberta le advierte a Diego que si Mía y Miguel siguen peleando, se terminará RBD. Javier le inventa a Roberta que Diego anda diciendo que la puede tener cuando quiera.

programme.title: Declaración de amor
programme.desc: Gastón le advierte a José que no siga investigando sobre él; Javier amenaza a Diego; Roberta rechaza a Diego cuando le pide que sea su novia; Roberta es castigada por entrar al cuarto de Diego; José le dice a Gastón que ya sabe que es su tutor.

programme.title: Serenata de amor
programme.desc: Gastón niega ser el tutor de José; Diego y Miguel le llevan serenata a Mía y Roberta, pero ellas lo toman como una burla; Pilar les dice a los alumnos que su papá ya corrió a Reverte; Roberta le pide a Alma que la lleve a casa de su papá.

programme.title: Reconciliación
programme.desc: Roberta busca a Reverte para pedirle que juntos aprendan a tratarse como padre e hija. Santos le dice a Mía que la forma de demostrar amor es perdonando. Mía le pide a Rocco que persiga y grabe a su papá, porque quiere saber quién es su novia.

programme.title: Defendiendo al profesor
programme.desc: Alma lleva reporteros a la Elite y así obliga a León a no expulsar a ningún alumno y Reverte regresa al colegio; Diego le advierte a Javier que lo desenmascarará frente a Roberta; Mía discute con Franco por negarse a retirarle su apoyo a Miguel.

programme.title: Madre sin amor
programme.desc: Franco quiere confesarle a Mía que anda con Alma, pero ella no quiere que Roberta se entere. Franco le ofrece trabajo a Miguel. Alma, celosa de Reverte, le dice a Roberta que si quiere se vaya con él. Javier golpea a Diego y lo deja inconsciente.

programme.title: En el hospital
programme.desc: Roberta le dice a León que Diego se cayó solo; Javier le confiesa a Reverte que fue él quien le pegó a Diego; Sol se enfurece al descubrir que su plan para separar a Tomás y Pilar falló; José recibe un correo informándole que su tutor murió.

programme.title: Cámara oculta
programme.desc: Roberta cree que Gastón fue quien le envió el correo a José para que deje de investigar sobre él; León corre del hospital a Roberta cuando pretendía visitar a Diego; Inés y León le dicen a Javier que ingresará a un colegio acorde a su personalidad.

programme.title: Otro colegio
programme.desc: León le muestra a Diego su oficina, para que empiece a trabajar con él; una amiga de Sabrina llama a Miguel para advertirle que no tuvo relaciones sexuales con ella; Franco le dice a Alma que no se precipite al ceder la patria potestad de Roberta.

programme.title: Renuncia por amor
programme.desc: Mía se entera de que Miguel la engaña y planea su venganza. Alma va a renunciar a la patria potestad de Roberta con tal de que ella sea feliz. Franco habla con Alma y le pide que le dé tiempo a Roberta para que tome la decisión correcta.

programme.title: La huida
programme.desc: Alma está desesperada por la desaparición de Roberta; en el colegio nadie sabe nada. José y Lupita le mienten a Alma al decirle que no saben a dónde fue Roberta. Javier ayuda a Roberta a escaparse, pero al final se arrepiente.

programme.title: Verdad dolorosa
programme.desc: Roberta golpea a Sol por burlarse de ella. Alma y Martín buscan a Roberta para hablar con ella sobre su custodia. Roberta decide irse a vivir con su padre. Lola busca entre las cosas de Lupita y encuentra los papeles donde dice que ella es adoptada.

programme.title: La verdad sobre su origen
programme.desc: Roberta le ofrece a Lupita hablar con Lola para que ya no se sienta triste, pero Lola no acepta que Lupita no le haya dicho la verdad sobre su origen desde un principio. Pilar pelea con Sol por sus burlas. Lupita se reconcilia con Lola.

programme.title: La maldad de Gastón
programme.desc: Roberta pasa su primera noche en la casa de su papá. Gastón corre a Jose de la escuela y la maestra Hilda la recibe en su casa.

programme.title: El retorno
programme.desc: Sol le confiesa a Raquel que conquistará a Gastón para que olvide a Mía. Miguel y Mía se encuentran afuera del salón y le dicen a Roberta que no habrá protesta porque los descubrieron. El profesor Enrique regresa al Colegio y se encuentra con Julia.

programme.title: La ira de Gastón
programme.desc: Roberta platica con José y le dice que Gastón la odia, ella cree que fue una carga muy grande y por eso está enojado. Alma dona toda la ropa de Roberta a una casa hogar.

programme.title: Accidente fatal
programme.desc: Gastón es buscado por la policía y cree que José fue quien los llamó. Mía le pone una trampa a Sol para que deje de usar su perfume. Teo y Miguel van con la policía a casa de Gastón. Miguel quiere impedir que Gastón se vaya.

programme.title: Una gran noticia
programme.desc: Gastón se encuentra grave en el hospital y recibe la visita de Enrique, quien aprovecha para pedirle un favor. Miguel encuentra a Franco y Alma besándose, pero ellos le piden que no le diga nada a Roberta y a Mía. José tiene miedo que Gastón muera.

programme.title: Profunda tristeza
programme.desc: León investiga a Diego y se da cuenta de que le ha estado mintiendo. Sin querer, Sol descubre que Franco y Alma son novios. El director hace una junta para decidir quién ocupará el puesto de Gastón. Jose está muy triste por la muerte de Gastón.

programme.title: Decisiones
programme.desc: Diego decide salirse del grupo porque su padre no acepta que sea cantante. Los chicos tratan de convencerlo, pero él está decidido. José platica con Lola y le dice que es doloroso ser huérfana.

programme.title: Buenas noticias
programme.desc: El profesor Enrique habla con Diego y le dice que podrá viajar a la gira en Los Ángeles. Diego le cuenta a Roberta que podrá ir con ellos a la gira. Mía se entera por un mensaje anónimo que su papá sale con Alma, ella cree que todo es mentira.

programme.title: Sin padre
programme.desc: Pilar cuestiona a Tomás sobre Celeste; Roberta admira a Diego por enfrentar a su papá; León intenta que Franco y Alma no dejen ir a sus hijas al concierto; Celeste va al Elite a visitar a Giovanni; los papás de Lola le dicen la verdad de su origen.

programme.title: Tristeza infinita
programme.desc: La banda planea su gira por Los Ángeles y todos están entusiasmados. Mía pelea con Miguel en el ensayo porque está celosa de Sabrina. Franco le da permiso a Mía para irse de viaje con Miguel.

programme.title: Felicidad incompleta
programme.desc: Max le dice a Celina que está enamorado de ella. Pilar le exige a Giovanni que le explique sobre su enfermedad. Celina recibe la visita de su mamá, la cual la hace sentir mal por su sobrepeso. León decide castigar a Diego por seguir en la banda.

programme.title: La gira
programme.desc: RBD da un show en Los Ángeles, California. Alma apoya nuevos talentos musicales. Santos le manda una rosa con dedicatoria a Lupita. Gastón le escribe una carta a Luján antes de morir. RBD regresa de gira con un gran anuncio.

programme.title: Siendo honesto
programme.desc: Roberta lee la carta que dejó Gastón. Javier se sincera con Roberta para que pueda volver a confiar en él, pero ella se decepciona más y lo abofetea. Después de ver casas, Mía le dice a su papá que ya sabe sobre su relación con Alma.

programme.title: La carta del tutor
programme.desc: Miguel se alegra al descubrir que no tuvo intimidad con Sabrina. Roberta se pelea con Mía por llamar a Alma mentirosa. Madariaga le entrega a José una carta que le dejó Gastón antes de morir. Roberta se enoja con Martín y decide huir a casa de Alma.

programme.title: Palabras verdaderas
programme.desc: Mía experimenta un conflicto por la relación de Franco y Alma. Mía habla con Alma sobre la relación que tiene con su papá y le exige que no salga con él. Miguel le reclama a Sabrina por hacerle creer a Mía que pasaron la noche juntos.

programme.title: Avergonzada
programme.desc: La mamá de Celina no la deja entrar a la boda de su hermana, al igual que a Vico, porque se avergüenza de ella, pero su novio la consuela y experimentan algo que no habían hecho antes. Se alistan los permisos para grabar el disco de RBD.

programme.title: Sin amor materno
programme.desc: Se alista la grabación del disco de RBD. Roberta se pone muy triste porque extraña a Alma, pero no puede perdonarla por tanta soledad que sintió cuando era niña, así que Martín la consuela. Mía confronta a Alma y Franco frente a Roberta.

programme.title: La confesión de Roberto
programme.desc: Tras una artimaña de León, Reverte es despedido del colegio y Roberta les confiesa a sus compañeros que el profesor es su padre. Se hace una fiesta de despedida para Reverte y Miguel sufre un desmayo, es llevado al hospital y cae en estado de coma.

programme.title: En riesgo de muerte
programme.desc: Mía llora desesperada porque Miguel puede morir. León amenaza con destruir la carrera de Alma Rey si no saca a Roberta de la escuela. Raquel desenmascara las mentiras de Sol y le afirma que nunca podrá ser una top model por su estatura.

programme.title: La venganza de León
programme.desc: León influye en los directivos de la escuela para expulsar a Roberta. Diego decide dejar la banda para proteger a Roberta de su papá. Mía se siente orgullosa de Franco y le pregunta si Miguel algún día abrirá los ojos.

programme.title: La revancha
programme.desc: Roberta, Diego y Martín Reverte arman un plan para que León sea encarcelado por los fraudes que cometió, pero León los descubre y lo impide. Alma llama a León para informarle que un amigo de ella tiene información comprometedora sobre él.

programme.title: El intercambio
programme.desc: Alma le exige a León que reincorporen a Roberta y al profesor Reverte al colegio a cambio de unos papeles que lo comprometen. Madariaga informa a los muchachos que si Miguel entra en un estado crítico y despierta puede tener daño cerebral.

programme.title: Vida olvidada
programme.desc: Diego le deja en claro a León que puede cuidarse solo y no necesita de su dinero. Mía cuida a Miguel mientras se encuentra en coma, pero cuando él abre los ojos, no la reconoce. José, finalmente, lee la carta que le dejó Gastón.

programme.title: Pérdida de memoria
programme.desc: Miguel despierta del coma, pero no recuerda nada, excepto a Diego. Diego intenta ayudar a Miguel para que recuerde. Mía se altera mucho porque Miguel no la recuerda. Los alumnos comienzan a buscar universidad.

programme.title: La prueba de embarazo
programme.desc: Vico le dice a Celina que Giovanni ya sabe sobre la prueba de embarazo, algo que preocupa a Vico y Celina, ya que no quieren que nadie sepa. Marina intenta saber quién le llamó misteriosamente al hotel y llama al celular de Alma.

programme.title: Embarazo al descubierto
programme.desc: Todos se enteran de que Celina está embarazada. Alma Rey habla con la mamá de Mía y Franco se enoja por meterse en sus asuntos. Mía piensa seguir los consejos de Alma y Lupita en torno a Miguel.

programme.title: Sola y con un hijo
programme.desc: Celina no sabe qué hacer con su bebé, se siente muy sola porque Max se fue y el profesor Madariaga la aconseja. Sol se entera del embarazo, chantajea a Celina y a sus amigas. Alma no cree en las intenciones de Marina de no acercarse a Mía.

programme.title: Confusión de nombres
programme.desc: Celina asiste a su primera cita médica. Marina le pide perdón a Franco por haberlo abandonado. Miguel le pide a Mía que le ayude a recordar sobre su novia, pero él cree que su novia es Sabrina. Diego es despedido de su trabajo por culpa de su padre.

programme.title: La mentira de Franco
programme.desc: Mía no perdona a Franco por mentirle toda su vida sobre el presunto fallecimiento de su madre. Miguel no acepta hacer la rehabilitación y Franco habla con él. Javier es inculpado en el robo de tangas y calzones a las alumnas de Elite Way.

programme.title: Tratando de recordar
programme.desc: Gandía le confiesa la verdad a Madariaga sobre las amenazas de León para que aceptara entrar en sus negocios; Mía quiere localizar a su mamá, pero Franco le dice que desapareció de nuevo; Miguel le pregunta a Diego y Roberta si Mía era su novia.

programme.title: The Straw Woman
programme.desc: The revival of a traditional festival at Midsomer Parva ends in tragedy when the curate, the Rev Alex Dakin, is burnt alive inside a straw effigy of a woman. Then his gay lover the priest, the Rev Jim Hale, dies too.

programme.title: Ghosts of Christmas Past
programme.desc: It's Christmas and the troubled Villiers family get together nine years after the death of eldest son Ferdy, a magician. A riddle in a cracker predicts that two people will die before midnight on Boxing Day, then the frail Lydia Villiers is hospitalised after a fall. As Barnaby abandons his Christmas lunch with the in-laws to investigate, it seems as though ghosts from the past are haunting the household.

programme.title: The Dark Rider
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones investigate when the appearance of a headless horseman at Quitewell Hall foreshadows a number of deaths among an aristocratic family called the DeQuettevilles. Meanwhile, the family stage a Civil War re-enactment with their hostile neighbours and relive historic battles. Can the detectives uncover the truth about the DeQuettevilles and the ghostly rider in order to prevent more murders?

programme.title: Murder of Innocence
programme.desc: When convicted murderer Grady Felton returns to the village where he killed a boy years earlier, his arrival is met with anger from the locals. Soon afterwards, a barrister is killed in Midsomer and suspicion falls on Grady. Grady has a solid alibi, but Barnaby suspects that he is working with an accomplice - until Grady himself is targeted in an arson attack.

programme.title: Death and the Divas
programme.desc: The murder of a journalist has chilling echoes of a 1960s horror film starring Midsomer's own Stella Harris. When Stella's more famous sister returns after a 40-year family rift, the killings escalate, each of them reminiscent of a movie plot - is life - and death - imitating art?

programme.title: Written in the Stars
programme.desc: As darkness covers Midsomer Stanton during a total eclipse of the sun, amateur astronomer Jeremy Harper is killed by a blow to the head with a meteorite. Barnaby and Jones soon discover intrigue, sexual tension and academic rivalry are rife among the star-seeking community.

programme.title: The Sicilian Defence
programme.desc: Harriet Farmer wakes up after being in a coma since the night she tried to elope. Harriet's boyfriend Finn Robson has been missing since the couple tried to run away together a year before. Then the president of the local chess society, Edward Stannington, is found dead in a lake with an ice pick in his back. His damaged car is nearby and Kate finds a clue in his mouth.

programme.title: Schooled in Murder
programme.desc: When a woman is crushed to death by a giant round of cheese at the home of the world-famous "Midsomer Blue", Barnaby and Jones are soon on the case. Debbie Moffett worked at the dairy, founded by her colleague Jim Caxton, who seems more anxious about his precious cheese than Debbie's death. And later, Debbie's lover Oliver Ordish is garrotted with cheese wire and covered with cheese fly larvae.

programme.title: Tainted Fruit
programme.desc: When the body of arrogant local beauty Melissa Townsend is discovered by the pool at her manor house, DCI Barnaby uncovers a seedy world of adultery and deceit within the affluent rural community.

programme.title: Ring Out Your Dead
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby investigates the murders of bell ringers from the village church who are being mysteriously murdered one by one. Barnaby and Troy find that they must solve a riddle from the past before the killer strikes again.

programme.title: Murder on St Malley's Day
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby uncovers an elite Mafia-like sect called the Pudding Club at private boys' school Devington College while investigating a murder, and must get to the bottom of the mystery before another victim turns up dead.

programme.title: Market for Murder
programme.desc: When the leader of a reading club used as a cover to run an investment portfolio is found battered to death, the club's secret activities are exposed and long-held secrets and desires return to haunt its members.

programme.title: A Worm in the Bud
programme.desc: When Susan Bartlett's body is discovered in a wood, villagers assume she killed herself because she could not have children. However, when it comes to light that her suicide note - in the form of an email - was sent too late, Barnaby soon finds himself in the midst of witchcraft, ancient potions, infidelity and land feuds.

programme.title: Death in the Slow Lane
programme.desc: New DCI John Barnaby is intrigued when he learns that the remains of famous racing driver Duncan Palmer have been discovered at Darnley Park School - 40 years after he was thought to have drowned in the Lake District. During the school's classic car show, racing legend Peter Fossett is annoyed that his fellow judge is club DJ Dave 'Doggy' Day, who knows nothing about cars. Soon afterwards, Doggy is crushed to death.

programme.title: Dark Secrets
programme.desc: A social services investigator calls on elderly eccentrics William and Mary Bingham, but he is sent away rudely by their daughter Selina and her husband Eddie Stanton. Artist Maggie Viviani also had a run-in with the investigator, so when his body is found in the river, they all come under suspicion. Barnaby learns that the Binghams never recovered from losing their elder daughter and son in a drowning accident.

programme.title: Echoes of the Dead
programme.desc: When a young woman is found dressed like a bride and drowned in a bath, it triggers a spate of ghoulish wedding-themed murders in Great Worthy. The case takes Barnaby and Jones to a donkey sanctuary, a heritage steam railway and a pub run by an ex-copper and former brothel madam. Could history be repeating itself?

programme.title: The Oblong Murders
programme.desc: When a young female member of a new age cult called The Oblong Foundation goes missing, DCI John Barnaby investigates and sends DS Jones undercover at the cult's base, Malham Hall. The police learn that the hall's previous owners, the Lamberts, died in a gas explosion on board their boat. Barnaby and Jones must try to find out what really happened to the Lamberts - and whether the case has a link to the missing woman.

programme.title: The Sleeper Under the Hill
programme.desc: When a farmer is found horribly murdered in the middle of a stone circle, suspicion points at a group of druids. DCI John Barnaby and DS Jones hurry to the scene of the crime, where they are joined by new pathologist Kate Wilding on her first assignment. Druid high priest Leticia Clifford shows Barnaby that sacred ley lines run through the stone circle and later is convinced she has made an exciting discovery.

programme.title: The Night of the Stag
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones are sampling the local cider at Midsomer Abbas spring fair when the body of a missing tax inspector is found floating in the cider vat. Meanwhile, publican Samuel Quested says that he wants to restore an ancient rite called the Stag in which men go in search of women from another village in order to 'refresh the gene pool'. As Barnaby and Jones investigate the murder they uncover an array of motives.

programme.title: A Sacred Trust
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones enter the cloistered and old-fashioned world of Midsomer Priory after a nun is found strangled. Jones visits the local pub, where he learns that a woman was seen acting strangely on the day of the murder, and that teenagers in the area sneak into the priory grounds for romantic liaisons. Later, the nuns discover that a valuable silver altar set has vanished, then the chaplain is found murdered.

programme.title: A Rare Bird
programme.desc: A row between keen birdwatchers in Midsomer-in-the-Marsh turns nasty when their president is killed. Patrick Morgan met his death while hoping to sight a rare bird, but is his obsession with ornithology to blame - or something more sinister? Barnaby and Jones attempt to discover the truth.

programme.title: Death's Shadow
programme.desc: The Barnabys plan to renew their wedding vows for their 25th anniversary when Tom is distracted by a murder of a dying man committed with an Indian sword in Badger's Drift.

programme.title: Strangler's Wood
programme.desc: The naked body of a young woman is found strangled in a local woodland nine years after three identical murders took place there. As DCI Barnaby and DS Troy investigate the killings, they are led further and further into the murky, clandestine world of Midsomer Worthy.

programme.title: Beyond the Grave
programme.desc: Mysterious events and the discovery of his relative's body lead the residents of Aspern Tallow to believe that Jonathan Lowrie's ghost is at large in their community. DCI Barnaby and DS Troy attempt to determine whether these strange occurrences are supernatural or if there is a more rational explanation.

programme.title: Blood Will Out
programme.desc: In the sleepy village of Martyr Warren, two opposing groups of travellers have set up home. DCI Barnaby and DS Troy are called in to investigate when the local magistrate, principal adversary of the new arrivals in the village, is found shot dead at his home.

programme.title: Habeas Corpus
programme.desc: When wealthy landowner Gregory Lancaster's body goes missing on the night of his death, a sinister web of secrets and lies is exposed in the village of Little Malton as Barnaby, Nelson and Kam Karimore are drawn into a world of body-snatching.

programme.title: The Incident at Cooper Hill
programme.desc: Mysterious lights are seen in the sky over famous UFO hot-spot Cooper Hill. When a local forest ranger suffers a strange death, the visiting UFO spotters are convinced aliens are responsible. DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson unearth suspicions, betrayals and long-buried secrets in their search for the truth.

programme.title: Breaking the Chain
programme.desc: An international cycling competition comes to the Midsomer village of Burwood Mantle. When the race leader is murdered, DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson find themselves drawn into a ruthlessly competitive world of blackmail, bribery and bloodshed where winning comes at any cost.

programme.title: A Dying Art
programme.desc: Art comes to the picturesque Midsomer village of Angel's Rise with the opening of a new sculpture park. When its launch is marred by murder, DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson have to get creative if they are to crack a case where art imitates death, and everything has a deeper meaning.

programme.title: Saints and Sinners
programme.desc: The discovery of a Saint's bones at an archaeological dig causes a stir in the village of Midsomer Cicely. But when the leader of the dig is murdered, DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson soon realise that it is not only skeletons that have been long buried in the hallowed ground.

programme.title: Harvest of Souls
programme.desc: The annual harvest fair and the daredevil riders of the Wall of Death arrive in Whitcombe Mallet; the owner of an equestrian centre is trampled by his horse.

programme.title: The House in the Woods
programme.desc: With the help of Acting DC Ben Jones, Barnaby investigates the garrotting of a husband and wife outside a deserted cottage near Midsomer Newton. Despite a reputation for being haunted, Winyard is a magnet for villagers, developers and conservationists. Barnaby and Jones must separate truth from rumour in order to reveal the cottage's secrets - and catch the killer.

programme.title: Dead Letters
programme.desc: Midsomer Barton is celebrating Oak Apple Week when a mother is found drowned. It looks like suicide, and that she was driven to it by grief over her dead daughter. Barnaby investigates and is shaken by two villagers who look like murder victims from his past. Then another body is discovered, and it appears that the festivities have stirred up a cocktail of adultery, contempt, unrequited love and revenge in the village.

programme.title: Vixen's Run
programme.desc: The death of wealthy aristocrat Sir Freddy Butler brings Barnaby and Jones to the privileged surroundings of Haddington Hall. It looks like Freddy suffered a heart attack, but when his will disappears and his lawyer is killed in an arson attack, the detectives close in on Freddy's family. What are they hiding, and where are the mysterious Haddington diamonds?

programme.title: Down Among the Dead Men
programme.desc: When council clerk Martin Barrett is shot dead, Barnaby and Jones discover that he was an expert blackmailer. They investigate which of his victims hated him enough to kill him, and the trail leads to Fennacombe Bay. Why are Richard and Maggie Florian spending so much time at sea, and could police committee chairman Sir John Waverley have a scandalous past? With the help of Barnaby, they intend to find out.

programme.title: Four Funerals and a Wedding
programme.desc: A battle of the sexes which has raged in Broughton since the First World War comes to a head when ageing feminist Mildred Danvers is found dead after returning to her childhood home. As Barnaby investigates, the misogynist vicar Rev Gantis is shot through the head during a humiliating donkey race at the village fair. Is the killer on the side of the men or women - or do tragedies in Broughton's past hold the answer?

programme.title: Country Matters
programme.desc: Controversial plans to build a supermarket in Elverton-cum-Latterly lead to murder when a man is stabbed to death and the pollution advisor for the site seems to be spending more time with the women of the village than at work. Can Barnaby and Jones discover the truth and learn what is really polluting Elverton?

programme.title: Death in Chorus
programme.desc: When Midsomer Worthy's baritone Connor Simpson is killed just days before a competition, the rest of the choir, including Joyce Barnaby, are in fear for their lives. Barnaby and Jones investigate and find an atmosphere of bitter rivalry and tense marital relationships. Then, there's another murder and the race is on to catch the killer before the choral showdown.

programme.title: Wow! Taiwan
programme.desc: The Peruvians are proud to promote their culture in Taiwan! Jorge owns a local restaurant, but also works as a radio host and DJ. He's been actively promoting Latin American culture for the last twenty-four years. Meanwhile, Ivan is a model enthusiast, who has managed to open his dream model shop right here in Taiwan. Let's see what unique performances these four guests have in store for us today.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Kobe vs Franco Canzoniere

programme.title: Stir The Pot
programme.desc: Gia Kim and Kelly Mi Li instantly bond over their similarities and share stories about their upbringing.

programme.title: Asia Beneath the Surface
programme.desc: From a glass-floored bridge suspended above a Vietnamese canyon to the classical grandeur of New York's Grand Central Station, the camera travels the world in search of structures that transcend their function to become statements of human ambition. Each location is a chapter in the longest story our species has written - the compulsion to build beyond what is necessary, toward what is magnificent. A documentary that treats architecture as the most public form of philosophy.

programme.title: Lady Detective Shadow
programme.desc: A kung fu fighting lady detective travels the badlands of ancient China bringing criminals to justice.

programme.title: 20 Days
programme.desc: Wesley struggles to choose between Liv and Mama's approval. Raina faces James's blackmail, and Jess gets jealous over Edrick's coworker.

programme.title: Absolutely Albuquerque
programme.desc: Renowned singer Vicente Griego takes Amanda on a flamenco-fueled journey.

programme.title: Plate It Baltimore
programme.desc: Chefs Tyler Johnson and Ben Lefenfeld get fancy for this Black Tie Dinner challenge.

programme.title: Uncle Roger

programme.title: ZHC

programme.title: ZHC

programme.title: Matched
programme.desc: It took just one picture for Karamjeet to agree to marry Jasdeep and after an engagement conducted from afar, will love blossom for this Kiwi Indian? And life after arranged marriage is explored: did their parents get it right?

programme.title: Both Worlds
programme.desc: Talented Chinese brush artist Wei Lun Ha wants to turn his passion into a career, but his parents are not convinced being a professional artist is a credible profession. Things become more difficult as Wei begins to express his social convictions through his artwork.

programme.title: Both Worlds
programme.desc: Flamboyant fashion design student Lenon Wakuwa has made a world for himself in small town New Zealand, but an assignment about identity forces him to confront how the African community views his unique and feminine style.

programme.title: Good Taste - Chinese
programme.desc: The sweet and nutty Taro Root is featured as Ching whips up some Taro Spring Rolls, Taro Root with Sugar Dip, and Taro Tapioca.

programme.title: Good Taste - Chinese
programme.desc: Ching demonstrates how to use Taro Root. Her choices include Lotus Root Soup with Pork Ribs and Peanuts, Lily Buds with Lotus Root, and Lotus Root Salad.

programme.title: Pirate Attacks and Tactics
programme.desc: Pirates want money or anything they can turn into money; consequently, they usually wish for a speedy surrender, do not want a battle and rarely sink captured ships; the many tactics pirates use to apprehend their prey in the age of sails.

programme.title: Buried Treasure and Pirate Economics
programme.desc: Very few pirates hit it big or try to bury their treasure on a deserted island; exploring the business aspect of piracy, which is one of the few aspects of life pirates can control; piracy is a no-prey, no-pay system; the risk of no pay is very real.

programme.title: Westward the Course of Empire
programme.desc: Some of the ways people think about the American West; how this vast, fascinating region comes into being; how it is shaped by centuries of myth-making; what about westward expansion fascinates every generation of Americans.

programme.title: The West in the Colonial Era
programme.desc: Understanding the mark left on the American West by its earliest colonists; the Spaniards, who introduce horses; the French, who develop a complex trade system; the English, who have little interest in colonizing the west of the Appalachians.

programme.title: Venturing Beyond the Appalachians
programme.desc: After the Revolutionary War, the land between the Appalachians and the Mississippi becomes part of the new republic; how the territory is organized; the Northwest Ordinance of 1787 creates a new set of rules that clashes with old realities.

programme.title: Discoveries of Lewis and Clark
programme.desc: The journey of the two explorers who map the Louisiana Purchase between 1804 and 1806; how Lewis and Clark fit into the tradition of explorers looking for a water route to the Pacific; the political and geographic history of the Louisiana Purchase.

programme.title: The Fur Trade and the Mountain Men
programme.desc: Fur traders and mountain men play an integral part in exploring and mapping the American West; why fur is a precious commodity; how John Jacob Astor dominates the American fur trade; how famous mountaineers like Jedediah Smith become legends.

programme.title: Trail of Tears
programme.desc: One of the most dismal episodes in the story of the American West; the forced migration of the "Five Civilized Tribes" under the Indian Removal Act of 1830; it is this ordeal that the Cherokee come to call the "Trail of Tears".

programme.title: Julia Disobeys Emperor Augustus
programme.desc: The experiences of Julia, the daughter of Caesar Augustus; a window into the way many pre-modern societies sought to control morality; Julia's life of thwarted potential; understanding what women had to overcome to make a mark on history.

programme.title: Herodias Has John the Baptist Beheaded

programme.desc: Nero's reputation for excess and cruelty; how Poppaea became the wife of the mad emperor; how Poppaea's religious sympathies likely influenced Nero's persecution of Christians; a complex story of spiritual zeal and vicious cruelty.

programme.title: Your Ancestry, Your Identity
programme.desc: Asking whether genes determine one's essential nature and identity, or one builds their own identity; exploring the essentialist and constructed philosophies; how one might incorporate aspects of both into their own view of personal identity.

programme.title: What Genetic Testing Brings to Ancestry
programme.desc: Labs that provide DNA ancestry information use hundreds of thousands of ancestry-information markers, or AIMs; learning about the AIMs that relate to major identifiable lineages; what can be gleaned from mitochondrial DNA and Y-DNA.

programme.title: Sensitive Approaches to Ancestry Results
programme.desc: There are many social issues affecting an individual's emotional response to receiving DNA ancestry results; how the reciprocal engagement method can help families face unexpected ancestry results; tips to consider before ordering one's own test.

programme.title: When Family Narrative Meets Genetic Testing
programme.desc: People want a family narrative, whereas DNA just "wants" to move itself forward and is neutral on issues of race, subterfuge or social connection; how to create a strategic family narrative to incorporate the scientific facts of DNA ancestry results.

programme.title: The Origins of King Arthur
programme.desc: Studying images of the Arthurian legend and their relationship to historical reality; tracing the history of post-Roman Britain; the large-scale invasions of the Anglo-Saxons; evidence that a single individual rose up to lead his people.

programme.title: An Arthur-Like Figure in Cornwall
programme.desc: Investigating archeological and historical evidence that supports the existence of an Arthur-like figure in early Britain; studying the site of Cadbury Castle, the center of operations of a leader who thwarted the Saxons; the supposed tomb of Arthur.

programme.title: King Arthur in the Latin Chronicles
programme.desc: Exploring some of the most significant early witnesses to the Arthurian legend; studying accounts of Arthur's exploits and death in Latin texts and the Welsh Annales Cambriae; how texts from the 11th and 12th century C.E. embellished the legend.

programme.title: King Arthur in Wales - The Mabinogion
programme.desc: How Arthur became a cultural touchstone in early Welsh history; key references to the Arthurian saga in the Black Book of Carmarthen and the Triads of the Island of Britain; the portrayal of Arthur in the tales of the Mabinogion.

programme.title: The Many Faces of Jesus
programme.desc: Scholars who have devoted their lives to studying the ancient sources about Jesus come to varying conclusions; seeing what can be learned about what Jesus most likely says and does by working from a strictly historical perspective.

programme.title: One Remarkable Life
programme.desc: Beginning the study of the historical Jesus by examining the world within which the Christian religion is born; this world is largely populated by "pagans" who, unlike the Jews and then later the Christians, believe not in one but in many gods.

programme.title: Scholars Look at the Gospels
programme.desc: The work of German writer D. F. Strauss argues that the Gospels are best understood as containing history-like stories that intend to convey truth but do not occur as they are narrated, which is why most scholars find his approach illuminating.

programme.title: Fact and Fiction in the Gospels
programme.desc: Scholars question the historical accuracy of some gospel accounts not out of hostility toward Christianity, but because of historical evidence; what this evidence is; how historians assess it.

programme.title: The Origins of Modern Archaeology
programme.desc: What archeologists actually do; the nature and scope of their work; misconceptions about the field; tracing the history of archeology, from its beginnings with the ancient Babylonian king Nabonidus to archeological luminaries of the 20th century.

programme.title: Excavating Pompeii and Herculaneum
programme.desc: Traveling to the sites of Pompeii and Herculaneum, which are destroyed by the 79 A.D. eruption of Mount Vesuvius; the history of their excavation; the preservation of buildings, objects and human remains; discovering details of ancient Roman life.

programme.title: Schliemann and His Successors at Troy
programme.desc: Following the exploits of Heinrich Schliemann as he looks for Homer's Troy; learning about his dig through nine stratified cities; the finds; the debates over which city is Troy; tracing subsequent work at the site; examining the conclusions.

programme.title: Early Archaeology in Mesopotamia
programme.desc: The history of finds in Mesopotamia; the 19th-century unearthing of the Assyrian palaces at Nimrud and Nineveh, with their libraries of cuneiform texts; contemplating the 20th-century discovery of the treasures of the "Death Pits of Ur".

programme.title: Your Ancestry, Your Identity
programme.desc: Asking whether genes determine one's essential nature and identity, or one builds their own identity; exploring the essentialist and constructed philosophies; how one might incorporate aspects of both into their own view of personal identity.

programme.title: What Genetic Testing Brings to Ancestry
programme.desc: Labs that provide DNA ancestry information use hundreds of thousands of ancestry-information markers, or AIMs; learning about the AIMs that relate to major identifiable lineages; what can be gleaned from mitochondrial DNA and Y-DNA.

As they investigate reports of strange noises, shadowy figures, and unexplained activity, they delve deeper into the eerie history surrounding the building. Will the spirits haunting The Carlton reveal their secrets, or will the team leave with more questions than answers?

Paranormal investigator Jayne Harris is on hand to capture proof for current owners Sean and Bex, who are hoping to understand more about the strange goings on in their home.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Katy from Mold, in Wales is convinced that her Party Shop is haunted be previous tenants of the 17th Century building. Paranormal investigator Lee Roberts has been enlisted to see if he can capture proof and back up claims that a ghost called Sarah, a young servant girl, is still residing in the premises.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Danny Moss has been charged with investigating a haunted house in Middlesbrough in the UK. Rose grew up in the house in the 1970's and 80s which was believed to have been the site of a fatal fire years earlier. She witnessed her first ghost when she was just 7 years old.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: The White Swan pub and hotel in Henley in Arden in the UK is reported to be a haunted hotspot. This former jailhouse with gallows has a gruesome history and owners Maria and Nigel believe a lady of the night who died in mysterious circumstances still roams the corridors.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: The Old Picture House in Nottingham in the UK, was a cinema abandoned in 1959. Today it houses a museum of haunted artefacts. Steve and Marie have captured what they believe to be paranormal activity on a hearse dating back to the Victorian era. Intrigued by the findings, we have sent MJ Dickson to investigate and validate their claims.

programme.title: The Haunted Castle
programme.desc: Bex and Sean head to Ewloe Castle in North Wales, believed to be haunted by ghosts and spirits.

programme.title: Haunted and Cursed Magpie Mines
programme.desc: Haunted Magpie Mines are located in the Peak District of Derbyshire. Believed to be one of the most paranormal mines in the UK. Ghost Dimension investigate claims of paranormal activity and a curse that has been set on to the land. Will a ghost be caught on camera? and will any of the paranormal equipment make contact with the spirit world?

programme.desc: The team investigate the Market Hotel in Bolton. Believed to be haunted by the lost soul of a previous landlord and a guest who likes to make herself known. They make contact with spirits from the other side and witness first hand paranormal activity.

programme.title: Shadow Menace Haunting Morley Market - Part 1
programme.desc: Sean heads to the town of Morley to investigate the infamous Morley Market. A place once bustling with people from years gone by, is now haunted by shadow figures and they appear to want to make themselves known.

programme.title: The Night Before the Storm
programme.desc: In this special episode, its the night before Sean and Bex are joined by their celebrity guest and they checkout The Black Horse in Pluckley Village to investigate the paranormal hauntings at the most haunted pub in the UK.

programme.title: Haunted Weir Mill
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team visit Weir Mill, the oldest and most paranormally active mill in Stockport. Dating back to 1790 this mill has seen accidents, suicides, murder and even occult practices. Will the team encounter the spirits or friendly, benevolent children or something darker and more malevolent that lurks within the maze?

programme.title: An Unexpected Haunted Adventure
programme.desc: The team head to Lydiate Abbey to investigate claims of a ghostly white lady and stumble upon a totally hidden gem deep in the woods, which has its own spirits haunting. With hidden priest holes and a building being reclaimed by the land. Be prepared for one of the scariest investigations ever.

programme.title: Witches and Vampires Haunting Saint James Cemetery
programme.desc: St James Cemetery is set behind Liverpool Cathedral and is claimed to be the worlds most haunted, with the remains of over 58,000 people buried at the location and multiple claims of paranormal sightings. Will the team survive the night unscathed? Will they encounter witchcraft or a vampire that is believed to roam the grounds to this very day?

programme.title: The Wheatsheaf Horror
programme.desc: Psychics claim to see the past as if it were unfolding before them. When Suzanna Hadwin visits the Wheatsheaf Pub in North England, she encounters a long-buried mystery. The owners hear whispers and find strange handprints, leading them to use a Ouija board. Their search uncovers evidence of an old murder-hidden behind the very walls of the pub, which soon turns against them.

programme.title: Field of Ghosts
programme.desc: Markie Beason has always sensed spirits in her home, but her family dismisses her fears-until the ghosts shift their focus to her. As the terrifying encounters intensify, Markie grows desperate for answers. When her father finally believes her, he calls in paranormal investigators to uncover the spirits' identities and help bring peace to their haunted home.

programme.title: Angels and Demons
programme.desc: When a demon haunts the home of Maryland single Mom Kathie Sheats , psychics, priests and paranormal investigators fail to resolve the issue. Only Kathie herself can conquer the dark entity ... with the help of an angel.

programme.title: Blood Visions
programme.desc: The Johnson family has found what they consider their perfect home in Michigan. But it turns out to be haunted, and a demon targets their son for possession. Only the power of prayer can restore peace and sanity.

programme.title: The Haunted Victorian
programme.desc: Edwin Gonzalez and Lillian Otero move into a dream Victorian home, but eerie footsteps and slamming doors soon plague them. When Edwin sees a full-body apparition, they seek help. Lillian's behavior darkens as an evil female spirit possesses her. She suffers physical attacks in her sleep, and as the hauntings escalate, they realize escaping may no longer be an option.

programme.title: Vision of Terror
programme.desc: After losing her husband in a tragic accident, Stacy Stowe hears ghostly sounds and assumes it's his spirit-until her daughter insists it's something evil. Dark figures prowl the home, and attacks escalate. A paranormal cleanser brings temporary peace, but a new psychic warns that unless Stacy closes the portal, the evil will never leave.

programme.title: Spirits of the Dead
programme.desc: Joanne and Jim Whitley's dream of running a horse-riding business turns into a nightmare when strange occurrences plague their New Hampshire farm. Their son hears eerie sounds, and Joanne senses a dark presence. As financial struggles mount, their horses fall mysteriously ill. When the spirit turns violent and threatens their child, Joanne calls on a Shamballa master to fight the evil force.

programme.title: The Demon's Revenge
programme.desc: Tiffany McKinnon, Billy Quattlebaum, and his daughter move into a 200-year-old farmhouse in Franklin, VA. While Tiffany tries to make peace with a lingering spirit, a darker entity lurks in the shadows, tormenting the family. Determined to stay, Tiffany seeks help from paranormal investigators and the church, hoping to expel the evil before it destroys their lives.

programme.title: Bug
programme.desc: At a rundown desert motel, Agnes (Ashley Judd) begins a tentative relationship with a newcomer named Peter (Michael Shannon). He has a strange charisma, one that offers fearful and unstable Agnes a flicker of hope. When Peter reveals that the military deliberately infected him with a bug and that he has tiny insects crawling under his skin, paranoia begins to envelop the desperate pair.

programme.title: Boogeyman
programme.desc: As a young boy, Tim (Aaron Murphy) witnesses the horrifying event of his father (Charles Mesure) being dragged away by the boogeyman. Despite the reassurances of his mother (Lucy Lawless) that the boogeyman is not real, he is never the same afterward. Years later, Tim (Barry Watson) manages to create a normal life for himself -- though he lives without closets and keeps his mattress on the floor. But when he learns of his mother's death, Tim must return home to face his childhood trauma.

programme.title: Boogeyman 2
programme.desc: A killer terrorizes patients at a mental institution where a woman (Danielle Savre) tries to cure her fear of the boogeyman.

programme.title: Boogeyman 3
programme.desc: An evil entity terrorizes a student (Erin Cahill) and her friends on a college campus.

programme.title: The Lazarus Effect
programme.desc: Medical researcher Frank (Mark Duplass), his fiancée Zoe (Olivia Wilde) and their team have achieved the impossible: they have found a way to revive the dead. After a successful, but unsanctioned, experiment on a lifeless animal, they are ready to make their work public. However, when their dean learns what they've done, he shuts them down. Zoe is killed during an attempt to recreate the experiment, leading Frank to test the process on her. Zoe is revived -- but something evil is within her.

programme.title: Burning Blue
programme.desc: An investigation into a series of fatal accidents leads to the exposure of a clandestine affair between two Navy pilots (Trent Ford, Rob Mayes).

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: This remake of the classic horror film is set in San Francisco. Matthew Bennell assumes that when a friend complains of her husband's strange mood, it's a marital issue. However, he begins to worry as more people report similar observations. His concern is confirmed when writer Jack Bellicec and his wife discover a mutated corpse. Besieged by an invisible enemy, Bennell must work quickly before the city is consumed.

programme.title: Masters of the Universe
programme.desc: When the evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) finds a mysterious power called the Cosmic Key, he becomes nearly invincible. However, courageous warrior He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) locates inventor Gwildor (Billy Barty), who created the Key and has another version of it. During a battle, one of the Keys is transported to Earth, where it is found by teenagers Julie (Courteney Cox) and Kevin (Robert Duncan McNeill). Now both He-Man and Skeletor's forces arrive on Earth searching for the potent weapon.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist.

programme.title: D.O.A.: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Four beautiful rivals at an invitation-only martial-arts tournament join forces against a sinister threat. Princess Kasumi (Devon Aoki) is an aristocratic warrior trained by martial-arts masters. Tina Armstrong (Jaime Pressly) is a wrestling superstar. Helena Douglas (Sarah Carter) is an athlete with a tragic past. Christie Allen (Holly Valance) earns her keep as a thief and an assassin-for-hire.

programme.title: Blindsided
programme.desc: A killer (Michael Keaton) terrorizes a blind woman (Michelle Monaghan) in her New York penthouse after murdering her boyfriend.

programme.title: Backtrack
programme.desc: While fixing a flat tire, artist Anne Benton (Jodie Foster) sees a mob killing. She reports the murder to the local police, but they are unable to protect her from Mafia don Lino Avoca (Vincent Price), who orders hitman Milo (Dennis Hopper) to track her down and kill her. Anne changes her identity, moves to Seattle and builds a new life, while Milo, preparing for his mission, becomes increasingly obsessed with her. When he finally finds Anne, Milo needs to decide what his next move will be.

programme.desc: In 1892 Lizzie Borden lives a quiet life in Massachusetts under the strict rules established by her father. Lizzie finds a kindred spirit in the live-in maid, Bridget, and friendship soon blossoms into a secret romance. But tension mounts in the Borden household, leading to a violent breaking point.

When he finally finds Anne, Milo needs to decide what his next move will be.
