programme.title: Sprinter Galore
programme.desc: The good-hearted Sprinter Galore is back at his home planet, battling evil villains bent.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn't take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn't give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow's nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown's face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS - ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What's that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown's face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS - ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What's that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: Kung Fu Yoga
programme.desc: Jack (Jackie Chan), a world-renowned archaeology professor, and his team are on a grand quest to locate a lost ancient Indian treasure when they are ambushed by a team of mercenaries and left for dead. Using his vast knowledge of history and kung fu, Jack leads his team on a race around the world to beat the mercenaries to the treasure and save an ancient culture.

programme.title: The DUFF
programme.desc: Frumpy high-school senior Bianca (Mae Whitman) has a rude awakening when she learns that her classmates secretly know her as the DUFF -- designated ugly fat friend -- to her prettier and more popular pals. Desperate to reinvent herself, Bianca enlists the aid of Wesley (Robbie Amell), a charming jock. In order to save her senior year from becoming a complete disaster, Bianca must find the confidence to overthrow a judgmental student (Bella Thorne) and revolutionize the school's social order.

programme.title: UHF
programme.desc: After losing yet another job, George (Weird Al Yankovic) wonders if there is any career that can handle his outrageous personality. When George's uncle (Stanley Brock) hands him the deed to a local TV station, George creates a series of television shows based on social satire and hyperactive humor, with the help of his best friend, Bob (David Bowe). However, a rival station's bitter CEO (Kevin McCarthy) tries to destroy George's wacky programming, forcing him to fight back.

programme.title: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: The Clampetts, home for Christmas, help Cousin Pearl woo Mr. Brewster, the big oil company executive.

programme.title: The Darlings Are Coming
programme.desc: Andy unexpectedly has his hands full as The Darlings, a family of musicians from the mountains, arrive in Mayberry to meet a bus due the next day.

programme.title: Andy's English Valet
programme.desc: Malcolm Merriweather, an English tourist, passes by Mayberry on a bicycle; after causing a traffic accident, he agrees to work off the damages as Andy's personal valet.

programme.title: Barney's First Car
programme.desc: Barney spends his life savings to buy a used car. Unbeknownst to him, the car is actually a lemon and has several issues and defects.

programme.title: Legally Blondes
programme.desc: British twin sisters (Milly Rosso, Becky Rosso) experience culture shock when they attend school in California.

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
programme.desc: Mother Nature (Saoirse Ronan) loves to cause mischief, and she steps in to help two love-starved souls find happiness. She helps an aging professional woman (Michelle Pfeiffer) who has no luck with love find her match with a much younger man (Paul Rudd). As their relationship blossoms into something beyond physical attraction, her adolescent daughter (Tracey Ullman) begins to question the tingling sensations she experiences whenever she is in the company of a handsome local boy.

programme.title: The Longshots
programme.desc: Curtis Plummer (Ice Cube), a down-on-his-luck former football player, becomes the new coach of the Minden, Illinois, Pop Warner football team. With his niece Jasmine (Keke Palmer) installed as the team's quarterback and secret weapon, Curtis has a chance to turn his life around, while the residents of Minden have a chance to recapture their team spirit and civic pride.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Tough Love
programme.desc: Madea gets herself into outrageous situations while helping children save their youth center.

programme.title: Madhouse
programme.desc: Mark (John Larroquette) and Jessie (Kirstie Alley) get blindsided by an unexpected visit from Mark's cousin, Fred (John Diehl), and his pregnant wife, Bernice (Jessica Lundy). The family reunion is suddenly extended from five days to six months after an accident renders Bernice bedridden, and Mark and Jessie's life is slowly turned upside down by a seemingly never-ending stream of house guests, including Jessie's neurotic sister (Alison La Placa) and her obnoxious son (Bradley Gregg).

programme.title: Return to Green Acres
programme.desc: Cast members from the original TV series are reunited when Oliver tries to save Hooterville from greedy developers.

programme.title: Gabriel Iglesias: Hot and Fluffy
programme.desc: Filmed at the Fox Theater in Bakersfield, California the comedian and well-known favorite to television viewers as being on "Last Comic Standing," performs impressions and silly voices.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Bob Ho (Jackie Chan), an undercover operative for the CIA, decides to give up his career and marry his girlfriend, Gillian (Amber Valletta). First however, he has one more mission to complete: Gain the approval of Gillian's children. Bob volunteers to baby-sit when Gillian is called away, but the operation hits a snag when one of the kids mistakenly downloads a top-secret formula, and a Russian terrorist takes aim at Bob's prospective family.

programme.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
programme.desc: In this musical comedy, Valerie is dealing with her philandering fiancé, Ted, when she finds that a trio of aliens have crashed their spaceship into her swimming pool. Once the furry beings are shaved at her girlfriend's salon, the women discover three handsome men underneath. After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in the 1980s Los Angeles.

programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven
programme.desc: In this animated feature, canine casino owner Charlie (Burt Reynolds) is killed by gambler Carface (Vic Tayback), but returns to Earth from heaven thanks to the powers of a magical, rewindable watch. Charlie sets out to take his revenge on Carface by means of an elaborate plan that involves an orphan girl, Anne-Marie. But as the plan progresses, Charlie discovers that Anne-Marie is being exploited by Carface. Charlie must decide whether to change his mission from one of revenge to one of rescue.

programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven 2
programme.desc: In this animated film, Charlie Barkin (Charlie Sheen) is finding life in dog heaven a little dull. Even after his best pal, Itchy (Dom DeLuise), arrives in town, Charlie still longs to go back to Earth. When Charlie's old nemesis, Carface (Ernest Borgnine), steals the horn used by the archangel Gabriel, Charlie and Itchy quickly volunteer to retrieve it. programme.desc: A man trying to board a flight is stopped by staff when they observed apparent signs of intoxication.

programme.title: Will I Be Accepted?

programme.title: Savage Family Murder

programme.title: Nicole White
programme.desc: When young mother Nicole White met Jonathan Harris online, he seemed like her ideal rugged man. CCTV from their second date at Jeepers Bar showed a great start, but Harris's mood changed. They drove off in Nicole's car, but she never made it home.

programme.title: Killer Gambit
programme.desc: Vince is a seasoned New Orleans sportscaster, and his marriage to the much younger Liz looks like a second chance for them both. When Liz is shot point blank in the face, police pursue a notorious vagrant who fits the witness's description. But the more police dig into this murder, the game appears to be bigamy, and all the rules are off the table.

programme.title: Notting Hill Horror (part 2)
programme.desc: John Christie kills at least eight women during the 1940s and 1950s, including his wife; he eluded capture for many years.

programme.title: The Brighton Trunk Murders
programme.desc: On a hot summers day in 1934, a horrifying discovery was made in a trunk at the left luggage office of Brighton Train Station.

programme.title: The Blood From the Vine
programme.desc: On September 2nd 2015, the body of two year-old Méline is found in her home; her father confesses to the murder.

programme.title: Rachel and Diane Staudte
programme.desc: This episode examines the notorious "Antifreeze Murders" that took place in 2012. Diane and Rachel Staudte murdered two members of their family and attempted to kill a third before police got involved.

programme.title: Dangerous Drivers 2

programme.title: Body Overboard
programme.desc: A woman's husband reports her falling overboard into Lake Erie, but police don't buy his story.

programme.title: The Ramsey Street Rapist

programme.title: San Bernardino Bodies
programme.desc: A woman is shocked to learn her DNA helped detectives identify a Jane Doe that remained a mystery for decades.

programme.title: Body of Evidence

programme.title: Deadly Games

programme.title: Saints and Sinners
programme.desc: A wicked church minister, and a teacher falls for a student.

programme.title: Steamy Lessons

programme.title: Woman with a Gun

programme.title: Backdoor Bust

programme.desc: The 20-year arms dealing career of Queens, N.Y., outcast Yuri Orlov (Nicolas Cage) serves as a window onto the end of the Cold War and the emergence of worldwide terrorism. He finds himself reassuring his more ethically challenged younger brother, Vitaly (Jared Leto), while adeptly sidestepping the pursuit of federal agent Jack Lawrence (Ethan Hawke). The globetrotting arms dealer also pursues the woman of his dreams, supermodel Ava Fontaine (Bridget Moynahan).

programme.title: The Bling Ring
programme.desc: A teenager (Israel Broussard) and his gang of fame-obsessed youths (Katie Chang, Taissa Farmiga) use the Internet to track the whereabouts of celebrities, then rob their homes.

programme.title: Priscilla
programme.desc: When teenage Priscilla Beaulieu meets Elvis Presley at a party, the man who is already a meteoric rock 'n' roll superstar becomes someone entirely unexpected in private moments: a thrilling crush, an ally in loneliness, a vulnerable best friend.

programme.title: Stand Up Guys
programme.desc: After serving 28 years in prison for accidentally killing the son of a crime boss, newly paroled gangster Val (Al Pacino) reunites with his former partners in crime, Doc (Christopher Walken) and Hirsch (Alan Arkin), for a night on the town. As the three men revisit old haunts, reflect on their glory days and try to make up for lost time, one wrestles with a terrible quandary: Doc has orders to kill Val, and time is running out for him to figure out a way out of his dilemma.

programme.title: Coi Leray
programme.desc: Hosts debate sneaker culture, rate weekly drops, and talk style with star guests.

programme.title: Earl Sweatshirt & The Alchemist
programme.desc: Today's biggest stars reveal their all-time favorites and answer fans' most-asked questions.

programme.title: Omar Apollo
programme.desc: Omar and his brother Quique talk about musical inspiration and growing up first-generation Mexican American while they make their mom's famous recipe for El Super Taco.

programme.title: The Notorious B.I.G.: Legend
programme.desc: Explores the rise of American rapper The Notorious B.I.G., from Brooklyn youth to King of New York.

programme.title: Kid Cudi & Tony Hawk
programme.desc: Today's biggest stars reveal their all-time favorites and answer fans' most-asked questions.

programme.title: Shaq & Myles O'Neal
programme.desc: Today's biggest stars reveal their all-time favorites and answer fans' most-asked questions.

programme.title: Idris Elba & John Cena
programme.desc: Today's biggest stars reveal their all-time favorites and answer fans' most-asked questions.

programme.title: Tupac Shakur: Before I Wake
programme.desc: Hip-hop pioneer Tupac Shakur during the final year of his life.

programme.title: Only God Forgives
programme.desc: In Thailand, a drug trafficker's (Ryan Gosling) icy mother (Kristin Scott Thomas) sends him on a mission to avenge his older brother, who was killed for beating an underage prostitute to death.

programme.title: Derailed
programme.desc: Temptation and a difficult home life leave Charles (Clive Owen) open to an affair with Lucinda (Jennifer Aniston), whom he meets during his commute. Both are married with children, and it isn't long before they are together in a sleazy motel. However, a thug named LaRoche (Vincent Cassel) bursts into the room and attacks them, and they can't report it without their families discovering the affair. As if the violation wasn't enough, LaRoche then calls Charles to blackmail him.

programme.title: City of Lies
programme.desc: Los Angeles Police Department detective Russell Poole has spent years trying to solve his biggest case -- the murders of The Notorious B.I.G. and Tupac Shakur -- but after two decades, the investigation remains open. Jack Jackson, a reporter desperate to save his reputation and career, is determined to find out why. In search of the truth, the two team up and unravel a growing web of institutional corruption and lies.

programme.title: Escobar: Paradise Lost
programme.desc: When a young surfer (Josh Hutcherson) begins a relationship with the niece of drug kingpin Pablo Escobar (Benicio del Toro), he finds his life on the line after being pulled into the dangerous world of the Escobar family business.

programme.title: Never Back Down
programme.desc: Jake (Sean Faris) moves to Orlando, Fla., with his mother (Leslie Hope) and brother (Wyatt Smith). He feels like an outsider in his new school and frequently lets his temper flare out of control. But Jake wants to fit in, and he decides to go to a party with his classmate Baja (Amber Heard). There, Jake is pushed into a fight and humiliated. Another classmate (Evan Peters) sees what happened, and encourages Jake to visit martial arts trainer Jean Roqua (Djimon Hounsou).

programme.title: Righteous Kill
programme.desc: Detectives Thomas Cowan (Robert De Niro) and David Fisk (Al Pacino), 30-year veterans of the NYPD, investigate the murder of a pimp. The crime resembles a case they solved many years earlier. As the body count rises, they realize they're dealing with a vigilante taking over when the police fail. The similarities between past and present crimes leads the detectives to wonder if they put the wrong man behind bars.

programme.title: The Boondock Saints
programme.desc: Tired of the crime overrunning the streets of Boston, Irish Catholic twin brothers Conner (Sean Patrick Flanery) and Murphy (Norman Reedus) are inspired by their faith to cleanse their hometown of evil with their own brand of zealous vigilante justice. As they hunt down and kill one notorious gangster after another, they become controversial folk heroes in the community. But Paul Smecker (Willem Dafoe), an eccentric FBI agent, is fast closing in on their blood-soaked trail.

programme.title: American Heist
programme.desc: Within 24 hours of being released from a 10-year sentence, Frankie (Adrien Brody) threatens to drag his brother James (Hayden Christensen) back into the criminal underworld that nearly swallowed them both years before.

programme.title: How to Make Money Selling Drugs
programme.desc: Eminem, 50 Cent, Susan Sarandon and others appear in a satirical course for aspiring drug dealers on how to maximize profits and evade prison.

programme.title: Billie Eilish & Quenlin Blackwell
programme.desc: Today's biggest stars reveal their all-time favorites and answer fans' most-asked questions.

programme.title: The LeBron James Interview
programme.desc: LeBron clears up the lying accusations, where he stands with Drake, and much more.

programme.desc: Join Joe La Puma as he takes artists, athletes, and icons to the best sneaker stores across the U.S.

programme.title: Tupac Assassination: Battle for Compton
programme.desc: The unsolved murders of Tupac Shakur and Christopher "Biggie Smalls" Wallace still stir the public's imagination after 20 years.

programme.title: The Products of the American Ghetto
programme.desc: A young boy resorts to joining the drug game to help his mom and take care of his siblings.

programme.title: Lucky Number Slevin
programme.desc: A case of mistaken identity puts a man named Slevin (Josh Hartnett) in the middle of a war between two rival New York crime lords: The Rabbi (Ben Kingsley) and the Boss (Morgan Freeman). While under the watchful eyes of Detective Brikowski (Stanley Tucci) and well-known assassin Goodkat (Bruce Willis), Slevin must quickly devise a plan to save his skin before his luck runs out.

programme.title: The Substitute
programme.desc: Inner-city Miami schoolteacher Jane Hetzko gets her knee broken when she stands up to the school's gang leader, Juan Lacas. Her boyfriend, mercenary combat specialist Jonathan Shale, goes undercover as a substitute teacher to take down the punk, but soon discovers that Lacas is merely an underling for the real criminal mastermind. Assembling the team from his last jungle raid, led by his right-hand man, Joey Six, Shale declares war.

programme.title: The Substitute 2: School's Out
programme.desc: A mercenary with a chip on his shoulder, Karl Thomasson poses as a teacher at an inner-city school to exact revenge on the gang members who murdered his brother. As Thomasson investigates the killing and tries to keep his estranged niece, Anya, safe, he begins to realize how dysfunctional and violent the urban school environment has become. Even with support from fellow soldier Joey Six, Thomasson is seriously outnumbered as he seeks vengeance.

programme.title: Return of the Black Queen
programme.desc: Harry is secretly thrilled when he hears Sandra is back in town, however, their initial meeting doesn't go well when they aren't capable of confessing their love.

programme.title: Do You Read Me...?
programme.desc: Incapacitated by an injured foot, a bored Stevie has become addicted to the two-way radio, which causes her to get involved in with a mystery man. Meanwhile, Sandra offers Kate a farm manager's job.

programme.title: Taking Care of Business
programme.desc: The women of Drovers Run are no longer a team of four. Kate is now working with Sandra as an overseer at Kinsella's. Jodi has gone into business for herself, selling cosmetics, and the work is tough.

programme.title: Old Flames
programme.desc: When Kate organises a reunion of the high school hiking club, she isn't prepared for the old feelings it's about to stir up. For Jodi, the reunion is fraught with tension as she faces her old rival, Natalie, and she ends up introducing Luke as the local mechanic, rather than as her boyfriend.

programme.title: Body Blows
programme.desc: When Harry suffers a stroke, he reconsiders his plans for Killarney and he makes it clear that he favours Nick over Alex.

programme.title: Sins of the Father
programme.desc: Nick discovers that Harry's heart condition could be quite serious and he goes into denial. Helping Tess with the hay, he works recklessly and has a frightful accident with the hay bales.

programme.title: Boy Made Good
programme.desc: Will Hamilton, an old boyfriend from Stevie's school days in Broken Hill shows up at Drovers Run. He is also the father of Rose, a daughter he has no idea exists. Will is at first shocked to learn he is a father but delights Stevie by wanting to know all about their daughter.

programme.title: The Pearl
programme.desc: In trouble again, Luke promises a concerned Jodi that he will extricate himself from the criminal's grasp, but his problems only escalate. Stevie urges Jodi to distance herself from Luke, but Jodi needs to give him one final chance. She rushes to the truck stop and is shattered to discover drugs hidden in Luke's wardrobe.

programme.title: The Prodigal Daughter
programme.desc: Tess's other cousin, Regan, visits Drovers Run and causes a few problems. Ultimately, Stevie must rely on Regan's help to escape a life-threatening farm accident and Regan must face her fears to save Stevie.

programme.title: Love and Obsession
programme.desc: Dave and Regan's flirtation steps up a level when Dave offers to help cure her of her animal phobia. As they fall for each other, Kate realises Regan has a secret she'll do anything to protect.

programme.title: One Long, Long Day
programme.desc: Tess learns Nick has been offered a job in Argentina and she makes the difficult decision that they will go overseas for six months. Meanwhile, Stevie takes care of Charlotte for the afternoon, but when the child goes missing, she turns Drovers Run upside down to find her. As Dave and Regan's romance blossoms, Kate is devastated.

programme.title: Down to Earth
programme.desc: Things are in a state of flux, if not panic, with the imminent departure of Tess and Nick. Stevie is now in charge, and she decides Kate and Jodi need to sort out who's going to take on her old overseer's job.

programme.title: Heart of Gold
programme.desc: When Regan starts the process to mine Drovers Run, the other women put up a fight and vow to stop her.

programme.title: Taking Flight
programme.desc: Today is Harry's birthday and he's in a foul mood. Alex is stuck giving Sandra a lift to Gungellan so that she can get to an appointment. Kate tries to avoid Dave during a birdcall competition, but he makes it difficult.

programme.title: Make Believe
programme.desc: Kate's grandmother comes for a visit and Kate is in hot water because her grandmother believes that she's engaged to Dave and she runs Drovers Run.

programme.title: Heaven and Earth
programme.desc: Harry buys the truck stop and appoints Moira as manager, leaving Terry as a lowly mechanic. The approach of a raging dust storm adds to the troubles at Drovers Run and Stevie struggles to save the life of Tess's horse Oscar.

programme.title: Moonstruck
programme.desc: Stevie borrows a water pump but leaves without the right hose when she learns that Alex won't be taking her to the ball. The wrong hose causes a tank to fill with toxic gas, and Alex shows up to help, but he is overcome by the fumes.

programme.title: If You Build It...
programme.desc: Stevie locks horns with Sandra during a drought but later helps her through a personal crisis, which temporarily eases tensions between them.

programme.title: Out of Time
programme.desc: Stevie thrilled at the prospect of a visit from Rose but things sour when Stevie's sister Michelle arrives with her. Protective of her adopted daughter, Michelle doesn't want the usually rash Stevie to take matters into her own hands and tell Rose the truth about who her real mother is.

programme.title: Betwixt and Between
programme.desc: Caught off guard when Rose discovers a baby's hospital bracelet, Stevie tells a half-truth: she did have a baby, but she put it up for adoption. Rose finds out the whole truth and takes off in the ute, accidentally reversing into the cattle yard gates.

programme.title: Truth or Dare
programme.desc: Patrick, Dave's adventurer brother literally parachutes onto Drovers Run and ensnares Kate's heart. In the wake of Patrick's appearance, Dave must deal with painful memories and a shocking family secret that's been hidden for years.

programme.title: The King and I
programme.desc: Jodi is on top of the world when she receives a birthday gift from the deceased Jack McLeod. Meanwhile, Dave begins training a new veterinary student. Alex wants to get out of doing an interview for local radio, which Harry has delegated to him.

programme.title: Intentions
programme.desc: Dave is forced to question his behaviour when his former student, Catriona, threatens him with a sexual harassment suit. Meanwhile, after confronting Meg about Jack's gift to her, Jodi feels that her whole life has been a lie.

programme.title: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: Meg agonises over Jodi's rejection of her, following the revelation that Jack McLeod is possibly her real father. Jodi reads her mother's novel, which is based on real life and details the mystery surrounding her birth.

programme.title: Twelve and A Half Hours Behind
programme.desc: When Tess returns home to Drovers Run, she discovers the exciting news that she's pregnant. Her joy is soon turned to grief, though, when a call comes from Argentina saying that the plane Nick was traveling on has been reported missing.

programme.title: Anniversary
programme.desc: Tess has been holed up in her room since the news of Nick's death, but she suddenly reappears, strong and composed. She throws herself back into work and declares she wants to hold a party to celebrate Nick's life.

programme.title: Body & Soul
programme.desc: Determined that the Ryan empire continues despite Nick's death, Harry quickly sets about organising his grandson's future, while Alex goes a.w.o.l after Nick's life celebration.

programme.title: New Beginnings
programme.desc: After a vivid dream, Stevie can no longer deny the love she has developed for Alex, but she struggles to tell him. Meanwhile, Harry pushes for his grandson to live near him, despite objections from Sandra, and Jodi gets the results of her DNA test

programme.title: Lost and Found
programme.desc: A week has passed since the fire and Alex's mysterious disappearance, but then he returns with his new fiancée and he unknowingly breaks Stevie's heart. Just when Tess is starting to get on top of things, she gets a call that sets her back: Nick's remains have been found.

programme.title: Truth Hurts
programme.desc: Alex and Fiona's engagement is publicly announced thanks to a meddling Harry. Meanwhile, a jealous Stevie, prompted by Dave, looks into Fiona's past and discovers something shocking. Meanwhile, Tess asks Jodi to move into the main house.

programme.title: Kiss of Death
programme.desc: Stevie is trying to deal with the fact that Alex may never be hers. She brings home a very young guy for the night, a move which ultimately endangers the land of Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Jodi comforts Rob and they are brought closer together when he reveals a secret.

programme.title: Luck Be A Lady
programme.desc: After the crop-dusting incident, Drovers has lost its contracts for organic produce and the women struggle to keep the bank from taking over. Trying to help, Stevie ends up gambling away Drover money.

programme.title: The Real McLeod
programme.desc: Jodi is stunned when Tess offers her half her share of Drovers Run. Tess feels that Jodi should have equity in the family heritage, as well as sharing their current debt. Leo, the pilot who dumped pesticide on Drovers Run, returns and tries to make Harry lift the black ban placed on him.

programme.title: The Calling
programme.desc: Kate falls and when Dave gives her a cursory examination, he notices a small sunspot on her back. After numerous attempts to convince her to see a doctor, Dave abducts Kate and drives her to the Gungellan GP.

programme.title: What Lies Beneath
programme.desc: Nick returns home to Drovers Run but is troubled by shadowy flashbacks of Argentina and his mugging. Meanwhile, Kate secretly goes to see a cancer specialist in the city, but Jodi figures out that something is going on and follows her.

programme.title: Where The Heart Is
programme.desc: Nick is anxious to start up the cattle breeding program he never had the chance to realise in Argentina. Tess and Stevie move Phoenix to a safer paddock, but another visit from the Brumbies leads to the discovery that she is already pregnant, no doubt to the brumby stallion.

programme.title: Deliver Us From Evil
programme.desc: Jodi risks her own life in an attempt to save Rob from the hitman that is hunting him, and with her courage, common sense and bushcraft, they survive the daylight risk. Meanwhile, Dave's brother Patrick returns with a truckload of "liberated" goats.

programme.title: The Big Commitment
programme.desc: When Patrick is blinded in a farming accident, he must rely on Kate for help. Stevie and Fiona take on a dodgy horse dealer, gaining a new-found respect for each other. Meanwhile, Meg and Terry adopt a new dream together.

programme.title: Biting the Bullet
programme.desc: When Regan returns to Drovers Run, she reveals a tragic secret. Though Tess has left, Jodi, Kate, and Stevie allow her to stay. Meanwhile, Fiona learns she is infertile but hides this information from Alex.

programme.title: Second Best
programme.desc: When Harry's stud ram is stolen, the Drovers Run women unmask an unlikely sheep rustler. Stevie ends up as Alex's backup best man in case Nick is not back from Argentina in time for the wedding.

programme.title: The Trouble With Harry
programme.desc: Jodi is driving back to Drovers Run when her phone rings. For a split second, she takes her eyes off the road and collides with a ute that Harry was driving. Meanwhile, the Japanese trade delegation visits to make an export deal with 'Gungellan Fresh'.

programme.title: The Legend of Harry Ryan
programme.desc: As he prepares for his father's funeral, Alex becomes obsessed with finding out why Harry had secreted away so many things. Stevie struggles to tell Alex that she argued with Harry on the day he died, and fears that it might have prompted the heart attack that killed him.

programme.title: Second Chances
programme.desc: Kevin returns unexpectedly and Jodi tells him the news about her real father. He isn't too surprised, though, and Jodi is later devastated to find he was just trying to access her inheritance money.

programme.title: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: The day before the big wedding has arrived and Stevie makes a shocking discovery that Fiona has been lying to Alex about being pregnant. Meanwhile, Kate decides to try on Fiona's dress and manages to stain it.

programme.title: The Life of Riley
programme.desc: After a group of brumbies are found shot dead, the girls of Drovers Run suspect a handsome stranger named Riley. Meanwhile, Sandra moves back into Killarney in hopes of carrying out Harry's legacy while Alex is absent

programme.title: Wild Horses
programme.desc: Stevie and Riley have gone into partnership to train the brumbies they saved from the national park, but they clash over techniques when they must have a horse ready for sale in one day. Meanwhile, Sandra and Fiona realise they're at a stalemate when they both secure damaging information about the other.

programme.title: The Great Temptation
programme.desc: Regan's horse-riding lessons have paid off. She is feeling confident in her ability and excited by the prospect of riding with the Drovers Cross Country team. After a mistake, Regan discovers that Drovers Run lost a contract to Sandra because she caused a paratyphoid outbreak in some cattle.

programme.title: Suspicious Minds
programme.desc: When evidence begins to mount against Stevie, Kate starts to believe that she could be the cause of Harry Ryan's death and must decide if she should go to the police with her suspicions. Meanwhile, Riley learns a local trainer abuses his horses and plans to do something about it.

programme.title: Days of Reckoning
programme.desc: Kate, who went to the police with her suspicions about Stevie's involvement in Harry's death, struggles to deal with the consequences of her actions. Alex returns from Argentina to find much has changed since he left, and he's got a lot to handle straight away.

programme.title: Scratch the Surface
programme.desc: The women of Drovers Run are determined to discover who killed Harry Ryan. When Leo returns to the district and locks horns with Stevie, she becomes convinced that he is the killer. Meanwhile, Alex discovers that Fiona has lied about her pregnancy.

programme.title: For Better Or Worse
programme.desc: Taking a short cut along the stock route, Moira is horrified when her petrol tanker has a dangerous fuel spill on Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Jodi and Kate struggle to make a decision about the future of the ranch given the possibility that Stevie may go to jail.

programme.title: The Eleventh Hour
programme.desc: Steve is busy trying to tie up loose ends before her trial begins, and Fiona joins the CFS in an attempt to show Alex how she can integrate herself into the town. When Alex and Riley are away from Killarney, doors all over the property are left open.

programme.title: Old Wrongs
programme.desc: Stevie's daughter, Rose, is coming to stay for a month, and it's the first time they've seen each other in two years. Stevie hopes to rebuild their relationship, but Rose is clear that she is only here for work experience.

programme.title: Handle With Care
programme.desc: Rose secretly begins seeing Leo, unaware of his history with Stevie. Meanwhile, Riley, Alex, Jodi and Kate take cattle along the stock route overnight.

programme.title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
programme.desc: After Rose and Stevie enthusiastically prepare dinner for Rose's "mystery man," the girls are horrified when they see whom the date turns out to be. Meanwhile, Kate wants to apply for the Young Farmer of the Year award but is crushed when she learns that Jodi has entered as well since Kate has never beaten Jodi at anything.

programme.title: One Perfect Day
programme.desc: Jodi has introduced Boer goats onto Drovers and wants to associate them with Gungellan Fresh. Phil Rakich is instantly opposed to the idea and bad mouths the animals, which causes tension with Riley.

programme.title: Winners & Losers
programme.desc: When Alex returns from the city with Fiona, Stevie fears he's changed his mind about leaving his wife. Meanwhile, Jodi and Patrick fight over who knows Kate the best.

programme.title: Damage Control
programme.desc: During a storm, Jodi wakes from a nightmare about fleeing from the hitman with Rob. Stevie wakes alone and full of remorse, while Alex wakes up in his ute, heartbroken after seeing Stevie with another man.

programme.title: Risk
programme.desc: After being offered a two-year research job in Africa, Dave tries to pretend he isn't interested. Meanwhile, Kate wins the Young Farmers Award but risks losing the man she loves when Patrick discovers he doesn't know Kate as well as he thought.

programme.title: Twenty Questions
programme.desc: After learning of Dave's plan to move to Africa, Kate realises she still has feelings for him. Meanwhile, Fiona turns up at Killarney claiming half of the furniture and sets the tone of the conflict by sawing the dining room table in half.

programme.title: Second Chances
programme.desc: It's shearing time at Drovers Run and Jodi is happy until her conflicted feelings for Rob recently returned (now going by his real name of Matt) and Riley rise to the surface.

programme.title: All The Wrong Places
programme.desc: Kate's romantic exit has stirred up some confusing emotions for Jodi who becomes obsessed with building a new dam on Drovers, with near tragic results.

programme.title: Digging Up The Past
programme.desc: Jodi is spooked by a mysterious vision and develops an angry rash on her wrists and ankles. Meanwhile, Tayler worries when Regan doesn't return on time but has her hands full caring for an injured possum with Patrick.

programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: Alex and Marcus come to blows over the future of Killarney, and Marcus reveals a secret that will change their lives forever. Meanwhile, Jodi is determined to help Riley make peace with his estranged father, Bill, when he visits Drovers Run.

programme.title: Reaching Out
programme.desc: Jodi questions her sanity when she is haunted by visions of her ancestor Emma McLeod and a murdered convict. Alex, angry that Marcus lied to him for so long, is doing his best to not deal with the fact that he and Marcus are brothers.

programme.title: Returned Favour
programme.desc: Jodi has her hands full with a major decision when both Riley and Matt declare their love for her. Meanwhile, Stevie may risk losing Alex again when she helps Marcus with a cattle deal.

programme.title: Of Hearts and Hunters
programme.desc: For Jodi and Matt, love is blossoming, and the world is looking remarkably sunny. Jodi suggests Matt move in permanently, and we find Matt making plans to ask Jodi to marry him, but Jodi faces a gut-wrenching decision when Matt is forced back into witness protection.

programme.title: Climb Every Mountain
programme.desc: Kate has a hard time coming to grips with her best friend's death and she decides to investigate the case of Jodi and Matt's murders herself. Meanwhile, Stevie has taken over a meeting that Jodi organised with Natural Resource Management and is determined to make her proud.

programme.title: Sisters are Doing It For Themselves
programme.desc: When Regan's sister Grace inherits part of Drovers Run from Jodi, Regan tries to reconcile with her. Stevie convinces Alex that they should keep their relationship a secret, but they quickly prove to be utterly hopeless at staying low-key.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Alex's plan to propose to Stevie goes horribly wrong when a series of accidents and disasters threaten to ruin their relationship. Meanwhile, Kate and Riley are caught in a game of theft and deception over stray cattle, as Moira finds herself on a date with Phil Rakich.

programme.title: Bloodlines
programme.desc: When sheep rustlers steal Drovers' breeding stock, Grace and Stevie take the law into their own hands. Meanwhile, Regan tries her best to convince her sister to make her stay on the ranch permanent.

programme.title: Warts and All
programme.desc: Stevie is not looking forward to being nothing more than "Mrs. Alex Ryan," and there are responsibilities that her new position brings. Bryce arrives for the engagement party, bearing an unwanted pre-nup.

programme.title: Conflicts of Interest
programme.desc: The girls fight to stop Drovers Run becoming the site of a toxic waste dump. Grace forces Regan to choose between her family and her rekindled relationship with her lover who is in charge of the site testing.

programme.title: Flesh and Stone
programme.desc: Grace kidnaps a government official to prevent the toxic dump from going ahead. Regan is also fighting to save Drovers Run, though her relationships with Grace and Lyle may reach a crisis point in the process.

programme.title: All's Fair In Love and War
programme.desc: Rose arrives at Drovers Run accompanied by Stevie's mother, Helen. Rose hoped to act as a peacemaker between the two, but instead, years of bitterness pour out.

programme.title: Ever After
programme.desc: On Alex and Stevie's long-awaited wedding day, things will run smoothly if the groom is able to get out of jail in time to make it to the altar. Meanwhile, Alex's sister Ashleigh attempts to ruin the wedding and take over Killarney.

programme.title: Grace Under Fire
programme.desc: While clashing with a rich new neighbour, Heath Barrett, Grace becomes convinced she's cursed Drovers Run when a series of bizarre plagues strike the farm. Meanwhile, while Alex is away on his honeymoon with Stevie, Ashleigh runs amok when she undermines Marcus' authority on Killarney.

programme.title: Gift Horse
programme.desc: ile desperately trying to resist Heath's charms, Grace questions her future on Drovers Run when she learns that her best friend has died.

programme.title: Hot Water
programme.desc: Grace may be making a deal with the devil when she accepts a secret loan from Ashleigh after the bank refuses credit to Drovers Run. Meanwhile, after Grace and Kate are taken hostage by a bankrupt farmer, Moira has a premonition that someone will get shot by the gunman.

programme.title: Leaving the Nest
programme.desc: Stevie returns from her honeymoon and plans to spend the summer with Rose before she starts university, but Rose has plans of her own which involve taking a year off to travel overseas. Meanwhile, Grace is forced to take desperate measures to repay Ashleigh, and Riley trains a new horse.

programme.title: Spark From Heaven
programme.desc: Rose returns from the hospital in a wheelchair and is involved in a freak car crash that may not have been an accident. Moira convinces the girls to do a naked rain dance, with unexpected results, and sceptic Phil gains a new respect for Moira's psychic gifts.

programme.desc: Incredible voices and unforgettable acts, these singers and instrumentalists truly hit the right notes.

programme.title: AGT’s Bizarre Acts
programme.desc: Expect the unexpected! Wild stunts and bizarre acts that push the limits of creativity and reality.

programme.title: Best of the Best on AGT
programme.desc: A roundup of the best AGT acts ever, unforgettable performances that defined the show's greatest moments.

programme.title: From Audition to Triumph

programme.title: Cozy Wintertime Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is a celebration of some of Lidia's favorite comfort foods. The combination of potaoes and pasta in one dish is not unusual in Italy and in her Pippette with Sweet Potatoes, Lidia adds a beloved American ingredient to give it a nutritious and complex finish. Veal Stew with Onion and Squash is the perfect one-pot meal, in which the protein and vegetables come together.

programme.title: A Perfect Weeknight Meal
programme.desc: Preparing a delicious and nutritious weeknight meal for the family is not always easy but Lidia shares some of her quickest and simplest recipes that willw ork in any kitchen. The menu includes: carrots and Apple Salad, Salmon Fillets with Prosecco served with Savory Potatoes and Apple Crumble- a dessert that can be made with almost any fruit.

programme.title: Jun Tanaka
programme.desc: Chef Jun Tanaka puts three home cooks through a series of culinary challenges, including how to make the perfect red wine sauce.

programme.title: Celebratory Food Traditions
programme.desc: Rutledge Wood and Damaris Philips find themselves in the unofficial Cajun capital of the south -- the French Louisiana region of Acadiana in Lafayette, Louisiana. Their first stop is Cafe Vermilionville for their New Orleans-inspired Crawfish 'Beignets' and Turtle Soup. Next, it's off to roadside stop Best Stop Boudin for their Boudin Blanc, Boudin Balls and fan-favorite Cracklins.

programme.title: Biloxi's Big Eats
programme.desc: In a city like Biloxi, Mississippi, it's a must to indulge in all the fresh seafood fished daily from the gulf so Damaris Philips and Rutledge Wood waste no time settling in. Their tour starts at local favorite seafood joint Hook with their fresh-caught fare like speckled trout smothered with a scratch-made Pass Christian sauce. On a visit to White Pillars, they feast on exceptional farm-to-table fare, chowing down on chicken-fried rabbit with black rice and grits.

programme.title: Pasta Pasta Pasta
programme.desc: Piled with pasta love: pork bolognese tortellini with cheese rose, soft ricotta gnudi in tomato sauce, creamy gorgonzola pasta with pancetta and charred veggies.

programme.title: Sweet Tooth Comfort
programme.desc: A sugar-fueled episode featuring candied-orange and caramelized white chocolate blondies with orange cream cheese icing.

programme.title: Street Food Comfort
programme.desc: From a Korean fried chicken "dog" with dual ketchups to buttermilkoniondipped drumsticks and popcornshrimp in wafflecone tacos - street eats done cozy.

programme.title: Potato Pizza
programme.desc: A dough made from potatoes, topped with mozzarella, tomatoes, extra virgin olive oil, oregano and grana padano; barley soup.

programme.title: Seafood Surprises
programme.desc: Artichokes with tuna, capers and hard-boiled eggs; grouper with potatoes and peppers; jam-filled mezzelune fritte.

programme.title: Veggies with V
programme.desc: Vanessa plans a vegetable-forward menu with a table to match! There's lentils and mushrooms, watermelon salad, a farro and squash wellington, Eton mess, and so much more!

programme.title: Cooking With Beef
programme.desc: Host Dez Daniels and Manitoba Beef Producers' Anna Borys make 4 delicious recipes: Flaky Pizza Roll with Sweet & Spicy Italian Beef Sausage, Ginger Beef Egg Rolls, Carne Asada Nachos, Pulled Beef Sliders with Mango Fennel Slaw.

programme.title: Budae Jjigae
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Budae Jjigae! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: The Rochester
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - The Rochester Garbage Plate! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Stuffed like a Pig
programme.desc: Portugal & South-West France: Visiting his boss's family farm, Tony helps slaughter and feast on a pig the family has been fattening all year. Then, Tony heads to France to experience the rich delights of a foie gras farm.

programme.title: My Hometown Favorites
programme.desc: New York, NY - Passionate about his city, Tony gives us an intimate tour of the New York City foods he loves - sturgeon and bagels, fluke ceviche, pan-seared foie gras, braised veal cheek, authentic cheese and, of course, a hotdog.

programme.title: How to be a Carioca
programme.desc: Brazil: What is Carioca? These natives of Rio de Janeiro are lovable scamps who somehow find ways to avoid work altogether, preferring the beach, flirting, and hanging out at restaurants and bars. Mr. Bourdain, under the tutelage of an exemplary Carioca, gives the lifestyle a try, enjoying a savage tan, Brazilian barbecue, and one too many Caipirinhas!

programme.title: The Lamb Show
programme.desc: Julia makes her classic Leg of Lamb Roast with Herbs and Mustard, and guest chef Moncef Meddeb serves Maine Lobster in Shallot Butter Sauce. Wine expert Richard Sanford of the Sanford Winery in Santa Ynez, California offers suitable wines.

programme.title: Deviled Rabbit
programme.desc: For a dinner honoring James Beard, the menu includes Kentucky Ham Puffs and Orange Souffle with Apricot Sauce. With chef Jean-Pierre Goyenvalle of Le Lion D'or in Washington, DC and Richard Maher of Beringer Vineyards in St. Helena, CA.

programme.title: Glasshouse Revisited
programme.desc: A few months on, there have been some departures from the Glass House. Who is in charge of the kitchen now? And, more importantly, is Ramsay's Caesar salad still on the menu?

programme.title: Family Food
programme.desc: Tom shares some of his family favorites inspired by simple food he enjoyed growing up that the family will absolutely love, including a flavorful omelette, a proper baked beans on toast, roast chicken, and an apple toffee crumble pie.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Huw grows native citrus fruits and collects industrial objects. Could ex-flight attendant Marianne or art lover Julie create a delicious dish to win his heart?

programme.title: Pozolillo with the Flack Family
programme.desc: With an aromatic broth of poblano and tomatillo, pozolillo is the perfect comfort food. Tessa utilizes a variety of fresh and unexpected ingredients in her version of this Mexican classic. But will it hold up to her mama's more traditional take?

programme.title: Jinhua Pork
programme.desc: Meiji Kinenkan is the oldest bridal hall in Japan undergoing an upgrade to celebrate its 50th anniversary. This includes the addition of a Chinese restaurant and its new grand chef.

programme.title: Yogurt
programme.desc: Iron Chef Chen stirs up his best yogurt presentation against Challenger Junichi Ito.

programme.title: Puff Pastry with Michel Richard
programme.desc: Michel Richard, author of Michel Richard's Home Cooking With a French Accent, prepares puff pastry, apricot pastries and torte Milanese.

programme.title: Chef Eric's Culinary Classroom
programme.desc: Join world-renowned Chef Eric Crowley for his first Masterclass video series inspiring you to feel confident in the kitchen with several spectacular dishes that are easy to create.

programme.title: Romanian Royal Court
programme.desc: The 90th Jubilee of King Michael I is being celebrated at the Romanian Royal Court.

programme.title: Artstetten Castle
programme.desc: Cuisine Royale has been invited to Artstetten Castle by the ancestors of the Habsburg Royal Family in Austria.

programme.title: Family Kitchen Revival 102
programme.desc: Meet Minna Waldeck whos son, Mikey, took his life several years ago. Its been an unimaginable journey including therapy at a horse ranch.

programme.title: Peeling Back The Layers Of Vidalia
programme.desc: Skye takes us back to Vidalia, GA, where she digs into oversized steaks and New York-style Italian food. Learn more about Vidalia's world-renowned sweet onions and the people who make up this south Georgia town.

programme.title: BBQ Bonanza
programme.desc: It's unlike any other cuisine. Something that is uniquely American. That's right, we're talking barbecue! Grab some napkins and put on that bib for this finger lickin' episode featuring ribs, brisket and traditional sides (collard greens, potato salad and baked beans).

programme.title: The Dish on Charlotte
programme.desc: Damaris Philips and Rutledge Wood get their southern food tour rolling in a growing city with an emerging food scene rooted in tradition -- Charlotte, North Carolina! Their first stop is at Brooks' Sandwich House -- a roadside shack that's remained in the family for 45 years -- famous for burgers smothered in their signature secret chili recipe.

programme.title: Scallion
programme.desc: The tiebreaker between Iron Chef Morimoto and Yamashita.

programme.title: Focaccia for Dessert with Craig Kominiak
programme.desc: Craig Kominiak, executive chef for New York's renowned Ecce Panis bakery, prepares bread loaves and focaccia.

programme.title: Japan, Italy, Guyana
programme.desc: Chef Devan shares recipes and stories from Christmas celebrations in Japan, Italy, and Guyana to help inspire your holiday feast.

programme.title: Lusk / Sydney, NSW, Australia
programme.desc: Our contributors are Mother and Daughter, Kate and Sarah Swetman. Sarah has been living in Sydney for 2 years now with her partner Aaron. We meet parents Noel and Kate in Lusk at the round tower, Dad Noel was born and raised in Lusk and he shows Catherine the old family home and farm and describes his early life in Lusk.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Gordon prepares a spectacular set of Christmas dishes that include his recipe for the ultimate turkey, superb stuffing, perfectly cooked vegetables and a stunning Christmas dessert. It's the Ultimate Christmas meal.

programme.title: Episode 23
programme.desc: Rosie lights up a party with her neon fireworks crate cake.

programme.title: Starring Olive Oil
programme.desc: Olive oil is an essential staple in every Italian home. It's the easiest way to add flavor to any soup, and Lidia shows you how when making Cannellini Bean and Lentil Soup. Olive oil is also used in desserts, and she makes Olive Oil Cake.

programme.title: Foraging Adventures
programme.desc: As a child, Lidia would forage for ingredients that were not produced in the courtyard, garden, or field. Ingredients that were foraged included asparagus, mushrooms, clams, and mussels, and this seasonal adventure was always extremely exciting. Lidia begins with a hearty Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu. She then gets on videochat with her grandson, Lorenzo, for an Asparagus Gratin Topped with Fried Egg. Her Clam Soup is perfect for a weeknight dinner!

programme.title: Grandma's Favorites
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia honors the Grandmothers of the family. She starts with a delicious and quick Skillet Gratin of Mushrooms and Chicken, one of her mother's favorites. As the chicken is cooking, she heads.to the side dish, Celery Potatoes and Tomatoes. Joing her at the end of the show is Lidia's granddaughter, Julia to taste Grandma Rosa's Apple cake.

programme.title: Heartwarming Comfort Foods
programme.desc: Who doesn't love comfort food? In this episode, Lidia shares some of her most requested and delicious comfort food recipes: Pasta and Bean Soup; Decadent ham in Marsala Sauce; and her italian version of one of America's favorites: Hamburger and Homemade Ketchup.

programme.title: The Industry of Food
programme.desc: Industrialization triggers the second great food revolution, transforming people's diets.

programme.title: Art in Harlem
programme.desc: Chez Lucienne and Gin Fizz are two intimate and convivial hot spots that greatly add to Harlem's mystique, as do Faction Art Projects and Artistic Noise, both of which have helped elevate Harlem's art scene to another level of success.

programme.title: Lady Lexis Sweets
programme.desc: Meet the mastermind behind Lady Lexis Sweets and the delicious treats found there, visit Ginny's Supper Club for an intimate conversation with Author Monica Rich Kosann and Journalist Tamron Hall, and experience the energy of Double Dutch.

programme.title: Pork Wellington
programme.desc: Julia Child tours a California vineyard to learn about fine wines. At dinner, her first course is Loin of Pork, Wellington, while her guest chef prepares Salmon Souffles. With Brooks Firestone and Rene Verdon.

programme.title: episode 8
programme.desc: In this final episode Rory prepares carrot, coconut and lemon grass soup followed by slow roast shoulder of lamb with aioli and salsa verde and rhubarb and strawberry trifle with almonds and pistachios to finish.

programme.title: episode 8
programme.desc: Moroccan harrira soup. Roast haddock with roast pepper, olive and basil salsa. Mashed potatoes with courgette, olive oil and marjoram. Romanesco. Chocolate, prune and armagnac puddings with chocolate sauce.

programme.title: A Moveable Feast with America's Favorite Chefs
programme.desc: Join Jose Andres, Lidia Bastianich, Rick Bayless, Chris Kimball, Ruth Reichl and Ming Tsai as each chef cooks up a single course, shares memorable stories and samples each other's dishes at a one-of-a-kind progressive dinner party.

programme.title: Onion Odyssey
programme.desc: Chef Dev prepares some of his favorite street food dishes from around the world that feature onions, including Seeni Sambol Buns from Sri Lanka, a Blooming Onion from the USA, and Scallion Pancakes from South Korea.

programme.title: Tuna Casserole
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Tuna Casserole! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Croque Madame
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Croque Madame! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Lifford/Maine & New Hampshire
programme.desc: In this episode, we first travel to Donegal to meet Ann to find out who is living away from home. Later Ann rustles up the dishes that remind James and Monica of home in Donegal, Snowballs and an Apple Pie. Catherine then travels to the US in hope to replicate Ann's dishes and bring a taste like home over to James and Monica.

programme.title: Johnny Gill and Lori Greiner
programme.desc: It's always great to have a little fun in the kitchen and Patti LaBelle gets that and more when singer Johnny Gill stops by to sing for his supper. A voice like that makes Patti whip up her "Oh So Delicious" sauteed jumbo garlic shrimp served with okra, corn and tomato stew over basmati rice. Then Patti has her own lobster fest in the kitchen with the lady known as Little Shark -- Lori Greiner from the million-dollar deal-making show Shark Tank.

programme.title: Robin Roberts and Joseph Sikora
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle makes a slow-cooked Southern meal for her good friend and morning show anchor Robin Roberts. She's treated to Patti's mouth-watering Corn Beef served with Fierce Fried Cabbage and rice with homemade gravy. Later, actor Joseph Sikora from the hit show Power gets his appetite satisfied with a tender T-bone steak and sauteed Brussels sprouts with turkey bacon served alongside garlic Yukon gold mashed potatoes.

programme.title: 50 Cent and Naturi Naughton
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle invites Grammy winner Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson over for some fresh and delicious comfort food. Dancing up a storm in the kitchen, they prepare a menu of Slow-Cooked Brisket, Smashed Potatoes and Patti's Southern-Style Fried Corn. Later, actress Naturi Naughton stops by for Patti's famous Succulent Scallops in Garlic Butter Sauce, and Miss Patti gives Naturi a cooking lesson that is "Over the Rainbow."

programme.title: Spice Blends
programme.desc: Spices were meant to be used in tandem, and our co-hosts Jasmin Ibrahim and Shahir Massoud will show you how! Cook along as they make a creamy, golden, Risotto Milanese, spiced not just with saffron, but with Ras el Hanout: a spice blend like no other! Next, a master class in spice blends and infusing them into oils, all topped off with some skewers of plump, juicy grilled shrimp. Finally, delicate Red Snapper is coated in aromatic Dukkah and served with a fresh Tomato and Chickpea Salad!

programme.title: Comfort + Spice
programme.desc: From Fettuccine Alfredo to Meatloaf, everyday recipes are enjoyed every day for a reason: we love them! Chefs Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim use spices to punch up these classic recipes. Meatloaf gets aromatic allspice, and is topped with bay leaf spiked ketchup. Fettuccine gets mustard; both the seed and the leafy green! Bacon and fried rice are ultimate comfort foods, but have you ever tried it with cardamom in the mix? Spice is the secret, a pinch of spice can make a world of difference!

programme.title: Northeast India
programme.desc: Gordon immerses himself in the life of a local tribe in Nagaland, visits Assam to enter a housewives' competition and sets up shop on the streets of Calcutta.

programme.title: Land, Sea & Air
programme.desc: Chefs Erica and Josh Karbelnik put their heads together to design a three-course menu, where each course must be based around either land, sea, or air! You have to "sea" it to believe it!

programme.title: Leo
programme.desc: Chef Siobhan is all in for Leo! She starts with a dish of quail and a sauce of honey, butter and Calvados for a fire-sign flambe! The next dish is one that's fit for a king (or queen): Siobhan's take on Clams Casino, covered in bacon and breadcrumbs! Next, a gigantic cast iron-seared, dry-aged rib steak, cooked to perfection and butter-basted, served alongside roast garlic and chili-spiked broccolini. Finally, a decadent orange-chocolate tart, with a gingersnap-hazelnut crust.

programme.title: Whole Hog
programme.desc: See what happens when 3 chefs turn leftover brisket into something unexpected.

programme.title: Shanghai
programme.desc: Discover the world through some of the most delicious and unusual dishes from countries like China, Morocco and Venezuela. In each episode, we will explore colourful local markets, discovering new flavours and regional produce. The ingredients we find will form the basis for some very special dishes that are simple to make at home.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Tonight Gordon joins Martine McCutcheon in her kitchen to help her prepare the perfect roast beef and Yorkshire pudding; while Janet Street Porter attempts to beat Gordon with her fig pudding.

programme.title: The Supply Chain
programme.desc: With every single bite or sip that people take, they participate in one of the most sophisticated journeys around the world ever taken; the global food supply chain is part of an $8 trillion network that produces over 4 billion tons of food annually.

programme.title: Boeuf Bourguignon (1971)
programme.desc: Julia Child shows you how to take advantage of beef specials -- turning them, with the addition of a little red wine, mushrooms and onions, into the most famous of all beef stews.

programme.title: Scipione Castle
programme.desc: Over the Po Plain, near Parma, lies the "Castello di Scipione". It is home to Count René, Countess Stefania von Holstein and their daughter Elisabeth.

programme.title: Skarhult Castle
programme.desc: Cuisine Royale gives a glimpse behind the scenes of the grand parties and dinners of the noble families of today.

programme.title: Casting The Net Wide On Tybee Island
programme.desc: Tybee Island is home to fun locals, a deep history, and, of course, seafood so delicious that it, alone, was enough reason for Skye to make a return trip.

programme.title: Game Time
programme.desc: It's game time on Food's Greatest Hits - so let's play ball! You want meaty, carby, salty, fatty, calorie-packed, unapologetically messy comfort foods...well, we're going to serve them up to you - Buffalo wings, submarine sandwiches, and a steaming bowl of chili.

programme.title: French Fridays
programme.desc: Prepare to feast on fantastic French cuisine on Xumo Free Food TV, as top chefs cook up culinary masterpieces right in your living room!

programme.title: Carrots
programme.desc: Carrots require a deep, light, stone free, fertile soil to do well. But if you get the soil right, you will be rewarded with a crunchy, sweet and flavoursome crop which will store well. Two or three well-timed sowings of carrots should see you self-sufficient all year round in this classic stockpot vegetable which is full of vitamins.

programme.title: Broccoli
programme.desc: Karen attempts to grow purple sprouting broccoli in a container, and travels to Hanako Flowers in West Cork; Michael gives a polytunnel masterclass.

programme.title: More Family Favorites
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia prepares three regional Italian dishes- from Piedmont to Tuscany to Emilia Romagna. Her colorful Peppers Piedmontese are a great addition to any antipasto or buffet table, her Malfada Michelangelo Style is a delicious pasta dish based on dish attributed to Michelangelo. lastly, she shares a Filet Mignon Italian Style with Balsamic Reduction using this liquid gold from the area of Modena.

programme.title: Dinnertime Soup Sandwhich
programme.desc: Lidia fell in love with the Soup and Sandwhich concept shortly after she arrived in America. And soups are one of her favorite creations to make. In this episode, she prepares a velvety Spinach and ChickpeaSoup; an Italian style Baked Toast Sandwhich and to finish, she enjoys some oatmeal crepes with her grandson Ethan.

programme.title: Going With the Grain
programme.desc: Frankie teaches you how to prep ingredients to make delicious, healthy meals for a fraction of the time and cost.

programme.title: Fancy Free
programme.desc: Going to the movies is expensive! Frankie shows us how to make a delicious TV dinner, popcorn, and dessert, for less than the cost of a movie ticket! Then, French food isn't all fancy and expensive. These classic peasant dishes are made with fresh affordable, ingredients for hearty meals big on flavor and light on your wallet.

programme.title: Brian McClintic, Ian Cauble & DLynn Proctor
programme.desc: Late night at Les Marchands in Santa Barbara, three sommeliers reunite to try to stump each other in an informal blind tasting.

programme.title: Comforting Family Faves
programme.desc: Nostalgia on a plate: moussaka crown, Italian herb roast halfchickens in sundriedtomato cream sauce, and velvety eggnog crème caramel.

programme.title: Street Food Comfort
programme.desc: From a Korean fried chicken "dog" with dual ketchups to buttermilkoniondipped drumsticks and popcornshrimp in wafflecone tacos - street eats done cozy.

programme.title: Retro TV Dinner Comfort
programme.desc: A modern nod to TV dinner nostalgia: Salisbury steak with gravy, Vichy peas, and a potato-cauliflower mash topped with Stilton cheese.

programme.title: Canadian Comfort
programme.desc: Spencer puts a Canadian spin on comfort: meat tourtière pies, Newfoundland-style figgy duff with mapleliqueur, and West Coast salmon rolls.

programme.title: Get to Know Your Grains
programme.desc: Cucumbers with whole wheat couscous; toasted grain soup; baked whole wheat penne and ceci beans.

programme.title: Autumn Feast
programme.desc: Vanessa plans an autumn-themed menu with a table to match! There's blood orange and broccolini salad, butternut squash mac 'n' cheese, cranberry-rosemary chicken thighs, sheet pan curried cauliflower, and so much more!

programme.title: Cooking With Beef
programme.desc: Host Dez Daniels and Manitoba Beef Producers' Anna Borys make 4 delicious recipes: Flaky Pizza Roll with Sweet & Spicy Italian Beef Sausage, Ginger Beef Egg Rolls, Carne Asada Nachos, Pulled Beef Sliders with Mango Fennel Slaw.

programme.title: Budae Jjigae
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Budae Jjigae! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Croque Madame
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Croque Madame! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Roscommon to Vancouver
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Roosky, Co. Roscommon to the McGowan's farm, first we meet Lisa's brother Ronan who gives Catherine a lift out to his mum Mary who is in the fields feeding the sheep. Mary as she tells us about how much she misses her only daughter Lisa who's been living abroad for over two years now and how much Lisa misses home cooked foods.

programme.title: No Beads, No Babes, No Bourbon Street
programme.desc: New Orleans, Louisiana: In New Orleans, Anthony Bourdain catches a Bayou alligator, cools off with a world famous sno cone, gets in trouble with the law, eats jambalaya with a dancing chef, and finally kicks back to enjoy some local jazz.

programme.title: Stuffed like a Pig
programme.desc: Portugal & South-West France: Visiting his boss's family farm, Tony helps slaughter and feast on a pig the family has been fattening all year. Then, Tony heads to France to experience the rich delights of a foie gras farm.

programme.title: Chef Shahir Moussaud
programme.desc: Things are heating up on Getting Grilled with Curtis Stone - an original video podcast show that will give you something to chew on. Join award-winning chef and the man behind one of the top-rated brands on HSN®.

programme.title: Walnut Tree Revisited
programme.desc: With its Michelin star in jeopardy, Ramsay's first job was to recruit a new head chef so the owner could concentrate on customers. But has Francesco managed to follow Ramsay's advice and stop meddling in the kitchen?

programme.title: Outdoor Food
programme.desc: We all enjoy eating outdoors in a beer garden, and Tom wants to show us how to create outdoor food properly. Chicken in a basket with a twist, a tasty fish burger, a delicious maple cake, extra special barbecued beef ribs... it is chow time.

programme.title: Food for Friends
programme.desc: Cooking for friends should not be time-consuming and should be a big hit with your friends. So, how do you accomplish this? Think: Sunday roast and a slow cooker, or mussels in ale. What about a hearty chorizo and chickpea stew?

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Melvyn arrives in Cambodia this week. Melvyn is first invited to dine with a privileged family. In their mansion, Melvyn feasts on one of the most unusual things he's ever experienced - ant's eggs!

programme.title: Far East Feast
programme.desc: Join our hosts Jason Park and George Wolf as Far East Feast takes you on a journey to find Asia's most unique, delicious and adventurous cuisine.

programme.title: Abalone
programme.desc: Iron Chef Morimoto battles with Challenger Tsuyoshi Kajimoto as they innovate with abalone, a shellfish.

programme.title: Blue Crab
programme.desc: The Iron Chef is called upon to face Miyoko Sakai, a famed Thai food critic who has had the privilege to learn the secrets of royal Thai cuisine straight from the source.

programme.title: Buttermilk White Bread and Salsa Quitza with Lora Brody
programme.desc: Lora Brody, an author, spokesperson, lecturer and cooking instructor, demonstrates bread machine breads, brie in brioche and quitza.

programme.title: Banana-Chocolate Beignets with Norman Love
programme.desc: Norman Love, corporate pastry chef of the Ritz-Carlton Hotel Company, prepares cake, espresso profiteroles and choux.

programme.title: Chef Eric's Culinary Classroom
programme.desc: Join world-renowned Chef Eric Crowley for his first Masterclass video series inspiring you to feel confident in the kitchen with several spectacular dishes that are easy to create.

programme.title: St. Emmeram Castle
programme.desc: St. Emmeram Castle lies in the Bavarian town of Regensburg. It is the largest inhabited Castle in Germany and home to one of the most established European nobles families: Thurn und Taxis.

programme.title: Castello di San Martino Alfieri (Piedmont, Italy)
programme.desc: The glorious Baroque castle, belonging to the sisters San Martino di Germano, lies in the picturesque Piedmont hillside, between Asti and Alba.

programme.title: Alpharetta On-Trend
programme.desc: From lobster pasta to poke donuts, Alpharetta has it all! See what makes this town worth another visit, then cook a classic sweet potato souffle with Skye.

programme.title: Carnival Eats
programme.desc: Bright lights, fast rides and great food, its carnival time! Just sit right back and enjoy the treats on Food's Greatest Hits: Carnival Eats...corn dogs, loaded fries and funnel cake.

programme.title: Celebratory Food Traditions
programme.desc: Rutledge Wood and Damaris Philips find themselves in the unofficial Cajun capital of the south -- the French Louisiana region of Acadiana in Lafayette, Louisiana. Their first stop is Cafe Vermilionville for their New Orleans-inspired Crawfish 'Beignets' and Turtle Soup. Next, it's off to roadside stop Best Stop Boudin for their Boudin Blanc, Boudin Balls and fan-favorite Cracklins.

programme.title: Get Crackin'!
programme.desc: In the funky food haven of Asheville, NC, Kimberly visits a couple of cracker makers who bake up small, handmade batches of crispy treats. Back home, she cooks up a sweet and savory feast featuring the underrated crunchy crisps, and David Barnes stops by.

programme.title: Trawlin' and Brawlin'
programme.desc: Austen finds it hard to bite his tongue when Shep feels attacked by the group; Naomie leans on her friends for support when Craig lashes out but finds Venita's allegiance is elsewhere.

programme.title: Wreck the Halls
programme.desc: Craig prepares for the gala; Shep reflects on his actions; Venita worries about her friendships; Austen and Olivia make strides in their relationship.

programme.title: Vows, Vendettas and Vibrators
programme.desc: The Charmers celebrate Madison's marriage to her Prince Charming, but everyone isn't in a festive mood; Austen comes face-to-face with multiple exes; Craig gets caught in the crossfire of an icy reunion between Shep and Taylor.

programme.title: Spilling the JT
programme.desc: The spotlight is on the aftermath of accusations spilled at Madison's wedding party, but attention quickly turns when newcomer JT vocalizes his suspicions about Austen and Taylor to Shep.

programme.title: He Said, She Said
programme.desc: The girls decide Taylor needs a good old-fashioned Southern soirée, swapping tales and spillin' tea; Shep kills the fun, however, when he delivers a scandalous rumor to Olivia's front door.

programme.title: In Vino Veritas
programme.desc: After Olivia hears what went down between Austen and Taylor, she's unsure how to move forward; Taylor brings the group together for her first big work event and more rumors bubble to the surface; Shep wastes no time confronting Austen.

programme.title: Party Fowl
programme.desc: Shep attempts to put the group's messiness aside and host a proper Southern dinner for his closest friends; when Olivia learns the truth from Taylor about what really happened with Austen, emotions boil over and Austen gets skewered.

programme.title: Family Bonds
programme.desc: The drama comes to a halt when a tragedy affects the Charmer's close circle, and they rally to support Olivia.

programme.title: The Naked Truth
programme.desc: Shep and Taylor try to move forward as friends, while Olivia and Rod's romance continues to blossom; when JT hosts an intimate dinner party, Southern etiquette is stripped away after Madison exposes Taylor's secret.

programme.title: Bra-gate

programme.title: The Correspondent

programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark (Michael Landon, Victor French) help a former dancer (Mokihana) overcome her bitterness at being disabled.

programme.title: Heaven Nose, Mister Smith

programme.title: The Whole Nine Yards

programme.title: Whose Trash Is It Anyway?

programme.title: Hello and Farewell - Part 2

programme.title: The Reunion

programme.title: The Squeaky Wheel

programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark investigate a gang of drug smugglers after an old friend of Mark's has disappeared.

programme.title: A Child of God
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark are on hand when a dying woman attempts a reconciliation with her estranged father.

programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark meet a child star whose fame is spoiling her rotten, destroying her family and taking away her childhood.

programme.title: Investment In Caring
programme.desc: Jonathan encourages residents in a neighborhood to unite against a cold-hearted developer.
