programme.title: Finals Fish
programme.desc: It's day two of the national finals, and the eight champions cook their fish courses. This year's challenge has been to produce dishes that are a lasting legacy to the New Elizabethan Age. They must showcase the transformation in British cuisine during the Queen's historic 64-year reign.

programme.title: Finals Main
programme.desc: It's main course day, the one course every chef wants to cook at the banquet. The chefs' dishes will be judged by Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton along with guest judge John Williams MBE, executive chef of The Ritz.

programme.title: Finals Dessert
programme.desc: It's the final day of the competition, and the last chance for the eight champions to get one of their dishes to the banquet for Queen Elizabeth II's Great Britons. Judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton will judge the dessert course and then decide on the banquet menu to be served at the Houses of Parliament. Joining them in the judging chamber is Grace Dent, restaurant critic, journalist and author.

programme.title: Banquet
programme.desc: The winning chefs arrive at the Palace of Westminster to cook for the Banquet of Great Britons. The chefs have been selected because their dishes showcase contemporary British cuisine and demonstrate the transformation in British food during the Queen's historic reign.

programme.title: London and South East Starter
programme.desc: The three chefs meet their surprise veteran judge and cook their starters. A dish celebrating childhood summer memories takes on a complicated courgette dish and a technically tricky take on the cucumber sandwich.

programme.title: London and South East Fish
programme.desc: The atmosphere in the kitchen gets even more intense as all the chefs take risks with their dishes. Mike Reid, executive chef at M Restaurants in London, shocks when he pairs his fish with some highly unusual flavours.

programme.title: London and South East Main
programme.desc: The kitchen is filled with smoke as the three chefs prepare their summer-themed mains. Selin Kiazim is in her element, preparing a feast inspired by the summer barbecues. Mike Reid uses wagyu beef. Tom Kemble uses juniper branches to smoke his meat.

programme.title: London and South East Dessert
programme.desc: All three chefs are feeling the pressure as they attempt their technical summer desserts. With only the two highest scorers going through to the regional final, who will be sent home?

programme.title: London and South East Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining London and the South East chefs must cook their entire taste of summer menus again. They're hoping to impress the formidable panel of Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and restaurateur Andi Oliver.

programme.title: South West Starter
programme.desc: The chefs have been challenged to create outstanding dishes that capture a 'taste of summer'. Their menus must reflect the tastes, smells and colours of everybody's favourite time of year.

programme.title: South West Fish
programme.desc: It's the fish course and, with a seafood specialist in the kitchen, the competition is stepping up a gear. Tom is hoping he'll be able to elevate the humble mackerel to the standards required for the Wimbledon banquet.

programme.title: South West Main
programme.desc: With a refined summer barbecue going up against a traditional Cornish speciality and a historic Wimbledon related recipe, who will come out on top? Andy Clatworthy is using his passion for historical cooking to reinvent a dish.

programme.title: South West Dessert
programme.desc: All three chefs are honouring Wimbledon and the British summer with their technically challenging strawberry desserts. Only the two highest scorers will go through to cook for the judges.

programme.title: South West Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs compete for a place in the national finals. To get there they'll have to impress the formidable panel of judges: Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and restaurateur Andi Oliver.

programme.title: North West Starter
programme.desc: Tom Parker is eager to impress with a salad that includes 10 elements. Meanwhile, Paul Askew, hopes his traditional techniques will triumph over his younger competitors, and Ellis Barrie is taking a risk with a creative cucumber and oyster starter.

programme.title: North West Fish
programme.desc: It is the fish course and the atmosphere in the kitchen gets even tenser as the three newcomers begin to understand the perfection and skill the veteran chef demands. Ellis Barrie attempts to create the flavour of a summer barbecue.

programme.title: North West Main
programme.desc: It is the main course and the pressure is intense in the kitchen. In the hope of impressing the veteran judge, Paul Askew is serving an extremely personal main course based on his mother's favourite food.

programme.title: North West Dessert
programme.desc: Dessert is the last chance for the chefs to secure a place cooking for the judges and the pressure in the kitchen is intense. Paul can't afford to make any mistakes and is pushing himself with a technically challenging baked Alaska.

programme.title: North West Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining north-west chefs must cook their entire taste of summer menus again. The guest judge is Greg Rusedski, former British number one, who understands the high standards expected at Wimbledon.

programme.title: North East Starter
programme.desc: Returning banquet champion Tommy Banks takes on two ambitious newcomers, Danny Parker and Josh Overington. They start by finding out who is the surprise veteran judge and who will be marking their dishes.

programme.title: North East Fish
programme.desc: The atmosphere in the kitchen gets even more heated, the three chefs are cooking their fish courses. Josh Overington creates a decadent dish inspired by the prestige of the Wimbledon Championships.

programme.title: North East Main
programme.desc: The chefs are cooking their main courses and are all taking risks to try and win a place at the banquet. Danny Parker is trying to recreate the flavours of an American barbecue, but the veteran chef is dubious about one of his ingredients.

programme.title: North East Dessert
programme.desc: Dessert is the last chance for the chefs to secure a place cooking for the judges and the pressure in the kitchen is intense. All the chefs are using unusual ingredients in their desserts.

programme.title: North East Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from the north-east must cook their entire taste of summer menus again. They're hoping to impress the formidable panel of judges Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort, Andi Oliver, and guest Judy Murray.

programme.title: Scotland Starter
programme.desc: It is the Scottish regional heats and returning chefs to the competition Michael Bremner and Ally McGrath battle ambitious newcomer Angela Malik for a place in the national finals. This time they are cooking their starters.

programme.title: Scotland Fish
programme.desc: The atmosphere in the kitchen gets even more heated and the veteran chef is expecting perfection from the fish course. Ally McGrath creates an inventive dish based on his summer memories of rock pooling in the River Tweed.

programme.title: Scotland Main
programme.desc: Angela Malik is in her element cooking a tiffin box based on memories of summer picnics. Michael Bremner is taking a huge risk, and Ally is creating an inventive dish based on a summer barbecue.

programme.title: Scotland Dessert
programme.desc: Dessert is the last chance for the chefs to secure a place cooking for the judges and the pressure in the kitchen is intense. Angela Malik is cooking a technically challenging dessert.

programme.title: Scotland Judging
programme.desc: The two Scottish chefs must cook their entire taste of summer menus again. They're hoping to impress the formidable panel of judges Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and Andi Oliver. They are joined by guest judge Gary Parsons.

programme.title: Wales Starter
programme.desc: Determined newcomers Paul Croasdale and Nick Brodie take on returning chef Phil Carmichael for a place in the national finals. It's Phil's third time in the competition and this year he's determined to make it to the banquet.

programme.title: Wales Fish
programme.desc: The pressure in the kitchen is high as the chefs prepare their fish courses. Paul Croasdale is trying to recreate the elegance of Wimbledon with luxury ingredients such as king crab and scallops.

programme.title: Wales Main
programme.desc: For the main course, all three chefs are cooking Welsh lamb in the hope of impressing the judge. Phil is taking a risk with barbecued lamb and in an attempt to elevate a humble barbecue to banquet level, he's serving it with many accompaniments.

programme.title: Wales Dessert
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the last chance for the chefs to secure a place cooking for the judges, so all three chefs are feeling the pressure. Phil Carmichael creates a tennis ball dessert that combines two British classics, Eton mess and trifle.

programme.title: Wales Judging
programme.desc: The two winning chefs from the Wales region must cook their entire taste of summer menus again. They're hoping to impress the formidable panel of judges and guest judge Dan Bloxham, Wimbledon's Master of Ceremonies.

programme.title: Central Starter
programme.desc: Pip Lacey's starter is a humorous take on the unpredictable British weather and features an unusual presentation. Ryan Simpson's dish represents an allotment complete with soil, while Nick Deverell-Smith's creation is a tribute to the precision cutting of Wimbledon's grass.

programme.title: Central Fish
programme.desc: With the chefs hoping to impress, they each take risks. Pip Lacey combines lobster with strawberry in a tribute to strawberries and cream. Ryan Simpson's also using lobster in his recreation of a BBQ and has invented a technique to create his chips.

programme.title: Central Main
programme.desc: Ryan Simpson hopes to elevate a ploughman's lunch into a gourmet affair, Pip Lacey pays tribute to an unusual Wimbledon icon, while Nick Deverell-Smith looks to celebrate a meat which he thinks is underused, venison.

programme.title: Central Dessert
programme.desc: Dessert is the last chance for the chefs to secure a place cooking for the judges. Pip Lacey's pineapple dessert uses coriander. Nick Deverell-Smith also pays tribute to the pineapple, creating a dessert featuring a rice pudding made with couscous.

programme.title: Central Judging
programme.desc: The two chefs who've made it through cook their four courses again. They must impress the formidable panel of judges Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort, Andi Oliver and guest judge Jordanne Whiley, one of Britain's most successful wheelchair tennis players.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Starter
programme.desc: The chefs meet their surprise veteran judge and cook their starters. Eddie is hoping to do better than last year, Joery is hoping to impress with a tribute to Richard Krajicek, and Tommy is creating a warm salad.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Fish
programme.desc: Joery Castel is combining mackerel and cucumber, and Tommy Heaney hopes his Murray Mound is a fitting tribute to Andy Murray's love of sushi. Eddie Attwell is creating five different strawberry elements to accompany the scallops in his dish.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Main
programme.desc: Tommy Heaney's BBQ dish is a surf and turf combination, Joey Castle's aiming to recreate a more American-style BBQ and Eddie Attwell's taking a risk with unusual meat.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Main
programme.desc: Tommy Heaney's BBQ dish is a surf and turf combination, Joey Castle's aiming to recreate a more American-style BBQ and Eddie Attwell's taking a risk with unusual meat.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Judging
programme.desc: The two chefs who have made it through cook their four courses again. They are hoping to impress the formidable panel of judges, Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and Andi Oliver, who are joined by tennis's greatest entertainer, Mansour Bahrami.

programme.title: Final Starter
programme.desc: With finals week ahead of them, judge Andi Oliver first summons the chefs to Wimbledon to have a look at where they could be cooking if they win. The judges are joined by guest judge Sue Barker, host of the Wimbledon coverage for more than 20 years.

programme.title: Final Fish
programme.desc: The chefs must cook their fish courses but with some exceptionally high scoring dishes in the regional heats, each chef will need to deliver perfection in order to see off the competition. The judges are joined by guest judge Tim Henman.

programme.title: Final Main
programme.desc: It is main course day and with only two spots remaining on the banquet menu, the competition is fierce. As the barbecues are fired up, all eight chefs are feeling the heat. The judges are joined by guest judge Gordon Reid.

programme.title: Final Dessert
programme.desc: It is dessert day and with just one place remaining at the Wimbledon banquet, each chef is giving everything they have got. The judges are joined by guest judge Annabel Croft, former British number one and Junior Wimbledon champion.

programme.title: Banquet
programme.desc: It's the grand finale and the winning chefs must now cook their dishes at the banquet. Once in the kitchen, the chefs face the huge challenge of scaling up their dishes.

programme.title: North East Starter
programme.desc: Competing for top spot are Danny Parker, head chef at Michelin starred 'House of Tides' in Newcastle, who is back to try his luck in the competition again after being knocked out in the regional heat last year following a tense tie-break. He's taking on two newcomers: Dan Fletcher, protégé of Phil Howard, and now head chef at 'Fenchurch' in the City of London, and David Coulson, who runs 'Peace and Loaf' in Newcastle, which boasts 2 AA rosettes.

programme.title: North East Fish
programme.desc: After a tense starter course the chefs are all aiming for 10s with their unique fish dishes. David is celebrating a personal connection to the brief with his `My Cod I Bet Me Ma'am Has Seen Some Trotters', a tribute to his mum who has worked as a chiropodist. Dan's `For All Those Sleepless Nights' pays tribute to night shift workers from the NHS with some bold but classic flavours while Danny's `Not All Superheroes Wear Capes' aims to give a taste of luxury to the hardworking staff.

programme.title: North East Main
programme.desc: Dan pays tribute to an icon of modern nursing, Florence Nightingale, while Danny is inspired by the founder of the NHS, Aneurin Bevan. David's dish is dedicated to the air ambulance staff who saved the life of his fiancé, and he even takes a trip to meet one of them.

programme.title: North East Dessert
programme.desc: It's the chefs' last chance to impress and tensions are high. Dan takes a risk with an unusual combination of ewe's milk and bergamot while Danny is determined to pull out all the stops with his complex dessert `Aunty Gwen's Chocolate'. David hopes to transform a childhood comfort classic into a show stopping dessert. Dan also takes a trip to meet Dr Ben Clarke who was working in the Royal London Hospital A&E during the London Bridge terror attack.

programme.title: North East Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining North East chefs must cook their four-course menus again, but will they take on board their veteran's advice as they serve their 'Feast To Say Thank You'?

programme.title: London South East Starter
programme.desc: Banquet champion Selin Kiazim, a rising star of the London scene renowned for her Turkish Cypriot fusion flavours, is back hoping to join the elite group of chefs who have made it to the banquet twice. She is up against James Cochran who's worked at some of London's toughest kitchens including 2 Michelin starred 'The Ledbury' and Scott Goss from 'The Twenty Six' in Tunbridge Wells, renowned for his use of local Kent ingredients.

programme.title: London South East Fish
programme.desc: The chefs do battle for the fish course and the atmosphere in the kitchen is tense. Lobster is catch of the day for James whose dish is Caribbean-inspired. Scott is attempting to elevate a classic fish pie, dedicated to his mum who worked as a pharmacist in the NHS for 23 years. And Selin is taking a risk with a complex three-part fish dish featuring sardines, scallops and langoustines, as a nod to the purported health benefits of a Mediterranean diet.

programme.title: London South East Main
programme.desc: Scott is showcasing rare-breed Tamworth pork to say thank you to the rare breed of people who work for the NHS. Selin is serving a complex duck dish using ingredients from all around the world to honour `Our Global NHS'. And James is presenting five cuts of goat cooked in five different ways, for his bold dish `Under The Knife'.

programme.title: London South East Dessert
programme.desc: Selin puts her own unique twist on tea and toast. James creates a decadent coconut parfait accompanied by mango purée filled doughnuts for his dessert 'Tree of Life' inspired by the coconut palm tree, the NHS and both of their contributions to our health. Scott hopes his elevated gypsy tart 'Honey Bee Good' will secure him a place in the final.

programme.title: London South East Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining London and the south-east chefs must cook their four-course menus again, but will they take on board their veteran's advice as they remake their 'Feast To Say Thank You'?

programme.title: Scotland Starter
programme.desc: Vying to be crowned champion of Scotland are three newcomers to the GBM kitchen. Lorna McNee is a former Scottish Chef of the Year and is renowned for her technical precision, gained from working at two-Michelin-starred restaurant 'Andrew Fairlie'.

programme.title: Scotland Fish
programme.desc: It is the fish course and the chefs are all out to impress. The heat is increased as all three serve their unique takes on lobster. Ross seeks victory with his dish 'Lobster Aid'. Lorna's 'Live Well, Live Very Well' features only three elements.

programme.title: Scotland Main
programme.desc: Ross is hoping to impress with 'Oh Deer It's Time For Your Penicillin', his tribute to Scottish scientist Alexander Fleming featuring an unusual yeast element as well as venison. Across the kitchen, Lorna, a former Game Chef of the Year, is also cooking venison in a bid to impress.

programme.title: Scotland Dessert
programme.desc: Ross is attempting to elevate a classic into a dish worthy of the banquet, Lorna is cooking a personal tribute to NHS staff using unusual yuzu and tonka bean flavours, and Ben is serving an experimental dish which includes a beeswax ice cream.

programme.title: Scotland Judging
programme.desc: It is judging day and the two remaining chefs must impress the panel of Oliver Peyton, Andi Oliver and Matthew Fort. Both chefs are gunning for success and are doing everything they can to deliver their menus to perfection.

programme.title: Central Starter
programme.desc: Three chefs compete in the heat for the central region. Returner Ryan Simson-Trotman, who failed to reach the national finals last year, is originally from Nuneaton and opened his own restaurant Orwells in the Oxfordshire countryside with his partner Liam, who is also a contestant in the North West region.

programme.title: Central Fish
programme.desc: It is the fish course and the chefs are pulling out all the stops. Marianne pays tribute to the `angels' in her local hospital who looked after her during a recent illness, and Ryan's dish is a reference to the purported health benefits of fish high in omega 3 oils, while Sabrina is inspired by her aunt, a retired nurse who used to take in food to share with her fellow workers during her shifts.

programme.title: Central Main
programme.desc: The chefs cook their mains and, following the previous day's results, tension is high. Both Marianne and Ryan are cooking muntjac in the hope of impressing the veteran judge, while Sabrina is making an ambitious technical take on a family feast.

programme.title: Central Dessert
programme.desc: With one dish left to impress the veteran judge, the chefs cook their desserts. Marianne is looking to raise a smile with her 'carry on' themed dessert, complete with surprise presentation. Sabrina hopes to make it through with an elevated take on jelly and ice cream while Ryan goes all out with his very sweet treat 'A Spoonful of Sugar'.

programme.title: Central Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining central region chefs do battle for a place in the national finals. They must impress the formidable panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton with their four-course menus.

programme.title: Wales Starter
programme.desc: Andrew is attempting to pay tribute to NHS staff with his take on a traditional healing recipe, 'Mum's Flu-Fighting Chicken Soup'. Jason's 'A Tea From The Heart' is a play on a post-war remedy which harks back to the era when the NHS was formed.

programme.title: Wales Fish
programme.desc: After the starter results, the chefs return to the kitchen hoping for high scores with their fish dishes. Chris once again is using ingredients he has foraged from around his restaurant, while Jason hopes to impress with a spicy scallop dish and Andrew prepares a cod dish with 11 different elements.

programme.title: Wales Main
programme.desc: The chefs are pulling out all the stops in a bid for big scores with their mains. All three dishes pay tribute to the founder of the NHS Aneurin Bevan, Chris's 'Everything But The Squeal' is an ambitious pork sharing platter, while Jason's 'For The Rich And The Poor' showcases lamb, and Andrew is hoping to impress with 'Aneurin Bevan For Better Steak'.

programme.title: Wales Dessert
programme.desc: It is the dessert course and the last opportunity for the chefs to impress. Chris is hoping to triumph with another dish which showcases the foraged ingredients available around his restaurant, while Jason attempts a technical feat in his dessert inspired by a childhood hospital stay and Andrew is inspired by a dish by his great-grandmother used to cook. Which two will make it through to the judging chamber?

programme.title: Wales Judging
programme.desc: It is the Wales regional final as the two remaining chefs do everything they can to impress the judging panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. After tensions ran high in the week, the chefs are under pressure to deliver perfection. The judges are joined by Aneira Thomas, the first baby born on the NHS, who is named in tribute to the service's founder Aneurin Bevan and who went on to dedicate her life to the service. Who will win a place in the national finals?

programme.title: South West Starter
programme.desc: It's the turn of three chefs representing the south-west, including two who have competed before but meet in the kitchen this week for the very first time. The chefs meet their surprise veteran judge and cook their celebratory starters.

programme.title: South West Fish
programme.desc: It's the fish course and with Tom renowned as a fish specialist all eyes are on him. He's cooking his take on a classic British fish supper in tribute to a charity which looks after the health of local fishermen. Jude is attempting a complex fusion dish featuring four different fish and an unusual X-Ray themed presentation, while Olivia is paying tribute to the staff who looked after her during the birth of her first son with her take on curried monkfish.

programme.title: South West Main
programme.desc: It's the main course and two of the chefs are hoping duck will win the day. Tom is preparing a technically challenging duck dish steeped in NHS history while Jude is making a multi-element Chinese duck dish inspired by his mum. Olivia is hoping her dish, using two unusual cuts of beef, will score top points. Olivia also visits her local children's hospital, home of the second-busiest paediatric A&E in the country.

programme.title: South West Dessert
programme.desc: With just one more chance to impress their veteran judge, the chefs are all hoping to use their pastry skills to deliver technically complex desserts. Tom's cooking an 'Invalid Fruit Tart' inspired by a 1950s recipe, while Jude is making six different apple elements for his 'An Apple A Day'. Olivia is using stout in reference to an outdated old wives' tale which suggested the drink was a healthy source of iron during pregnancy.

programme.title: South West Judging
programme.desc: It's time for the two remaining chefs representing the South West to go head-to-head as they cook their menus again for the exacting panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. With a spot in the National Finals at stake, both are aiming for perfection as they bid for glory. The judges are joined by Barbara Childs, a Matron in the Cardiac Intensive Care Unit at Great Ormond Street Hospital, who isn't afraid to speak her mind in the chamber.

programme.title: North West Starter
programme.desc: Three chefs take to the kitchen in a bid to represent the north-west in the national final. They include Ellis Barrie, from the award-winning Marram Grass in Anglesey, Liam Simpson-Trotman, an accomplished pastry chef and co-owner of the 4 AA rosette Orwell's in Oxfordshire, and Craig Sherrington, who sharpened his skills working under top names including Eric Chavot and is now Chef Patron of Virginia House in Cumbria.

programme.title: North West Fish
programme.desc: It's the fish course and the chefs are all gunning for tens. Craig pays tribute to a friend who has revolutionised hospital food in Morecambe Bay, while Liam is inspired by health advice his grandma gave him and Ellis is dedicating his dish to the staff who delivered his son Albert. With cod, mackerel, shrimp and cockles on the menu, which of the chefs will score highly?

programme.title: North West Main
programme.desc: Time for the chefs to cook their mains and the pressure is on. Craig is hoping to impress using two cuts of Dexter beef, while Liam prepares his take on a Bajan lamb stew and Ellis prepares four cuts of suckling pig. Liam meets his personal hero, Nola Ishmael OBE, who became the UK's first ever black Director of Nursing.

programme.title: North West Dessert
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the last chance for the North West chefs to impress in a bid to make it through to the regional final. Liam is cooking 'Not So Hot Toddy' in honour of a friend who works night shifts in the NHS, while Ellis' 'Worth Their Weight in Gold' is dedicated to the staff who saved his brother's life and Craig's dish 'The Missed Celebration' pays tribute to his wife with an unusual Christmas concept.

programme.title: North West Judging
programme.desc: The two highest scoring chefs from the week return to cook their menus again. Judging them are Matthew Fort, Oliver Peyton and Andi Oliver who are joined by Dr Jake Dunning MBE, an infectious disease specialist who has been recognised for his work during the West Africa Ebola epidemic.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Starter
programme.desc: Three chefs are doing battle to represent Northern Ireland. Tommy Heaney, Head Chef at the Great House Hotel in South Wales, is taken on by Shauna Froydenlund, Chef Patron at Marcus Wareing's two Michelin starred restaurant, and James Devine, the 2017 National Chef of the Year.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Fish
programme.desc: After a tense starter course, the chefs return to the kitchen to cook their fish dishes. James is making his elevated take on a fried chicken takeaway as a tribute to the NHS staff who care for his sister. Shauna is also taking inspiration from a personal connection with a tribute to staff from a facility in her hometown of Londonderry. Tommy is hoping to impress with a dish dedicated to the discovery of DNA.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Main
programme.desc: With two courses down it's time for the chefs to cook their main courses. It's the battle of beef with each using the same meat in their innovative creations. Tommy also meets the first baby ever born on the NHS.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Dessert
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the final chance for the chefs to impress. After such a tightly fought battle all week, each is hoping to deliver a technically perfect dessert. Tommy and James are both using passion fruit in their complex dishes while Shauna is hoping to use her pastry chef training to score full marks.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Judging
programme.desc: The two chefs representing Northern Ireland go head-to-head. Judging as ever are Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and Andi Oliver who are joined by Shehan Hettiaratchy, lead trauma surgeon at St Mary's Hospital who helped treat victims of the Grenfell Tower fire.

programme.title: Finals Starter
programme.desc: The winning chefs from all eight regions must battle it out for the honour of a spot on 2018's 'Feast To Say Thank You' banquet menu, celebrating 70 years of the NHS, one of Britain's most prized institutions.

programme.title: Finals Fish
programme.desc: The chefs must prepare fish courses, and after some exceptionally high-scoring dishes in the starter round, everyone is desperate to deliver perfection. Once again, the chefs present their innovative, witty and heart-warming creations.

programme.title: Finals Main
programme.desc: It's main course day and with only two spots remaining on the banquet menu, the competition is fierce. Both chefs and judges alike are amazed at the high standard of cooking and an incredible number of 10s are dished out as the chefs serve up venison, rabbit, duck, beef, lamb and pork for scrutiny.

programme.title: Finals Dessert
programme.desc: It's dessert day and with just one place remaining at the banquet feast, each chef is giving everything they've got for a chance to say thank you to the heroic NHS staff. All the chefs have significantly re-worked or re-invented their desserts since the regional heats, proving that they'll do everything they can in a bid for that final winning spot.

programme.title: Banquet
programme.desc: It's the grand finale as the winning chefs cook their dishes at a banquet for the heroes of the NHS. Having arrived at St Bartholomew's Hospital, the chefs are shown the incredible location for event, the almost three-hundred-year-old Great Hall.

programme.title: London and South East - Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Competing for the top spot are 3 new chefs to the competition representing some of the most exciting culinary talent from London, Paul Walsh, Luke Selby and Ben Marks.

programme.title: London and South East Mains and Desserts
programme.desc: The three chefs are halfway through their heat and the pressure is mounting. Only two will proceed to Friday's judging and have a chance to represent the London and the South East region at the regional finals.

programme.title: London and South East - Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining London chefs must cook their four-course menus again. The chefs need to impress the formidable judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

programme.title: North East: Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Three chefs new to the competition compete in the North East heats. Three of the region's chefs battle it out for the top spot: Mike Carr, Samira Effa, and Tom Anglesea. The three chefs must present the menu of their careers, inspired by 50 years of British pop music.

programme.title: North East: Main and Dessert
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through their heat and will serve up their main courses and desserts. The stakes are high, and again they are each serving a unique take on the pop music brief. Mike is confident about his northern dish, 'Rack n Roll', which puts both classic Yorkshire hogget and traditional Lancashire hotpot in the spotlight.

programme.title: North East: Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining North East chefs must cook their four-course menus again for the judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the British pop industry's finest.

programme.title: Central Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Newcomer Kray brings an urban edge to proceedings, with a starter inspired by grime music called 'Fire in the Booth'. It combines hot sauce, veal sweetbreads and tuna belly. Returner Sabrina is compiling a dish of her favourite ingredients, including pasta and ox cheek, for her Italian inspired starter called 'My Mixtape'.

programme.title: Central Main and Dessert
programme.desc: For his main course, Ryan Simpson-Trotman is confident his dish, `The UK's Number 1', will hit the top spot with his combination of a beef pie and rump cap. Sabrina Gidda is taking inspiration from her grandad's collection of old 45s for her `Sunday Jukebox' main: pork Wellington and Black Country faggots.

programme.title: Central Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining Central chefs must cook their four-course menus again for judges food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

programme.title: North West Starter and Fish
programme.desc: Competing for a place on the banquet menu are two chefs returning to the competition for a second time, plus a supremely talented newcomer. Liam Simpson, who co-owns a high-end gastropub near Henley-on-Thames, is hoping to make it all the way after being knocked out in the heats during the 2018 competition.

programme.desc: Llega la boda entre Toña y Brayan tras los excesos de las despedidas de solteros.

programme.title: Mis pobres diablillos
programme.desc: Don Roque cumple años y él cree que Vanessa le está organizando una fiesta sorpresa. Benito y sus amigos hacen travesuras a los vecinos con ayuda de Pedro.

programme.title: Competencia de hot dogs
programme.desc: Una mujer casi atropella a Luis, por lo que los vecinos quieren que construyan un tope. Para obtener dinero, Lorena pone un puesto de hot dogs y Magda le hace la competencia.

programme.desc: Zacarías termina su relación con doña Olegaria y comienza a trabajar con el Trácalas. Natasha trata de convencer a Apolinar para dar a conocer la verdad a través de un documental.

programme.desc: Es Nochebuena y los López están tristes, ya que no tienen dinero para regalos ni para la cena, pero dos personas llegan sorpresivamente a cambiar la noche y hacer que sea una Navidad memorable para todos.

programme.title: No andaban muertos
programme.desc: Márgara trata de reunir a los héroes y Zacarías regresa a la banda. Hassan secuestra a Prisca. Los héroes se presentan ante los medios y hay reacciones encontradas.

programme.title: Sin recuerdos
programme.desc: Albertano y Vítor despiertan en una playa, perdidos y sin saber qué pasó, deciden buscar juntos a Natacha para regresar a su casa.

programme.title: Belleza peligrosa
programme.desc: Dos mujeres deciden vivir con Cuca y Nacho, ellos las aceptan felices sin saber que son peligrosas estafadoras, pero Albertano y Vítor los salvan.

programme.title: Niño envuelto
programme.desc: Es el día del santoral de Plácido y quiere festejarlo con una cena, pero la falta de presupuesto complica el plan. Además, Tulio se fue de la casa y la familia debe decidir si Gertrudis se va o se queda con ellos.

programme.title: Acuérdate de Acapulco
programme.desc: Plácido se queda sin pensión por error y debe conseguir un nuevo trabajo para mantener a su familia. Mientras tanto, un exnovio de la Nena vuelve para conquistarla, pero Adolfo trata de impedirlo.

programme.title: Madre solo hay una
programme.desc: Martina convence a la tía Licha de hacerle una broma a la Nena para que no extrañe a Adolfo. Mientras tanto, Justito sufre las molestias de unos compañeros.

programme.title: Éramos muchos
programme.desc: El exnovio de Carlos regresa a casa de los López para pedir asilo. Además, Plácido y Adolfo consiguen un nuevo trabajo, pero también una nueva deuda.

programme.title: Coma Pozole
programme.desc: María sale del hospital y todos en la vecindad la reciben con cariño, María le pide a Doña Lucha le prepare pozole para celebrar que despertó del coma e invita a toda la vecindad. Llega la enfermera a casa de Albertano y pelea con María por su amor.

programme.title: Tiempo de Amigos
programme.desc: El chino entra a la escuela y lleva a su casa al Macaco, al verlo Doña Lucha le prohíbe juntarse con él, pero termina aceptándolo. Albertano se entristece, no tiene amigos, pero el chino y Macaco le ofrecen su amistad.

programme.title: Niños de Oro
programme.desc: Ludovico y Federica inscriben a Junior en el concurso Niños de Oro, donde participa cantando ópera, pues desean ganar el gran premio.

programme.title: Sueño de telenovela
programme.desc: Ludovico sueña que está en una telenovela en la que es millonario, su mujer es la villana y termina casándose con una sirvienta.

programme.title: Clavado en La Quebrada
programme.desc: Toña se va de fiesta a Acapulco para olvidar a Brayan. Él quiere recuperarla, pero, para volver con ella, tendrá que saltar de La Quebrada.

programme.title: Y volver volver
programme.desc: Brayan se avienta de La Quebrada para obtener el perdón de Toña, pero todo se complica cuando Irmita visita a un Brayan convaleciente.

programme.title: Viaje a Canadá
programme.desc: Magda se niega a pagarle a Germán para arreglar la pared del edificio. Benito consigue un comercial en Canadá y mientras él trabaja, Frankie y Lorena van a esquiar. Eugenio Derbez y Alessandra Rosaldo llegan de incógnito al mismo hotel.

programme.title: Viaje a Canadá
programme.desc: Frankie consigue por error un maletín con secretos íntimos de Eugenio Derbez y Alessandra Rosaldo y decide chantajearlo para obligarlo a que le compre sus guiones.

programme.title: Exploding Port-a-Potty

programme.title: Is Yawning Contagious?

programme.title: Cooling a Six-Pack
programme.desc: The fastest way to chill a six-pack of beer; how to rebuild a crash test dummy; examining whether a crude battery was invented more than 2,000 years ago.

programme.title: Son of a Gun
programme.desc: The probability of a woman becoming pregnant by a bullet during the Civil War; using a telephone during a thunderstorm.

programme.title: Breaking Glass

programme.desc: The fatal airplane brace position and cellphone driving are investigated.

programme.title: Bulletproof Water

programme.title: Chinese Invasion Alarm
programme.desc: An ancient Chinese subterranean sonar system is put to the test; the "five-second rule" about eating food dropped on the ground.

programme.title: Confederate Rocket

programme.desc: Adam and Jamie receive an email with a photo of a shredded plane and must decide if it is genuine; they investigate if it was the propeller or another aircraft that was the cause.

programme.title: Antigravity Device
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test the flammability of Christmas tree lights; Kari, Grant, and Tori test the claims of several antigravity devices.

programme.title: Firearms Folklore
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test three gun-related myths, including one from "Saving Private Ryan;" Kari, Grant and Tori go to great lengths to see whether mankind's first and simplest tool could be far more dangerous.

programme.title: 22,000 Foot Fall
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie create the biggest explosion in MythBuster history.

programme.title: Holiday Special
programme.desc: The team investigates whether reindeer could help Santa fly and more.

programme.title: More Myths Reopened
programme.desc: Jamie and Adam revisit the most controversial myths; they repeat them to see if their original answer was genuine.

programme.title: Western Myths
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie saddle up for some western myths -- but that is not all.

programme.title: Big Rig Myths
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie try to find out if an exploding truck tire can kill.

programme.title: Grenades and Guts
programme.desc: Jamie and Adam investigate a grenade blast; will consuming diet soda and Mentos rupture a person's stomach?

programme.title: Snow Special
programme.desc: The team goes on the slopes to tackle snow myths; they try to determine if popping a whip can cause an avalanche.

programme.title: Viewer Special
programme.desc: The Mythbusters put a new batch of viewer suggestions to the test.

programme.title: Red Rag to a Bull
programme.desc: The team tests the "bull in a china shop" saying.

programme.title: Superhero Hour
programme.desc: The Marvel comic maestros are put under the MythBusters microscope.

programme.title: Myth Revolution
programme.desc: Kari, Tory and Grant put a radio-frequency identification conspiracy theory to the test; Adam and Jamie test two myths about weapons.

programme.title: Exploding Water Heater
programme.desc: Testing if an ordinary water heater has the ability to fly like a rocket, right through your house; this is a tale of explosive transformation.

programme.title: Shooting Fish in a Barrel
programme.desc: The MythBusters test the truth behind some time-honored sayings.

programme.title: Confederate Steam Gun
programme.desc: Jamie and Adam test a mythical steam-powered confederate weapon.

programme.title: James Bond Special- Part 1
programme.desc: The crew tests myths about James Bond-inspired gadgets, getaways and guns.

programme.title: Lead Balloon
programme.desc: The team tests if dynamite can create ideal surfing conditions and then tests the proverbial lead balloon.

programme.title: James Bond Special- Part 2
programme.desc: The Mythbusters dedicate this one-hour special to action hero James Bond.

programme.title: Viewer Special 2
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie open their inbox again; they test several myth-busting ideas from the fan site.

programme.title: Alaska Special
programme.desc: Alaska provides an ideal habitat to test some Alaskan anecdotes.

programme.title: NASA Moon Landing
programme.desc: The team tackles the tallest tale of all in Moon Landing Hoax Hour.

programme.title: Exploding Steak
programme.desc: Jamie and Adam try to tenderize steak with explosives; they test to see if a motorist uses more fuel when driving under stress.

programme.title: Ninjas 2
programme.desc: Jamie and Adam revisit some old ninja myths and tackle some new ones.

programme.title: Viral Hour
programme.desc: The team examines viral videos from the internet; they try to find out if people truly believe what they see.

programme.title: Water Stun Gun
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie try to turn a conventional electric stun gun into a water-powered electric stun gun.

programme.title: Alcohol Myths

programme.title: Motorcycle Flip
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie take on an Indiana Jones movie stunt.

programme.title: Coffin Punch
programme.desc: The whole team gets together to test myths about survival; in Coffin Punch, Kari, Tory and Grant test the silver screen saga; Adam and Jamie question what bullet-proof is.

programme.title: End With a Bang
programme.desc: The team joins forces, placing popular sayings under the microscope to determine whether it really is "impossible to polish a turd," possible to "hit the ground running" or advisable to "end with a bang."

programme.title: Viewer Special Threequel
programme.desc: The team puts four myths sent in by viewers to the test, including finding out whether drinking alcohol can help to avoid hypothermia.

programme.title: Alaska Special 2
programme.desc: The team busts the myth about the defensive properties of Pykrete.

programme.title: Exploding Bumper
programme.desc: The teams test two myths of locomotion from the reliable horse to the sometimes-unreliable motor car.

programme.title: Seesaw Saga
programme.desc: The team designs and builds a giant see-saw.

programme.title: Thermite vs. Ice
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie put a YouTube myth to the test; the team experiments with Thermite, car stereo systems and handguns.

programme.title: Prison Escape
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test if it's possible to cling to the roof of a speeding car; Kari, Tory and Grant try to solve some jailbreak myths.

programme.title: Curving Bullets
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie find out if a sonic shock wave can shatter glass; Tory, Grant and Kari try to bend bullets around obstacles.

programme.title: Car vs. Rain
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test out theories surrounding driving in the rain; they find out whether it is possible to stay dry by putting pedal to the metal.

programme.title: Knock Your Socks Off
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test the physics theory of bullet dropped vs. bullet fired; Kari, Grant and Tory test if it's possible to knock someone's socks off.

programme.title: Duct Tape Hour
programme.desc: The team explores the capabilities of duct tape.

programme.title: Dirty vs. Clean Car
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test whether a dirty car gets better gas mileage than a clean one; Kari, Grant and Tory test an old adage about hangovers concerning beer and liquor.

programme.title: Hurricane Windows
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test whether it's better to keep windows open or closed during a hurricane; liquid nitrogen.

programme.title: Crash and Burn
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test a myth of an out-of-control car crashing and burning.

programme.title: Myth Evolution
programme.desc: Exploring water heaters capabilities and well known car myths.

programme.title: Dumpster Diving
programme.desc: The team tests if diving into a dumpster is a valid way to get off a roof.

programme.title: Antacid Jail Break
programme.desc: Exploring how prisoners can escape and survive outside prison.

programme.title: Boomerang Bullet
programme.desc: Exploring the elastic properties of trees and a bullets ability to bounce.

programme.desc: Testing a Styrofoam cup filled with soda has against a car windshield.

programme.title: El sacrificio
programme.desc: Tomás le cuenta a Lety que doña Julieta está intentando sabotear su boda con Aldo; Omar acude con Tomás para poder conquistar a Carolina.

programme.title: Indiscreta
programme.desc: Gracias a doña Julieta, Fernando se entera de la verdadera identidad de Aurora; Alicia y Tomás pasan su primera noche juntos.

programme.title: Yo te apoyo
programme.desc: Fernando le dice a Lety que debe quedarse con Aldo y que él apoyará su relación; Simón les enseña a las del cuartel su título en informática; Marcia y Luigi salen de compras y alguien los sigue.

programme.title: Hombre nuevo
programme.desc: Simón recibe su nuevo puesto en Conceptos y le propone matrimonio a Paula María; Fernando y Omar llevan al nuevo coordinador de informática a celebrar su próxima boda.

programme.title: Malentendidos
programme.desc: Lety decide suspender su boda con Aldo, quien se pelea con Fernando; Simón se despide de Jaimito y Paula María.

programme.title: La boda de Paula María
programme.desc: Lety se da cuenta de que necesita a Aurora para ayudar a Aldo a recuperar su restaurante; Simón y Paula María se casan; los empleados de Conceptos se esfuerzan por juntar a Omar con Carolina.

programme.title: Intervención policial
programme.desc: La boda de Simón y Paula María continúa, pero la policía interrumpe la fiesta para llevarse detenido a Efrén; Carolina y Omar arreglan sus diferencias.

programme.title: Hombre libre
programme.desc: Aldo se molesta con Fernando, Lety y Omar por ocultarle la verdad sobre Aurora; Efrén sale de la cárcel y le dice a Lola que quiere regresar con ella y que está dispuesto a dejar a Jazmín.

programme.title: Casa nueva
programme.desc: Aldo recupera su restaurante y el programa de Conceptos resulta ser un éxito; Luigi se niega a recibir la visita de su padre; Martha y su familia por fin compran su casa.

programme.title: Mi verdadero yo
programme.desc: Luigi transforma a Lety en su verdadero yo y todos quedan fascinados en la oficina; Fernando intenta arreglar la relación entre Aldo y Leticia; Alicia decide robarle dinero a Tomás.

programme.title: Amor de padre
programme.desc: Alicia descubre que está embarazada: la familia Padilla se prepara para la boda de Lety con Aldo; don Erasmo se disculpa con Lety, pues se siente responsable por todo lo que le pasó.

programme.title: El millón que falta
programme.desc: Tomás descubre que Alicia robó el millón de pesos que le falta a Conceptos; Ariel hace todo lo posible por rastrear el dinero y desenmascarar al culpable; Lety le ofrece su ayuda a su amigo.

programme.title: Los dueños
programme.desc: Alicia intenta despedirse de Tomás y se arrepiente de haberlo lastimado; Aldo entrega Conceptos a sus verdaderos dueños.

programme.title: Final feliz
programme.desc: Lety prepara todo para su boda con Fernando; Tomás y Alicia deciden reanudar su relación; la tan esperada boda de los protagonistas.

programme.title: Currículum vitae
programme.desc: Lety se presenta a una entrevista de trabajo en Conceptos, una casa productora, para ser secretaria ejecutiva, pero compite con la bella pero inexperta Alicia.

programme.title: Comparaciones
programme.desc: Fernando y Marcia tienen conflictos por la contratación de Leticia, y Marcia le pide a Fernando una explicación; en el fondo, a Marcia le preocupa que Lety esté tan bien preparada.

programme.title: Asignación de funciones
programme.desc: Fernando les asigna a Lety y Alicia sus funciones en la empresa: Lety se encargará del papeleo y Alicia de las relaciones públicas.

programme.title: Regaños
programme.desc: Bajo las órdenes de Fernando, Simón le pide perdón a Lety por molestarla. Fernando regaña a Lety por dejar la agenda personal descuidada y le da indicaciones.

programme.title: Falso despido
programme.desc: Fernando se entera de que López despide a Lety y decide ir a salvarla, por lo que se enfurece con Marcia y amenaza a López con despedirlo.

programme.title: Tristezas
programme.desc: Román deja plantada a Lety, quien escucha que Fernando se casará con Marcia. Paula María y Jaimito van a la oficina. Simón le pide perdón a Lety.

programme.title: Corte de personal
programme.desc: Lety recibe y ordena la información de los ejecutivos de Conceptos, pero Alicia se lleva los créditos tras apropiarse del informe que realizó Lety.

programme.title: Festejo con tamales
programme.desc: Lety recibe el comentario de que Fernando es un don Juan, y la advertencia de que no se enamore. Ariel encuentra errores en la propuesta de Fernando para tener la presidencia.

programme.title: Plan de trabajo
programme.desc: Fernando le pide a Alicia elaborar un trabajo especial, pero ella no sabe cómo resolverlo. Lety trabaja fuertemente en el plan de trabajo de Fernando, pero lo pierde en el transporte público.

programme.title: Ineficiencia y mala muerte
programme.desc: Alicia le dice a Fernando que no hizo el trabajo que le pidió. Cuco y Adriana descubren que el CD que encontraron es de Lety. Omar se niega a ayudar a Alicia a preparar el plan de negocios. Don Erasmo llega a Conceptos.

programme.title: Despido falso
programme.desc: Lety tiene un malentendido con Fernando, y cree que la despidieron. Lola le reclama a Efrén por su pensión.

programme.title: Indiscreción
programme.desc: Fernando le pide a Lety acompañarlo a la junta con Ariel; Tomás le dice a don Erasmo que su hija es secretaria; Ariel se burla porque Leticia estará en la junta de ejecutivos.

programme.title: Táctica de celos
programme.desc: Alicia necesita una cita con Ariel para celar a Omar. Paula María invita a Lety a salir con amigos. Fernando está en casa de Marcia, aburrido decide ir algún lugar a bailar, Marcia se queda. Lety y Fernando se encuentran en el antro y bailan juntos.

programme.title: Apoyo incondicional
programme.desc: Fernando decide pasar la noche con Marcia en su apartamento; Don Erasmo reprende a Lety por salir sin permiso.

programme.title: Nombramiento merecido
programme.desc: Marcia se niega a comunicar a Lety con Fernando porque está concursando en el hipódromo; Lety obliga a Simón a llevarla al club para hablar con Fernando de inmediato.

programme.title: Ascenso oficial
programme.desc: Alicia le cuenta a Marcia cómo la humillaron las otras secretarias y sobre el nombramiento de Lety; Marcia le reclama a Fernando por el ascenso de su secretaria.

programme.title: Balance maquillado
programme.desc: Olarte le dice a Ariel que Fernando es capaz de maquillar el balance que presentará en la junta del comité; Ariel se le insinúa a Alicia y ella se molesta, pero igual lo usa para poner celoso a Omar.

programme.title: Gran oportunidad
programme.desc: El ingeniero Ortiz le dice a Olarte que Lety bloqueó el acceso a los archivos; la niña que iba a grabar el comercial se enferma, Lola aprovecha la oportunidad y le sugiere a Irma usar a Adrianita.

programme.title: Sin respaldo
programme.desc: Lety no hace las copias de seguridad y la computadora se descompone, no hay forma de presentar el balance. El ingeniero Ortiz le comunica al Comité los problemas con la computadora de Lety. Ariel reprende a Lety por no tener respaldo de sus archivos.

programme.title: Nuevo nombramiento merecido
programme.desc: Lety se integra a la junta del Comité para explicar el balance financiero de Conceptos. Lety da una explicación detallada y logra rebatir todas las objeciones y dudas de Ariel respecto a la buena situación de la empresa.

programme.title: Nuevas responsabilidades
programme.desc: El club casi descubre al responsable de lo sucedido con la computadora de Lety; Lety está más cerca de ser vicepresidenta financiera.

programme.title: Una espía
programme.desc: Omar deja a Paula María en un bar; un zapato de Lety se cae en una fuente; Ariel le pide a Alicia informarle todo lo que pase en Conceptos; Fernando le pide a Lety supervisar la compra de unas cámaras de video.

programme.title: Confianza que incomoda
programme.desc: Marcia le da a Alicia un cheque para pagar la luz y el gas; Fernando le pide a Luigi usar otra cámara mientras llega la de cine, pero él se niega; Marcia se molesta porque Fernando autorizará la firma de Lety en los bancos.

programme.title: Comisión comprometedora
programme.desc: Alicia decide no salir con Omar; Lety convence a Fernando de que Cine Rent es la mejor opción; Ariel llega al departamento de Alicia; Omar se encuentra a Paula María y le ofrece llevarla a su casa.

programme.title: Negocio redondo
programme.desc: Alicia escucha a Fernando contarle a Marcia del contrato con Cine Rent y se lo dice a Ariel; Fernando le cuenta a Miguel que Lety lo convenció para aceptar su propuesta.

programme.title: Recapacitando
programme.desc: Don Erasmo le pide a Lety no aceptar la comisión que le ofrecieron, pues sería un soborno y cuestionaría su honestidad. Lety le cuenta a Fernando acerca de la comisión que le ofrecieron en Cine Rent y él a su vez, se lo cuenta a Marcia.

programme.title: Empresa nueva
programme.desc: Carolina critica a Fernando y Omar por burlarse de la fealdad de Lety; Luigi se molesta al ver sus bocetos pintarrajeados; Lola le pide a Simón que se lleve a los niños y que tire las evidencias que los delaten.

programme.title: Más problemas
programme.desc: Fernando supervisa la recepción de Beni; Marcia le dice a Fernando que Fabiola y Gregorio tienen parados los nuevos foros por problemas con los clientes de los comerciales.

programme.title: La nueva presidenta
programme.desc: Luigi se molesta porque Fernando le entrega una cámara de video en vez de una de 35 milímetros que le pidió; el Club de las Feas decide festejar que Lety se quedará como presidenta de Conceptos.

programme.title: Desilusión
programme.desc: Carolina le dice a Fernando lo que acordó con la prensa; las secretarias del Club de las Feas se desilusionan cuando descubren que Rolando es el novio de Luigi; Arturo le cancela a Fernando el contrato con la disquera.

programme.title: Emborrachadas
programme.desc: Fernando, Marcia y Omar van a Los Ángeles a cerrar un contrato. Lety y sus amigas se van de antro y terminan borrachas.

programme.title: Travesuras
programme.desc: Lety autoriza que Cuco, Adrianita, Jaimito y Clarita se queden en Conceptos; los niños encuentran unos carteles y deciden hacer una mezcla; Martha y Sara retienen el cheque de pago de Alicia.

programme.title: Por mi culpa
programme.desc: Lety le dice a Fernando por qué no contrató a las modelos; Fernando le reclama a Lety haber permitido que los niños se quedaran en la empresa; Fernando le pide a Luigi que regrese a trabajar.

programme.title: El que busca, encuentra
programme.desc: Fernando acuerda los términos de contratación con las modelos y con Luigi; Fátima llega en busca de Fernando; Paula María se encuentra con López; Omar le aconseja a Fernando seducir a Fátima.

programme.title: Terror de despido
programme.desc: Simón llega al bar por Paula María y deja empeñado su reloj para pagar la cuenta; Simón intenta hacerle ver a Paula María cuánto la quiere y ella le da un beso.

programme.title: Conmoción en la oficina
programme.desc: Marcia llega a Conceptos y todos van a quejarse con ella; Alicia protesta por cómo la tratan las del club y Luigi se queja porque Fernando le pidió contratar modelos baratas.

programme.title: Cuentas claras, amistades largas
programme.desc: Alicia le cuenta a Marcia cómo vio a Paula María con Omar; Jazmín convence a Efrén para que la deje trabajar en Conceptos y Lola se molesta; Marcia le recuerda a Alicia el préstamo que le hizo.

programme.title: Proyecto exitoso
programme.desc: Luigi presenta su comercial y los clientes aceptan; Alicia se burla de las del club por ser pobres; Fernando se niega a presentarle los estados financieros a Ariel.

programme.title: Meta inalcanzable
programme.desc: Lola le ofrece a Simón dinero para que enamore a Jazmín; Lety le dice a Fernando que no alcanzarán la meta ni siquiera con el contrato millonario y Fernando le pide apoyo a Marcia para tomar una decisión.

programme.title: Cumpliendo una promesa
programme.desc: Fernando acepta disfrazarse de travesti; Jazmín sale a comer con Simón; Luigi, Ricardo y Fernando firman el contrato; Martha les pone una trampa a Jazmín y a Simón.

programme.title: La iniciación
programme.desc: Alicia le da un cheque a Marcia, acepta comprar la ropa a crédito y le dice que Omar regresó con ella; Fernando acepta pagar por anticipado al proveedor de Panamá y Lety expresa su desacuerdo.

programme.title: Odisea nocturna
programme.desc: Fernando le pide ayuda a Lety y ella sale en busca de Celso; Fernando patea la reja de Conceptos y lo detiene la policía por armar un escándalo en la vía pública.

programme.title: Puras mentiras
programme.desc: Fernando le tiene que explicar a Marcia por qué le pidió ayuda a Lety y no a ella; Paco deja a Clarita con Martha; Fernando le dice a Marcia que viajará a Nueva York para cerrar el negocio del equipo.

programme.title: Espía descubierta
programme.desc: Leticia encuentra a Alicia esculcando su oficina. Jazmín y los niños le cuentan a las secretarias sobre el choque de Simón. Fernando regresa de su viaje y Simón no se atreve a confesarle que chocó su carro. Ariel cancela su alianza con Alicia.

programme.title: Equipo de grabación confiscado
programme.desc: Fernando le aclara a Simón que el empleado del restaurante fue despedido por chocar el automóvil; Omar le cuenta a Fernando que se reconcilió con Alicia; un cargamento es confiscado en la aduana por ser contrabando.

programme.title: Malos negocios
programme.desc: Alicia informa a Ariel lo que le dijo Marcia sobre los proveedores de Nueva York; Lety y Fernando inscriben ante el notario la deuda de Conceptos con Filmo Imagen.

programme.title: Embarazo confirmado
programme.desc: Martha recibe un cheque para comprarse un automóvil; Marcia le dice a Fernando que Alicia sí está embarazada; Ariel cuestiona a Marcia sobre el embarazo de Alicia.

programme.title: Grandes avances
programme.desc: Marcia le dice a Fernando que Bella Life y la agencia de publicidad aceptaron que Conceptos se encargue de lanzar la campaña; las secretarias convencen a Martha de hacerse una liposucción.

programme.title: Embargo inminente
programme.desc: Omar le cuenta a Fernando sobre el abogado que le recomendaron para embargar Conceptos; Omar le da un cheque a Alicia para ayudarle con el embarazo; Paula María le promete a Jaimito conseguirle un mejor papá.

programme.title: Remordimientos
programme.desc: Las chicas del Club de las Feas sospechan que Alicia no está embarazada. El abogado de Filmo Imagen hace efectiva la demanda de embargo. Fernando tiene muchos remordimientos por la grave situación económica de Conceptos.

programme.title: Situación crítica
programme.desc: El esposo de Martha se decepciona porque ella decidió operarse. Los padres de Fernando llegan de viaje y le piden un informe acerca de la situación de la empresa. Simón intenta que incluyan a Jazmín en la coreografía de Bela Life.

programme.title: Embargo precautorio
programme.desc: Las del club escuchan a Alicia decir que se hizo unos análisis de sangre; Martha habla al laboratorio y, a nombre de Alicia, pide que hagan una prueba de embarazo y se la envíen.

programme.title: Abierto coqueteo
programme.desc: En el ensayo del comercial, Fátima le coquetea a Fernando y Marcia se lo reclama; Lety le pide discreción al licenciado Sánchez para levantar el embargo.

programme.title: Intriga y curiosidad
programme.desc: Luigi le niega a Fernando despedir a Fátima; Fernando se altera porque Alicia no llega; Marcia le reclama a Lety no tener efectivo para pagos; Martha atiende el teléfono de Lety y le dice frente a Fernando que le habló su novio Tomás.

programme.title: Preparativos para el lanzamiento
programme.desc: Fernando duda de la honestidad de Lety; las secretarias deciden hacer dieta en solidaridad con Martha, pero un mesero les revela que Martha está devorando todo; Fernando le encarga la oficina a Lety.

programme.title: Despido justificado
programme.desc: Fernando se entera de que Fátima se emborrachó y lo anda buscando; Fernando le cuenta a Marcia que Luigi despidió a Fátima y le pide a Jazmín que la sustituya.

programme.title: Acceso exclusivo
programme.desc: Omar convence a Fernando para dejar entrar a las del club a un importante evento; el guardia reconoce a Paco y lo deja entrar con Jaimito y Clarita; Marcia se molesta con Fernando por desautorizarla ante las del club.

programme.title: Decisiones importantes
programme.desc: Simón convence a Jazmín de cenar con él y le dice a Efrén que saldrá con las bailarinas; Paula María convence a Simón de irse con ella.

programme.title: Lectura de la suerte
programme.desc: Marcia nota la ausencia de Paula María quien llega a Conceptos oliendo a Simón y con la ropa del día anterior; Ariel le exige a Alicia renunciar a Conceptos.

programme.title: Inicia la conquista
programme.desc: Omar le sugiere a Fernando emborracharse para poder ver a Lety más bonita; Simón intenta conquistar a Paula María y ella les confiesa a las del club que no puede estar con él porque no tiene dinero.

programme.title: Sin embargo
programme.desc: El licenciado Sánchez le sugiere a Tomás seguir con el embargo a Conceptos, pero Tomás se niega.

programme.title: Sin liquidez
programme.desc: Fernando le dice a Omar que Lety no quiere a Tomás. Tomás le cuenta a Lety todo lo que ha pasado con el licenciado Sánchez. Simón le pide a Paula María formalizar su relación, pero ella lo rechaza.

programme.title: Plan en marcha
programme.desc: Marcia le pide a Lola que le explique por qué las despidió Juanita y le ofrece un préstamo para pagar el celular de Jazmín. Tomás le da una carta a los niños para que se la entreguen a Alicia.

programme.title: Una oportunidad
programme.desc: Omar ignora las insinuaciones de Alicia; Lety se molesta porque Omar invita a Fernando a salir con las modelos; Fernando le dice a Lety que no ama a Marcia y le pide que se den una oportunidad para descubrir lo que sienten.

programme.desc: In this TV special, a handsome geriatric patient surrounded by his many girlfriends shocks everyone, including the nurses, when he goes into life-threatening painkiller withdrawal.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Nursing Intuition
programme.desc: In this TV special, a stroke patient's heart mysteriously stops, starts again and then stops. A nurse is in a predicament when the only available bed for a foul-mouthed woman is next to an elderly nun awaiting hip surgery.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Party Fails
programme.desc: In this TV special, a group of frat boys arrives at the ER due to a "blue pee epidemic" and a bride with kidney stones refuses to remove her wedding gown.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Secrets
programme.desc: In this TV special, an embarrassing secret prohibits a heart attack patient from being rushed to the ER for surgery. A man with a 5-hour erection gets caught between his wife and his mistress.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Temptations
programme.desc: In this TV special, a man comes into the ER with a surprising body part stuck inside a camping stove.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Worst Day Ever
programme.desc: In this TV special, two skydivers land on a metal post and a woman has a tie rod sticking out of her temple.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Didn't See It Coming
programme.desc: In this TV special, a man comes to the ER with a metal pipe stuck through his face and out his neck. A man lands on a shovel and it gets stuck in his perineum. Then, a heavy man has a knife lodged in his chest - only 1cm from his heart.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Labor Pains
programme.desc: In this TV special, a doctor delivers a baby in a car and another one to parents unaware they were expecting!

programme.title: The Big Save
programme.desc: An anesthesiologist has a heart attack, a pregnant woman has a cerebral aneurysm, a man is stabbed in the heart and a sex worker's unusual hiding place for money is found.

programme.title: My Job Is Mayhem
programme.desc: An opera singer suffers a severe neck injury, a patient's artificial hip has become dislocated and a 25-year-old has been shot in the chest after being accused of cheating at cards.

programme.title: We Have a Heartbeat
programme.desc: A policewoman has been shot by a carjacker, a homeless woman has cellulitis, a drug dealer is unresponsive after being beaten, two middle-aged men have severe burns, and a man in his 70s has been found unresponsive.

programme.title: No Time to Think
programme.desc: A circus performer and exotic snake collector is brought into the ER; Dr. Bush must figure out what type of antivenin to use on him.

programme.title: Red Blanket
programme.desc: A patient is passing out for no apparent reason; while being examined by Dr. Craig Mittleman, the patient drinks a glass of cold water and goes into cardiac arrest.

programme.title: A Scary Feeling
programme.desc: A teen is brought in with a live cockroach stuck in his ear canal, a man slices his hand with a saw and more.

programme.title: A Day from Hell
programme.desc: When a 6-year-old's illness has no discernible cause, the doctor begins to suspect his mother is poisoning him.

programme.title: Prepare for the Worst
programme.desc: Two gang members threaten to kill Dr. Carroll while he tries to save three men with gunshot wounds; reattaching fingers; car burglar.

programme.title: No Down Time
programme.desc: Dr. Castillo thought he had seen it all until the day a seven-foot man comes in blind drunk and unconscious.

programme.title: We Need a Miracle
programme.desc: Dr. Michos has his hands full when ten critically ill teenagers are brought in after experimenting with drugs.

programme.title: I Need Some Help Here
programme.desc: Paramedics wheel in an 18-year-old woman who is unresponsive after being involved in a car accident, and discover she's pregnant; doctor faces a patient with an ax sticking out his head.

programme.title: How Can This Happen
programme.desc: Neurosurgeon Dr. Smith is under extreme pressure after a young boy punctures his skull with a pitchfork.

programme.title: Call the Code
programme.desc: A man, 21, suffers massive internal injuries in a motorcycle accident; four trauma patients hurt in a car crash are treated; a 14-year-old boy needs a blood transfusion.

programme.title: What a Day
programme.desc: Doctors declare a man brain-dead, and his wife keeps him on life-support so that his organs may be harvested; a woman comes into the ER with severe abdominal pain and claims there is an alien in her stomach.

programme.title: Nothing's Working
programme.desc: Another day, another surprise pregnancy. A woman in the ER discusses whether she's ready to be a mother.

programme.title: We Need Further Tests
programme.desc: It's a busy day in the ER as Dr. Heilbron battles to treat a man whose intestine has come out, among others.

programme.title: Pressure Is Building
programme.desc: A boy is rushed in after breathing in an unspecified poisonous chemical. Has it permanently damaged his lungs?

programme.title: Surgery Won't Help
programme.desc: Crisis breaks out in the ER when a depressed man walks in, pulls out a gun and takes a doctor hostage.

programme.title: Jaws of Life
programme.desc: A car with teen girls crashes into a fence, with a pole shooting through the windshield and into the driver.

programme.title: A Day at the Beach
programme.desc: A young boy is attacked by a shark and teeters between life and death as the ER surgeons try to save his life; on Halloween night, a lady is screaming in agony as there is something in her ear, and it needs to come out.

programme.title: Say Your Prayers
programme.desc: A man is bitten by a deadly rattlesnake but because of religious reasons cannot receive a blood transfusion.

programme.title: A Life in Their Hands
programme.desc: A young girl paralyzed from the waist down arrives at the emergency room; her parents are angry as the doctors sent her home a week earlier.

programme.title: Code Green in the ER
programme.desc: Doctors perform a chest incision while awaiting surgeons. An iguana is brought in following a car accident.

programme.title: Exorcism in the ER
programme.desc: A man goes into anaphylactic shock, a tough guy fears needles and a man stabs himself with a ninja sword.

programme.title: The Golden Hour
programme.desc: A soldier comes into the ER with a stab wound; a young man bleeds from the ears; a woman overdoses on diet pills.

programme.title: Toilet Paper-Eating Patient
programme.desc: A woman with a habit of eating toilet paper complains of abdominal pains; a patient in a correctional facility is found unresponsive and running a high fever.

programme.title: Long Live the King
programme.desc: Doctors are baffled when a retired admiral is brought in, and they don't understand what is making him grow weaker by the day.

programme.title: Coma Woman Surprise

programme.title: Til Death Do Us Part

programme.title: Mystery of the Traveling Bullet
programme.desc: A cowboy shows the staff how to treat patients; a patient with a gunshot wound in the thigh complains of chest pains.

programme.title: An ER Miracle
programme.desc: A horrible accident leaves a young boy with a severed head and doctors need to race to save his life; cops bring in a man suspected of robbing a bank and a patient complains of chest pains.

programme.title: A Real Pain in the Neck
programme.desc: A multiple personality disorder patient comes in with strange markings all over her body and chest; a man is rushed to the ER with a 16-inch bar protruding from his neck.

programme.title: From ER to Rushing River
programme.desc: A young boy's feet have been crushed by a train and ER surgeons work desperately to save his life; a woman falls into an icy river.

programme.title: Shot Through the Heart

programme.title: Sudden Killers
programme.desc: Doctors help a woman who is brutally attacked by a mountain lion; a difficult lady has abdominal problems.

programme.title: Liver Die
programme.desc: Jarret is rushed into ER after being violently tackled in a football game; a CAT scan reveals that his liver is split, and he needs emergency surgery.

programme.title: Elements of Danger

programme.title: Crushed

programme.title: Deadly Impact
programme.desc: A driver falls asleep at the wheel, suffering a traumatic amputation; a woman with psychiatric problems fakes fainting; a six-year-old girl is rushed to the ER with intermittent seizures.

programme.title: Under Siege
programme.desc: Doctors must look after their own when a psychotic gunman enters the hospital and starts shooting staff.

programme.title: Family Tragedy

programme.desc: A surgical resident puts her training to the test when a mugging survivor arrives with two bullet wounds.

programme.desc: A doctor opens a nurse's chest and takes her heart in his hand in a desperate effort to save her life.

programme.desc: Dos hombres falsifican herencias en Sevilla y conquistan a las hermosas mujeres del lugar.

programme.desc: Un buen hombre enfrenta problemas con su esposa, cuando ella decide llevar a su casa a toda su familia.

programme.desc: La esposa de un empresario posa desnuda a sus espaldas, pero cuando su esposo se entera sobrevienen los problemas.

programme.desc: Dos grandes amigos son muy mujeriegos, pero uno ama a la hermana del otro, pero por enredos de faldas la pierde.

programme.desc: En vista de que su esposa no puede darle el hijo que él añora, un hombre se consuela engañándola cada vez que puede.
