programme.title: A Christmas Visitor
programme.desc: Una familia, afligida por la muerte de su hijo menor en la guerra del golfo, estan determinados a traer de nuevo la alegria a su hogar esta navidad. Occure en formas que ninguno de ellos anticipa despues de invitar a un misterioso extraño a su hogar.

programme.title: Matchmaker Santa
programme.desc: Chris, quien podría ser Santa Claus, está convencido de que Melanie merece estar con el asistente de su novio.

programme.title: Ladies Of The House
programme.desc: Tres poderosas mujeres planean reconstruir una casa en ruinas. A pesar del acuerdo de los feligreses para supervisar la renovación de la propiedad con el fin de reunir fondos en la iglesia local, las mujeres deben superar sus diferentes personalidades y aceptar los grandes cambios en sus vidas domésticas para poder tener éxito.

programme.title: Love's Unending Legacy
programme.desc: Una pareja de recién casados lucha una batalladespués de adquirir acres de tierra para construir su rancho.

programme.title: Falling In Love With The Girl Next Door
programme.desc: Mark y Theresa se enamoran, pero sus madres dominantes arruinan sus planes de boda y tal vez su futuro juntos.

programme.title: Once Upon A Date
programme.desc: Josh, agente de bienes raíces, es enviado a adquirir un teatro y se enamora de la hija del propietario.

programme.title: Expecting A Miracle
programme.desc: Una pareja estadounidense varada en un pueblo mexicano, elige ayudar a un niño a alcanzar su milagro.

programme.title: Always and Forever
programme.desc: Ex novios de la escuela secundaria vuelven a reencontrarse durante la reunión de la 20ª clase de secundaria.

programme.title: Farewell Mr. Kringle
programme.desc: Una periodista, quien hace tiempo perdió su espíritu navideño, es designada a escribir en el pueblo Mistletoe.

programme.title: Uncorked
programme.desc: Una mujer adicta al trabajo es enviada a un retiro de su empresa en las viñas de California y conoce un chef.

programme.title: Cloudy With A Chance Of Love
programme.desc: Un meteorólogo se enamora de su productora de noticias después de conseguir un trabajo en una estación de televisión.

programme.title: Single Santa Seeks Mrs. Claus
programme.desc: Viuda hermosa y solitaria y su hijo son los beneficiarios cuando el guapo hijo primogenito y heredero del verdadero Santa Claus deja el polo norte para encontrar una esposa a tiempo para Navidad.

programme.title: All I Want For Christmas
programme.desc: Un niño le pide a los organizadores de un torneo que le encuentren un esposo a su madre (Gail O'Grady), una viuda.

programme.title: Santa Jr.
programme.desc: El hijo de Santa Claus, de mala gana toma el cargo del negocio familiar, pero las cosas van mal cuando lo confunden con el conocido "Bandido Navideño" y es arrestado.

programme.title: The Christmas Card
programme.desc: Conmovido por una tarjeta de Navidad anonima enviada al frente Iraqui, Cody, un solitario capitan del ejercito, viaja a Vermont para conocer al remitente de la tarjeta, Faith.

programme.title: Mistletoe Connection
programme.desc: Es Navidad y Kate dirige una nostálgica tienda de regalos en un vecindario que acaba de ser remodelado. Un encuentro casual en el autobús con Mark hace saltar chispas para ambos.

programme.title: Christmas In Canaan
programme.desc: Una amistad imposible florece entre dos niños de 10 años de diferentes antecedentes culturas durante los tiempos racistas de Texas rural en 1964.

programme.title: The Christmas Gift
programme.desc: Tres niños huérfanos se quedan temporalmente con una pareja (Dean Cain, Jean Louisa Kelly) durante la Navidad.

programme.title: Angel In The Family
programme.desc: Un padre viudo y enfermo junto a sus dos hijas experimentan un milagro cuando su difunta matriarca regrasa para pasar Navidad con ellos.

programme.title: Annie Claus Is Coming To Town
programme.desc: Annie Claus, la hija de Santa, viaja a Los Ángeles y descubre el hombre que ella realmente ama.

programme.title: Dial S For Santa
programme.desc: Una investigadora de seguros trabaja con un jefe de policía para resolver una serie de robos en su ciudad natal.

programme.title: What I Did For Love
programme.desc: Un abogado citadino (Jeremy London) enfrenta al jurado más difícil cuando acompaña a su campirana novia (Dorie Barton) a casa de sus padres en Navidad.

programme.title: Help For The Holidays
programme.desc: Santa envía a su duende favorito a Los Ángeles para ayudar a una familia a redescubrir su espíritu navideño.

programme.title: Matchmaker Santa
programme.desc: Chris, quien podría ser Santa Claus, está convencido de que Melanie merece estar con el asistente de su novio.

programme.title: Love's Christmas Journey Part 2
programme.desc: Viuda recientemente, Ellie visita a su hermano Aaron durante Navidad. Pero las festividades son amenazadas cuando Aaron desaparece.

programme.title: A Grandpa For Christmas
programme.desc: Bert O'Reiley es un actor retirado el cual se convierte en un instanste en abuelo de una nieta que no sabia de su existensia hasta que se va a vivir con el.

programme.title: The Christmas Pageant
programme.desc: Después de ser despedida, una directora teatral de Broadway se ve obligada a dirigir una obra de Navidad.

programme.title: North by Northpole: A Dial "S" Mystery
programme.desc: Santa Claus regresa para ayudar a una pareja a resolver un misterio y encontrar el amor. El deseo de Zoey de organizar el Festival de Navidad perfecto se ve comprometido cuando choca con su compañero Dalton, mientras ocurren cosas sospechosas que podrían detener el festival.

programme.title: Ordinary Miracles
programme.desc: Un juez se apiada de una niña adoptiva delinquente y la deja libre bajo su propia cutodia para las festividades, y finalmente encuentra al padre biologico de la niña a tiempo para una reunion familiar navideña.

programme.title: Wild Hearts
programme.desc: Megan, una rebelde adolescente de Chicago y su padre policía Bob, se mudan a la casa rural de su infancia.

programme.title: Working Miracles
programme.desc: Un accidente provoca que un empleado (Eddie Cibrian) de limpieza tenga la habilidad de sanar a otras personas, pero arriesgando su propia vida.

programme.title: The Right Girl
programme.desc: Una niña rica y consentida pierde su fortuna y se ve obligada a tomar un empleo en el mundo real.

programme.title: Always A Bride
programme.desc: Jordan despierta una mañana y descubre que se había casado con un actor famoso de Hollywood en Las Vegas.

programme.title: Undercover Angel
programme.desc: Una niña reza para que un milagro ayude a su madre que ha enviudado, un ángel se hace pasar por un reparador.

programme.title: Love's Long Journey
programme.desc: Missie que está embarazada, se siente fascinada y también aterrada dejando atrás la casa de sus padres.

programme.title: Letter Never Sent
programme.desc: De visita en casa, Henry encuentra una carta de amor que escribió en la secundaria para su mejor amiga Claire.

programme.title: The Wedding Do Over
programme.desc: Abby es una organizadora de bodas especializada en arreglar bodas que salieron mal. Obligada a trabajar con su exprometido, pronto empieza a cuestionarse si su relación fue el desastre que ella recuerda.

programme.title: Always and Forever

programme.desc: La viuda Christy conoce al viudo Charlie y descubren que tienen más que la perdida de seres queridos en común.

programme.desc: A German shepherd needs help with his territorial tendencies, and a dachshund has a habit of biting.

programme.title: Year of the Dog
programme.desc: Cesar helps a newlywed couple whose dogs don't let them get close and another pair who met online and are nervous about introducing their dogs.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is at Longmeadow with plenty of seasonal advice to keep gardens colourful. Will Young shows off his south London courtyard garden and reveals why it has become an absolute joy in his life, and Joe Swift helps him create some seasonal pot displays for sunny and shady spots.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gets some shrubs in the ground and plans ahead for spring with some bulb planting. Meanwhile, Frances Tophill joins Sue Kent on her allotment to find out how her growing year has been.

programme.title: Appleton
programme.desc: In Warrington, the team answer an SOS from ten-year-old Oliver, their youngest applicant ever. Bike-mad Oliver wants something that no one else has ever asked the designers for: a BMX track in his back garden.

programme.title: Leamington Spa
programme.desc: The team are in Leamington Spa to help Robert and Gemma and their young daughter Darcey. The family want a place where Darcey can come out and play without fear of falling into nettles or injuring herself on the uneven and broken patio.

programme.title: Swindon
programme.desc: In Swindon, busy working couple Nicola and Anthony moved to their new house a year ago. They regard it as their forever dream home, but the garden is letting them down, and they hope to bring some Mediterranean glamour to it.

programme.title: Petersfield
programme.desc: Jeannie and Norman have spent their retirement making the most of their long garden in Petersfield, Hampshire, but they want to turn an area at the back into a secluded, calm, Japanese-inspired 'garden within a garden' just for them.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty harvests his spuds and sows seeds for autumn veg. He also shows how to get plants for free by taking cuttings.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty refreshes a container of overgrown herbs, plants alpines and revisits the shrub and perennial cuttings he took a few weeks ago. Arit Anderson meets a designer who is placing sustainability and the environment at the heart of her gardens.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty's dividing his Pulmonaria and gives advice on frost-protection, Joe visits a tropical oasis outside Bristol, and Carol looks at Rowans from around the world.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: In Teddington, Jennifer enlists the help of her sisters to create an Italian-themed garden in memory of their parents. She has great ideas and a budget to match, but growing citrus trees, olive trees and vines in a leafy London suburb is easier said than done. Will Monty be able to guide the sisters to a Mediterranean style success?

programme.title: Brighton/High Wycombe
programme.desc: In Brighton determined duo Helen and Dax have their hands full with twins, one of whom has special needs. Meanwhile in High Wycombe, newly single Valerie is looking for a fresh lease of life.

programme.title: Bury & Hackney
programme.desc: Monty Don visits two sets of ambitious gardeners, each facing challenges on a very different scale. One is a tiny urban courtyard in Hackney and the other is an outdoor area for a community.

programme.title: Rome
programme.desc: Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a power base of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

programme.title: Florence
programme.desc: Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

programme.title: The South
programme.desc: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

programme.title: The Veneto, Lucca and The Lakes
programme.desc: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun. In the Lakes, Monty meets up with the garden society, the Grandi Giardini Italiani, to peer over the fence at luxurious creations of the rich and famous. The journey ends on Lake Maggiore to see the most theatrical horticultural gem of Italy.

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Morocco, Monty discovers the wide variety of paradise gardens. He begins just outside the city of Marrakesh in an enormous royal walled meadow, The Agdal. From there he moves to the heart of the town where he comes upon a tiny garden where huge banana plants jostle with palms to create a secret paradise garden, a shelter from the busy world outside. And in another part of the city a rundown old palace has been turned into a stunning contemporary garden with a twist.

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Turkey Monty is dazzled by an extraordinary display of the Ottoman Empire's favourite flower, the tulip, and learns of its sacred significance. Travelling further East to India he encounters a new type of spirituality in the tomb gardens of the Mughal Empire. Stunning mausoleums were set in vast gardens as places where an earthly king could enter a divine paradise.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Join Adam in his garden for a seasonal catch-up. Toby Buckland gives timely tips on summer and autumn maintenance for borders, plus join singer-songwriter Billie Marten as she shares her passion for growing vegetables.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With autumn fast approaching, Monty is preparing the borders for the change of seasons and looking ahead to spring. Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond visit a glorious historic garden in North Yorkshire - Scampston Hall.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Carol Klein and Nick Bailey celebrate gardeners throughout the country who have created some truly unique gardens and made every space count. Carol meets a couple in Dorset whose garden is full of inspirational features.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty welcomes a special guest, the Duchess of Cornwall, to Longmeadow, where she shares her love of gardening. Nick Bailey visits Knoll Gardens and gives his tips on the tall perennials which give a burst of colour towards the end of the season.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is at Longmeadow, enjoying the colours of late summer in the garden. Adam Frost, Carol Klein and Frances Tophill get an exclusive preview of Gardeners' World Live at the NEC.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is at Longmeadow with plenty of seasonal advice to keep gardens colourful. Will Young shows off his south London courtyard garden and reveals why it has become an absolute joy in his life, and Joe Swift helps him create some seasonal pot displays for sunny and shady spots.

programme.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels from Missouri to Chicago and then across to New York and Philadelphia. He begins his journey in a prairie, the original American flowering wilderness. Much of the prairie has disappeared, but he meets a couple who have revived the tradition and enjoy showing it to him in full bloom.

programme.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
programme.desc: Monty goes South to explore gardens of early independent America and learns how the history of this part of the country is still very much evident in the places and people he meets. He visits the famous garden where President Thomas Jefferson, one of America's founding fathers, enjoyed spending his time seeking out seeds and plants for his thousand-foot vegetable garden.

programme.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
programme.desc: Monty explores the extraordinary scenery of the west coast of America. He begins his journey in Arizona where he learns about cacti and marvels at the sight of them in the desert and in private gardens where they have replaced traditional plants and lawns.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty sows rocket, harvests chillies and tomatoes, and demonstrates how to take semi-ripe cuttings. Frances Tophill meets a head gardener in south London who's started gardening sustainably.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost is in his garden, bringing viewers up to date on how it has been developing, as well as giving advice on growing hydrangeas. Toby Buckland shares his tips on dealing with damaged shrubs, tree pruning and transplanting perennials.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As autumn unfolds in the garden, Monty Don and Nigel make the most of the season and prepare for the winter ahead. Meanwhile, Carol Klein is in Surrey looking at wild and cultivated heathers.

programme.title: Essex & Ipswich
programme.desc: Monty meets two sets of gardeners who have unimaginable ambitions for their outdoor spaces. In Essex Denise has never ventured beyond the decking area behind her house. Meanwhile in Ipswich, a father and daughter plan to build a terraced allotment.

programme.title: Stockport & Tufnell Park
programme.desc: Monty comes to the rescue of two couples in need of help transforming their rubble filled back gardens into havens of peace and tranquillity. They are in serious need of help and advice, but can Monty set them on the right track?

programme.title: Blackpool/Cumbria
programme.desc: Two gardeners, each living on their own, are hoping Monty can help them. In Blackpool, Alex dreams of turning her boring backyard into a magical enchanted forest. Also in Bristol, Ross has taken on a very over-grown allotment.

programme.title: Daresbury
programme.desc: The team are in Daresbury in Chester with downsizers, Karen and Alan. The couple have a small, wedge-shaped garden with so little in it that the only thing to look at is the fences, but those fences don't even provide privacy from the neighbours.

programme.title: St Ives
programme.desc: The team visit Bernadette, a dedicated social worker for troubled adults who has always put the needs of others before her own. Having recently turned sixty, Bernadette finally wants some 'me time': a new garden could give her a well-deserved reward.

programme.title: Bristol Bradley Stoke
programme.desc: The team have an unusual challenge: to turn a long, pointed front garden into a water-saving, wildlife-friendly space. Mum Laura wants a place to encourage the bugs and creepy-crawlies that young son William loves.

programme.title: Salford
programme.desc: In Salford, the team meet Nicole, who grew up in Germany. She wants to recreate her family's German 'kleine' garden, a traditional community space divided into fruit, veg and lawn.

programme.title: Venice
programme.desc: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

programme.title: Croatia
programme.desc: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

programme.title: Greece
programme.desc: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty and the team celebrate the wonder of trees and explore the vital role they play in gardens and the wider landscape. Zoe Ball joins Toby Buckland on a visit to a tree project in North London.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is back at Longmeadow, getting stuck into more seasonal tasks. Joe Swift heads to Houghton Lodge Gardens in Hampshire renowned for its walled kitchen garden and heritage fruit collection.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is preparing for spring colour as well as harvesting pumpkins and squashes. Carol Klein visits comedian Joe Lycett at home, and together, they plant up a container packed with layers of colourful bulbs. Toby Buckland visits Sue Kent's garden near Swansea to help out with autumnal maintenance.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty and team share the best practical gardening advice, meet passionate plants-people up and down the country, and provide inspiration with visits to some of the UK's most remarkable gardens.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With spring just around the corner, Monty makes a start on his bog garden and demonstrates how to divide perennials and get plants for free. Rachel de Thame visits a garden in Kent, a labour of love where meticulous planning, discipline and precision have cleverly extended the season, and Arit Anderson plants up a seasonal container inspired by the colours of spring.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gets stuck into some seasonal jobs at Longmeadow. Nick Bailey heads to Bodnant Garden in north Wales to find out how the team are tackling the recent storm damage and what new planting opportunities have been created.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gets involved in more seasonal tasks at Longmeadow. Carol Klein celebrates the spring highlights at Beth Chatto's Gardens in Essex, and Toby Buckland is in Cornwall to meet a gardener who fell out of love with gardening.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Charlie Dimmock and the Rich brothers Harry and David, are in Hook, Hampshire to save young couple Cat and Joel from the garden from hell. These loved-up, newly-weds dream of a family garden for the children that they plan to have, a space full of grass and wildlife-friendly flowers, but the trouble is, all they have now is a concrete garden made up of nothing but paving stones!

programme.title: Newport Cwmcarn
programme.desc: The team tackle a vertiginous three-tiered garden. This is no simple back lawn: the garden is so steep that it rises above the roof of the house to offer fantastic views of the local forest and mountain, which the owners want to take advantage of.

programme.title: Horsham
programme.desc: The Rich brothers and Arit Anderson are on a mission to create a family garden in Horsham in Sussex for James, Charlotte and their young daughter Esmé. The trouble is, at the moment, their garden is about as exciting as a blank sheet of A4 paper.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: After an extraordinary season, Monty's orchard has a bountiful harvest of apples and he gives advice on how to pick and store them. Frances Tophill makes a final visit to her shared allotment and joins in with the festivities at their annual show. Adam Frost visits the RHS garden Wisley where he meets the Curator to discuss the effects of summer. Nick Bailey investigates knotweed, one of the most pernicious weeds in the UK, Arit Anderson provides inspiration for colourful late season containers.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As the days get shorter, it is a busy time in the garden. Monty Don cracks on with his seasonal tasks at Longmeadow, giving hints and tips along the way. Carol Klein visits first-time gardeners Dan and Dominique for the very last time.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost is at home sharing his love of ornamental grasses, tackling the problem of building a patio on a slope and giving some inspiration on what to plant at the base of a wall. In Margate, the team visit a man who has come up with a unique way of using a shed roof to grow vegetables, and they travel to Swansea to meet inspirational gardener Sue Kent, who shows how she has designed her garden to enable her to garden successfully despite her upper limb difference.

programme.title: Leyton
programme.desc: In Leyton, Tariq and Sairah want to turn their dumping ground of a backyard into a sumptuous award-winning garden, suitable for entertaining friends and family. Both have competitive jobs in the banking sector and are used to winning at work but when it comes to gardening, they don't know where to begin.

programme.title: Cadeby and Sussex
programme.desc: One couple battle to turn a clay-clogged building site in Sussex into a piece of Portugal. Another tackle a forest of overgrowth in their new back garden in Cadeby. They are determined to create a productive space, something they have always wanted.

programme.title: Wakefield and Swindon
programme.desc: A truck driver from Wakefield with a passion for flowers wants to create a perfect outside space for his girlfriend and burgeoning family, while in Swindon a widow wants to find the best way of turning her bleak patch of green into a cottage garden.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels from the north-west coast of Scotland to the north-east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of London's gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored garden close to where he grew up in Hampshire.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the south-west of the country to visit some of Britain's most exotic gardens. On this journey, Monty also goes to some of the country's most historic gardens, as well as some challenging contemporary ones.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty continues planting up perennials in his recently extended orchard beds and begins a redesign in the dry garden. Toby Buckland explores the impressive collection of heritage daffodils at Cotehele in Cornwall.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: It's the Easter bank holiday, and at Longmeadow, Monty turns his attention to planting up his new bog garden, sows cucumber and melon seeds and continues with changes to the dry garden. Adam Frost heads to a beautiful walled garden that is both ornamental and productive in West Sussex. It's the first visit of the year to Sue Kent's garden near Swansea as she reveals news about an exciting new project.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty continues his revamp of the dry garden, repots succulents and plants up a window box, while Frances Tophill visits a north London garden which has sustainable produce at its core.

programme.title: The Big Skid

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: Lisa Kelly and Steph Custance team up for a challenging passage on the icy terrain; Art Burke brings a split load into the north country, hoping this will be his last load of the year; Todd Dewey hauls a double oversized camp shack.

programme.desc: When a Turkish activist ignites protests in the U.S., Turkey's president demands his extradition.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: While on a secret mission to Afghanistan, President Kirkman meets with two infamous warlords.

programme.title: Three-Letter Day
programme.desc: Emily, Seth, Aaron, Llyor and Kendra join forces to get answers and possibly save a life.

programme.title: Line of Fire
programme.desc: Kirkman is alerted to a group who refuse to evacuate when a forest fire threatens to engulf their cabin.

programme.title: Grief
programme.desc: It's been ten weeks since his wife died, and President Kirkman's senior staff insist he seek professional help

programme.title: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: A missile meant to bring water to astronauts in space is hacked. Kirkman must work with Russia to save lives.

programme.title: Original Sin
programme.desc: When a video of the president visiting prison leaks to the media, his team works to minimize the fallout.

programme.title: In the Dark
programme.desc: When a blackout threatens to shut down the government, President Kirkman joins forces with the D.C. mayor.

programme.title: Summit
programme.desc: As tensions between East and West Hanchu escalate, Kirkman travels to Camp David to broker a peace treaty.

programme.title: Fallout
programme.desc: President Kirkman and his staff have credible intelligence that a dirty bomb is on U.S. soil.

programme.title: Overkill

programme.title: Kirkman Agonistes
programme.desc: More content from President Kirkman's confidential therapy sessions leaks out.

programme.title: Capacity
programme.desc: Attorney Ethan West calls on President Kirkman's closest advisors and staff as he begins his investigation

programme.title: Bad Reception
programme.desc: President Kirkman negotiates with a foreign government to release an American held overseas.

programme.title: Target
programme.desc: White House Council Kendra Daynes finds herself in danger, putting another White House staffer's life at risk.

programme.title: Run
programme.desc: A natural disaster threatens the lives of two staffers. The president makes an announcement no one saw coming.

programme.title: #thesystemisbroken
programme.desc: Now running for office for the first time, Kirkman and his nascent campaign stumble out of the gate.

programme.desc: A heated debate over child marriage roils Kirkman's staff; Opioid addiction hits home for Mars.

programme.title: #privacyplease
programme.desc: A political attack on Kirkman puts transgender rights in the spotlight; Aaron weighs a major decision.

programme.title: #makehistory
programme.desc: Aaron's heritage and a widespread teachers' strike become polarizing issues.

programme.title: #nothingpersonal
programme.desc: Emotions run high after a despicable news story goes viral. Wells finds a clue pointing to conspiracy.

programme.title: #whocares

programme.title: #identity/crisis
programme.desc: A stray Russian bomber jeopardizes Seattle, Mars crusades against a drug company.

programme.title: #scaredsh*tless
programme.desc: Kirkman mobilizes a frantic hunt for the bioterrorist.

programme.title: #undecided

programme.title: #truthorconsequences

programme.title: Pilot
programme.desc: Tom Kirkman is a lower-level cabinet member who is suddenly appointed President of the United States.

programme.title: The First Day
programme.desc: Hours after the attack, President Kirkman steps into his role as Commander-in-Chief in the midst of chaos.

programme.desc: President Kirkman and his staff work to keep a high-level security breach of the White House a secret.

programme.title: The Enemy
programme.desc: Kirkman learns who is behind the attack and grapples with the prospect of war and brewing domestic troubles.

programme.title: The Mission
programme.desc: Kirkman makes the difficult decision of sending Navy SEALs on a mission that will define his presidency.

programme.title: The Interrogation

programme.title: Galapagos, Part Two: Striped Marlin, Grouper and Snapper with Pete Santini
programme.desc: On this second part of Peter's Galapagos Islands adventure, he breaks out the fly rod for a giant striped marlin and has partner Pete Santini of Sport Fish Galapagos join him for a few extra large striped marlin.

programme.title: Proven Off-Road with Yamaha
programme.desc: From behind-the-scenes insight with the testers who develop Yamaha Side-by-Sides and ATVs, to professional racers.

programme.title: Fairways of Life
programme.desc: The award-winning Fairways of Life show is the largest and the most widely distributed live golf television program in the world. It is hosted by multiple-time NY Times Best Selling author and NBC/Golf Channel's Matt Adams every week and is an...

programme.title: Pursuit Channel Presents: Dakota Sportsman TV 11/02/26
programme.desc: Pursuit Channel Presents: Dakota Sportsman TV 11/02/26.

programme.title: Deer Camp 2025-2
programme.desc: Long-time repeat client and friend Davis heads up to Canadian whitetail Outfitters for a chance encounter with a known buck.

programme.title: From Bowfishing to the Big Stage
programme.desc: In this episode, Rock and the OTR crew take Rascal Flatts lead singer Gary LeVox out on the water for an epic day of bow fishing before his big concert! They share plenty of laughs and Cajun hospitality.

programme.title: BAM Pro Tour Championship - The Battle for the TOC Title! Cal Delta Championship Bass Tournament
programme.desc: Watch the 1 hour show BAM Pro Tour Bass Tournament Championship on the California Delta The 2024 BAM Pro Tour Tournament of Champions (TOC)-sponsored by Bass Boat Technologies and presented by Tackle Warehouse the City of Oakley.

programme.title: MWO Ep. 2123
programme.desc: Andrew Ragas and Larry Ladowski are catching smallies in northern Wisconsin; and we're hunting does to donate to local food pantries!

programme.title: Down to the Wire: Kenny's Make-or-Break Mountain Elk Hunt
programme.desc: Kenny faces one of his biggest challenges yet as he navigates Colorado's unforgiving mountain terrain on the final day of his elk hunt. With two consecutive archery elk tags already filled, he's determined to make it happen for a third success.

programme.title: No Guarantees with LiveScope
programme.desc: Just because you have the greatest invention in fishing doesn't always guarantee success. G3 Sportsman Scott Turnage and Westin Yancey throw everything but the kitchen sink at the crappie.

programme.title: Deer Hunting at the Rockin U
programme.desc: The best whitetail deer hunting stories from across the nation; incorporating product features, up-close encounters, storytelling, insight about management, as well as tactics to both entertain and educate even the most seasoned whitetail hunter.

programme.title: Hunting Black Roe Deer In Germany
programme.desc: Mark Peterson ventures into the heart of Germany's forests in pursuit of a Black Roe Deer, one of Europe's most coveted trophies. Known for their striking dark coat and exceptional wariness, these animals present a unique challenge even for...

programme.title: Redfishing Grand Isle Part 1
programme.desc: This week, we're having fun in the sun with our friends from Garmin as we travel to Grand Isle, Louisiana, to debut the latest and greatest Garmin gear, and go to battle with some of the strongest, savviest fish in the sea!

programme.title: Virginia Deer and Dove
programme.desc: Kip and the kids have an epic dove hunt, and Kat takes her biggest buck with a bow on opening day. Meanwhile, across the mountain, their producer, Ryan, is chasing some great bucks with his bow.

programme.title: Horse-Sized Duck
programme.desc: Join The Fish Guyz! Captain Lain Goodwin, Earl Byrd III, and an eclectic crew of local legends showcase the best fishing and tourism the Conch Republic offers. Professional chef Cat Pfeiffer demystifies seafood with simple recipes made for home kitchens.

programme.title: Bearclaw Lodge
programme.desc: Bearclaw Lodge in Alaska's Bristol Bay is a full-service lodge on the edge of the Wood-Tikchik State Park, the largest State Park in the United States. Get ready for salmon, trout, char and grayling.

programme.title: The Lure Mechanic
programme.desc: CA is joined by Zman lure designer Jose Chavez for some field-testing on the west central coast of Fl.

programme.title: National Championship - Jacksonville, Florida
programme.desc: The 2025 Elite Fishing Series National Championship takes over Jacksonville, Florida, as the best from the East face off against the best from the West for redfish supremacy. After a full season of competition across both coasts, the top anglers...

programme.title: Crystal Coast Redfishing
programme.desc: Nick visits the Crystal Coast of North Carolina to search out redfish and sea trout in the backwaters with Capt. Joe Tunstall and Capt. Chris Kinney.

programme.title: Alpena Coast
programme.desc: John Bergsma showcases fishing hot spots in the Great Lakes region.

programme.title: Sails in El Salvador
programme.desc: Capts. Rick and Ridge Murphy venture south to Casa del Golfo in El Salvador in pursuit of sailfish in the Pacific.

programme.title: HUB CAP CRAPPIE
programme.desc: This episode takes the crew to Lake Fork in Texas. Known for its great bass fishing, Mark and Xavier will be looking to catch some giant crappie. Mark met Xavier at the Crappie Classic through a mutual relationship they hold with Jenko Fishing.

programme.title: Into the Thick Stuff: Alberta Elk
programme.desc: Ryan Kohler and Gunther Tondelier head deep into Alberta's timber in search of elk. After days of hard hunting, the duo finishes strong with full freezers.

programme.title: Giving you the bird
programme.desc: Brody hunts his home state of Pennsylvania for Upland bird and Turkey.

programme.title: River Valley Buck
programme.desc: Ted takes a nice buck at SpiritWild Ranch with his Mathews bow. Plus, watch the television debut of What would Charlie Daniels do?, the new song from Ira Dean featuring Ted Nugent. This is an episode you don't want to miss!

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: New Kiwis, the Bolton family meet a cheeky puppy. Kate and Neill are ready for a new four-legged friend after a bereavement and flatmates Amanda and Rob look for a canine addition.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Single Dad Rinesh and his two girls are looking for a puppy. Newlyweds Heidi and Steve are excited to rescue a fur baby and sisters Sally and Megan met a nervous dog with a traumatic history.

programme.title: Episode 13
programme.desc: Julian faces a massive challenge trying to save one of the biggest calves he's ever had to deliver. And farmer Rob, who lost a newborn two days ago, is fearing the worst.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: A young Ewe is struggling to birth, her not so little lamb has his head stuck which puts both their lives in jeopardy. If Peter pulls him out, it could kill mum, but a caesarean will take too long for the baby. They must make a difficult decision.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Peter treats two wild owls brought into his practice. Shona rushes to the aid of a horse that has trodden on a nail. Julian has to learn sign language in order to communicate with a deaf dachshund that requires surgery.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: Near Harrogate, Julian rushes to an emergency call out to see Cheryl the cow. When Julian delves further, he discovers her conditions are rare and it's serious. Going downhill rapidly, time is of the essence. Can Julian save Cheryl's life?

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Peter is tasked with castrating an over-amorous chinchilla, and devoted owner Rodney faces putting down his much-loved sheepdog, Millie. Elsewhere in the programme is a three-foot-monitor lizard that tends to bite and not let go, and a house-trained pig that is supposed to be 'micro', but in truth she is anything but.

programme.title: A 5 Legged Lamb and Other Curious Creatures
programme.desc: Over on young vet Katy's family farm a baby has arrived that everyone is talking about. A lamb has been born with five fully-formed legs! Peter is on a wild peacock chase when young male Percy turns up on a housing estate and ruffles some feathers.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Staff tend to a poodle with a problem penis, a rabbit with an abscess, a cow with a neck wound and an overly-amorous donkey before gathering to say farewell to Sarah who is leaving to have a baby.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Peter battles to deliver lambs who are jumbled up and stuck inside their mum, and he is shocked by what he finds. Julian has to contend with an angry parrot that has escaped in the surgery. A rescue dog is attacked by another dog.

programme.title: Wetland Babies
programme.desc: This day takes place in some of the wetlands of the world with cygnets and baby crocodiles among the babies featured.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Julian battles to save a young cow who's prolapsed her uterus giving birth. Peter rushes to help a choking lamb and also meets Jemima - a little duck with a big attitude. Katy and Julian join forces to try to save a desperately ill, 6-month-old puppy.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: Can loving deaf couple Danni and Salomon break through cute cavoodle Milo's separation anxiety and will unconventional priest Steve and partner Fiona be the right match for abused border collie Bear'

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Star, a 3-legged sheep, might be given a new lease of life if Matt can fit her with a prosthetic leg. Julian meets Teddy, a 10-month-old dachshund and his owner Kerry, who believes Teddy saved her life when she went into cardiac arrest.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: The RSPCA are called to the aid of elderly crossbreed, Ben. In Lancashire, a couple must improve their living conditions or face losing their beloved Bichon Frise. We catch up with Molly. On Valentine's Day, Cardiologist Chris Linney tries to fix the tiny Terrier's broken heart. And see the incredible transformation of Zeus, a Dogue de Bordeaux is given a second chance.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Julian Norton receives an emergency call from alpaca breeder Jackie, whose prize-winning female Cinderella is having a difficult labour. Peter Wright has to castrate Larry the chinchilla who is responsible for a population explosion.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Missy the Shih tzu was surrendered with her four offspring when her owner died. She really needs some love and so does beautiful artistic Toni, who's waited 50 years to get a dog.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian gets a panic-stricken call from Alpaca farmer, Jackie Barlow. Two of her alpacas, Gavroche and Francesca, have sneaked into the barn and gorged themselves on the food stash. They're struggling to breathe, foaming at the mouth and choking. At Skeldale, Julian faces one of his toughest challenges to date - Bertram the Bloodhound has a nasty tumour, as big as an egg, above his eye.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Africa
programme.desc: We are going on safari through Africa. Catch some Jackal pups in action as they show off their best wrestling moves, be impressed at the way Gorilla babies put their own goofy spin on things.Don't miss the Cheetah cubs zipping around playing Tag.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: In this episode Peter braves the elements and heads out to pregnancy test a small herd of young cows. But the farm is on high ground and with heavy snow settling on Yorkshire's hills will winter's icy grip prevent him from getting there?

programme.title: Baby Animals From Polar Regions
programme.desc: We visit the young, hardy inhabitants of the Polar regions. A flock of zippy Dall lambs tearing around the frosty mountaintops. There's also an adorable litter of cuddly Polar Bear cubs in the north or some goofy Elephant seal pups in the south.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Inspector Helen Smith saves Turner and Hooch, two Dogue de Bordeauxs found abandoned in a garden. Inspector Becky Bedson tracks down a dog that was spotted stranded in a flood relief channel. It's a freezing day so she needs to act fast. Shih Tzu Olive was found on a building site, heavily matted and in pain. And meet Pepper, the Dalmatian stealing hearts across Merseyside.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: After enjoying a relaxing cycle into work, Julian soon faces an uphill struggle at the Thirsk practice. A Large Munsterlander has a cancerous tumour on his jaw, and another vet has already recommended having him put to sleep. Can Julian offer any hope?

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Sammy the Jack Russell has the wiggliest bum ever, and could be the perfect complement to young Alex's dry reserve. Plus, neglect victim Martin the Staffy may finally find the caring home he deserves.

programme.title: Winter On The Moors Special
programme.desc: Called out to remote farms to tend animals in labour and the sick and injured, vets Julian Norton and Peter Wright must battle the weather to treat and save patients including owls and cattle.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: A pet pig is brought to the practice to see Julian. Peter heads to see goat brothers because all isn't rosy in their garden. A German short-haired pointer requires surgery. A pregnant cow requires an emergency C-section.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Melissa is looking to begin her journey as a first-time dog owner, and carer for the elderly Jillian hopes for a furry companion who will enjoy the social side of her job.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: The Ashcroft-Schulz family are excited to adopt a rescue dog, but son Arlo is nervous. Hamilton mother of eight Jo wants a furry friend and newlyweds Hannah and Lynda meet a Swiss Shepherd.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Radio DJ Bree and her partner Sophia are looking for a bestie for their terrier, Whitney Houston. Barry and his daughter Lily are looking for a calm companion to join their family.

programme.title: More Zoo Babies
programme.desc: We are off round the planet getting face to face with zoo babies, great and small. Tiny hippos in the hippo pond, rhino calf romping around, and a roller coaster ride with a pair of baby marmosets.

programme.title: Baby Animals From North America
programme.desc: North America is the destination in this episode. Tag along with baby raccoons as they explore the woods. Have a need for speed? Then zoom along some mountain rapids with a Moose calf. And if you like non-stop action, simply hang out with baby Bears.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Will gentle giant Tessa the Bull Arab, a cruelty case rescue, find love with the Doyle family? And are newlyweds Craig and Rodney the right fit for bonded pair Zoe and Buster?

programme.title: Special On Call
programme.desc: In The Yorkshire Vet - On Call, Peter and Julian catch up with old friends and find out how they're getting on. Previously, Peter saved a bullock with pneumonia. He feared the worst but the next day the bullock was doing well and Peter was both amazed and thrilled. Now, he's back at the Greensit Brothers farm on call to yet another emergency.

programme.title: More Autumn Babies
programme.desc: Our day is being spent hanging around with more of autumn's babies. Goofy panda cubs, meerkats, and a show-off baby jaguar are some of the babies featuring this time.

programme.title: More Summer Babies
programme.desc: We are having fun in the sun with an energetic bunch of maritime babies and their families, tree topping with Koalas, and spend time with young chipmunks carving up a storm.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Matt delivers a calf, Peter removes a lump from a dog's eye, and Julian repairs a slipped patella on a cat and nips a sheep with a birth defect. Peter and Shona go 4-wheeling.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Inspector Anthony Joynes refuses to be intimidated as he rescues two dogs, one with a serious skin problem. When the owner becomes aggressive it's up to Anthony and the police to get the dogs out as safely as possible.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: In the Malawi Special, we follow Anthony and vet Riaz Rhemu as they rescue a roadside stray and go undercover to investigate the illegal puppy trade. They also help out at an open-air surgery on World Spay Day and vaccinate an astounding number of dogs against rabies.

programme.title: Extreme Heat Babies
programme.desc: Being wrapped around the Earth's belly it's no surprise that conditions in the equatorial regions are on the warm side year round. Our day this time is being spent with some wild youngsters in the hottest part of the planet. Baby elephants, monkeys and lion cubs are among some of the babies featured.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian races over to the llama trekking centre in the Dales, after one of the youngsters breaks his jaw in a freak accident. A goat with a painful foot condition is brought in to Peter. A bulldog is rushed in after eating some chewing gum.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter treats a lamb with a leg infection while Julian deals with a mysterious lump on a llama called Imposter. A greyhound with a crushed ankle receives an implant.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Julian is called out to treat two cattle from farmer Stuart Robinson's herd. Julian removes a stone from the first cow's hoof. But the second animal is a different proposition. Despite being sedated, one ton bull Merchant drags Julian around the barn. Chaos ensues as the bull simply refuses to be pulled to the ground for treatment.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: It's Autumn, and the start of what will prove to be the most punishing year of training for the students have ever faced. With places on the course more in-demand than Oxbridge, only the very best of over four thousand applicants have made it past the selection process, but now the lucky twenty-five must show they've got what it takes to go all the way.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Peter faces a late night emergency as Abbie rushes in her sheep who is pregnant with triplets. The babies aren't due for another three weeks, but Peter must act quickly. Julian is preparing for the opening of his new veterinary centre.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Peter heads to see a worried farmer whose newborn calf can't stand up. If it's a serious joint problem, as the farmer suspects, he might not make it. Julian welcomes Exotic Joe to the practice. Joe normally brings in all kinds of weird and wonderful creatures.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Greg and Allan are flat mates hoping Betty the Staffy will become their 3rd roomie, she really brings some personality to the meeting pen. And Jason falls hard for husky Lara but is the feeling mutual?

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian has a mystery to solve when he treats two pet goats that have been attacked by an unknown animal. Peter visit an old friend's farm where he meets a pig that is under the weather. One of two dogs has eaten children's vitamin pills.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Elderly Timmy, a Collie cross, is discovered in a house with a huge painful tumour on his face, but inspector Anthony Joynes refuses to give up on him. Inspector Helen Smith meets Archie, a stroppy Shih-Tzu that has become so matted, he can barely see or hear. Inspector Simon Evans pays a visit to two French Bulldog puppies, Yoda and Mogwai, that were found in Pontypool Park in Wales.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Peter turns shoemaker to try and save a lame cow. An unusual case of llama colic poses a problem for Julian, who also has a fight on his hands with Rocky the cat. A pioneering new treatment is tried at Skeldale. And a plucky parrot needs a pedicure.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Julian heads out to help a rare breed of cow named Bertha. She is a champion breeder with a troubling eye infection. Peter returns yet again to the Green's to check on one of their donkeys. It is just one of many visits Peter has made to the Greens in the 36 years he's been helping them, but will things go as routine as before?

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter Wright treats a pet sheep with flystrike, resulting in maggots living in its ear. The Huddersfield team perform spinal surgery on a French bulldog. Julian Norton meets pet pig Pumba that has hay netting tangled around its teeth.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Julian is reunited with an alpaca he delivered by C-section when she develops a mystery eye problem. A heavily pregnant ewe is rushed into the Huddersfield hospital. Peter examines his brother's terrier. Matt treats 3 marmosets.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Family of five the Bascals are looking for a new buddy for their dog, while Karina and her son Alex meet a bonded pair of Jack Russell Chihuahua brothers.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Janine and her two girls are looking for a dog to join their girl squad while the Sulinom family have been waiting over 20 years to adopt a puppy.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Lanita and her two grown-up kids meet a dog with a rough backstory, mum of five Danielle wants a furry friend to keep her company and avid cyclists Jo and Jarvie are ready to join the dog club.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Peter treats two very poorly newborn calves. Julian tires to remove a huge tumour from a sheepdog and a sparky Shetland pony gives the vets the runaround.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Southeast Asia
programme.desc: Get set to monkey around with a bunch of baby Orangutans, hanging out comes naturally. Asian Elephant calves are keen to have some good clean fun in the mud, while a rare Red Shanked Douc is ready to ride the branches and show off its tree surfing skills.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: How will flatmates Mercedes and Jason decide between exotic Catahoula pups Brynn and Bristol? And is Vada, a cattle-bull mastiff cross, the right dog for Correan and her adorable son Rocco?

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter battles to save a mum-to-be and her unborn calf. There's a 'cuteness overload' when Julian meets Finlay and his beloved hamster, Christopher Nibbles. Bella, the much-loved rescue sausage dog, needs life-saving surgery. Can Peter save her? Julian visits an old friend, Dobby the lama - but Dobby may not be so pleased to see him. Peter pops in on elderly colourful farmers the Greens.

programme.title: Zoo Babies
programme.desc: We are off to the zoo.We take a hidden camera into the den of red pandas, and then see them take their first steps. Baby bears enthrall us with their playful behavior, and baby baboons enjoy time in the water.

programme.title: Desert Babies
programme.desc: Today we visit some of the deserts and dry areas of the world. Coyote pups, meerkats, and baby bison are some of the animals that are featured.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: It's a landmark day at the hospital in Huddersfield, as Shona and the team use a new electro chemotherapy treatment on a pet pygmy goat's cancerous tumour. Peter heads into surgery with an elderly Lhasa apso who's been suffering with a painful eye problem.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Julian Norton and Peter Wright work together to try to save a working sheepdog. They are also both needed at a local farm, where a cow is in agony.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Julian operates on a French Bulldog that has injured one of his 3 legs. Matt Smith rushes to a farm to try and save a ewe and her unborn lamb. Elsewhere, Peter and Shona have some donkey work to do at the Greens' farm to solve a problem.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Julian rushes to a dramatic emergency at Jackie Barlow's alpaca farm, where a new mum desperately needs his help. But rural North Yorkshire isn't always the ideal place to drive when time is of the essence, and Julian gets stuck behind not one, but two tractors.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Peter gets an emergency call from Ivor Shaw. He's found one of his calves limping, and Peter suspects her little leg is broken. Julian is overwhelmed when 18 rats are brought onto the practice. A blind sheep and a stray dog are treated.

programme.title: More Winter Babies
programme.desc: We spend time chilling out with babies in the cold of winter. Shorter days and snow mean that the babies need their winter coats.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter treats a lamb that was born with a life-threatening cyst full of spinal fluid on its head, which will require delicate and painstaking surgery to safely remove. Julian is called out in the middle of the night to save a cow that has experienced dangerous complications while giving birth, a pig is resistant to being castrated, and a dog swallows a bottle of e-cigarette liquid.

programme.title: Spring Babies
programme.desc: The changing of seasons means changes for Earth's creatures. Spring is one of the greatest changes from the cool of winter to the blooming of the land. We spend time with the youngsters born at this time of the year. Red deer, reindeer, goats and baby lynx are among those featured.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian returns to Jacki Barlow's alpaca farm to investigate a worrying lump in the mouth of one of the animals. Peter carries out dental surgery on a Yorkshire terrier and Julian examines a pygmy-goat.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Julian is called to see cattle farmer Richard's cow, a young mum, who has a badly infected foot. Her condition is so bad that Julian may have to take drastic action... Will he be able to get mum back on her feet and reunited with her baby?

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Wendy the wallaby is struggling but can Peter to save her? Julian performs urgent surgery to save Griff the terrier. Peter's battles to save a mum-to-be and her unborn twin lambs. Julian pregnancy tests a pedigree herd which reveals Lawrence the bull might have a problem. An eye-watering test should reveal the truth.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: A 15-year old farmer's favourite calf is struggling with a suspected hernia. And, as Matt investigates Maggie's condition, all might not be as expected. Julian heads into theatre to remove one of the largest lumps his team have ever seen on a dog.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Hunky Tom Rigby meets his match in Keira the kelpie. And will this be it for serial dater Lily the pug when she meets human Lily and her family in the meeting pen?

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: It's birthing season on Jackie Barlow's alpaca farm. And after Julian turns up just in time to see one baby born, it's the cria who arrived yesterday that needs his help. Kestrel has deformed legs and he's struggling to walk, let alone run.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Peter Wright must battle a blizzard to reach a patient on a remote farm. Cynthia the pigmy goat is cute and loveable but has a problem. In an out-of-hours emergency, poorly cat Emily is unsteady on her paws, while Digz the dog is lucky to be alive after a hit-and-run. Peter is also called out to assist graduate vet Katie with an emergency caesarean.

programme.desc: Yenni exige la aprobación de su esposo para dar en adopción a su hija que tiene una grave malformación. Pedro demanda a su empleadora, quien lo incitó a masturbarse ante la cámara y luego lo despidió.

programme.title: Maestros armados; Gemelas de 17 casarse con tercero
programme.desc: Marlene aprueba que los maestros porten armas, su esposo no, ella quiere el divorcio y la custodia de su hija. Sasha pide la emancipación de sus gemelas, alega que ya no puede controlarlas.

programme.title: Niña pintora, padre abusador; ¿Qué hacemos con María desnuda?
programme.desc: Melissa es pintora y tiene nueve años, afirma que su padre la explota, quiere vivir con su abuela. Ana pide que sus cuñados se ocupen de su suegra, perdió la razón y ella no puede cuidarla.

programme.title: Me casé con suegro x papeles; Bebé muere asfixiada
programme.desc: Ana se casó con Juan, su suegro, para obtener la residencia. Además, una bebé murió ahogada por su hermana mayor. La madre culpa al padre porque, mientras ocurría la tragedia, el hombre estaba teniendo sexo con la niñera que debía cuidar a las niñas.

programme.title: Asilo de viejos gozando; Beba no quiere medula de mamá
programme.desc: Ana Lola es dueña de un asilo de ancianos donde los residentes tienen sexo unos con otros. Beba necesita un trasplante de médula ósea para sobrevivir, pero no quiere a su madre como donante.

programme.title: Mata puercos; Adicta a ser bebé
programme.desc: En casa de Yamileth inician un negocio ilegal de matar cerdos, teme que arresten a toda la familia. Laura es una mujer adulta con una extraña adicción: vivir como un bebé varias horas al día.

programme.title: Sangre de rata rejuvenece; Hijastros con sida
programme.desc: Ángela crea un tratamiento para rejuvenecer y el principal ingrediente es sangre de ratas; su arrendador la demanda. David demanda a su esposa; descubrió que los gemelos que adoptó tienen sida.

programme.title: Odio a papá por poner cuernos; Whatsapp dudoso testigo
programme.desc: Carla no soporta que su padre le fuera infiel a su madre, le exige que deje la casa y se divorcie. Nataly demanda a su hermana por acusarla falsamente de acoso sexual; quiere 50 mil dólares.

programme.title: Madre renta novio de hija; Padre gay, hermano gay
programme.desc: Lucía demanda a su madre, asegura que malgasta su herencia en pagarle a su exnovio por su compañía. Liz descubre que su padre es gay y está enamorado de su hermano adoptivo, quiere desalojarlo.

programme.title: Jailhouse Wreck
programme.desc: On his first job in a heavy wrecker since his heart attack, Ken Duperon faces a load of pipe outside a prison.

programme.title: Burning Treasure
programme.desc: A raging truck fire tests Dylan and Team Reliable, and leads to a valuable surprise in the ashes.

programme.title: Anything Can Happen

programme.title: A Load of Problems
programme.desc: Gary's team fights to upright a battered trailer; a rookie takes his first shot as lead operator on the rotator.

programme.title: Washout

programme.title: Night of the Living Dead
programme.desc: A ragtag group of Pennsylvanians barricade themselves in an old farmhouse to remain safe from a bloodthirsty, flesh-eating breed of monsters who are ravaging the East Coast of the United States.

programme.title: Season Finale
programme.desc: We look back at the best and worst experiences of the season as Bridget and Dene finally come to terms with each other.

programme.title: The Kwa-Zulu Natal Coastline
programme.desc: Bridget and Dene journey the Kwa-Zulu Natal coastline, and while Dene feels at home in the sun and surf, Bridget finds her happiness in a traditional Durban curry.

programme.title: Master Bedroom Challenge
programme.desc: Our design duos get briefed on their fourth challenge, decorating the master bedroom. They collaborate with local designers and meet with their mentors.

programme.title: Bathroom Winner
programme.desc: It is deadline day for the double bathroom challenge, Will the designers manage to finish this mammoth task in time? One duo's bathroom is seen as very controversial. Who will be crowned as the winners of challenge three by our panel of judges?

programme.title: Spare Room Winner
programme.desc: It is deadline day for the second spare room challenge, and things are tense. Will all three duos finish in time? Stay tuned to find out who will be crowned as the winners of challenge two by our panel of judges

programme.title: Bathroom Challenge
programme.desc: Our design duos get briefed on their third challenge, a double room challenge they must decorate both bathrooms. They meet with their mentors to discuss their ideas. Breaking down walls seems to be the trend for this challenge.

programme.title: Paris
programme.desc: Paris, a place where the romantics are as common as the cobblestone streets. There is a new wave of African immigrants and expats, searching for not only the creative and cultural but also the notion of identity.

programme.title: Abidjan
programme.desc: The festival of Urban Music of Anoumabo celebrates 10 years of cultural and artistic brewing, tourism, professional exchanges, training and sharing in Cote d'Ivoire's thriving capital, Abidjan.

programme.title: Lucky Dube
programme.desc: One of South Africa's most-loved reggae artists, Lucky Dube, was murdered in a botched hijacking. Crimes Uncovered delves deeper into exactly what happened on the night South Africa lost a true icon.

programme.title: Sordid Lies: The Cezanne Visser Story
programme.desc: In an enthralling tale that spans two continents Crimes Uncovered follows the story of Cezanne Visser, her partner Dirk Prinsloo and how they callously broke the law and left a trail of broken lives in their wake.

programme.title: The Rise
programme.desc: The first chapter analyses the origins of Afrobeat and its musical evolution. We dig into the history of its creation with Fela Kuti but also with the other music genres related to recent Afrobeats, such as the Nigerian Highlife of the 70s and 80s.

programme.title: The Takeover
programme.desc: Afrobeats continues to grow whilst having a huge influence on pop culture. African superstars now regularly sell out concerts overseas and receive airplay on platforms around the world.

programme.title: Italian Cuisine
programme.desc: Di italiani sono famosi per il loro cibo. And while that may have you lost in translation, it doesn't take a linguist to enjoy linguine, as we dine on some irresistible Italian cuisine.

programme.title: Dancing & Dishes
programme.desc: Janez may not be the greatest dancer, but these Latin American dishes are sure to get your hips moving!

programme.title: Asian Food In Jozi
programme.desc: This week Janez and Amanda traverse through Jozi looking for the spots with the best Asian food.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Along the banks of the Mighty Zambezi River, lies The Lower Zambezi National Park. A poignant tale emerges, as ecologist David Ngwenyama goes on a mission to preserve this wild haven from the biggest threat in its history.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: A riveting episode of how Lower Zambezi, came into being, and a relentless quest to protect this unique and fragile ecosystem.

programme.title: Eno Inwek
programme.desc: Africa's funniest stand-up comedians are featured onstage and on location in this laugh-a-minute series. See Eno Inwek represent Nigerian humor like never before!

programme.title: Edwin Okong'o
programme.desc: Africa's funniest stand-up comedians are featured onstage and on location in this laugh-a-minute series. Check out a day in the life of Kenya funny man Edwin Okong'o.

programme.title: Married to a Baller
programme.desc: In this captivating urban faith stage play, a woman is married to a pro football player who is suddenly injured. Broken in both body and spirit, he hits rock bottom, but his nurse tries to bring him back to the man he was.

programme.title: Kevin Hart: Standing Tall
